examples.english: Standing atop the mountain, the child watched the birds soar and felt filled with longing.

english: to leap; make a giant leap
semanticNote: Almost always figurative — major leap forward in development, technology, knowledge. 飛躍式發展 (leapfrog development). Aspirational, often in contexts of progress.

examples.chinese: 這項技術是科學的重大飛躍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù shì kēxué de zhòngdà fēiyuè.
examples.english: This technology is a major scientific leap.

examples.chinese: 他的跳遠成績在這一季有了驚人的飛躍，打破了校際紀錄。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tiàoyuǎn chéngjī zài zhè yī jì yǒule jīngrén de fēiyuè, dǎpòle xiàojì jìlù.
examples.english: His long jump performance made an astonishing leap this season, breaking the inter-school record.

semanticNote: Illegal — unambiguous legal status. 非法行為 (illegal acts), 非法移民 (illegal immigrants). Pair with 合法 (legal). Strict legal/news register.

examples.chinese: 未經許可使用這些圖片是非法的。
examples.pinyin: Wèi jīng xǔkě shǐyòng zhèxiē túpiàn shì fēifǎ de.
examples.english: Using these images without permission is illegal.

examples.chinese: 政府展開大規模行動，掃蕩非法賭場。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhǎnkāi dà guīmó xíngdòng, sǎodàng fēifǎ dǔchǎng.
examples.english: The government launched a large-scale operation to crack down on illegal gambling establishments.

semanticNote: Fertile soil. 肥沃的土地 (fertile land). Agricultural and geographic vocabulary. Pair with 貧瘠 (barren).

examples.chinese: 這片土地非常肥沃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì fēicháng féiwò.
examples.english: This land is very fertile.

examples.chinese: 臺灣西部平原土質肥沃，是重要的農業生產地。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xībù píngyuán tǔzhì féiwò, shì zhòngyào de nóngyè shēngchǎn dì.
examples.english: The western plains of Taiwan have fertile soil and are an important agricultural production area.

semanticNote: Verbal slander / defamation. 誹謗罪 (defamation as a crime). Legal/strong word — implies serious damage to someone's reputation. Compare to 中傷 (slander, similar) and 造謠 (spread rumors).

examples.chinese: 他控告對方誹謗。
examples.pinyin: Tā kònggào duìfāng fěibàng.
examples.english: He sued the other party for defamation.

examples.chinese: 在網路上散布不實言論誹謗他人，可能面臨刑事訴追。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng sànbù bùshí yánlùn fěibàng tārén, kěnéng miànlín xíngshì sùzhuī.
examples.english: Spreading false statements online to slander others may result in criminal prosecution.

semanticNote: Lung. 肺癌 (lung cancer), 肺炎 (pneumonia — also COVID-related: 新冠肺炎). Anatomy word.

examples.chinese: 抽煙對肺很不好。
examples.pinyin: Chōuyān duì fèi hěn bù hǎo.
examples.english: Smoking is very bad for the lungs.

examples.chinese: 空氣污染會損害肺部健康，長期下來可能導致慢性疾病。
examples.pinyin: Kōngqì wūrǎn huì sǔnhài fèibù jiànkāng, chángqī xiàlái kěnéng dǎozhì mànxìng jíbìng.
examples.english: Air pollution can damage lung health and may lead to chronic diseases over time.

semanticNote: To formally abolish — laws, systems, treaties. 廢除奴隸制 (abolish slavery), 廢除死刑 (abolish the death penalty). Strong, formal word for legal/institutional change.

examples.chinese: 很多國家已經廢除了死刑。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō guójiā yǐjīng fèichúle sǐxíng.
examples.english: Many countries have abolished the death penalty.

examples.chinese: 公司決定廢除績效獎金制度，改以員工股票選擇權取代。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng fèichú jìxiào jiǎngjīn zhìdù, gǎi yǐ yuángōng gǔpiào xuǎnzéquán qǔdài.
examples.english: The company decided to abolish the performance bonus system and replace it with employee stock options.

english: to forget sleep and food (idiom: utterly absorbed)
semanticNote: Literally 'abandon sleep, forget food' — used to praise dedication and focus when someone is utterly absorbed in work or study. 廢寢忘食地工作 (work to the point of forgetting to eat or sleep). Often admiring.

examples.chinese: 他廢寢忘食地寫小說。
examples.pinyin: Tā fèiqǐnwàngshí de xiě xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: He wrote his novel forgetting to eat or sleep.

examples.chinese: 研究人員廢寢忘食地投入實驗，終於在截止日前完成論文。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán fèiqǐn-wàngshí de tóurù shíyàn, zhōngyú zài jiézhǐ rì qián wánchéng lùnwén.
examples.english: The researchers worked day and night on their experiments and finally completed their paper before the deadline.

semanticNote: Ruins of buildings — after war, disaster, time. 城市的廢墟 (city ruins), 廢墟中重建 (rebuild from the ruins). Often appears in disaster news and historical writing.

examples.chinese: 地震後,小鎮成了廢墟。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu, xiǎo zhèn chéngle fèixū.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the town became ruins.

examples.chinese: 考古學家在廢墟中挖掘出數百件珍貴文物。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔxuéjiā zài fèixū zhōng wājué chū shùbǎi jiàn zhēnguì wénwù.
examples.english: Archaeologists excavated hundreds of precious artifacts from the ruins.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) literal boiling — 水沸騰了 (water is boiling); (2) figurative — emotions/crowd boiling over: 群情沸騰 (the crowd is in an uproar), 熱血沸騰 (blood boiling with passion). Vivid metaphor.

examples.chinese: 觀眾熱情沸騰。
examples.pinyin: Guānzhòng rèqíng fèiténg.
examples.english: The audience boiled with excitement.

examples.chinese: 水在攝氏一百度時開始沸騰，這是基本的物理常識。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ zài shèshì yībǎi dù shí kāishǐ fèiténg, zhè shì jīběn de wùlǐ chángshí.
examples.english: Water begins to boil at 100 degrees Celsius — this is basic physics knowledge.

semanticNote: To distinguish between similar things. 分辨真假 (tell real from fake), 分辨方向 (figure out direction). Compare to 區分 (distinguish, similar) and 識別 (identify).

examples.chinese: 我分辨不出他們兩個誰是誰。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fēnbiàn bù chū tāmen liǎng ge shéi shì shéi.
examples.english: I can't tell which of the two is which.

examples.chinese: 這款軟體能精準分辨聲音，判斷說話者的情緒狀態。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎntǐ néng jīngzhǔn fēnbiàn shēngyīn, pànduàn shuōhuàzhě de qíngxù zhuàngtài.
examples.english: This software can accurately distinguish voices and determine the speaker's emotional state.

semanticNote: Knowing proper limits in speech and action. 有分寸 (knows when to hold back), 沒分寸 (no sense of limits / inappropriate). Important social-skill word — Chinese culture highly values knowing 分寸. 把握分寸 = strike the right balance.

examples.chinese: 開玩笑要有分寸。
examples.pinyin: Kāi wánxiào yào yǒu fēncun.
examples.english: You need to know your limits when joking.

examples.chinese: 他說話不知分寸，常常在不合適的場合說出令人尷尬的話。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà bù zhī fēncun, chángcháng zài bù héshì de chǎnghé shuōchū lìng rén gāngà de huà.
examples.english: He doesn't know when to draw the line with his words and often says embarrassing things in inappropriate situations.

semanticNote: Profit-sharing — year-end employee bonuses, stockholder dividends. 年終分紅 (year-end bonus). Common business and personal finance vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 公司每年都給員工分紅。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měi nián dōu gěi yuángōng fēnhóng.
examples.english: The company gives employees bonuses every year.

examples.chinese: 年終分紅是許多企業留住優秀人才的重要激勵手段。
examples.pinyin: Niánzhōng fēnhóng shì xǔduō qǐyè liúzhù yōuxiù réncái de zhòngyào jīlì shǒuduàn.
examples.english: Year-end profit sharing is an important incentive for many companies to retain talented employees.

semanticNote: To break something into components — physical (decompose, biology/chemistry: 食物分解), mathematical (factor — 因式分解), or process (break down a complex task: 把問題分解). Scientific and analytical word.

examples.chinese: 塑膠很難自然分解。
examples.pinyin: Sùjiāo hěn nán zìrán fēnjiě.
examples.english: Plastic is hard to decompose naturally.

examples.chinese: 老師在黑板上把這道複雜的數學題逐步分解，讓學生更容易理解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng bǎ zhè dào fùzá de shùxuétí zhúbù fēnjiě, ràng xuéshēng gèng róngyì lǐjiě.
examples.english: The teacher broke down this complex math problem step by step on the blackboard, making it easier for students to understand.

semanticNote: To split apart — countries (國家分裂), families, organizations, cells (細胞分裂). 精神分裂 = schizophrenia (literally 'mind split'). Strong word implying division.

examples.chinese: 這個組織因內鬥而分裂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zǔzhī yīn nèi dòu ér fēnliè.
examples.english: This organization split due to internal disputes.

examples.chinese: 細胞分裂是生物生長和繁殖的基本過程。
examples.pinyin: Xìbāo fēnliè shì shēngwù shēngzhǎng hé fánzhí de jīběn guòchéng.
examples.english: Cell division is the fundamental process of biological growth and reproduction.

semanticNote: Biological secretion — glands, hormones. 內分泌 (endocrine), 分泌物 (secretions). Medical vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 壓力大會影響荷爾蒙的分泌。
examples.pinyin: Yālì dà huì yǐngxiǎng hé'ěrméng de fēnmì.
examples.english: High stress can affect hormone secretion.

examples.chinese: 運動時，身體會分泌大量腎上腺素，使人感到精力充沛。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng shí, shēntǐ huì fēnmì dàliàng shènshàngxiànsù, shǐ rén gǎndào jīnglì-chōngpèi.
examples.english: During exercise, the body secretes large amounts of adrenaline, making a person feel energized.

semanticNote: Clearly distinguishable / clearly so. 黑白分明 (black and white are clearly separated — used for clear moral distinctions), 分明是他做的 (it was clearly him). Used to emphasize clarity, often with a hint of accusation.

examples.chinese: 分明是你錯了,還不承認。
examples.pinyin: Fēnmíng shì nǐ cuòle, hái bù chéngrèn.
examples.english: It's clearly your mistake — you still won't admit it.

examples.chinese: 他說話愛憎分明，從不模稜兩可。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà àizēng-fēnmíng, cóng bù móléng-liǎngkě.
examples.english: He speaks with clear likes and dislikes, never ambiguous.

semanticNote: Disagreement / divergence in views. 意見分歧 (differing opinions), 解決分歧 (resolve differences). Common in diplomatic, business, and family contexts. Less harsh than 衝突 (conflict).

examples.chinese: 雙方在這個問題上有分歧。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zài zhè ge wèntí shàng yǒu fēnqí.
examples.english: The two sides have differing views on this issue.

examples.chinese: 兩黨對移民政策存在嚴重分歧，難以達成共識。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng dǎng duì yímín zhèngcè cúnzài yánzhòng fēnqí, nányǐ dáchéng gòngshí.
examples.english: The two parties have serious disagreements over immigration policy, making it difficult to reach consensus.

semanticNote: To spread out / scatter — people, attention, risk. 分散注意力 (distract / split attention), 分散風險 (diversify risk). Pair with 集中 (concentrate). Investment and management vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 投資要分散風險。
examples.pinyin: Tóuzī yào fēnsàn fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: You should diversify investment risk.

examples.chinese: 地震發生後，政府迅速將災民分散安置在各處臨時庇護所。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, zhèngfǔ xùnsù jiāng zāimín fēnsàn ānzhì zài gèchù línshí bìhùsuǒ.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the government quickly dispersed and resettled the disaster victims in various temporary shelters.

semanticNote: To give instructions to someone — usually elder/superior to junior/subordinate. 媽媽吩咐我去買東西 (mom told me to go buy things). Slightly hierarchical. 有事吩咐 = let me know if you need anything (polite, often spoken to elders).

examples.chinese: 我會按您的吩咐去做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì àn nín de fēnfù qù zuò.
examples.english: I'll do as you've instructed.

examples.chinese: 主廚吩咐助理提前準備好所有食材，不得有任何遺漏。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔchú fēnfù zhùlǐ tíqián zhǔnbèi hǎo suǒyǒu shícái, bùdé yǒu rènhé yílòu.
examples.english: The head chef instructed the assistant to prepare all ingredients in advance without any omission.

semanticNote: Grave/tomb. 掃墳墓 (sweep the graves — done at 清明節 Qingming Festival). Death vocabulary; often appears in solemn or literary contexts.

examples.chinese: 清明節我們去掃墳墓。
examples.pinyin: Qīngmíngjié wǒmen qù sǎo fénmù.
examples.english: On Qingming Festival we sweep the graves.

examples.chinese: 考古學家在挖掘古代墳墓時，發現了大量精美的陪葬品。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔxuéjiā zài wājué gǔdài fénmù shí, fāxiànle dàliàng jīngměi de péizàngpǐn.
examples.english: While excavating ancient tombs, archaeologists discovered a large number of exquisite burial objects.

semanticNote: Fine powder — often refers to substances ground into powder form. 藥物粉末 (medicinal powder). Science/manufacturing vocabulary. Compare to 粉 (powder, more general/everyday).

examples.chinese: 請把藥研成粉末。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yào yánchéng fěnmò.
examples.english: Please grind the medicine into powder.

examples.chinese: 咖啡豆研磨成細緻的粉末後，才能沖泡出香濃的咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi dòu yánmó chéng xìzhì de fěnmò hòu, cái néng chōngpào chū xiāngnóng de kāfēi.
examples.english: Only after coffee beans are ground into fine powder can you brew a rich, aromatic cup.

semanticNote: The color pink. 粉色衣服 (pink clothes). Modern color word. In Taiwan, 粉紅色 is more common as the standard form, but 粉色 has gained ground in recent years (especially online).

examples.chinese: 她最喜歡粉色。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì xǐhuān fěnsè.
examples.english: Her favorite color is pink.

examples.chinese: 春天盛開的櫻花一片粉色，美不勝收。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān shèngkāi de yīnghuā yī piàn fěnsè, měibù-shèngshōu.
examples.english: The cherry blossoms in full bloom in spring are a swath of pink, a beauty beyond compare.

semanticNote: To smash into tiny pieces — physical (粉碎機 = shredder/crusher) or figurative (粉碎陰謀 = smash a conspiracy, 夢想被粉碎 = dreams shattered). Strong, decisive verb.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想被現實粉碎了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng bèi xiànshí fěnsuì le.
examples.english: His dreams were shattered by reality.

examples.chinese: 工廠用專業機械將廢棄玻璃粉碎，以便回收再利用。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng yòng zhuānyè jīxiè jiāng fèiqì bōli fěnsuì, yǐbiàn huíshōu zài lìyòng.
examples.english: The factory uses specialized machinery to crush discarded glass for recycling.

semanticNote: Weight or heft — physical (這道菜分量很足 = this dish is generous in portion) or figurative (他的話很有分量 = his words carry weight). Note tone: 分 here read fèn, not fēn.

examples.chinese: 他在公司裡很有分量。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī lǐ hěn yǒu fènliàng.
examples.english: He carries a lot of weight in the company.

examples.chinese: 這道菜的分量非常足，一個人根本吃不完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de fènliàng fēicháng zú, yí ge rén gēnběn chī bù wán.
examples.english: The portion of this dish is very generous — one person simply can't finish it.

semanticNote: Strong anger — heavier than 生氣 (angry, casual). Implies righteous indignation, often public/political (民眾憤怒 = popular anger). Common in news headlines.

examples.chinese: 他憤怒地拍了拍桌子。
examples.pinyin: Tā fènnù de pāile pāi zhuōzi.
examples.english: He angrily slammed the table.

examples.chinese: 群眾對這項不公平的政策感到憤怒，紛紛走上街頭抗議。
examples.pinyin: Qúnzhòng duì zhè xiàng bù gōngpíng de zhèngcè gǎndào fènnù, fēnfēn zǒu shàng jiētóu kàngyì.
examples.english: The public was furious about this unfair policy and took to the streets in protest.

semanticNote: Used most often as a complimentary description of a curvy/well-developed feminine figure (身材豐滿). Also: full/plentiful — 內容豐滿 (rich content). Body-positive flavor when describing women.

examples.chinese: 她身材豐滿。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēncái fēngmǎn.
examples.english: She has a full figure.

examples.chinese: 作者筆下的人物個性豐滿，每位角色都有鮮明的特質。
examples.pinyin: Zuòzhě bǐ xià de rénwù gèxìng fēngmǎn, měi wèi jiǎosè dōu yǒu xiānmíng de tèzhì.
examples.english: The characters written by the author are fully fleshed out, each with distinct qualities.

semanticNote: Lavish — almost always used about food/meals. 豐盛的晚餐 (a lavish dinner), 豐盛的菜餚 (sumptuous dishes). Hospitality and celebration vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 媽媽準備了豐盛的晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma zhǔnbèile fēngshèng de wǎncān.
examples.english: Mom prepared a lavish dinner.

examples.chinese: 婚宴上菜色豐盛，共十二道佳餚，賓客大快朵頤。
examples.pinyin: Hūnyàn shàng càisè fēngshèng, gòng shí'èr dào jiāyáo, bīnkè dàkuài-duǒyí.
examples.english: The wedding banquet had a lavish spread of twelve courses, and the guests ate to their heart's content.

semanticNote: Bountiful harvest — agricultural literal sense and metaphorical (a year of professional/personal achievement: 大豐收 = a great harvest of accomplishments). Positive, celebratory word.

examples.chinese: 今年水稻大豐收。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián shuǐdào dà fēngshōu.
examples.english: This year's rice harvest was bountiful.

examples.chinese: 農民慶祝豐收，臉上洋溢著收穫的喜悅。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín qìngzhù fēngshōu, liǎn shàng yángyìzhe shōuhuò de xǐyuè.
examples.english: The farmers celebrated the bumper harvest, their faces beaming with the joy of the harvest.

semanticNote: Storm — literal weather (沙塵暴 = sandstorm) or figurative (政治風暴 = political storm, 金融風暴 = financial crisis). Often dramatic and news-flavored.

examples.chinese: 這場風暴造成了巨大的損失。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng fēngbào zàochéngle jùdà de sǔnshī.
examples.english: This storm caused huge losses.

examples.chinese: 金融風暴席捲全球，導致數十家銀行相繼倒閉。
examples.pinyin: Jīnróng fēngbào xíjuǎn quánqiú, dǎozhì shùshí jiā yínháng xiāngjì dǎobì.
examples.english: The financial storm swept across the globe, causing dozens of banks to collapse one after another.

semanticNote: Personal bearing / refined manners. 有風度 (has class), 紳士風度 (gentlemanly demeanor). Culturally weighted compliment — implies someone who handles things with grace under pressure.

examples.chinese: 他輸了還能笑著恭喜對手,真有風度。
examples.pinyin: Tā shūle hái néng xiàozhe gōngxǐ duìshǒu, zhēn yǒu fēngdù.
examples.english: He congratulated his opponent with a smile after losing — real class.

examples.chinese: 她在接受採訪時從容優雅，展現出一位成熟女性的風度。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jiēshòu cǎifǎng shí cóngróng yōuyǎ, zhǎnxiànchū yī wèi chéngshú nǚxìng de fēngdù.
examples.english: During the interview, she was poised and elegant, displaying the bearing of a mature woman.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) noun — scenic view (自然風光 = natural scenery); (2) adjective — having a glorious/proud moment (他真風光 = he really had his moment). The 'glorious moment' sense often carries a slight ironic or fleeting flavor.

examples.chinese: 這裡的自然風光非常美麗。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de zìrán fēngguāng fēicháng měilì.
examples.english: The natural scenery here is beautiful.

examples.chinese: 他如今事業有成，風光無限，和十年前的窘境相比判若雲泥。
examples.pinyin: Tā rújīn shìyè yǒuchéng, fēngguāng wúxiàn, hé shí nián qián de jiǒngjìng xiāngbǐ pànruò-yúnní.
examples.english: Today he's highly successful and in the spotlight — a world apart from the difficult situation ten years ago.

semanticNote: The prevailing social atmosphere or common practice in a group/society. 社會風氣 (social atmosphere/morals), 公司風氣 (company culture). Often used in moral or critical discussions.

examples.chinese: 我們應該營造良好的社會風氣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi yíngzào liánghǎo de shèhuì fēngqì.
examples.english: We should foster a good social atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 辦公室裡形成了互助合作的風氣，員工之間的關係非常融洽。
examples.pinyin: Bàngōngshì lǐ xíngchéngle hùzhù hézuò de fēngqì, yuángōng zhījiān de guānxì fēicháng rónghé.
examples.english: The office has developed a spirit of mutual cooperation, and the relationships among employees are very harmonious.

semanticNote: Witty in a refined, charming way — often used about a person's conversational style. 風趣的人 (a witty person), 說話很風趣 (speaks wittily). Compliment with sophistication.

examples.chinese: 他說話很風趣,逗得大家笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn fēngqù, dòu de dàjiā xiào.
examples.english: He talks wittily and gets everyone laughing.

examples.chinese: 這位老師講課風趣幽默，深受學生喜愛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī jiǎngkè fēngqù yōumò, shēn shòu xuéshēng xǐ'ài.
examples.english: This teacher's lectures are witty and humorous, much loved by students.

semanticNote: The local environment, culture, and people of a place. 了解當地的風土人情 (understand the local customs). Travel and ethnographic vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡了解各地的風土人情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān liǎojiě gèdì de fēngtǔrénqíng.
examples.english: I enjoy learning about local customs and culture.

examples.chinese: 旅行的意義不只是看風景，更是深入體驗當地的風土人情。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de yìyì bù zhǐ shì kàn fēngjǐng, gèng shì shēnrù tǐyàn dāngdì de fēngtǔ-rénqíng.
examples.english: The meaning of travel is not just to see scenery, but to deeply experience local customs and conditions.

semanticNote: Distinctive flavor — usually food (台灣風味 = Taiwanese flavor) or style (異國風味 = exotic flavor). Restaurant menus and cultural descriptions love this word.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳有正宗的四川風味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yǒu zhèngzōng de Sìchuān fēngwèi.
examples.english: This restaurant has authentic Sichuan flavor.

examples.chinese: 原住民族的傳統料理帶有獨特的山地風味，令人回味無窮。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhùmínzú de chuántǒng liàolǐ dài yǒu dútè de shāndì fēngwèi, lìng rén huíwèi-wúqióng.
examples.english: Traditional indigenous cuisine has a unique mountain flavor that leaves a lasting impression.

semanticNote: To close off — physical (封閉道路 = close a road) or figurative (封閉的社會 = closed/insular society, 性格封閉 = closed-off personality). Negative when figurative — implies isolation.

examples.chinese: 這條路因施工封閉了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yīn shīgōng fēngbì le.
examples.english: This road is closed for construction.

examples.chinese: 他長期處於封閉的環境中，缺乏與外界的接觸，性格變得內向。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángqī chǔyú fēngbì de huánjìng zhōng, quēfá yǔ wàijiè de jiēchù, xìnggé biànde nèixiàng.
examples.english: He spent a long time in a closed environment with little contact with the outside world, and his personality became introverted.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) historical — feudal society (封建社會); (2) figurative criticism of outdated thinking (思想很封建 = old-fashioned/backward views, especially about gender, family, marriage). The figurative critical sense is very common.

examples.chinese: 他的觀念太封建了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de guānniàn tài fēngjiàn le.
examples.english: His views are too old-fashioned.

examples.chinese: 中國的封建社會持續了兩千年，直到清朝末年才走向終結。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de fēngjiàn shèhuì chíxùle liǎng qiān nián, zhídào Qīngcháo mònián cái zǒuxiàng zhōngjié.
examples.english: China's feudal society lasted two thousand years, only coming to an end at the close of the Qing Dynasty.

semanticNote: To blockade — borders, areas, information. 經濟封鎖 (economic blockade), 信息封鎖 (information blackout). Military and political vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 政府對該國實施經濟封鎖。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ duì gāi guó shíshī jīngjì fēngsuǒ.
examples.english: The government imposed an economic blockade on that country.

examples.chinese: 警方迅速封鎖現場，禁止閒雜人員進入案發地點。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng xùnsù fēngsuǒ xiànchǎng, jìnzhǐ xiánzá rényuán jìnrù àn fā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Police quickly sealed off the scene, prohibiting unauthorized personnel from entering the crime location.

semanticNote: Sharp — blades (鋒利的刀 = sharp knife) or figurative (鋒利的言辭 = sharp/incisive words). Compare to 尖銳 (sharp/pointed, often more abstract).

examples.chinese: 這把刀非常鋒利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo fēicháng fēnglì.
examples.english: This knife is very sharp.

examples.chinese: 她的批評言辭鋒利，一針見血地指出了問題的核心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pīpíng yáncí fēnglì, yīzhēn-jiànxuè de zhǐchūle wèntí de héxīn.
examples.english: Her criticism was sharp and pointed, hitting the nail on the head in identifying the core of the problem.

semanticNote: To encounter / coincide with — usually appears in compounds: 每逢 (whenever, e.g., 每逢佳節 = whenever a holiday comes), 重逢 (meet again after long separation). Slightly literary.

examples.chinese: 每逢過年,大家都會回家。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng guònián, dàjiā dōu huì huí jiā.
examples.english: Every year at New Year, everyone goes home.

examples.chinese: 逢年過節，這條老街總是人山人海，熱鬧非凡。
examples.pinyin: Féng nián guò jié, zhè tiáo lǎo jiē zǒngshì rénshān-rénhǎi, rènào fēifán.
examples.english: Whenever there's a holiday, this old street is always packed with people, lively beyond description.

semanticNote: To dedicate selflessly — life, talent, time to a cause/people. 奉獻精神 (spirit of dedication). High moral register, often used about teachers, doctors, soldiers, religious figures.

examples.chinese: 她把一生奉獻給了教育事業。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yìshēng fèngxiàn gěile jiàoyù shìyè.
examples.english: She dedicated her whole life to education.

examples.chinese: 志工們默默奉獻，為社區提供了許多無償服務。
examples.pinyin: Zhìgōngmen mòmò fèngxiàn, wèi shèqū tígōngle xǔduō wúcháng fúwù.
examples.english: The volunteers quietly dedicated themselves, providing many free services to the community.

semanticNote: To formally veto or reject a proposal/motion. 否決權 (veto power), 否決提案 (reject a proposal). Political, legislative, board-meeting vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 董事會否決了這個提案。
examples.pinyin: Dǒngshìhuì fǒujuéle zhè ge tí'àn.
examples.english: The board vetoed this proposal.

examples.chinese: 法案在國會審議中被否決，提案人表示將重新修改後再提交。
examples.pinyin: Fǎ'àn zài guóhuì shěnyì zhōng bèi fǒujué, tí'àn rén biǎoshì jiāng chóngxīn xiūgǎi hòu zài tíjiāo.
examples.english: The bill was rejected during parliamentary review, and the proposer said they would revise and resubmit it.

semanticNote: A married couple. 老夫婦 (elderly couple). Slightly more formal than 夫妻 (also 'husband and wife'). Both work; 夫婦 has slight literary flavor.

examples.chinese: 那對夫婦很恩愛。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì fūfù hěn ēn'ài.
examples.english: That couple is very loving.

examples.chinese: 這對白頭偕老的夫婦攜手走過了六十年，令人羨慕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì báitóu-xiélǎo de fūfù xiéshǒu zǒuguòle liùshí nián, lìng rén xiànmù.
examples.english: This couple who have grown old together have walked hand in hand for sixty years, which everyone envies.

semanticNote: Formal address for a married woman / 'Mrs.' Used for someone's wife in formal/diplomatic contexts: 第一夫人 (First Lady), 王夫人 (Mrs. Wang). Respectful and formal.

examples.chinese: 請問夫人有什麼吩咐?
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn fūrén yǒu shénme fēnfù?
examples.english: May I ask, madam, do you have any instructions?

examples.chinese: 外交官夫人代表政府出席了歡迎晚宴。
examples.pinyin: Wàijiāoguān fūrén dàibiǎo zhèngfǔ chūxíle huānyíng wǎnyàn.
examples.english: The diplomat's wife attended the welcome banquet on behalf of the government.

english: to handle perfunctorily; go through the motions
semanticNote: To handle something half-heartedly just to get by, without sincerity. 敷衍了事 (just go through the motions). Negative — implies lack of effort or care. Common in workplace and relationship complaints.

examples.chinese: 他工作態度敷衍。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tàidù fūyǎn.
examples.english: His work attitude is perfunctory.

examples.chinese: 她不喜歡敷衍了事，每一件工作都認真對待。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān fūyǎn liǎoshì, měi yī jiàn gōngzuò dōu rènzhēn duìdài.
examples.english: She doesn't like to be perfunctory about things and takes every task seriously.

semanticNote: To obey — orders, rules, leadership. 服從命令 (obey orders), 服從多數 (defer to majority). Implies submission to authority. Compare to 聽從 (listen to/follow advice, less hierarchical).

examples.chinese: 士兵必須服從上級的命令。
examples.pinyin: Shìbīng bìxū fúcóng shàngjí de mìnglìng.
examples.english: Soldiers must obey their superior's orders.

examples.chinese: 在民主社會，政府應服從民意，而非民意服從政府。
examples.pinyin: Zài mínzhǔ shèhuì, zhèngfǔ yīng fúcóng mínyì, ér fēi mínyì fúcóng zhèngfǔ.
examples.english: In a democratic society, the government should comply with the will of the people, not the other way around.

semanticNote: To be convinced of/accept someone's superiority or correctness. Often appears in negative form: 不服氣 (won't accept it / not convinced). Pride-and-defeat vocabulary — common in competitive contexts.

examples.chinese: 他輸了還是不服氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā shūle háishì bù fúqì.
examples.english: He lost but still won't accept it.

examples.chinese: 她的表現太出色了，連對手都不得不服氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoxiàn tài chūsè le, lián duìshǒu dōu bùdébù fúqì.
examples.english: Her performance was so outstanding that even her opponents couldn't help but acknowledge it.

semanticNote: Captive — military prisoner. 戰俘 = POW. As verb: to capture/take prisoner. War vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 敵軍抓了很多俘虜。
examples.pinyin: Díjūn zhuāle hěn duō fúlǔ.
examples.english: The enemy took many prisoners.

examples.chinese: 根據國際法，戰爭中的俘虜必須受到人道對待。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù guójìfǎ, zhànzhēng zhōng de fúlǔ bìxū shòudào réndào duìdài.
examples.english: Under international law, prisoners of war must be treated humanely.

semanticNote: Symbol or sign — math, language, branding, semiotics. 標點符號 (punctuation marks), 數學符號 (math symbols). Standard analytical word.

examples.chinese: 請使用正確的標點符號。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shǐyòng zhèngquè de biāodiǎn fúhào.
examples.english: Please use correct punctuation.

examples.chinese: 數學裡的加減乘除都有各自的符號，便於計算和表達。
examples.pinyin: Shùxué lǐ de jiā jiǎn chéng chú dōu yǒu gèzì de fúhào, biànyú jìsuàn hé biǎodá.
examples.english: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division all have their own symbols in math, facilitating calculation and expression.

semanticNote: Range/magnitude of change/movement. 大幅度 (large extent / by a lot), 小幅度 (small extent), 變化幅度 (range of change). Common in news about prices, temperatures, performance.

examples.chinese: 今年銷售大幅度增長。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xiāoshòu dà fúdù zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: Sales have grown substantially this year.

examples.chinese: 氣溫在短時間內大幅度驟降，讓人措手不及。
examples.pinyin: Qìwēn zài duǎn shíjiān nèi dà fúdù zhòujiàng, ràng rén cuòshǒu-bùjí.
examples.english: The temperature dropped dramatically in a short time, catching people off guard.

semanticNote: Radiation — physics, health concerns (核輻射 = nuclear radiation, 電磁輻射 = electromagnetic radiation). Modern essential vocab.

examples.chinese: 手機輻射對健康有影響嗎?
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī fúshè duì jiànkāng yǒu yǐngxiǎng ma?
examples.english: Does cell phone radiation affect health?

examples.chinese: 核電廠事故洩漏的輻射對周圍環境造成了長期影響。
examples.pinyin: Hédiànchǎng shìgù xièlòu de fúshè duì zhōuwéi huánjìng zàochéngle chángqī yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Radiation leaked from the nuclear power plant accident caused long-term effects on the surrounding environment.

semanticNote: Benefits/welfare — workplace (員工福利 = employee benefits), social (社會福利 = social welfare). Increasingly used as internet slang for unexpected perks/treats: 員工福利 = something nice the company gave us.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This company has great benefits.

examples.chinese: 政府持續提升社會福利制度，保障弱勢族群的基本生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chíxù tíshēng shèhuì fúlì zhìdù, bǎozhàng ruòshì zúqún de jīběn shēnghuó.
examples.english: The government continues to improve the social welfare system to protect the basic livelihood of vulnerable groups.

semanticNote: A blessing / having good fortune in life. 有福氣 (blessed/lucky in life), 你真有福氣 (you're so blessed — common compliment, especially to elders or new parents). Warm, traditional flavor.

examples.chinese: 奶奶說我有福氣。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō wǒ yǒu fúqì.
examples.english: Grandma says I'm blessed.

examples.chinese: 能生在和平年代，本身就是一種難得的福氣。
examples.pinyin: Néng shēng zài hépíng niándài, běnshēn jiùshì yī zhǒng nándé de fúqì.
examples.english: Being born in a time of peace is itself a rare blessing.

semanticNote: To gently stroke/caress — a child's head, a pet, a beloved object. Tender word. Compare to 摸 (touch) — 撫摸 implies gentle, prolonged, affectionate touch.

examples.chinese: 她輕輕撫摸著小貓。
examples.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng fǔmōzhe xiǎo māo.
examples.english: She gently stroked the kitten.

examples.chinese: 孩子生病時，母親輕聲安慰，溫柔地撫摸著他的額頭。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shēngbìng shí, mǔqīn qīngshēng ānwèi, wēnróu de fǔmōzhe tā de étóu.
examples.english: When the child was sick, the mother comforted him softly, gently stroking his forehead.

semanticNote: To raise children — provide for them physically and emotionally. 撫養孩子 (raise a child), 撫養費 (child support). Legal/family vocabulary. Compare to 養育 (similar, sister word).

examples.chinese: 他獨自撫養兩個孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā dúzì fǔyǎng liǎng ge háizi.
examples.english: He raises two children on his own.

examples.chinese: 祖父母替子女撫養孫子，是台灣家庭常見的現象。
examples.pinyin: Zǔfùmǔ tì zǐnǚ fǔyǎng sūnzi, shì Táiwān jiātíng chángjiàn de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Grandparents raising grandchildren for their adult children is a common phenomenon in Taiwanese families.

english: to look down at; overlook (from above)
semanticNote: To look down from above — physical perspective (從山頂俯視 = look down from the mountaintop). Pair with 仰視 (look up at). Photography, architecture, geography vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 從這裡可以俯視整個城市。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ kěyǐ fǔshì zhěng ge chéngshì.
examples.english: From here you can look down on the whole city.

examples.chinese: 雄鷹在高空中俯視獵物，準備隨時出擊。
examples.pinyin: Xióng yīng zài gāokōng zhōng fǔshì lièwù, zhǔnbèi suíshí chūjī.
examples.english: The eagle looks down from high altitude at its prey, ready to strike at any moment.

semanticNote: Supporting role — assist, supplement. 輔助工具 (auxiliary tool), 輔助學習 (aid in learning). Implies a secondary, supporting function. Compare to 幫助 (help, primary action).

examples.chinese: 這個應用程式輔助學習中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yìngyòng chéngshì fǔzhù xuéxí Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This app assists in learning Chinese.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議他在正規治療之外，採取輔助療法緩解疼痛。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā zài zhèngguī zhìliáo zhīwài, cǎiqǔ fǔzhù liáofǎ huǎnjiě téngtòng.
examples.english: The doctor suggested he adopt supplementary therapies alongside conventional treatment to relieve the pain.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) literal — rotten/spoiled food; (2) figurative — political/moral corruption. The political sense dominates: 反腐敗 (anti-corruption), 腐敗官員 (corrupt official). One of the heaviest words in modern Chinese political discourse.

examples.chinese: 政府正在嚴打腐敗。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài yán dǎ fǔbài.
examples.english: The government is cracking down on corruption.

examples.chinese: 這個官員因涉嫌腐敗被調查，最終遭到開除公職。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guānyuán yīn shèxián fǔbài bèi diàochá, zuìzhōng zāodào kāichú gōngzhí.
examples.english: This official was investigated on suspicion of corruption and ultimately dismissed from public office.

semanticNote: Physical rotting/decaying — fruit, wood, organic matter. 水果腐爛了 (the fruit has rotted). Sometimes figurative for moral decay. Visceral word.

examples.chinese: 這些蔬菜已經腐爛了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shūcài yǐjīng fǔlàn le.
examples.english: These vegetables have already rotted.

examples.chinese: 木造建築若未做好防水處理，很容易因潮濕而腐爛。
examples.pinyin: Mù zào jiànzhú ruò wèi zuòhǎo fángshuǐ chǔlǐ, hěn róngyì yīn cháoshī ér fǔlàn.
examples.english: Wooden structures that are not properly waterproofed can easily rot due to moisture.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) chemical erosion/corrosion — 腐蝕金屬 (corrode metal); (2) moral corruption — 腐蝕年輕人 (corrupt young people). Powerful figurative use.

examples.chinese: 金錢和權力會腐蝕人心。
examples.pinyin: Jīnqián hé quánlì huì fǔshí rénxīn.
examples.english: Money and power can corrupt the heart.

examples.chinese: 海水中的鹽分會腐蝕金屬，船體需要定期檢修。
examples.pinyin: Hǎishuǐ zhōng de yánfèn huì fǔshí jīnshǔ, chuántǐ xūyào dìngqī jiǎnxiū.
examples.english: Salt in seawater corrodes metal, so ships need regular maintenance.

semanticNote: Decayed/rotten — physical (rotten wood) or figurative (腐朽的制度 = a decadent system). Strong moral judgment when figurative — implies something old and morally bankrupt that needs to be replaced.

examples.chinese: 舊的制度已經腐朽了。
examples.pinyin: Jiù de zhìdù yǐjīng fǔxiǔ le.
examples.english: The old system has become decadent.

examples.chinese: 那棵老樹的樹幹已經腐朽，樹心幾乎是空的。
examples.pinyin: Nà kē lǎo shù de shùgàn yǐjīng fǔxiǔ, shùxīn jīhū shì kōng de.
examples.english: The trunk of that old tree has already rotted — the heartwood is almost hollow.

semanticNote: A burden — financial, emotional, social. 經濟負擔 (financial burden), 心理負擔 (emotional burden), 負擔不起 (can't afford). Common in everyday discussions of stress and obligations.

examples.chinese: 養孩子是一個很大的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Yǎng háizi shì yí ge hěn dà de fùdān.
examples.english: Raising kids is a big burden.

examples.chinese: 房價高漲讓許多年輕人背負沉重的房貸負擔。
examples.pinyin: Fángjià gāozhǎng ràng xǔduō niánqīngrén bēifù chénzhòng de fángdài fùdān.
examples.english: Soaring housing prices have saddled many young people with a heavy mortgage burden.

semanticNote: To agree with/echo someone without independent thought — go along with what others say. Slightly negative — implies sycophancy or lack of opinion. 隨聲附和 (echo whatever's being said).

examples.chinese: 他總是附和老闆的意見。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì fùhè lǎobǎn de yìjiàn.
examples.english: He always echoes the boss's opinions.

examples.chinese: 她沒有主見，別人說什麼，她就附和什麼，缺乏獨立思考。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhǔjiàn, biérén shuō shénme, tā jiù fùhè shénme, quēfá dúlì sīkǎo.
examples.english: She has no opinions of her own — she just agrees with whatever others say, lacking independent thinking.

semanticNote: Attachment — overwhelmingly common in email context (郵件附件 = email attachment). Also: documents accompanying a letter or proposal. Essential modern office vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 請查看郵件附件。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng chákàn yóujiàn fùjiàn.
examples.english: Please check the email attachment.

examples.chinese: 申請表格上需要附上所有必要的附件，包括身分證影本和學歷證明。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng biǎogé shàng xūyào fùshàng suǒyǒu bìyào de fùjiàn, bāokuò shēnfènzhèng yǐngběn hé xuélì zhèngmíng.
examples.english: All necessary attachments must be included with the application form, including a photocopy of your ID and academic credentials.

semanticNote: Attached/subsidiary — schools (附屬中學 = affiliated middle school, common naming for university-affiliated schools), companies (附屬公司 = subsidiary), bodies/organs. Institutional vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 這是大學的附屬中學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì dàxué de fùshǔ zhōngxué.
examples.english: This is the university-affiliated middle school.

examples.chinese: 這間公司在海外設有多個附屬機構，負責拓展當地業務。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān gōngsī zài hǎiwài shè yǒu duō ge fùshǔ jīgòu, fùzé tuòzhǎn dāngdì yèwù.
examples.english: This company has established several overseas subsidiaries responsible for expanding local business.

english: to come back to life; resurrection
semanticNote: Resurrection / coming back to life. 復活節 = Easter. Also figurative — old projects, brands, dead trends being revived: 復活了那部電視劇 (revived that TV show).

examples.chinese: 復活節是西方的重要節日。
examples.pinyin: Fùhuójié shì Xīfāng de zhòngyào jiérì.
examples.english: Easter is an important Western holiday.

examples.chinese: 瀕危的語言若沒有積極推廣，很難自然復活。
examples.pinyin: Bīnwēi de yǔyán ruò méiyǒu jījí tuīguǎng, hěn nán zìrán fùhuó.
examples.english: Endangered languages are unlikely to naturally revive without active promotion.

semanticNote: Revival/renaissance of culture, nation, economy. 文藝復興 = Renaissance (the historical European era). 民族復興 = national rejuvenation (politically loaded phrase). Grand-scale word.

examples.chinese: 傳統文化正在復興。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng wénhuà zhèngzài fùxīng.
examples.english: Traditional culture is being revived.

examples.chinese: 這場藝術復興運動帶動了本土創作的繁榮，掀起一股文化熱潮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yìshù fùxīng yùndòng dàidòngle běntǔ chuàngzuò de fánróng, xiānqǐ yī gǔ wénhuà rècháo.
examples.english: This arts revival movement spurred the flourishing of local creative works, igniting a cultural wave.

semanticNote: Two main uses: (1) prefix for second-in-command — 副總統 (vice president), 副經理 (deputy manager); (2) measure word for pairs/sets — 一副眼鏡 (a pair of glasses), 一副笑臉 (a smiling face). Very productive prefix.

examples.chinese: 他是公司的副總經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī de fù zǒngjīnglǐ.
examples.english: He's the deputy general manager of the company.

examples.chinese: 她臉上掛著一副笑容，讓人倍感親切。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎn shàng guàzhe yī fù xiàoróng, ràng rén bèi gǎn qīnqiè.
examples.english: She wore a smile on her face that made people feel immediately at ease.

semanticNote: To give/bestow — usually abstract things: rights, meaning, responsibilities. 賦予權力 (grant power), 賦予意義 (give meaning). Formal/literary register. Common in legal and philosophical writing.

examples.chinese: 法律賦予公民言論自由。
examples.pinyin: Fǎlǜ fùyǔ gōngmín yánlùn zìyóu.
examples.english: The law grants citizens freedom of speech.

examples.chinese: 這幅畫透過獨特的色彩，賦予平凡的日常生活詩意的美感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà tòuguò dútè de sècǎi, fùyǔ píngfán de rìcháng shēnghuó shīyì de měigǎn.
examples.english: Through its unique use of color, this painting bestows a poetic beauty on the ordinary details of everyday life.

semanticNote: Wealthy / prosperous — applied to families, regions, lives. 富裕的家庭 (wealthy family), 共同富裕 (common prosperity — Chinese policy buzzphrase). More substantial than 有錢 (rich, casual).

examples.chinese: 這個地區人民生活富裕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū rénmín shēnghuó fùyù.
examples.english: People in this region live prosperous lives.

examples.chinese: 她出身富裕家庭，從小衣食不愁，卻仍勤奮努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūshēn fùyù jiātíng, cóngxiǎo yī shí bù chóu, què réng qínfèn nǔlì.
examples.english: She came from a wealthy family and never worried about food or clothing growing up, yet she remained diligent and hardworking.

semanticNote: Medical term for diarrhea. More formal than 拉肚子 (have diarrhea, casual everyday). Doctor-and-pharmacy register.

examples.chinese: 他吃壞肚子,引起腹瀉。
examples.pinyin: Tā chīhuài dùzi, yǐnqǐ fùxiè.
examples.english: He ate something bad and got diarrhea.

examples.chinese: 旅遊時因不習慣當地水質而引起腹瀉，是許多人常遇到的問題。
examples.pinyin: Lǚyóu shí yīn bù xíguàn dāngdì shuǐzhì ér yǐnqǐ fùxiè, shì xǔduō rén cháng yùdào de wèntí.
examples.english: Getting diarrhea from water quality unfamiliar to the body while traveling is a common problem many people encounter.

semanticNote: To cover — physical (snow covering ground) or coverage (信號覆蓋 = signal coverage, 覆蓋率 = coverage rate). Common in news, telecom, statistics, geography.

examples.chinese: 白雪覆蓋著大地。
examples.pinyin: Báixuě fùgàizhe dàdì.
examples.english: White snow covers the earth.

examples.chinese: 政府推動5G網路建設，目標是讓訊號覆蓋全島每一個角落。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīdòng 5G wǎnglù jiànshè, mùbiāo shì ràng xùnhào fùgài quán dǎo měi yī ge jiǎoluò.
examples.english: The government is promoting 5G network construction, with the goal of covering every corner of the island with signal.

semanticNote: To improve gradually — products, methods, breeds. 品種改良 (breed improvement, agriculture), 技術改良 (technical improvements). Implies gradual refinement, not revolutionary change.

examples.chinese: 科學家改良了水稻品種。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā gǎiliángle shuǐdào pǐnzhǒng.
examples.english: Scientists improved the rice variety.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的土壤經過多年改良，現在終於適合種植蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de tǔrǎng jīngguò duō nián gǎiliáng, xiànzài zhōngyú shìhé zhòngzhí shūcài.
examples.english: After years of improvement, the soil in this region is now finally suitable for vegetable cultivation.

semanticNote: Calcium (chemistry/nutrition). 補鈣 (supplement calcium), 缺鈣 (calcium deficient). Health and dietary vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 老年人需要補充鈣。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoniánrén xūyào bǔchōng gài.
examples.english: Elderly people need to supplement calcium.

examples.chinese: 牛奶、豆腐和深色蔬菜都是天然的鈣質來源。
examples.pinyin: Niúnǎi, dòufu hé shēnsè shūcài dōu shì tiānrán de gàizhì láiyuán.
examples.english: Milk, tofu, and dark-colored vegetables are all natural sources of calcium.

semanticNote: To affix an official seal/stamp on a document. Chinese bureaucracy is heavily seal-based — 蓋章 is a regular life event (banking, contracts, government). Internet slang: 蓋章 = give your seal of approval (jokingly endorse something).

examples.chinese: 請在這裡蓋章。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ gàizhāng.
examples.english: Please stamp here.

examples.chinese: 合約需要雙方簽名並蓋章，才具有法律效力。
examples.pinyin: Hétóng xūyào shuāngfāng qiānmíng bìng gàizhāng, cái jùyǒu fǎlǜ xiàolì.
examples.english: The contract requires signatures and stamps from both parties before it carries legal force.

semanticNote: Drought/dry conditions. 嚴重乾旱 (severe drought). Climate, agriculture, news vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 今年發生了嚴重的乾旱。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián fāshēngle yánzhòng de gānhàn.
examples.english: There was a severe drought this year.

examples.chinese: 長達半年的乾旱使農作物大量枯死，農民損失慘重。
examples.pinyin: Cháng dá bàn nián de gānhàn shǐ nóngzuòwù dàliàng kūsǐ, nóngmín sǔnshī cǎnzhòng.
examples.english: A drought lasting half a year caused crops to wither and die in large numbers, and farmers suffered heavy losses.

semanticNote: To interfere/disrupt — signal, work, peace. 信號干擾 (signal interference), 干擾別人 (disturb others). Tech, communication, and everyday contexts.

examples.chinese: 請不要干擾我工作。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào gānrǎo wǒ gōngzuò.
examples.english: Please don't interrupt me while I'm working.

examples.chinese: 噪音污染嚴重干擾了周邊居民的日常生活和睡眠。
examples.pinyin: Zàoyīn wūrǎn yánzhòng gānrǎole zhōubiān jūmín de rìcháng shēnghuó hé shuìmián.
examples.english: Noise pollution has seriously disrupted the daily lives and sleep of nearby residents.

semanticNote: To meddle in someone else's affairs — often unwelcome. 干涉內政 (interfere in internal affairs — diplomatic phrase), 干涉別人的私事 (meddle in someone's private business). Negative connotation.

examples.chinese: 請不要干涉我的私生活。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào gānshè wǒ de sī shēnghuó.
examples.english: Please don't meddle in my personal life.

examples.chinese: 他國沒有權利干涉我國的內政事務。
examples.pinyin: Tā guó méiyǒu quánlì gānshè wǒ guó de nèizhèng shìwù.
examples.english: Other countries have no right to interfere in our country's internal affairs.

semanticNote: More neutral than 干涉 — government intervention, market intervention, parental intervention. 政府干預 (government intervention), 武力干預 (military intervention). Policy and analytical vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 政府不應該干預市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bù yīnggāi gānyù shìchǎng.
examples.english: The government shouldn't intervene in the market.

examples.chinese: 聯合國在衝突地區的干預行動引發了國際社會的廣泛討論。
examples.pinyin: Liánhéguó zài chōngtū dìqū de gānyù xíngdòng yǐnfāle guójì shèhuì de guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
examples.english: The United Nations' intervention in conflict regions sparked widespread discussion in the international community.

semanticNote: Awkwardness — social, situational. 尷尬的氣氛 (awkward atmosphere), 場面尷尬 (an awkward scene). Heavily used among younger speakers as the go-to word for cringey/awkward moments. The two characters look like the awkwardness they describe.

examples.chinese: 忘記了她的名字真尷尬。
examples.pinyin: Wàngjìle tā de míngzì zhēn gāngà.
examples.english: Forgetting her name was so awkward.

examples.chinese: 他在人群中大聲叫錯了陌生人的名字，當場陷入極度尷尬。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài rénqún zhōng dàshēng jiào cuòle mòshēngrén de míngzì, dāngchǎng xiànrù jídù gāngà.
examples.english: He loudly called out the wrong name to a stranger in a crowd, instantly finding himself in an extremely awkward situation.

english: sigh with emotion; be moved with mixed feelings
semanticNote: The bittersweet feeling that comes from witnessing or recalling something significant — often a mix of admiration, nostalgia, sadness, or recognition of impermanence. 感慨萬千 = overcome with emotion (lit. 'ten thousand feelings'). Not pure sadness or pure joy — it's that reflective, slightly melancholic 'what a thing time/life is' feeling. Very common in literature and personal essays. 他感慨地說... = he said with a sigh... A distinctly Chinese emotional register that's hard to translate directly.

examples.chinese: 看著孩子長大，她不禁感慨時光飛逝。
examples.pinyin: Kànzhe háizi zhǎng dà, tā bùjīn gǎnkǎi shíguāng fēishì.
examples.english: Watching her child grow up, she couldn't help sighing at how quickly time flies.

examples.chinese: 舊地重遊，讓他感慨萬千。
examples.pinyin: Jiùdì chóngyóu, ràng tā gǎnkǎi wànqiān.
examples.english: Returning to this old place, he was overcome with a flood of emotions.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) medical infection — 病毒感染 (viral infection); (2) figurative — emotionally infect/influence — 被她的熱情感染 (got infected by her enthusiasm). Both senses common.

examples.chinese: 傷口感染了。
examples.pinyin: Shāngkǒu gǎnrǎn le.
examples.english: The wound got infected.

examples.chinese: 她的快樂感染了所有人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de kuàilè gǎnrǎnle suǒyǒu rén.
examples.english: Her happiness was contagious to everyone.

semanticNote: Drive/work energy/enthusiasm for getting things done. 充滿幹勁 (full of drive), 幹勁十足 (highly motivated). Workplace and motivational vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 年輕人應該充滿幹勁。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yīnggāi chōngmǎn gànjìn.
examples.english: Young people should be full of drive.

examples.chinese: 獲得升職後，他工作起來格外有幹勁。
examples.pinyin: Huòdé shēngzhí hòu, tā gōngzuò qǐlái géwài yǒu gànjìn.
examples.english: After getting promoted, he worked with exceptional drive and energy.

semanticNote: Program / platform / overarching guidelines — political party, organization. 政治綱領 (political platform), 行動綱領 (action plan). Heavy political/organizational vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 政黨制定了新的綱領。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngdǎng zhìdìngle xīn de gānglǐng.
examples.english: The political party formulated a new platform.

examples.chinese: 這份施政綱領清楚說明了政府未來四年的主要政策方向。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn shīzhèng gānglǐng qīngchǔ shuōmíngle zhèngfǔ wèilái sì nián de zhǔyào zhèngcè fāngxiàng.
examples.english: This governing platform clearly outlines the government's main policy directions for the next four years.

semanticNote: Job position / professional post. 工作崗位 (job position), 堅守崗位 (stand by one's post). Slightly formal — implies a defined role with responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 他在這個崗位工作了十年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè ge gǎngwèi gōngzuòle shí nián.
examples.english: He's worked at this position for ten years.

examples.chinese: 緊急情況下，所有消防員必須立即返回崗位待命。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, suǒyǒu xiāofángyuán bìxū lìjí fǎnhuí gǎngwèi dàimìng.
examples.english: In an emergency, all firefighters must immediately return to their posts and stand by.

semanticNote: Port for ships. 國際港口 (international port). Geography and shipping vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 上海是一個重要的港口城市。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi shì yí ge zhòngyào de gǎngkǒu chéngshì.
examples.english: Shanghai is an important port city.

examples.chinese: 基隆港是台灣北部最重要的商業港口，每天都有大量貨輪進出。
examples.pinyin: Jīlóng gǎng shì Táiwān běibù zuì zhòngyào de shāngyè gǎngkǒu, měitiān dōu yǒu dàliàng huòlún jìnchū.
examples.english: Keelung Port is the most important commercial port in northern Taiwan, with large numbers of cargo ships entering and exiting every day.

semanticNote: Sheltered harbor/bay. Often figurative: 心靈的港灣 (a haven for the soul / emotional safe harbor). Romantic/literary use is common in songs and poetry.

examples.chinese: 家是我溫暖的港灣。
examples.pinyin: Jiā shì wǒ wēnnuǎn de gǎngwān.
examples.english: Home is my warm safe harbor.

examples.chinese: 這個小漁村依山傍海，天然港灣保護著漁船免受風浪侵擾。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo yúcūn yī shān bàng hǎi, tiānrán gǎngwān bǎohùzhe yúchuán miǎn shòu fēnglàng qīnrǎo.
examples.english: This small fishing village is nestled between mountains and sea, with a natural harbor protecting fishing boats from wind and waves.

semanticNote: Lever — physics (Archimedes), figurative leverage in business/finance (金融槓桿 = financial leverage), tools (crowbar). Modern finance has popularized the figurative sense.

examples.chinese: 投資有時需要使用財務槓桿。
examples.pinyin: Tóuzī yǒushí xūyào shǐyòng cáiwù gànggǎn.
examples.english: Investing sometimes requires using financial leverage.

examples.chinese: 他利用媒體影響力作為槓桿，成功推動了多項政策改革。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng méitǐ yǐngxiǎnglì zuòwéi gànggǎn, chénggōng tuīdòngle duō xiàng zhèngcè gǎigé.
examples.english: He used media influence as leverage to successfully push forward multiple policy reforms.

semanticNote: Superb — applied to skills, techniques, abilities. 高超的技藝 (superb skills), 醫術高超 (superb medical skills). Compliment for craft/expertise.

examples.chinese: 他的廚藝高超。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chúyì gāochāo.
examples.english: His cooking skills are superb.

examples.chinese: 這位雕塑家以高超的技藝，將一塊普通的石頭化為藝術品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi diāosùjiā yǐ gāochāo de jìyì, jiāng yī kuài pǔtōng de shítou huà wéi yìshùpǐn.
examples.english: This sculptor, with superb skill, transformed an ordinary stone into a work of art.

semanticNote: Peak/climax — story climax (故事的高潮), high tide, song chorus (歌的高潮 = the hook), revolutionary tide. Also a euphemism for sexual climax. Context disambiguates.

examples.chinese: 電影的高潮非常精彩。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng de gāocháo fēicháng jīngcǎi.
examples.english: The climax of the film was thrilling.

examples.chinese: 整場音樂會在最後一首曲目達到高潮，全場起立鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: Zhěng chǎng yīnyuèhuì zài zuìhòu yī shǒu qǔmù dádào gāocháo, quánchǎng qǐlì gǔzhǎng.
examples.english: The entire concert reached its climax at the final piece, with the whole audience standing and applauding.

semanticNote: Peak — physical (mountain peak) and figurative. 高峰時期 (peak period), 高峰會議 (summit meeting), 上下班高峰 (rush hour). Pair with 低谷 (low point/trough).

examples.chinese: 我事業正處於高峰。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyè zhèng chǔyú gāofēng.
examples.english: My career is at its peak.

examples.chinese: 下班時間是交通高峰期，路上經常大塞車。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān shíjiān shì jiāotōng gāofēng qī, lù shàng jīngcháng dà sāichē.
examples.english: Quitting time is the traffic peak period, and there are often major traffic jams.

semanticNote: Brilliantly clever — strategy, technique, person. 高明的見解 (brilliant insight), 醫術高明 (brilliant medical skill). Praise word; sometimes asked rhetorically: 你有什麼高明的辦法? (You have any brilliant ideas?).

examples.chinese: 他的見解非常高明。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiànjiě fēicháng gāomíng.
examples.english: His insights are truly brilliant.

examples.chinese: 這個外交方案看似平凡，實則高明，有效化解了雙方的對立。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wàijiāo fāng'àn kànsì píngfán, shí zé gāomíng, yǒuxiào huàjiěle shuāngfāng de duìlì.
examples.english: This diplomatic plan appeared ordinary but was actually brilliant, effectively defusing the opposition between both sides.

semanticNote: Noble in character — moral and spiritual elevation. 高尚的品格 (noble character). Reverent compliment, mostly about people's moral qualities. Compare to 崇高 (lofty, applies broadly to ideals/character).

examples.chinese: 他是一個品德高尚的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge pǐndé gāoshàng de rén.
examples.english: He's a person of noble character.

examples.chinese: 捨己為人是一種高尚的情操，值得我們學習。
examples.pinyin: Shějǐ-wèirén shì yī zhǒng gāoshàng de qíngcāo, zhídé wǒmen xuéxí.
examples.english: Self-sacrifice for others is a noble moral quality worth learning from.

semanticNote: To surge / rise rapidly — emotions, prices, tensions, demand. 物價高漲 (prices surging), 情緒高漲 (emotions running high). News and economics vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 物價高漲讓人民生活困難。
examples.pinyin: Wùjià gāozhǎng ràng rénmín shēnghuó kùnnán.
examples.english: Soaring prices make life difficult for people.

examples.chinese: 運動會前夕，選手們的士氣高漲，迫不及待想要上場競技。
examples.pinyin: Yùndònghuì qiányī, xuǎnshǒumen de shìqì gāozhǎng, pòbù-jídài xiǎng yào shàngchǎng jìngjì.
examples.english: On the eve of the sports meet, the athletes' morale was running high — they couldn't wait to compete.

semanticNote: Manuscript / draft submitted to publication. 投稿稿件 (submitted manuscript), 收稿件 (receive submissions). Writers, editors, journalists vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 編輯收到了很多稿件。
examples.pinyin: Biānjí shōudàole hěn duō gǎojiàn.
examples.english: The editor received many manuscripts.

examples.chinese: 投稿前請確認稿件符合本刊的格式要求。
examples.pinyin: Tóugǎo qián qǐng quèrèn gǎojiàn fúhé běn kān de géshì yāoqiú.
examples.english: Before submitting, please confirm that the manuscript meets the format requirements of this publication.

semanticNote: Formal farewell — politely take leave from a host or gathering. 我先告辭了 (I'll take my leave). Slightly old-fashioned/formal; more casual everyday options: 我先走了, 我得走了.

examples.chinese: 時間不早了,我先告辭了。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ xiān gàocí le.
examples.english: It's getting late — I'll take my leave.

examples.chinese: 宴會結束後，他向主人恭敬地告辭，感謝盛情款待。
examples.pinyin: Yànhuì jiéshù hòu, tā xiàng zhǔrén gōngjìng de gàocí, gǎnxiè shèngqíng kuǎndài.
examples.english: After the banquet ended, he respectfully took his leave of the host, thanking them for the warm hospitality.

semanticNote: To warn/admonish — usually elder/superior to younger/subordinate. 父親告誡兒子 (the father admonished his son). Formal and weighty. Compare to 警告 (warn, more impersonal/severe) and 提醒 (remind, gentle).

examples.chinese: 老師告誡我們要誠實。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gàojiè wǒmen yào chéngshí.
examples.english: The teacher admonished us to be honest.

examples.chinese: 父親臨終前告誡子女，做人一定要正直，不能貪心。
examples.pinyin: Fùqīn línzhōng qián gàojiè zǐnǚ, zuòrén yīdìng yào zhèngzhí, bù néng tānxīn.
examples.english: Before passing away, the father admonished his children to always be upright and never greedy.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) physical bump/lump on skin (起疙瘩 = break out in bumps); (2) figurative emotional knot — 心裡有疙瘩 (have a knot in one's heart, lingering issue between people). The figurative sense is rich and very Chinese.

examples.chinese: 我們之間還有點疙瘩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhī jiān hái yǒu diǎn gēda.
examples.english: There's still a bit of unresolved tension between us.

examples.chinese: 她的皮膚對某些化妝品過敏，一擦就起了一身疙瘩。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pífū duì mǒuxiē huāzhuāngpǐn guòmǐn, yī cā jiù qǐle yī shēn gēda.
examples.english: Her skin is allergic to certain cosmetics — as soon as she applies them, bumps break out all over.

semanticNote: Pigeon / dove. 和平鴿 (dove of peace). Also: 鴿子 became internet slang for 'someone who flakes / cancels' (放鴿子 = to stand someone up). Very common modern slang.

examples.chinese: 他又放我鴿子了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu fàng wǒ gēzi le.
examples.english: He stood me up again.

examples.chinese: 廣場上的鴿子見到遊客撒出麵包屑，一哄而上。
examples.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shàng de gēzi jiàndào yóukè sā chū miànbāo xiè, yī hōng ér shàng.
examples.english: When the pigeons in the square saw tourists scatter breadcrumbs, they swarmed in.

semanticNote: Two main uses: (1) put/place something somewhere — 把書擱在桌上 (put the book on the table); (2) set aside / shelve — 擱在一邊 (set it aside), 擱置爭議 (shelve the dispute). The 'shelve' sense is very common in workplace/diplomatic contexts.

examples.chinese: 這個項目暫時擱一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàngmù zànshí gē yíxià.
examples.english: Let's put this project on hold for now.

examples.chinese: 他把那個問題擱在心裡很久，一直想不出解決辦法。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ nàge wèntí gē zài xīn lǐ hěn jiǔ, yìzhí xiǎng bù chū jiějué bànfǎ.
examples.english: He had been keeping that problem in mind for a long time without being able to think of a solution.

semanticNote: To cut — with a blade. 割肉 (cut meat), 割傷 (cut/laceration). Modern internet slang: 割韭菜 (literally 'cut the chives' = exploit gullible investors over and over).

examples.chinese: 他不小心割傷了手。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn gēshāngle shǒu.
examples.english: He accidentally cut his hand.

examples.chinese: 農夫用鐮刀熟練地割著麥子，動作俐落。
examples.pinyin: Nóngfū yòng liándāo shúliàn de gēzhe màizi, dòngzuò lìluò.
examples.english: The farmer skillfully cut the wheat with a sickle, with nimble movements.

english: to extol; sing the praises of
semanticNote: To celebrate / sing praises of — usually grand subjects: motherland, heroes, love, virtues. 歌頌祖國 (extol the motherland). Reverent register; common in songs, poems, official speeches.

examples.chinese: 這首歌歌頌了母愛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē gēsòngle mǔ'ài.
examples.english: This song sings the praises of motherly love.

examples.chinese: 詩人以優美的文字歌頌大自然的壯闊與美麗。
examples.pinyin: Shīrén yǐ yōuměi de wénzì gēsòng dàzìrán de zhuàngkuò yǔ měilì.
examples.english: The poet praised the grandeur and beauty of nature with beautiful words.

semanticNote: Major political/social/technological revolution. 工業革命 (Industrial Revolution), 文化大革命 (Cultural Revolution), 革命家 (revolutionary). Heavy political weight in Chinese discourse.

examples.chinese: 互聯網引發了一場資訊革命。
examples.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng yǐnfāle yì chǎng zīxùn gémìng.
examples.english: The internet sparked an information revolution.

examples.chinese: 工業革命改變了人類的生產方式，深刻影響了社會結構。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyè gémìng gǎibiànle rénlèi de shēngchǎn fāngshì, shēnkè yǐngxiǎngle shèhuì jiégòu.
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution changed humanity's mode of production and profoundly influenced social structure.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) layout/structure — physical (房子的格局 = the layout of the house) or strategic (世界格局 = world structure/landscape); (2) someone's mental/strategic horizon — 沒有格局 (lacking vision/big-picture thinking). The vision sense has become trendy in business talk.

examples.chinese: 做事要有大格局。
examples.pinyin: Zuòshì yào yǒu dà géjú.
examples.english: You need to think with a big-picture mindset.

examples.chinese: 兩岸關係的格局正在悄悄改變，值得持續關注。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng'àn guānxì de géjú zhèngzài qiāoqiāo gǎibiàn, zhídé chíxù guānzhù.
examples.english: The pattern of cross-strait relations is quietly shifting, worth continued attention.

semanticNote: Format — documents, files, presentations. 文件格式 (file format), 格式化 (to format, both documents and disks). Tech and document-formatting vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 請按照標準格式寫報告。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào biāozhǔn géshì xiě bàogào.
examples.english: Please write the report following the standard format.

examples.chinese: 這種檔案格式不被舊版軟體支援，需要先轉換。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng dǎng'àn géshì bù bèi jiù bǎn ruǎntǐ zhīyuán, xūyào xiān zhuǎnhuàn.
examples.english: This file format is not supported by older versions of the software and needs to be converted first.

semanticNote: Emotional/cultural/communication barrier between people or groups. 消除隔閡 (remove the barrier), 文化隔閡 (cultural divide). Often appears in discussions of relationships, diplomacy, family.

examples.chinese: 他們之間有些隔閡。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zhī jiān yǒuxiē géhé.
examples.english: There's some estrangement between them.

examples.chinese: 語言隔閡讓許多外籍人士難以融入當地社會。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán géhé ràng xǔduō wàijí rénshì nányǐ róngrù dāngdì shèhuì.
examples.english: Language barriers make it difficult for many foreigners to integrate into local society.

semanticNote: To isolate / quarantine — public health (疫情期間隔離 = quarantine during epidemic), social (社會隔離 = social isolation). Massive presence in vocab during COVID. Also figurative.

examples.chinese: 確診患者必須隔離。
examples.pinyin: Quèzhěn huànzhě bìxū gélí.
examples.english: Confirmed cases must be quarantined.

examples.chinese: 實驗室將危險病毒樣本與其他材料完全隔離，以防污染。
examples.pinyin: Shíyànshì jiāng wēixiǎn bìngdú yàngběn yǔ qítā cáiliào wánquán gélí, yǐ fáng wūrǎn.
examples.english: The laboratory completely isolated dangerous virus samples from other materials to prevent contamination.

semanticNote: Individual entity — person, organism. Pair with 群體 (group/collective). Used in sociology, biology, business (個體戶 = self-employed individual / sole proprietor in mainland legal terminology).

examples.chinese: 每個個體都是獨特的。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge gètǐ dōu shì dútè de.
examples.english: Every individual is unique.

examples.chinese: 社會由無數個體組成，每個人的選擇都會影響整體。
examples.pinyin: Shèhuì yóu wúshù gètǐ zǔchéng, měi ge rén de xuǎnzé dōu huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngtǐ.
examples.english: Society is composed of countless individuals, and each person's choices affect the whole.

semanticNote: Everyone freely expresses their own opinions in a discussion. 大家各抒己見 (everyone offered their views). Common in encouraging open discussion.

examples.chinese: 會上大家各抒己見。
examples.pinyin: Huì shàng dàjiā gèshūjǐjiàn.
examples.english: At the meeting, everyone shared their own views.

examples.chinese: 討論這個敏感話題時，成員們各抒己見，討論十分熱烈。
examples.pinyin: Tǎolùn zhège mǐngǎn huàtí shí, chéngyuánmen gèshū-jǐjiàn, tǎolùn shífēn rèliè.
examples.english: While discussing this sensitive topic, members voiced their own views freely, making for a very lively discussion.

semanticNote: Deeply rooted — usually negative (prejudices, customs, problems). 根深蒂固的偏見 (deeply rooted prejudices). Implies hard to change, has been there a long time.

examples.chinese: 這種觀念根深蒂固。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guānniàn gēnshēndìgù.
examples.english: This view is deeply ingrained.

examples.chinese: 性別刻板印象根深蒂固，改變需要幾個世代的努力。
examples.pinyin: Xìngbié kèbǎn yìnxiàng gēnshēn-dìgù, gǎibiàn xūyào jǐ ge shìdài de nǔlì.
examples.english: Gender stereotypes are deeply entrenched; change requires the effort of several generations.

semanticNote: Root cause / origin of a problem. 找出問題的根源 (find the root of the problem). Analytical word — distinguishes from 原因 (reason/cause, broader).

examples.chinese: 我們要從根源上解決問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào cóng gēnyuán shàng jiějué wèntí.
examples.english: We need to solve the problem at its root.

examples.chinese: 貧窮是許多社會問題的根源，解決它需要系統性的政策介入。
examples.pinyin: Pínqióng shì xǔduō shèhuì wèntí de gēnyuán, jiějué tā xūyào xìtǒngxìng de zhèngcè jièrù.
examples.english: Poverty is the root cause of many social problems; addressing it requires systematic policy intervention.

semanticNote: Right in front of / beside someone. 在我跟前 (in front of me / at my side). Slightly more colloquial than 面前. Casual register.

examples.chinese: 她坐在奶奶的跟前。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò zài nǎinai de gēnqián.
examples.english: She sat right beside Grandma.

examples.chinese: 合約就放在你的跟前，仔細看清楚再簽名。
examples.pinyin: Hétóng jiù fàng zài nǐ de gēnqián, zǐxì kànqīngchǔ zài qiānmíng.
examples.english: The contract is right in front of you — read it carefully before signing.

semanticNote: To follow — physically (walk behind) or figuratively (follow a leader, trend). 跟隨潮流 (follow the trend). Slightly more formal than 跟著.

examples.chinese: 小狗跟隨著主人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu gēnsuízhe zhǔrén.
examples.english: The puppy follows its owner.

examples.chinese: 他決定跟隨父親的腳步，進入醫學領域。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng gēnsuí fùqīn de jiǎobù, jìnrù yīxué lǐngyù.
examples.english: He decided to follow in his father's footsteps and enter the medical field.

semanticNote: To track / shadow — covertly following someone (police tail, stalker, paparazzi) or tracking data/progress. 跟蹤調查 (follow-up investigation), 跟蹤報導 (follow-up coverage). Spy-thriller AND analytical contexts.

examples.chinese: 她覺得有人在跟蹤她。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde yǒu rén zài gēnzōng tā.
examples.english: She felt someone was following her.

examples.chinese: 員警跟蹤嫌犯長達一個月，掌握了充分的犯罪證據。
examples.pinyin: Yuánjǐng gēnzōng xiánfàn cháng dá yí ge yuè, zhǎngwòle chōngfèn de fànzuì zhèngjù.
examples.english: Police tailed the suspect for a full month, gathering sufficient evidence of criminal activity.

semanticNote: To update / renew — software (軟體更新 = software update), data, equipment, oneself. Modern essential vocabulary. Note tone: 更 here read gēng, not gèng.

examples.chinese: 請更新到最新版本。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gēngxīn dào zuì xīn bǎnběn.
examples.english: Please update to the latest version.

examples.chinese: 政府每隔幾年就會更新身分證的設計。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ měi gé jǐ nián jiù huì gēngxīn shēnfènzhèng de shèjì.
examples.english: The government updates the ID card design every few years.

semanticNote: To formally correct an error in published or stated information. 更正啟事 (correction notice, in newspapers). Formal register. Compare to 改正 (correct, broader/everyday).

examples.chinese: 報紙更正了昨天的錯誤報導。
examples.pinyin: Bàozhǐ gēngzhèngle zuótiān de cuòwù bàodǎo.
examples.english: The newspaper corrected yesterday's erroneous report.

examples.chinese: 發言人在記者會上正式更正了之前的說法。
examples.pinyin: Fāyánrén zài jìzhěhuì shàng zhèngshì gēngzhèngle zhīqián de shuōfǎ.
examples.english: The spokesperson formally corrected the earlier statement at the press conference.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) to plow farmland; (2) arable land as a noun (耕地面積 = arable land area). Agricultural vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 中國的耕地越來越少。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de gēngdì yuèláiyuè shǎo.
examples.english: China's arable land is shrinking.

examples.chinese: 老農扶著犁，慢慢地耕地。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo nóng fúzhe lí, mànmàn de gēngdì.
examples.english: The old farmer gripped the plow and slowly tilled the field.

semanticNote: Handcrafted artisan goods — pottery, wood carving, embroidery, jade work. Common souvenir vocabulary in Chinese tourism.

examples.chinese: 我買了一些當地的工藝品。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yìxiē dāngdì de gōngyìpǐn.
examples.english: I bought some local handicrafts.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的原住民族工藝品深受國際買家青睞。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yuánzhùmínzú gōngyìpǐn shēn shòu guójì mǎijiā qīnglài.
examples.english: Taiwan's indigenous handicrafts are highly sought after by international buyers.

semanticNote: Mainland China's term for police bureau. 公安 alone = police (mainland). Taiwan uses 警察局 instead. Officially the institutional name in PRC.

examples.chinese: 他去公安局報案。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù gōng'ānjú bào'àn.
examples.english: He went to the public security bureau to file a report.

examples.chinese: 公安局正在調查一起詐騙案件。
examples.pinyin: Gōng'ānjú zhèngzài diàochá yī qǐ zhàpiàn ànjiàn.
examples.english: The public security bureau is investigating a fraud case.

semanticNote: Fair/just — prices (價格公道 = reasonable price), treatment (公道一點 = be fair). Also noun: 討公道 (demand justice / get a fair shake). Old-school justice-flavored word.

examples.chinese: 這家店價錢很公道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn jiàqián hěn gōngdao.
examples.english: This shop has very fair prices.

examples.chinese: 世上沒有絕對的公道，但我們仍要努力追求。
examples.pinyin: Shìshàng méiyǒu juéduì de gōngdao, dàn wǒmen réng yào nǔlì zhuīqiú.
examples.english: There is no absolute fairness in the world, but we must still strive for it.

semanticNote: Official public announcement — government notices, corporate disclosures, building bulletin board notices. More official than 通知 (notification).

examples.chinese: 請看公告欄上的最新公告。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng kàn gōnggàolán shàng de zuìxīn gōnggào.
examples.english: Please check the latest announcement on the notice board.

examples.chinese: 公司發布公告，宣布將於下個月進行重組。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī fābù gōnggào, xuānbù jiāng yú xià ge yuè jìnxíng chóngzǔ.
examples.english: The company issued an announcement declaring it would restructure next month.

semanticNote: Public relations. 公關危機 (PR crisis), 公關人員 (PR personnel). Modern business vocabulary. Sometimes ironic — 'this is PR' = damage control / spin.

examples.chinese: 她在公關部門工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngguān bùmén gōngzuò.
examples.english: She works in the PR department.

examples.chinese: 這次事件已演變成嚴重的公關危機，公司急需應對。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiàn yǐ yǎnbiànchéng yánzhòng de gōngguān wéijī, gōngsī jí xū yìngduì.
examples.english: This incident has turned into a serious PR crisis, and the company urgently needs to respond.

semanticNote: Citizen of a country — legal/political concept. 公民權利 (civil rights), 公民責任 (civic responsibility). More formal than 國民 (national).

examples.chinese: 每個公民都有投票權。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge gōngmín dōu yǒu tóupiào quán.
examples.english: Every citizen has the right to vote.

examples.chinese: 身為公民，有責任遵守法律並關心社會公共事務。
examples.pinyin: Shēn wéi gōngmín, yǒu zérèn zūnshǒu fǎlǜ bìng guānxīn shèhuì gōnggòng shìwù.
examples.english: As a citizen, one has a responsibility to obey the law and care about public affairs.

semanticNote: To do something openly without shame — usually negative actions done in defiance. 公然違法 (openly break the law), 公然挑釁 (brazenly provoke). Critical tone — implies the person didn't even bother to hide it.

examples.chinese: 他公然違反規定。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngrán wéifǎn guīdìng.
examples.english: He openly violated the rules.

examples.chinese: 示威者公然焚燒旗幟，引發強烈爭議。
examples.pinyin: Shìwēizhě gōngrán fénshāo qízhì, yǐnfā qiángliè zhēngyì.
examples.english: The protesters openly burned flags, sparking strong controversy.

semanticNote: Recognized by everyone. 公認的事實 (a generally acknowledged fact), 公認的權威 (widely recognized authority). Implies broad consensus.

examples.chinese: 她是公認的最佳選手。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gōngrèn de zuì jiā xuǎnshǒu.
examples.english: She's generally recognized as the best player.

examples.chinese: 愛因斯坦是公認的二十世紀最偉大的科學家之一。
examples.pinyin: Àiyīnsītǎn shì gōngrèn de èrshí shìjì zuì wěidà de kēxuéjiā zhī yī.
examples.english: Einstein is widely acknowledged as one of the greatest scientists of the 20th century.

semanticNote: Mathematical/scientific formula. 數學公式 (math formula), 化學公式 (chemical formula). Also figurative: 成功的公式 (formula for success). Academic and analytical.

examples.chinese: 請記住這個數學公式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jìzhù zhè ge shùxué gōngshì.
examples.english: Please memorize this math formula.

examples.chinese: 他認為努力加上機遇，就是成功的公式。
examples.pinyin: Tā rènwéi nǔlì jiāshàng jīyù, jiùshì chénggōng de gōngshì.
examples.english: He believes that hard work plus opportunity is the formula for success.

semanticNote: Official duties — government, civil service. 公務員 (civil servant — coveted job in China/Taiwan), 出公差 (go on official business trip). Government-employee vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 他是一名公務員。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yì míng gōngwùyuán.
examples.english: He's a civil servant.

examples.chinese: 她因公務繁忙，無法出席今天的活動。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīn gōngwù fánmáng, wúfǎ chūxí jīntiān de huódòng.
examples.english: She couldn't attend today's event because of heavy official duties.

semanticNote: Just/fair/impartial — judges, decisions, treatment. 公正的判決 (a fair verdict). Slightly more formal than 公道 (fair, casual). Heavy moral weight.

examples.chinese: 法官的判決必須公正。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān de pànjué bìxū gōngzhèng.
examples.english: A judge's verdict must be impartial.

examples.chinese: 老師批改試卷時，應做到公正，不受個人喜好影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī pīgǎi shìjuàn shí, yīng zuòdào gōngzhèng, bù shòu gèrén xǐhào yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: When grading papers, teachers should be impartial and not be influenced by personal preferences.

semanticNote: Legal notarization — having a document officially certified by a notary. 公證處 (notary office), 公證書 (notarized document). Legal vocabulary, important for international document recognition.

examples.chinese: 這份文件需要公證。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn xūyào gōngzhèng.
examples.english: This document needs to be notarized.

examples.chinese: 她去公證處辦理遺囑公證，確保文件具有法律效力。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù gōngzhèngchù bànlǐ yízhǔ gōngzhèng, quèbǎo wénjiàn jùyǒu fǎlǜ xiàolì.
examples.english: She went to the notary office to have her will notarized, ensuring the document has legal effect.

semanticNote: Credit for achievements. 立下大功勞 (made a great contribution), 沒有功勞也有苦勞 (even if no merit, at least put in the hard work — common Chinese saying). Common in workplace and team contexts.

examples.chinese: 這次成功是大家的功勞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chénggōng shì dàjiā de gōngláo.
examples.english: This success is everyone's contribution.

examples.chinese: 他不愛搶功勞，默默付出，從不炫耀。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù ài qiǎng gōngláo, mòmò fùchū, cóng bù xuànyào.
examples.english: He never scrambles for credit, contributing quietly without ever showing off.

semanticNote: Tangible effects of medicine, products, methods. 藥的功效 (efficacy of the drug), 顯著的功效 (notable effect). Pharmaceutical and beauty product vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 這種藥的功效很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào de gōngxiào hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This medicine is very effective.

examples.chinese: 廣告宣稱這款保養品有抗老化的功效，但缺乏科學根據。
examples.pinyin: Guǎnggào xuānchēng zhè kuǎn bǎoyǎngpǐn yǒu kàng lǎohuà de gōngxiào, dàn quēfá kēxué gēnjù.
examples.english: The ad claims this skincare product has anti-aging efficacy, but lacks scientific backing.

semanticNote: To attack — military, verbal, in sports/games. 言語攻擊 (verbal attack), 網路攻擊 (cyberattack). Also figurative: 人身攻擊 = personal attack (in arguments). Common across many contexts.

examples.chinese: 他在會議上攻擊了我的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shàng gōngjīle wǒ de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: He attacked my viewpoint at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 政府網站遭到駭客攻擊，導致大量個資外洩。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wǎngzhàn zāodào hèikè gōngjī, dǎozhì dàliàng gèzī wàixiè.
examples.english: Government websites were hacked, causing a massive leak of personal data.

semanticNote: To capture militarily, or figuratively overcome a difficulty. 攻克難關 (overcome a tough challenge), 攻克技術難題 (crack a technical problem). Achievement-oriented word.

examples.chinese: 科學家終於攻克了這個難題。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhōngyú gōngkèle zhè ge nántí.
examples.english: Scientists finally cracked this problem.

examples.chinese: 軍隊經過兩週的激戰，終於攻克了這座城市。
examples.pinyin: Jūnduì jīngguò liǎng zhōu de jīzhàn, zhōngyú gōngkèle zhè zuò chéngshì.
examples.english: After two weeks of fierce fighting, the army finally captured the city.

semanticNote: Supply can't keep up with demand. Common in business/economics. Pair with 供過於求 (supply exceeds demand). News and market analysis vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 這款手機供不應求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī gōngbúyìngqiú.
examples.english: Demand for this phone exceeds supply.

examples.chinese: 目前市場上的人才供不應求，許多企業找不到合適的工程師。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián shìchǎng shàng de réncái gōngbúyìngqiú, xǔduō qǐyè zhǎo bù dào héshì de gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: Talent in the current market is in short supply, and many companies cannot find suitable engineers.

semanticNote: To provide supply — goods, resources, services. 供給商 (supplier). Economics vocabulary; pair with 需求 (demand). Note tone: 給 here read jǐ.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的水電供給很穩定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de shuǐdiàn gōngjǐ hěn wěndìng.
examples.english: This region has stable water and electricity supply.

examples.chinese: 戰時糧食供給出現短缺，政府緊急調配物資。
examples.pinyin: Zhànshí liángshí gōngjǐ chūxiàn duǎnquē, zhèngfǔ jǐnjí diàopèi wùzī.
examples.english: During wartime, food supplies fell short and the government urgently dispatched resources.

semanticNote: Palace — for emperors and kings. 故宮 = the Forbidden City (the most famous palace in China). Tourist and historical vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 這座宮殿建於唐朝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gōngdiàn jiàn yú Tángcháo.
examples.english: This palace was built in the Tang Dynasty.

examples.chinese: 故宮是世界上最大的宮殿建築群之一。
examples.pinyin: Gùgōng shì shìjiè shàng zuìdà de gōngdiàn jiànzhùqún zhī yī.
examples.english: The Forbidden City is one of the world's largest palace complexes.

semanticNote: Respectful — in attitude and behavior, especially toward elders/superiors. 恭敬地行禮 (bow respectfully). More formal/visible than 尊敬 (respect, internal feeling).

examples.chinese: 他恭敬地向老師鞠躬。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngjìng de xiàng lǎoshī jūgōng.
examples.english: He bowed respectfully to the teacher.

examples.chinese: 晚輩面對長輩時，應保持恭敬的態度。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnbèi miànduì zhǎngbèi shí, yīng bǎochí gōngjìng de tàidù.
examples.english: When juniors face their elders, they should maintain a respectful attitude.

semanticNote: To strengthen/consolidate — knowledge (鞏固知識 = consolidate what you've learned), positions, relationships, achievements. Common in education and political contexts.

examples.chinese: 複習能鞏固所學的知識。
examples.pinyin: Fùxí néng gǒnggù suǒ xué de zhīshì.
examples.english: Review consolidates what you've learned.

examples.chinese: 政府努力鞏固與鄰國的外交關係。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ nǔlì gǒnggù yǔ língguó de wàijiāo guānxì.
examples.english: The government works to consolidate diplomatic relations with neighboring countries.

semanticNote: Republic (form of government). 中華人民共和國 (People's Republic of China), 中華民國 (Republic of China — Taiwan). Heavy political/historical vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 中華人民共和國成立於1949年。
examples.pinyin: Zhōnghuá Rénmín Gònghéguó chénglì yú yī jiǔ sì jiǔ nián.
examples.english: The People's Republic of China was founded in 1949.

examples.chinese: 中華民國是亞洲最早成立的共和國之一。
examples.pinyin: Zhōnghuá Mínguó shì Yàzhōu zuì zǎo chénglì de gònghéguó zhī yī.
examples.english: The Republic of China is one of the earliest republics established in Asia.

semanticNote: To total / sum up. 共計一百萬 (totaling a million). Used in financial summaries, reports, calculations.

examples.chinese: 這次活動共計花費十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng gòngjì huāfèi shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: This event cost a total of 100,000 yuan.

examples.chinese: 全校學生共計一千三百人，其中男生佔多數。
examples.pinyin: Quán xiào xuéshēng gòngjì yī qiān sān bǎi rén, qízhōng nánshēng zhàn duōshù.
examples.english: The school has a total enrollment of 1,300 students, with boys in the majority.

semanticNote: Two senses: (1) physical resonance; (2) figurative emotional resonance — 引起共鳴 (resonate, strike a chord). The figurative sense dominates everyday speech — about songs, films, books, ideas that connect with people.

examples.chinese: 這首歌引起了我的共鳴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē yǐnqǐle wǒ de gòngmíng.
examples.english: This song really resonated with me.

examples.chinese: 提琴的共鳴箱讓聲音更加飽滿。
examples.pinyin: Tíqín de gòngmíngxiāng ràng shēngyīn gèngjiā bǎomǎn.
examples.english: The violin's resonance box makes the sound fuller and richer.
