examples.english: The government took emergency measures, hoping to reverse the continuously worsening economic situation.

semanticNote: A button on clothing. 縫鈕扣 (sew on a button), 解開鈕扣 (undo a button). Taiwan uses 鈕扣 without 兒化. Distinct from 按鈕 (push-button/electronic button).

examples.chinese: 她的外套少了一顆鈕扣，便趁空閒時間縫了回去。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàitào shǎo le yī kē niǔkòu, biàn chèn kòngxián shíjiān féng le huíqù.
examples.english: Her coat was missing a button, so she took advantage of some free time to sew it back on.

examples.chinese: 這件古董旗袍的鈕扣是手工製作的，極為精緻。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn gǔdǒng qípáo de niǔkòu shì shǒugōng zhìzuò de, jíwéi jīngzhì.
examples.english: The buttons on this antique qipao are handmade and exquisitely crafted.

semanticNote: The traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar. 農曆新年 (Lunar New Year), 農曆正月初一 (first day of the first lunar month). Governs all major traditional festivals in Taiwan — Lunar New Year, Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, etc. Also called 陰曆.

examples.chinese: 臺灣許多民俗節慶都依照農曆計算，例如元宵節和中秋節。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xǔduō mínsú jiéqìng dōu yīzhào nónglì jìsuàn, lìrú Yuánxiāojié hé Zhōngqiūjié.
examples.english: Many of Taiwan's folk festivals are calculated according to the lunar calendar, such as the Lantern Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival.

examples.chinese: 爺爺習慣用農曆記事，每年都會買一本農民曆。
examples.pinyin: Yéye xíguàn yòng nónglì jìshì, měinián dōu huì mǎi yī běn nóngmínlì.
examples.english: Grandpa is used to keeping track of things by the lunar calendar and buys a farmer's almanac every year.

semanticNote: Dense, thick, or strong — literal (thick fog, dense smoke) and figurative (strong interest, rich atmosphere). 興趣濃厚 (strong/keen interest), 學術氛圍濃厚 (strong academic atmosphere). The figurative sense — intense, rich — is very common.

examples.chinese: 她對歷史有著濃厚的興趣，常常一讀就是幾個小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì lìshǐ yǒu zhe nónghòu de xìngqù, chángcháng yī dú jiùshì jǐ gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: She has a strong interest in history — she often reads for hours at a stretch.

examples.chinese: 這條老街保留了濃厚的日治時期建築風格，深受觀光客喜愛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǎojiē bǎoliú le nónghòu de Rìzhì shíqī jiànzhú fēnggé, shēn shòu guānguāng kè xǐ'ài.
examples.english: This old street has retained a strong Japanese colonial-era architectural style and is very popular with tourists.

semanticNote: A slave — historically and figuratively. 奴隸制度 (slavery), 奴隸貿易 (slave trade), 成為金錢的奴隸 (become a slave to money). 奴化教育 is a term used in Taiwan's colonial history discourse for cultural suppression.

components.meaning: servant; subordinate; attached; clerical script (隸書)

examples.chinese: 廢除奴隸制度是近代人類歷史上最重要的道德進步之一。
examples.pinyin: Fèichú núlì zhìdù shì jìndài rénlèi lìshǐ shàng zuì zhòngyào de dàodé jìnbù zhī yī.
examples.english: The abolition of slavery is one of the most important moral advances in modern human history.

examples.chinese: 他自嘲說自己成了工作的奴隸，每天加班到深夜。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìcháo shuō zìjǐ chéng le gōngzuò de núlì, měitiān jiābān dào shēnyè.
examples.english: He joked that he had become a slave to his work, staying late at the office every night.

semanticNote: To abuse or maltreat — physically, emotionally, or systematically. 虐待兒童 (child abuse), 虐待動物 (animal abuse). More severe than 欺負 (bully) — implies systematic or severe cruelty. 虐待罪 (the crime of abuse) is a legal category.

examples.chinese: 動保團體揭露了這家農場虐待動物的惡行，引發社會公憤。
examples.pinyin: Dòngbǎo tuántǐ jiēlù le zhè jiā nóngchǎng nüèdài dòngwù de èxíng, yǐnfā shèhuì gōngfèn.
examples.english: Animal rights groups exposed the farm's animal abuse, triggering widespread public outrage.

examples.chinese: 長期遭受虐待的孩子需要專業的心理輔導，才能逐漸走出陰影。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī zāoshòu nüèdài de háizi xūyào zhuānyè de xīnlǐ fǔdǎo, cái néng zhújiàn zǒu chū yīnyǐng.
examples.english: Children who have suffered long-term abuse need professional psychological counseling to gradually emerge from the shadow.

semanticNote: To move or shift something from one place to another. 挪一下 (move it over a bit), 挪出時間 (free up time). Key extended sense: 挪用公款 (misappropriate public funds) is a very common legal/financial term.

components.meaning: shift; move; displace; relocate (扌 hand radical)

examples.chinese: 她把桌子挪到窗邊，這樣採光更好。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhuōzi nuó dào chuāng biān, zhèyàng cǎiguāng gèng hǎo.
examples.english: She moved the desk to the window — the natural light is much better there.

examples.chinese: 該官員被控挪用公款，目前正接受司法調查。
examples.pinyin: Gāi guānyuán bèi kòng nuóyòng gōngkuǎn, mùqián zhèng jiēshòu sīfǎ diàochá.
examples.english: This official is accused of misappropriating public funds and is currently under judicial investigation.

semanticNote: Interjection indicating sudden understanding or dawning realization (read ò, falling tone). 哦，原來如此 (Oh, I see). Distinct from 噢 (ō — surprise) and 哦 read ó (doubt). The ò reading marks a specific moment of comprehension. Very common in casual conversation.

components.meaning: oh; I see; interjection of realization (口 mouth + 我 phonetic)

examples.chinese: 「哦，原來你今天請假了，難怪我沒看到你。」
examples.pinyin: "Ò, yuánlái nǐ jīntiān qǐngjià le, nánguài wǒ méi kàn dào nǐ."
examples.english: "Oh, so you took today off — no wonder I didn't see you."

examples.chinese: 聽完解釋後，他點點頭說：「哦，我明白了。」
examples.pinyin: Tīng wán jiěshì hòu, tā diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: "Ò, wǒ míngbái le."
examples.english: After hearing the explanation, he nodded and said: "Oh, I understand now."

semanticNote: To physically beat or assault someone. More formal and legal-sounding than 打人 (hit someone) — used in police reports, news, and legal documents. 互毆 (mutual assault — both sides hit each other) is a common legal term.

examples.chinese: 監視器拍到他在巷口遭人毆打，員警已鎖定嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Jiānshìqì pāi dào tā zài xiàngkǒu zāo rén ōudǎ, yuánjǐng yǐ suǒdìng xiányírén.
examples.english: Security cameras caught him being assaulted at the alley entrance, and police have already identified the suspect.

examples.chinese: 雙方在酒吧發生口角後互毆，造成多人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zài jiǔbā fāshēng kǒujué hòu hù ōu, zàochéng duō rén shòushāng.
examples.english: After an argument broke out at the bar, both sides exchanged blows, leaving several people injured.

semanticNote: To vomit or retch. 嘔吐感 (feeling of nausea), 引起嘔吐 (cause vomiting). 上吐下瀉 (vomiting and diarrhea) is a common phrase for gastroenteritis. 嘔 alone can figuratively mean 'make one want to vomit' (disgusting).

examples.chinese: 孩子吃了不新鮮的食物，回家後開始嘔吐，媽媽趕緊帶他去看診。
examples.pinyin: Háizi chī le bù xīnxiān de shíwù, huí jiā hòu kāishǐ ǒutù, māma gǎnjǐn dài tā qù kànzhěn.
examples.english: The child ate something not fresh and started vomiting after getting home — Mom rushed him to the doctor.

examples.chinese: 有些人初次坐船時會感到頭暈嘔吐，這是暈船的典型症狀。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén chūcì zuò chuán shí huì gǎndào tóuyūn ǒutù, zhè shì yūnchuán de diǎnxíng zhèngzhuàng.
examples.english: Some people feel dizzy and nauseous the first time they take a boat — this is a typical symptom of seasickness.

semanticNote: An idol — religious (a statue/image of a deity) and modern pop culture (a music or entertainment idol). In Taiwan, 偶像 primarily refers to entertainment idols. 偶像劇 (idol drama) is a popular TV genre that originated in Taiwan and spread across Asia.

examples.chinese: 她從小就把這位歌手當作偶像，房間裡貼滿了他的海報。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù bǎ zhè wèi gēshǒu dāngzuò ǒuxiàng, fángjiān lǐ tiē mǎn le tā de hǎibào.
examples.english: She has idolized this singer since childhood — her room is covered in his posters.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的偶像劇在亞洲各地擁有廣大的粉絲群，帶動了觀光熱潮。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de ǒuxiàngjù zài Yàzhōu gèdì yōngyǒu guǎngdà de fěnsī qún, dàidòng le guānguāng rècháo.
examples.english: Taiwan's idol dramas have a massive fan base across Asia and have sparked tourism booms.

semanticNote: To lie face down or lean forward with one's chest/stomach against a surface. 趴著睡 (sleep on one's stomach), 趴在桌上 (slump/lean on the desk). Distinct from 躺 (lie down, on one's back). 趴下 (get down!) is used in action/military contexts.

components.meaning: lie face down; prostrate; lean on with chest down

examples.chinese: 午休時間，他趴在桌上小睡，不一會兒就睡著了。
examples.pinyin: Wǔxiū shíjiān, tā pā zài zhuō shàng xiǎo shuì, bù yīhuìr jiù shuìzháo le.
examples.english: During lunch break, he slumped onto the desk for a nap and fell asleep before long.

examples.chinese: 孩子趴在地板上畫畫，畫得非常專注，渾然忘我。
examples.pinyin: Háizi pā zài dìbǎn shàng huà huà, huà de fēicháng zhuānzhù, húnrán wàng wǒ.
examples.english: The child lay on the floor drawing, completely absorbed and lost in the work.

semanticNote: To reject, repel, or exclude. 器官排斥 (organ rejection — in transplant medicine), 排斥外來文化 (reject foreign culture), 相互排斥 (mutually exclusive). Both physical (magnetic repulsion) and social/psychological (exclusion, rejection).

components.meaning: push away; row; arrange; discharge; repel

examples.chinese: 器官移植後，患者需要長期服藥以防止身體排斥新器官。
examples.pinyin: Qìguān yízhí hòu, huànzhě xūyào chángqī fúyào yǐ fángzhǐ shēntǐ páichì xīn qìguān.
examples.english: After organ transplantation, the patient needs to take medication long-term to prevent the body from rejecting the new organ.

examples.chinese: 他起初排斥這個想法，但在深思熟慮後，逐漸接受了它的合理性。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐchū páichì zhège xiǎngfǎ, dàn zài shēnsī-shúlǜ hòu, zhújiàn jiēshòu le tā de hélǐxìng.
examples.english: He initially rejected the idea, but after careful thought gradually came to accept its reasonableness.

semanticNote: To eliminate, rule out, or remove something. 排除障礙 (remove obstacles), 排除嫌疑 (rule out as a suspect), 排除萬難 (overcome all difficulties). More deliberate and systematic than 去除 (get rid of). Common in legal, investigative, and problem-solving contexts.

examples.chinese: 警方初步調查後，已排除他涉案的可能性。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng chūbù diàochá hòu, yǐ páichú tā shèàn de kěnéngxìng.
examples.english: After preliminary investigation, police have ruled out the possibility of his involvement in the case.

examples.chinese: 她排除萬難，堅持完成了這項艱鉅的研究計畫。
examples.pinyin: Tā páichú wànnán, jiānchí wánchéng le zhè xiàng jiānjù de yánjiū jìhuà.
examples.english: She overcame every obstacle and persisted in completing this arduous research project.

semanticNote: To discharge or emit — waste, pollutants, gases, or wastewater. 排放廢氣 (emit exhaust), 碳排放 (carbon emissions), 排放標準 (emission standards). A key environmental term. 減少碳排放 (reduce carbon emissions) is central to Taiwan's climate and industry policy.

components.meaning: release; emit; let go; put; set free

examples.chinese: 這家工廠違法排放廢水，嚴重污染了附近的河川，遭到重罰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng wéifǎ páifàng fèishuǐ, yánzhòng wūrǎn le fùjìn de héchuan, zāodào zhòngfá.
examples.english: This factory illegally discharged wastewater, seriously polluting nearby rivers, and was heavily fined.

examples.chinese: 全球各國正積極制定政策，以減少溫室氣體的排放，應對氣候變遷。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú gèguó zhèng jījí zhìdìng zhèngcè, yǐ jiǎnshǎo wēnshì qìtǐ de páifàng, yìngduì qìhòu biànqiān.
examples.english: Countries around the world are actively formulating policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and address climate change.

semanticNote: To rehearse a performance — for theatre, dance, music, or ceremonies. 彩排 (dress rehearsal) is a specific type distinct from general 排練. Common performing arts vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 演出前一週，演員們每天都在排練，力求呈現最完美的表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchū qián yī zhōu, yǎnyuánmen měitiān dōu zài páiliàn, lìqiú chéngxiàn zuì wánměi de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: In the week before the performance, the actors rehearsed every day, striving to deliver the most perfect show.

examples.chinese: 這齣舞台劇從劇本到正式演出，共排練了三個月。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chū wǔtáijù cóng jùběn dào zhèngshì yǎnchū, gòng páiliàn le sān gè yuè.
examples.english: This stage play took three months of rehearsal from script to opening night.

english: pace back and forth; hesitate; waver
semanticNote: To pace back and forth or linger without moving on — from hesitation, anxiety, or reluctance. 在門口徘徊 (hover at the doorway), 在兩個選擇之間徘徊 (waver between two choices). More literary and evocative than 猶豫 (hesitate).

examples.chinese: 他在辦公室門口徘徊了好一會兒，遲遲不敢敲門。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōngshì ménkǒu páihuái le hǎo yīhuìr, chíchí bù gǎn qiāo mén.
examples.english: He lingered outside the office door for quite a while, hesitating to knock.

examples.chinese: 她在留下與離開之間徘徊，始終無法做出決定。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài liú xià yǔ líkāi zhījiān páihuái, shǐzhōng wúfǎ zuòchū juédìng.
examples.english: She wavered between staying and leaving, unable to make a decision.

english: denomination; group; school; faction; school of thought; sect
semanticNote: A faction, school of thought, or denomination — within a party, religion, or philosophical tradition. 政治派別 (political faction), 宗教派別 (religious denomination), 學術派別 (academic school). Common in political science, religious studies, and intellectual history.

examples.chinese: 這個政黨內部派別林立，各方意見分歧，難以形成共識。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngdǎng nèibù pàibié línlì, gèfāng yìjiàn fēnqí, nányǐ xíngchéng gòngshí.
examples.english: This party is riven with internal factions — opinions diverge widely and it is hard to form consensus.

examples.chinese: 基督教有許多不同的派別，各自在教義和儀式上有所差異。
examples.pinyin: Jīdūjiào yǒu xǔduō bùtóng de pàibié, gèzì zài jiàoyì hé yíshì shàng yǒusuǒ chāyì.
examples.english: Christianity has many different denominations, each with variations in doctrine and ritual.

semanticNote: To officially dispatch or send someone on a mission or assignment. 派遣士兵 (dispatch soldiers), 派遣人員 (send personnel), 派遣海外 (post overseas). More formal and official than 派 alone. Common in military, diplomatic, and organizational contexts.

examples.chinese: 政府決定派遣維和部隊前往衝突地區，協助當地恢復秩序。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng pàiqiǎn wéihé bùduì qiánwǎng chōngtū dìqū, xiézhù dāngdì huīfù zhìxù.
examples.english: The government decided to dispatch peacekeeping troops to the conflict zone to help restore order.

examples.chinese: 公司派遣她前往海外分公司擔任總監，任期兩年。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī pàiqiǎn tā qiánwǎng hǎiwài fēngōngsī dānrèn zǒngjiān, rènqī liǎng nián.
examples.english: The company dispatched her to an overseas branch to serve as director, for a two-year term.

english: to climb; clamber; to pull oneself up
semanticNote: To climb or scale something — a mountain, wall, or career ladder. 攀登高峰 (scale the peak), 攀登聖母峰 (climb Everest). More literary and effortful than 爬 (climb/crawl) — 攀登 implies deliberate, upward striving.

components.meaning: pull oneself up; cling to; climb; grasp
climb; ascend; mount; publish; step onto

examples.chinese: 他花了三年時間準備，終於成功攀登了玉山頂峰。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián shíjiān zhǔnbèi, zhōngyú chénggōng pāndēng le Yùshān dǐngfēng.
examples.english: He spent three years preparing and finally successfully scaled the summit of Yushan.

examples.chinese: 她的職涯如同攀登高山，每一步都需要努力與堅持。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhíyā rútóng pāndēng gāoshān, měi yī bù dōu xūyào nǔlì yǔ jiānchí.
examples.english: Her career is like climbing a mountain — every step requires effort and perseverance.

semanticNote: To spiral, circle, or hover — of birds, aircraft, or smoke. 老鷹在空中盤旋 (an eagle circling in the sky), 直升機盤旋 (helicopter hovering). Figurative: a thought 在腦中盤旋 (circling/lingering in the mind). More literary than 繞 (go around).

examples.chinese: 幾隻老鷹在山頂上空盤旋，尋覓獵物的蹤跡。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ zhī lǎoyīng zài shāndǐng shàngkōng pánxuán, xúnmì lièwù de zōngjì.
examples.english: Several eagles circled in the sky above the mountaintop, searching for prey.

examples.chinese: 這個問題一直在她腦海中盤旋，讓她夜不能寐。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yīzhí zài tā nǎohǎi zhōng pánxuán, ràng tā yè bù néng mèi.
examples.english: This question kept circling in her mind, keeping her awake at night.

english: judgment (by a court of law); adjudicate
semanticNote: A court judgment or verdict — both the act of ruling and the ruling itself. 法院判決 (court ruling), 無罪判決 (not-guilty verdict), 宣判 (announce the verdict). 上訴推翻判決 (appeal to overturn the ruling) is a common phrase. Core legal vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 法院宣判被告無罪，全場響起一片掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn xuānpàn bèigào wúzuì, quánchǎng xiǎng qǐ yī piàn zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: The court announced a not-guilty verdict for the defendant, and the entire courtroom erupted in applause.

examples.chinese: 他不服地方法院的判決，決定提起上訴。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùfú dìfāng fǎyuàn de pànjué, juédìng tíqǐ shàngsù.
examples.english: He rejected the district court's ruling and decided to file an appeal.

semanticNote: A bank, side, or boundary — typically of water or a field. 湖畔 (lakeside), 河畔 (riverbank). Primarily literary — in everyday speech 旁邊 or 岸邊 are more common. Often appears in place names and poetic descriptions.

components.meaning: bank; side; boundary; edge (田 field + 半 half — the edge of a field)

examples.chinese: 他們在湖畔散步，夕陽的餘暉映照在平靜的水面上。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài hú pàn sànbù, xīyáng de yúhuī yìngzhào zài píngjìng de shuǐmiàn shàng.
examples.english: They strolled along the lakeside, the glow of the setting sun reflected on the calm water.

examples.chinese: 這首古詩描繪了詩人獨坐河畔，思念遠方故人的情懷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gǔshī miáohuì le shīrén dú zuò hé pàn, sīniàn yuǎnfāng gùrén de qínghuái.
examples.english: This classical poem depicts the poet sitting alone on the riverbank, longing for a dear friend far away.

semanticNote: Enormous in scale, size, or number. 龐大的組織 (a massive organization), 龐大的開銷 (enormous expenses). More formal and emphatic than 巨大 (huge) — 龐大 specifically emphasizes unwieldy or overwhelming scale. Common in news and formal writing.

examples.chinese: 這個跨國集團旗下擁有龐大的子公司網絡，遍及全球五十個國家。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kuàguó jítuán qíxià yōngyǒu pángdà de zǐgōngsī wǎngluò, biànjí quánqiú wǔshí gè guójiā.
examples.english: This multinational conglomerate has a massive subsidiary network spanning fifty countries worldwide.

examples.chinese: 政府面臨龐大的財政壓力，必須削減部分公共支出。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ miànlín pángdà de cáizhèng yālì, bìxū xuējiǎn bùfèn gōnggòng zhīchū.
examples.english: The government faces enormous fiscal pressure and must cut some public expenditure.

semanticNote: To abandon or discard — a person, belief, or possession. 拋棄家人 (abandon one's family), 拋棄舊觀念 (discard old ideas), 被拋棄 (be abandoned/dumped). More emotionally charged than 丟棄 (throw away) — often used for relationships or deeply held values.

components.meaning: throw; toss; fling; abandon; cast aside

examples.chinese: 他為了追求自己的夢想，拋棄了穩定的工作和舒適的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, pāoqì le wěndìng de gōngzuò hé shūshì de shēnghuó.
examples.english: He abandoned his stable job and comfortable life to pursue his dream.

examples.chinese: 她被男友突然拋棄，一時之間難以接受現實。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi nányǒu tūrán pāoqì, yīshí zhījiān nányǐ jiēshòu xiànshí.
examples.english: She was suddenly dumped by her boyfriend and found it hard to accept reality for a time.

semanticNote: Foam or soap bubbles; figuratively, an economic bubble. 泡沫經濟 (bubble economy), 房地產泡沫 (real estate bubble). 泡沫破裂 (the bubble burst) is a set phrase. The economic bubble sense is very common in financial news.

examples.chinese: 海浪拍打礁石，激起大片白色的泡沫，景象壯觀。
examples.pinyin: Hǎilàng pāidǎ jiāoshí, jīqǐ dà piàn báisè de pàomò, jǐngxiàng zhuànguān.
examples.english: The waves crashed against the reef, sending up great swaths of white foam — a magnificent sight.

examples.chinese: 分析師警告，當前的房市泡沫一旦破裂，將對整體經濟造成嚴重衝擊。
examples.pinyin: Fēnxīshī jǐnggào, dāngqián de fáng shì pàomò yīdàn pòliè, jiāng duì zhěngtǐ jīngjì zàochéng yánzhòng chōngjí.
examples.english: Analysts warn that once the current real estate bubble bursts, it will deal a serious blow to the overall economy.

semanticNote: To cultivate or nurture — plants (breeding), people (developing talent), or ideas. 培育人才 (cultivate/develop talent), 培育新品種 (breed new varieties). More nurturing and developmental in tone than 訓練 (train).

components.meaning: cultivate; bank up soil; foster; nurture
raise; educate; give birth to; grow; rear

examples.chinese: 農業研究所花了多年時間培育出這種耐旱的新稻米品種。
examples.pinyin: Nóngyè yánjiūsuǒ huā le duō nián shíjiān péiyù chū zhè zhǒng nàihàn de xīn dàomǐ pǐnzhǒng.
examples.english: The agricultural research institute spent many years developing this new drought-resistant rice variety.

examples.chinese: 學校重視培育學生的批判性思維，鼓勵他們獨立思考。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhòngshì péiyù xuéshēng de pīpànxìng sīwéi, gǔlì tāmen dúlì sīkǎo.
examples.english: The school emphasizes cultivating students' critical thinking, encouraging them to think independently.

semanticNote: To equip or outfit with necessary items; also the equipment itself. 配備武器 (equip with weapons), 配備齊全 (fully equipped). Common in military, industrial, and consumer product contexts. Often seen in product specs: 配備先進的功能 (equipped with advanced features).

examples.chinese: 這家醫院配備了最新型的醫療設備，能提供高品質的診療服務。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn pèibèi le zuì xīnxíng de yīliáo shèbèi, néng tígōng gāo pǐnzhì de zhěnliáo fúwù.
examples.english: This hospital is equipped with the latest medical devices and can provide high-quality diagnostic and treatment services.

examples.chinese: 這款筆電配備了高效能處理器，非常適合需要大量運算的專業用戶。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn bǐdiàn pèibèi le gāo xiàonéng chǔlǐqì, fēicháng shìhé xūyào dàliàng yùnsuàn de zhuānyè yònghù.
examples.english: This laptop is equipped with a high-performance processor, making it ideal for professional users who need heavy computing.

semanticNote: Spouse or marital partner. 配偶簽證 (spouse visa). A formal legal and administrative term — used in official documents and medical records. Taiwan legalized same-sex marriage in 2019, making 同性配偶 a legal category. More formal than 老婆/老公 or 伴侶.

examples.chinese: 填寫醫院表格時，需要填入配偶的基本資料與緊急聯絡方式。
examples.pinyin: Tiánxiě yīyuàn biǎogé shí, xūyào tián rù pèi'ǒu de jīběn zīliào yǔ jǐnjí liánluò fāngshì.
examples.english: When filling out hospital forms, you need to include your spouse's basic information and emergency contact details.

examples.chinese: 臺灣於2019年通過同婚法案，同性配偶依法享有與異性配偶相同的權利。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yú èr líng yījiǔ nián tōngguò tóng hūn fāng'àn, tóngxìng pèi'ǒu yīfǎ xiǎngyǒu yǔ yìxìng pèi'ǒu xiāngtóng de quánlì.
examples.english: Taiwan passed the same-sex marriage bill in 2019, giving same-sex spouses the same legal rights as heterosexual spouses.

semanticNote: To form a complete set or package; complementary measures that go together. 配套措施 (complementary/accompanying measures), 配套設施 (supporting facilities). Very common in government policy and urban planning — policies are expected to come with 配套措施.

components.meaning: set; suit; package; envelop; apply; overlap

examples.chinese: 政府推行新稅法時，必須同步規劃完善的配套措施，避免造成民眾負擔。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīxíng xīn shuìfǎ shí, bìxū tóngbù guīhuà wánshàn de pèitào cuòshī, bìmiǎn zàochéng mínzhòng fùdān.
examples.english: When implementing new tax laws, the government must simultaneously plan comprehensive complementary measures to avoid burdening the public.

examples.chinese: 新社區的配套設施齊全，包括學校、公園和商業區，非常適合家庭居住。
examples.pinyin: Xīn shèqū de pèitào shèshī qíquán, bāokuò xuéxiào, gōngyuán hé shāngyèqū, fēicháng shìhé jiātíng jūzhù.
examples.english: The new community has complete supporting facilities including schools, parks, and a commercial area — very suitable for families.

semanticNote: A geographic basin — a low-lying area surrounded by higher land. 臺北盆地 (Taipei Basin), 四川盆地 (Sichuan Basin). Taipei's basin geography is why it gets especially hot, stuffy summers — heat is trapped by the surrounding hills.

examples.chinese: 臺北市位於盆地地形之中，四周群山環繞，夏季悶熱不易散熱。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi shì wèiyú péndì dìxíng zhī zhōng, sìzhōu qúnshān huánrào, xiàjì mēnrè bù yì sànrè.
examples.english: Taipei is situated in a basin surrounded by mountains on all sides, making it particularly hot and stuffy in summer.

examples.chinese: 四川盆地土地肥沃，自古以來就是中國的重要農業區。
examples.pinyin: Sìchuān péndì tǔdì féiwò, zìgǔ yǐlái jiùshì Zhōngguó de zhòngyào nóngyèqū.
examples.english: The Sichuan Basin has fertile soil and has been an important agricultural region in China since ancient times.

semanticNote: Cooking or the culinary arts — the skill and process of preparing food. 烹飪技巧 (cooking techniques), 烹飪節目 (cooking show). More formal and encompassing than 做菜 (cook dishes) or 煮飯 (cook rice/food). Common in culinary education, media, and food culture.

examples.chinese: 她對烹飪充滿熱情，閒暇時總是研究各種食譜，嘗試新菜色。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì pēngrèn chōngmǎn rèqíng, xiánxiá shí zǒng shì yánjiū gèzhǒng shípǔ, chángshì xīn càisè.
examples.english: She is passionate about cooking — in her spare time she always studies various recipes and tries new dishes.

examples.chinese: 這所學校開設了烹飪課程，讓學生從小培養生活技能。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào kāishè le pēngrèn kèchéng, ràng xuéshēng cóng xiǎo péiyǎng shēnghuó jìnéng.
examples.english: This school offers cooking classes, allowing students to develop life skills from a young age.

english: hold or carry with both hands facing up
semanticNote: To hold or carry with both hands facing up — 捧著碗 (hold a bowl with both hands). Extended: 捧場 (show support by attending; be a good audience), or to flatter excessively — 捧他 (praise/flatter him). Context determines which sense applies.

components.meaning: hold with both hands upward; support; flatter (扌 hand radical)

examples.chinese: 她雙手捧著那碗熱湯，小心翼翼地走回座位。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuāngsǒu pěng zhe nà wǎn rètāng, xiǎoxīn yìyì de zǒu huí zuòwèi.
examples.english: She carried the bowl of hot soup back to her seat with both hands, being very careful.

examples.chinese: 朋友們專程來捧場，讓她在台上表演得格外起勁。
examples.pinyin: Péngyǒumen zhuānchéng lái pěngchǎng, ràng tā zài táishàng biǎoyǎn de géwài qǐjìn.
examples.english: Her friends came specially to show their support, which made her perform on stage with extra vigor.

semanticNote: Wholesale — buying or selling goods in large quantities at lower unit prices. 批發商 (wholesaler), 批發市場 (wholesale market). Contrasts with 零售 (retail). Taiwan's Dihua Street (迪化街) in Taipei is a famous wholesale market for dry goods, fabric, and traditional items.

components.meaning: send out; distribute; issue; develop; emit

examples.chinese: 她每週都去批發市場採購食材，再拿回餐廳使用，省了不少成本。
examples.pinyin: Tā měizhōu dōu qù pīfā shìchǎng cǎigòu shícái, zài ná huí cāntīng shǐyòng, shěng le bùshǎo chéngběn.
examples.english: Every week she goes to the wholesale market to buy ingredients for her restaurant, saving considerable costs.

examples.chinese: 這家店以批發價格供應給下游的零售商，利潤靠量取勝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yǐ pīfā jiàgé gōngyìng gěi xiàyóu de língshòu shāng, lìrùn kào liàng qǔshèng.
examples.english: This store supplies downstream retailers at wholesale prices, making its profit on volume.

semanticNote: To criticize or critically analyze — more structured and principled than 批評 (criticize casually). 批判性思維 (critical thinking), 批判精神 (spirit of critical inquiry). In academic contexts, 批判 implies rigorous analysis and judgment, not just negative commentary.

components.meaning: criticize; comment on; a batch; annotate

examples.chinese: 這位學者以犀利的筆鋒批判了當前教育制度的種種弊端。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě yǐ xīlì de bǐfēng pīpàn le dāngqián jiàoyù zhìdù de zhǒngzhǒng bìduān.
examples.english: This scholar used a sharp pen to critically expose the many flaws in the current education system.

examples.chinese: 培養批判性思維，是現代教育最重要的目標之一。
examples.pinyin: Péiyǎng pīpànxìng sīwéi, shì xiàndài jiàoyù zuì zhòngyào de mùbiāo zhī yī.
examples.english: Cultivating critical thinking is one of the most important goals of modern education.

semanticNote: To split or chop with a sharp instrument. 劈柴 (chop firewood), 劈開 (split open), 被雷劈 (struck by lightning). 劈頭蓋臉 (right in the face; straight at someone) is a common fixed expression. 劈腿 means doing the splits (gymnastics) or cheating in a relationship (slang).

components.meaning: split; chop; cleave; lightning strike (刀 knife radical)

examples.chinese: 他拿起斧頭，用力地劈開了一根粗大的木頭。
examples.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ fǔtóu, yòng lì de pīkāi le yī gēn cūdà de mùtou.
examples.english: He picked up the axe and forcefully split open a thick log.

examples.chinese: 她劈頭蓋臉地罵了他一頓，讓他完全沒有機會辯解。
examples.pinyin: Tā pītóu-gàiliǎn de mà le tā yī dùn, ràng tā wánquán méiyǒu jīhuì biànjiě.
examples.english: She lit into him right to his face, leaving him no chance at all to defend himself.

semanticNote: Leather — tanned animal hide used for goods. 真皮皮革 (genuine leather), 人造皮革 (faux/synthetic leather). In Taiwan, 真皮 (genuine leather) is specified for natural hide to distinguish from synthetic alternatives. Common in fashion, furniture, and manufacturing.

examples.chinese: 這款皮包採用義大利頂級皮革製作，質感細膩，觸感極佳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn pí bāo cǎiyòng Yìdàlì dǐngjí pígé zhìzuò, zhìgǎn xìnì, chùgǎn jí jiā.
examples.english: This handbag is made from top-grade Italian leather — the texture is delicate and the feel is superb.

examples.chinese: 隨著動保意識提升，越來越多品牌開始改用仿皮革取代動物皮革。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe dòngbǎo yìshí tíshēng, yuèláiyuè duō pǐnpái kāishǐ gǎi yòng fǎng pígé qǔdài dòngwù pígé.
examples.english: As animal protection awareness grows, more and more brands are switching to faux leather instead of animal hide.

semanticNote: Utterly exhausted and worn out. 疲憊不堪 (absolutely exhausted — a common fixed phrase), 身心疲憊 (physically and mentally drained). Stronger than 疲倦 (tired/weary) — 疲憊 implies being pushed past one's limit. Common in literary and emotional contexts.

components.meaning: exhausted; worn out; done in; drained

examples.chinese: 連續加班一週後，他終於趴在桌上，疲憊地睡著了。
examples.pinyin: Liánxù jiābān yī zhōu hòu, tā zhōngyú pā zài zhuō shàng, píbèi de shuìzháo le.
examples.english: After a week of continuous overtime, he finally slumped on his desk and fell asleep in utter exhaustion.

examples.chinese: 長途旅行讓全家人都疲憊不堪，一到飯店便各自倒頭大睡。
examples.pinyin: Chángtú lǚxíng ràng quánjiā rén dōu píbèi bùkān, yī dào fàndiàn biàn gèzì dǎo tóu dà shuì.
examples.english: The long journey left the whole family completely exhausted — the moment they reached the hotel, everyone crashed into bed.

semanticNote: Tired and weary — a moderate level of fatigue. 感到疲倦 (feel tired), 眼神疲倦 (weary eyes). Less extreme than 疲憊 (utterly exhausted) — 疲倦 describes the normal tired feeling after work or activity, not total depletion. Common in everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 工作了一整天，她感到有些疲倦，決定早點休息。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò le yī zhěngtiān, tā gǎndào yǒuxiē píjuàn, juédìng zǎo diǎn xiūxi.
examples.english: After working a full day, she felt a little tired and decided to rest early.

examples.chinese: 即便感到疲倦，他仍堅持把最後一章讀完才去睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Jíbiàn gǎndào píjuàn, tā réng jiānchí bǎ zuìhòu yī zhāng dú wán cái qù shuìjiào.
examples.english: Even though he was tired, he persisted in finishing the last chapter before going to sleep.

semanticNote: Buttocks; rear end. A colloquial, slightly crude but commonly used term. 坐下屁股 (plop one's bottom down). Common in everyday speech; mildly impolite in formal settings. Also used figuratively: 擦屁股 (clean up someone else's mess — lit. 'wipe the bottom').

examples.chinese: 孩子摔了一跤，坐在地上揉著屁股哭泣。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shuāi le yī jiāo, zuò zài dì shàng róu zhe pìgu kūqì.
examples.english: The child took a tumble, sat on the ground rubbing their bottom and cried.

examples.chinese: 老闆總是留下爛攤子讓員工去擦屁股，讓大家怨聲載道。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zǒng shì liú xià làn tānzi ràng yuángōng qù cā pìgu, ràng dàjiā yuànshēng zài dào.
examples.english: The boss always left a mess for employees to clean up, making everyone grumble.

english: for example; for instance; such as
semanticNote: For example; for instance — introduces an illustrative example. 譬如說 (for example; let's say). More literary and formal than 比如 (for example — everyday) or 例如 (for example — formal/written). Common in essays, speeches, and formal discourse.

components.meaning: like; as; if; according to; for example

examples.chinese: 許多日常物品都含有化學成分，譬如洗碗精、牙膏和洗髮精。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rìcháng wùpǐn dōu hányǒu huàxué chéngfèn, pìrú xǐwǎnjīng, yágāo hé xǐfàjīng.
examples.english: Many everyday products contain chemical ingredients — for example, dish soap, toothpaste, and shampoo.

examples.chinese: 語言學習需要長期堅持，譬如每天練習聽力、口說和閱讀。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán xuéxí xūyào chángqī jiānchí, pìrú měitiān liànxí tīnglì, kǒushuō hé yuèdú.
examples.english: Language learning requires long-term persistence — for instance, practicing listening, speaking, and reading every day.

semanticNote: A bias or deviation from a standard or correct value. 測量偏差 (measurement deviation), 認知偏差 (cognitive bias), 出現偏差 (develop a deviation/error). More technical and neutral than 偏見 (prejudice — which is emotionally loaded). Common in science, statistics, and quality control.

components.meaning: lean to one side; deviate; biased; partial

examples.chinese: 研究人員發現數據出現了嚴重偏差，需要重新進行實驗。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán fāxiàn shùjù chūxiàn le yánzhòng piānchā, xūyào chóngxīn jìnxíng shíyàn.
examples.english: Researchers found serious deviations in the data and needed to redo the experiment.

examples.chinese: 他的認知出現了偏差，讓他對整件事做出了錯誤的判斷。
examples.pinyin: Tā de rènzhī chūxiàn le piānchā, ràng tā duì zhěng jiàn shì zuòchū le cuòwù de pànduàn.
examples.english: His thinking developed a bias that led him to make an incorrect judgment about the whole matter.

semanticNote: Prejudice — a preconceived, often unfair opinion about a person or group. 種族偏見 (racial prejudice), 消除偏見 (eliminate prejudice), 帶有偏見 (hold a prejudiced view). More emotionally loaded than 偏差 (deviation/bias) — 偏見 implies unfair judgment of people. Common in social, ethical, and political discourse.

components.meaning: lean to one side; biased; partial; prejudiced

examples.chinese: 她努力克服社會對女性工程師的偏見，最終在業界闖出一片天。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì kèfú shèhuì duì nǚxìng gōngchéngshī de piānjiàn, zuìzhōng zài yèjiè chuǎng chū yī piàn tiān.
examples.english: She worked hard to overcome society's prejudice against female engineers and ultimately made her mark in the industry.

examples.chinese: 教育的作用之一，是幫助人們消除對不同文化的偏見。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù de zuòyòng zhī yī, shì bāngzhù rénmen xiāochú duì bùtóng wénhuà de piānjiàn.
examples.english: One of education's roles is to help people overcome prejudice against different cultures.

english: remote and isolated; far from the city
semanticNote: Remote, isolated, and far from the city or main areas. 偏僻的山區 (remote mountainous area), 地點偏僻 (the location is out of the way). More specific than 遠 (far) — 偏僻 implies both distance and poor accessibility. Common in descriptions of rural areas or hard-to-reach locations.

components.meaning: lean to one side; off-center; remote; partial
out of the way; remote; secluded; eccentric

examples.chinese: 這個村落地處偏僻，交通不便，醫療資源嚴重匱乏。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cūnluò dì chǔ piānpì, jiāotōng bù biàn, yīliáo zīyuán yánzhòng kuìfá.
examples.english: This village is in a remote location with poor transportation and a severe shortage of medical resources.

examples.chinese: 她特意選了一間偏僻的咖啡館寫作，避免受到干擾。
examples.pinyin: Tā tèyì xuǎn le yī jiān piānpì de kāfēiguǎn xiězuò, bìmiǎn shòudào gānrǎo.
examples.english: She deliberately chose an out-of-the-way café to write in, to avoid being disturbed.

semanticNote: Unexpectedly; contrary to expectations; of all things. 偏偏就是他 (of all people, it had to be him), 偏偏這時候下雨 (it just had to rain at this moment). Expresses irony, frustration, or the perversity of fate — things turning out exactly how you didn't want.

components.meaning: lean to one side; contrary; just (emphasizing the unexpected)

examples.chinese: 好不容易準備好了，偏偏車子在半路拋錨，真是倒楣。
examples.pinyin: Hǎobùróngyì zhǔnbèi hǎo le, piānpiān chēzi zài bànlù pāomáo, zhēnshì dǎoméi.
examples.english: Finally everything was ready — and of all times, the car broke down halfway there. What bad luck.

examples.chinese: 她偏偏在最需要安靜的時候，隔壁開始裝修。
examples.pinyin: Tā piānpiān zài zuì xūyào ānjìng de shíhòu, gébì kāishǐ zhuāngxiū.
examples.english: Of all times, the neighbors started renovating just when she needed quiet the most.

semanticNote: A fragment, passage, or extract — a part of something larger. 記憶片段 (memory fragments), 電影片段 (film clip/excerpt), 對話片段 (excerpt of a conversation). Taiwan uses 片段. Implies incompleteness — just a piece of the whole.

examples.chinese: 她只記得那場夢的幾個模糊片段，無法拼湊出完整的情節。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ jìde nà chǎng mèng de jǐ gè móhú piànduàn, wúfǎ pīncòu chū wánzhěng de qíngjié.
examples.english: She only remembered a few blurry fragments of that dream and couldn't piece together the full story.

examples.chinese: 影片中有幾個精彩的片段讓觀眾印象深刻，久久難忘。
examples.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn zhōng yǒu jǐ gè jīngcǎi de piànduàn ràng guānzhòng yìnxiàng shēnkè, jiǔjiǔ nán wàng.
examples.english: Several brilliant scenes in the film left a deep impression on the audience, lingering in their memory for a long time.

semanticNote: A short period of time; a moment. 片刻之間 (in a moment), 稍候片刻 (wait a moment), 片刻不離 (not apart for even a moment). More literary than 一會兒 (a while) — 片刻 emphasizes brevity and is often used in formal or literary writing.

components.meaning: quarter hour; moment; engrave; carve; immediately

examples.chinese: 請稍候片刻，我去通知一下裡面的人。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shāo hòu piànkè, wǒ qù tōngzhī yīxià lǐmiàn de rén.
examples.english: Please wait a moment — I'll go let the people inside know.

examples.chinese: 她在繁忙的工作中抽出片刻，靜靜地喝完了一杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fánmáng de gōngzuò zhōng chōuchū piànkè, jìngjìng de hē wán le yī bēi chá.
examples.english: She carved out a brief moment from her busy work to quietly finish a cup of tea.

semanticNote: To float on or hover above a surface; to drift. 在水面漂浮 (float on the water surface), 雲朵漂浮 (clouds drifting). Figurative: 漂浮不定 (drifting and unsettled — of a person's life or feelings). More evocative than 浮 (float) alone — implies drifting without fixed direction.

examples.chinese: 幾片落葉漂浮在平靜的湖面上，隨著微風緩緩移動。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ piàn luòyè piāofú zài píngjìng de húmiàn shàng, suízhe wēifēng huǎnhuǎn yídòng.
examples.english: A few fallen leaves floated on the calm lake surface, drifting slowly with the gentle breeze.

examples.chinese: 畢業後他過著漂浮不定的生活，換了幾份工作，仍找不到方向。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu tā guò zhe piāofú bùdìng de shēnghuó, huàn le jǐ fèn gōngzuò, réng zhǎo bù dào fāngxiàng.
examples.english: After graduating he lived a drifting, unsettled life — changing jobs several times but still unable to find his direction.

english: wave in the wind; flutter; fly
semanticNote: To wave or flutter in the wind — of flags, hair, or banners. 國旗飄揚 (the national flag waves), 彩旗飄揚 (colorful flags fluttering). More evocative and literary than 飛 (fly). Often used in patriotic or celebratory imagery.

examples.chinese: 奧運會場上，各國國旗迎風飄揚，場面壯觀。
examples.pinyin: Àoyùnhuì chǎng shàng, gèguó guóqí yíng fēng piāoyáng, chǎngmiàn zhuànguān.
examples.english: At the Olympic venue, national flags from all countries waved in the breeze — a magnificent sight.

examples.chinese: 她的長髮在海風中飄揚，顯得格外浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Tā de cháng fà zài hǎifēng zhōng piāoyáng, xiǎnde géwài làngmàn.
examples.english: Her long hair fluttered in the sea breeze, giving her a particularly romantic air.

semanticNote: Multiple senses: (1) the left-curving brushstroke 丿 in Chinese calligraphy — one of the eight basic strokes; (2) to throw or fling aside — 撇開 (set aside); (3) to skim off — 撇去浮沫 (skim off the foam). In calligraphy, 撇 and 捺 (right-curving stroke) are a classic pairing.

components.meaning: left-curving stroke 丿; throw aside; skim off (扌 hand radical)

examples.chinese: 老師在黑板上寫了一個「人」字，先撇後捺，讓學生模仿筆順。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng xiě le yī gè "rén" zì, xiān piě hòu nà, ràng xuéshēng mófǎng bǐshùn.
examples.english: The teacher wrote the character 人 on the blackboard — left stroke first, then right — and had students copy the stroke order.

examples.chinese: 煮湯時要記得撇去表面的浮沫，湯汁才會清澈。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔ tāng shí yào jìde piě qù biǎomiàn de fúmò, tāngzhī cái huì qīngchè.
examples.english: When making soup, remember to skim off the foam from the surface so the broth stays clear.

semanticNote: To fight or strive with all one's effort — in competition, adversity, or pursuit of a goal. 拼搏精神 (the spirit of giving one's all), 奮力拼搏 (strive with all one's might). More active and combative than 努力 (work hard). Common in sports, motivational, and competitive contexts.

components.meaning: join; piece together; risk; go all out

examples.chinese: 這支球隊雖然技術條件不如對手，卻憑著拼搏精神殺入決賽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì suīrán jìshù tiáojiàn bùrú duìshǒu, què píng zhe pīnbó jīngshén shā rù juésài.
examples.english: Although this team was technically inferior to its opponents, it fought its way into the finals through sheer determination.

examples.chinese: 她相信，只要全力拼搏，就算無法達到頂峰，也不會留下遺憾。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiāngxìn, zhǐyào quánlì pīnbó, jiùsuàn wúfǎ dádào dǐngfēng, yě bù huì liú xià yíhàn.
examples.english: She believes that as long as she gives everything, even if she can't reach the top, she'll have no regrets.

english: risk one's life; desperately; with all one's might
semanticNote: With all one's might; desperately; even at risk to one's life. 拼命工作 (work desperately hard), 拼命三郎 (an extremely hard-working, reckless person). More intense than 盡力 (do one's best). Implies pushing past all limits.

components.meaning: risk; go all out; join; piece together

examples.chinese: 他拼命衝刺，終於在最後一秒超越了對手，奪得金牌。
examples.pinyin: Tā pīnmìng chōngcì, zhōngyú zài zuìhòu yī miǎo chāoyuè le duìshǒu, duódé jīnpái.
examples.english: He sprinted with everything he had and finally overtook his opponent in the last second, winning the gold medal.

examples.chinese: 她拼命地追上最後一班公車，氣喘吁吁地跳上車門。
examples.pinyin: Tā pīnmìng de zhuīshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, qìchuǎn xūxū de tiào shàng chēmén.
examples.english: She desperately chased the last bus and leaped onto the door, completely out of breath.

semanticNote: Lacking in content, variety, or richness — meager or deficient. 知識貧乏 (meager knowledge), 詞彙貧乏 (a limited vocabulary). Can refer to material poverty but more often refers to intellectual or experiential deficiency. Stronger than 不足 (insufficient).

examples.chinese: 她認為自己的人生經歷太過貧乏，決定辭職去旅行充實自己。
examples.pinyin: Tā rènwéi zìjǐ de rénshēng jīnglì tài guò pínfá, juédìng cízhí qù lǚxíng chōngshí zìjǐ.
examples.english: She felt her life experiences were too meager and decided to quit her job and travel to enrich herself.

examples.chinese: 這篇文章論點雖多，但例證貧乏，說服力明顯不足。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng lùndiǎn suī duō, dàn lìzhèng pínfá, shuōfúlì míngxiǎn bùzú.
examples.english: This essay makes many arguments, but the evidence is meager and its persuasive power is clearly insufficient.

semanticNote: Materially poor and lacking sufficient resources. 貧困家庭 (impoverished family), 陷入貧困 (fall into poverty), 脫貧 (escape poverty — a key policy goal). 貧困線 (poverty line) is a key social policy term. Common in social welfare and development discourse.

examples.chinese: 這個NGO長期在貧困地區推動教育計畫，幫助孩子脫離貧困循環。
examples.pinyin: Zhège NGO chángqī zài pínkùn dìqū tuīdòng jiàoyù jìhuà, bāngzhù háizi tuōlí pínkùn xúnhuán.
examples.english: This NGO has long promoted education programs in impoverished areas, helping children break out of the poverty cycle.

examples.chinese: 她出身貧困，卻憑藉著努力與毅力考上了頂尖大學。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūshēn pínkùn, què píngjiè zhe nǔlì yǔ yìlì kǎo shàng le dǐngjiān dàxué.
examples.english: She came from poverty, but through hard work and perseverance gained admission to a top university.

semanticNote: Happening frequently and repeatedly. 頻繁地往來 (frequent comings and goings), 頻繁發生 (occur frequently). More formal than 常常 (often) — 頻繁 implies a notably high rate of occurrence, often with a concerned or noteworthy tone.

examples.chinese: 近年來，極端氣候事件頻繁發生，讓各國政府不得不正視氣候危機。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, jíduān qìhòu shìjiàn pínfán fāshēng, ràng gèguó zhèngfǔ bùdébù zhèngshì qìhòu wēijī.
examples.english: In recent years, extreme weather events have been occurring frequently, forcing governments around the world to face the climate crisis.

examples.chinese: 他最近頻繁加班，連週末都幾乎沒有休息，讓家人非常擔心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn pínfán jiābān, lián zhōumò dōu jīhū méiyǒu xiūxi, ràng jiārén fēicháng dānxīn.
examples.english: He has been working overtime frequently lately, barely resting even on weekends, which worries his family greatly.

semanticNote: Frequency — both in physics (cycles per second; Hz) and general usage (how often something occurs). 無線電頻率 (radio frequency), 出現頻率 (frequency of occurrence). Colloquial: 我們的頻率不合 (we're not on the same wavelength — lit. 'our frequencies don't match').

examples.chinese: 不同電台使用不同的無線電頻率廣播，避免相互干擾。
examples.pinyin: Bùtóng diàntái shǐyòng bùtóng de wúxiàndiàn pínlǜ guǎngbō, bìmiǎn xiānghù gānrǎo.
examples.english: Different radio stations broadcast on different radio frequencies to avoid interfering with each other.

examples.chinese: 她覺得和他聊天非常舒服，感覺兩人的頻率很合。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde hé tā liáotiān fēicháng shūfu, gǎnjué liǎng rén de pínlǜ hěn hé.
examples.english: She found chatting with him very comfortable — she felt like they were on the same wavelength.

english: try; taste a small amount; to sample
semanticNote: To taste or sample food or drink carefully and with appreciation. 品嘗美食 (savor delicacies), 品嘗紅酒 (taste wine). Implies deliberate, attentive tasting rather than just eating. More refined than just 嚐 (taste/try). Common in food culture, wine tasting, and tourism.

examples.chinese: 旅遊時，她最喜歡品嘗當地特色小吃，感受不同的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Lǚyóu shí, tā zuì xǐhuān pǐncháng dāngdì tèsè xiǎochī, gǎnshòu bùtóng de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: When traveling, she loves tasting local specialty foods and experiencing different food cultures.

examples.chinese: 莊園邀請賓客品嘗今年新釀的葡萄酒，現場氣氛熱絡。
examples.pinyin: Zhuāngyuán yāoqǐng bīnkè pǐncháng jīnnián xīn niàng de pútáojiǔ, xiànchǎng qìfēn rèluò.
examples.english: The estate invited guests to taste this year's newly brewed wine — the atmosphere at the event was lively.

semanticNote: One's moral character, virtue, and ethical conduct. 品德優良 (good moral character), 品德教育 (moral education). More character-focused than 道德 (morality as a system) — 品德 specifically refers to an individual's personal virtue. Common in education and evaluations of people.

examples.chinese: 學校不只重視學業成績，更看重學生的品德培養。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào bùzhǐ zhòngshì xuéyè chéngjì, gèng kànzhòng xuéshēng de pǐndé péiyǎng.
examples.english: The school values not just academic performance, but also the cultivation of students' moral character.

examples.chinese: 他事業有成，卻品德低落，最終在醜聞中一敗塗地。
examples.pinyin: Tā shìyè yǒuchéng, què pǐndé dīluò, zuìzhōng zài chǒuwén zhōng yī bài tú dì.
examples.english: He was successful in his career but had poor moral character — he ultimately suffered a complete downfall in scandal.

semanticNote: Quality — of goods, services, or a person's character. 產品品質 (product quality), 生活品質 (quality of life). In Taiwan, 生活品質 is a major social concern. As personal character: 具備優秀的品質 (possess excellent qualities/virtues).

examples.chinese: 消費者越來越重視產品的品質，而非只看價格。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě yuèláiyuè zhòngshì chǎnpǐn de pǐnzhì, ér fēi zhǐ kàn jiàgé.
examples.english: Consumers are placing increasing importance on product quality, rather than just looking at the price.

examples.chinese: 她具備誠實與責任心兩項重要的品質，深受主管賞識。
examples.pinyin: Tā jùbèi chéngshí yǔ zérèn xīn liǎng xiàng zhòngyào de pǐnzhì, shēn shòu zhǔguǎn shǎngshí.
examples.english: She possesses two important qualities — honesty and a sense of responsibility — which are highly valued by her supervisor.

semanticNote: A breed or variety — of plants, animals, or products. 新品種 (new variety/breed), 品種改良 (breed/variety improvement). In agriculture, 品種改良 is a key R&D activity for Taiwan's fruit and rice industries. Common in agriculture, biology, and product categorization.

components.meaning: kind; type; seed; species; breed; variety

examples.chinese: 臺灣農業研究人員培育出多種優良稻米品種，使產量大幅提升。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nóngyè yánjiū rényuán péiyù chū duō zhǒng yōuliáng dàomǐ pǐnzhǒng, shǐ chǎnliàng dàfú tíshēng.
examples.english: Taiwan's agricultural researchers have developed many excellent rice varieties, significantly increasing yields.

examples.chinese: 這間寵物店販售多種貓咪品種，其中不乏稀有且受歡迎的品種。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān chǒngwùdiàn fànshòu duō zhǒng māomī pǐnzhǒng, qízhōng bùfá xīyǒu qiě shòu huānyíng de pǐnzhǒng.
examples.english: This pet shop sells many cat breeds, including some rare and popular varieties.

semanticNote: Ordinary, common, and unremarkable — without distinction. 平凡的生活 (an ordinary life), 平凡人 (ordinary person/everyman). Neutral or positive in tone — not necessarily pejorative. 平凡中見偉大 (greatness in ordinariness) is a common literary theme.

examples.chinese: 她嚮往一種平凡而踏實的生活，不需要名利，只要家人健康平安。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàngwǎng yī zhǒng píngfán ér tāshí de shēnghuó, bù xūyào mínglì, zhǐyào jiārén jiànkāng píng'ān.
examples.english: She yearns for an ordinary, down-to-earth life — no fame or wealth, just health and safety for her family.

examples.chinese: 他說：「平凡並不可恥，能把平凡的事做到極致，才是真正的不凡。」
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Píngfán bìng bù kěchǐ, néng bǎ píngfán de shì zuò dào jízhì, cái shì zhēnzhèng de bùfán."
examples.english: He said: "Ordinariness is nothing to be ashamed of — to do ordinary things to perfection is what is truly extraordinary."

english: a plane (i.e. flat surface); type; category
semanticNote: A flat surface or plane — in geometry (a 2D plane) and everyday usage. 平面設計 (graphic design — a very common professional title), 平面地圖 (flat/2D map). 立體 vs 平面 (3D vs 2D). 平面設計師 (graphic designer) is common in Taiwan's creative industries.

examples.chinese: 在幾何學中，平面是一個無限延伸的二維空間。
examples.pinyin: Zài jǐhéxué zhōng, píngmiàn shì yī gè wúxiàn yánshēn de èrwéi kōngjiān.
examples.english: In geometry, a plane is an infinitely extending two-dimensional space.

examples.chinese: 她是一名平面設計師，擅長為品牌設計視覺識別系統。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī míng píngmiàn shèjìshī, shàncháng wèi pǐnpái shèjì shìjué shíbié xìtǒng.
examples.english: She is a graphic designer specializing in creating visual identity systems for brands.

semanticNote: Flat and smooth — of terrain, roads, or surfaces. 平坦的道路 (a flat/smooth road), 地形平坦 (flat terrain). Figurative: 人生的道路不總是平坦的 (the road of life is not always smooth). More literary than 平 (flat) alone.

components.meaning: flat; candid; frank; at ease; open

examples.chinese: 臺灣西部地形平坦，是主要的農業耕作區；東部則多山地。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xībù dìxíng píngtǎn, shì zhǔyào de nóngyè gēngzuò qū; dōngbù zé duō shāndì.
examples.english: Western Taiwan has flat terrain and is the main agricultural area; the east has mostly mountains.

examples.chinese: 她在平坦的跑道上奔跑，速度越來越快，最終打破了個人紀錄。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài píngtǎn de pǎodào shàng bēnpǎo, sùdù yuèláiyuè kuài, zuìzhōng dǎpò le gèrén jìlù.
examples.english: She ran on the flat track, picking up speed until she finally broke her personal record.

semanticNote: Parallel — of lines that never meet, or things happening concurrently. 平行線 (parallel lines), 平行進行 (proceed concurrently), 平行宇宙 (parallel universe), 平行進口 (parallel imports — a business/legal term in Taiwan). Very common across everyday, scientific, and business contexts.

examples.chinese: 在幾何學中，兩條平行線永遠不會相交。
examples.pinyin: Zài jǐhéxué zhōng, liǎng tiáo píngxíng xiàn yǒngyuǎn bù huì xiāngjiāo.
examples.english: In geometry, two parallel lines will never intersect.

examples.chinese: 公司決定同時推動兩個平行的研發計畫，以加快產品上市的速度。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng tóngshí tuīdòng liǎng gè píngxíng de yánfā jìhuà, yǐ jiākuài chǎnpǐn shàngshì de sùdù.
examples.english: The company decided to advance two parallel R&D projects simultaneously to speed up the product launch.

semanticNote: Mediocre — ordinary and lacking distinction or excellence. 平庸之輩 (mediocre people), 甘於平庸 (content with mediocrity). A slightly critical or dismissive term — implies failing to rise above average. Contrasts with 卓越/傑出 (outstanding/distinguished).

examples.chinese: 他不甘於平庸，立志要在業界做出一番成績。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù gān yú píngyōng, lìzhì yào zài yèjiè zuòchū yī fān chéngjì.
examples.english: He refused to settle for mediocrity and was determined to make his mark in the industry.

examples.chinese: 這部電影情節平庸，缺乏創意，令觀眾大失所望。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng qíngjié píngyōng, quēfá chuàngyì, lìng guānzhòng dà shī suǒ wàng.
examples.english: This film had a mediocre plot lacking creativity, leaving audiences deeply disappointed.

semanticNote: A flat geographic plain. 一望無際的平原 (an endless plain), 嘉南平原 (Chianan Plain — Taiwan's main agricultural area). Contrasts with 山地 (mountainous area) and 丘陵 (hills). Taiwan's western plains are the main agricultural and population areas.

examples.chinese: 嘉南平原土地肥沃，長期是臺灣最重要的糧食生產區。
examples.pinyin: Jiānán píngyuán tǔdì féiwò, chángqī shì Táiwān zuì zhòngyào de liángshí shēngchǎnqū.
examples.english: The Chianan Plain has fertile soil and has long been Taiwan's most important food-producing area.

examples.chinese: 站在山頂俯瞰，廣闊的平原一望無際，景色令人震撼。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shāndǐng fǔkàn, guǎngkuò de píngyuán yī wàng wú jì, jǐngsè lìng rén zhènhàn.
examples.english: Looking down from the mountaintop, the vast plain stretched endlessly to the horizon — the scenery was awe-inspiring.

semanticNote: To evaluate, assess, or appraise — of risk, performance, or impact. 風險評估 (risk assessment), 績效評估 (performance appraisal), 環境影響評估 (environmental impact assessment — 環評). More systematic and professional than 評價 (evaluate/comment on).

components.meaning: comment on; review; judge; rate; assess

examples.chinese: 公司每年進行績效評估，根據結果決定員工的調薪與晉升。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měinián jìnxíng jìxiào pínggū, gēnjù jiéguǒ juédìng yuángōng de diào xīn yǔ jìnshēng.
examples.english: The company conducts annual performance appraisals, using the results to determine salary adjustments and promotions for employees.

examples.chinese: 在重大建設動工之前，必須先完成環境影響評估的審查程序。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhòngdà jiànshè dōnggōng zhīqián, bìxū xiān wánchéng huánjìng yǐngxiǎng pínggū de shěnchá chéngxù.
examples.english: Before major construction projects can begin, the environmental impact assessment review process must first be completed.

semanticNote: A comment, review, or critical commentary. 發表評論 (make a comment), 時事評論 (current affairs commentary), 網路評論 (online review/comment). Broader than 批評 (criticism — only negative) — 評論 can be positive, negative, or neutral analysis.

examples.chinese: 這部電影上映後，各大媒體紛紛發表評論，褒貶不一。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shàngyìng hòu, gèdà méitǐ fēnfēn fābiǎo pínglùn, bāobiǎn bùyī.
examples.english: After the film was released, major media outlets published reviews — opinions were mixed.

examples.chinese: 她在社群平台上的美食評論深受粉絲喜愛，吸引了大批追蹤者。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shèqún píngtái shàng de měishí pínglùn shēn shòu fěnsī xǐ'ài, xīyǐn le dà pī zhuīzōng zhě.
examples.english: Her food reviews on social media platforms are very popular with fans and have attracted a large following.

semanticNote: A screen or display (TV, computer, phone). In everyday Taiwan speech, 螢幕 (yíngmù) is far more common than 屏幕 — 屏幕 is the Mainland term and appears mainly in technical or imported-software contexts. 觸控屏幕 (touchscreen), 屏幕保護程式 (screensaver).

examples.chinese: 這台筆記型電腦的屏幕解析度很高，畫面非常清晰細緻。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái bǐjìxíng diànnǎo de píngmù jiěxī dù hěn gāo, huàmiàn fēicháng qīngxī xìzhì.
examples.english: This laptop's screen resolution is very high, and the picture is extremely sharp and detailed.

examples.chinese: 長時間盯著手機屏幕容易造成眼睛疲勞，建議每小時休息一下。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān dīngzhe shǒujī píngmù róngyì zàochéng yǎnjīng píláo, jiànyì měi xiǎoshí xiūxí yīxià.
examples.english: Staring at your phone screen for long periods easily causes eye fatigue — it's recommended to take a break every hour.

semanticNote: A barrier or protective screen/shield — physical or figurative. 天然屏障 (natural barrier, e.g. mountains), 防護屏障 (protective barrier). More literary/formal than 牆壁 (wall) or 障礙 (obstacle), emphasizing a protective function.

examples.chinese: 中央山脈是臺灣東部對抗颱風的天然屏障。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyāng shānmài shì Táiwān dōngbù duìkàng táifēng de tiānrán píngzhàng.
examples.english: The Central Mountain Range is a natural barrier protecting eastern Taiwan against typhoons.

examples.chinese: 良好的防火牆能夠成為企業資訊安全的重要屏障。
examples.pinyin: Liánghǎo de fánghuǒqiáng nénggòu chéngwéi qǐyè zīxùn ānquán de zhòngyào píngzhàng.
examples.english: A good firewall can serve as an important barrier for a company's information security.

semanticNote: A slope or incline — of land, roads, or hills. 上坡/下坡 (uphill/downhill), 山坡 (hillside), 坡度 (gradient). Often used as a suffix in compound nouns describing terrain.

examples.chinese: 這條山路坡度很陡，騎自行車上坡相當吃力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù pōdù hěn dǒu, qí zìxíngchē shàngpō xiāngdāng chīlì.
examples.english: This mountain road has a very steep grade — riding a bike uphill is quite exhausting.

examples.chinese: 房子建在山坡上，從陽台可以俯瞰整個山谷的景色。
examples.pinyin: Fángzi jiàn zài shānpō shàng, cóng yángtái kěyǐ fǔkàn zhěnggè shāngǔ de jǐngsè.
examples.english: The house is built on a hillside, and from the balcony you can look down over the entire valley.

english: to splash; to spill; rude and unreasonable; brutish
semanticNote: As a verb, 潑 means to splash or spill liquid — 潑水 (splash water, famous from 潑水節, the Water-Splashing Festival). As an adjective (often 潑辣), it describes someone shrewish, unreasonable, or aggressively forceful — slightly derogatory, as in 潑婦 (shrew).

examples.chinese: 小心一點，別把湯潑到桌上了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn yīdiǎn, bié bǎ tāng pō dào zhuō shàng le!
examples.english: Be careful, don't spill the soup on the table!

examples.chinese: 她在菜市場跟攤販大吵大鬧，行為十分潑辣，讓周圍的人都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài càishìchǎng gēn tānfàn dà chǎo dà nào, xíngwéi shífēn pōlà, ràng zhōuwéi de rén dōu xià le yī tiào.
examples.english: She had a huge shouting match with a vendor at the market, behaving so shrewishly that everyone around was startled.

english: rather; quite; inclined to one side
semanticNote: 頗 is a formal/literary adverb meaning 'quite' or 'rather' — e.g. 頗為滿意 (quite satisfied), 頗有道理 (makes quite a lot of sense). More bookish than 相當/挺/很 — common in news writing and formal speech, less so in casual conversation.

examples.chinese: 這項新政策推出後，社會各界的反應頗為兩極。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè tuīchū hòu, shèhuì gèjiè de fǎnyìng pō wéi liǎngjí.
examples.english: After this new policy was introduced, reactions from various sectors of society were quite polarized.

examples.chinese: 對於這次的考試成績，他感到頗為滿意。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhè cì de kǎoshì chéngjì, tā gǎndào pō wéi mǎnyì.
examples.english: He felt quite satisfied with his exam results this time.

semanticNote: A chengyu describing eagerness so strong one cannot wait — 'can't wait to...'. Often used positively for excitement, e.g. 迫不及待想要... Common in everyday speech, not overly formal.

examples.chinese: 收到入學通知後，她迫不及待地打電話告訴爸媽這個好消息。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào rùxué tōngzhī hòu, tā pòbùjídài de dǎ diànhuà gàosù bàmā zhège hǎo xiāoxī.
examples.english: After receiving the admission notice, she couldn't wait to call her parents to tell them the good news.

examples.chinese: 孩子們迫不及待地拆開禮物，臉上滿是興奮的笑容。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen pòbùjídài de chāikāi lǐwù, liǎn shàng mǎn shì xīngfèn de xiàoróng.
examples.english: The children couldn't wait to unwrap their presents, their faces full of excited smiles.

semanticNote: To persecute, especially politically or for one's beliefs — implies systematic, often state-sponsored oppression. 政治迫害 (political persecution), 宗教迫害 (religious persecution). A serious, formal term used in historical, political, and human-rights contexts.

examples.chinese: 許多人權團體長期關注政治犯遭受迫害的問題。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rénquán tuántǐ chángqí guānzhù zhèngzhìfàn zāoshòu pòhài de wèntí.
examples.english: Many human rights groups have long been concerned about the persecution of political prisoners.

examples.chinese: 在那段歷史時期，許多知識分子因為言論而遭到迫害。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà duàn lìshǐ shíqí, xǔduō zhīshì fènzǐ yīnwèi yánlùn ér zāodào pòhài.
examples.english: During that period of history, many intellectuals were persecuted because of their speech.

semanticNote: To break with usual rules or precedent to make an exception, usually for special circumstances. 破例允許 (exceptionally allow), 從不破例 (never make an exception). Implies departing from established practice, often as a favor.

examples.chinese: 由於情況特殊，主管決定破例讓他提前下班照顧生病的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qíngkuàng tèshū, zhǔguǎn juédìng pòlì ràng tā tíqián xiàbān zhàogù shēngbìng de háizi.
examples.english: Given the special circumstances, the supervisor decided to make an exception and let him leave work early to care for his sick child.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳平時不接受訂位，但這次破例為老顧客保留了位子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng píngshí bù jiēshòu dìngwèi, dàn zhè cì pòlì wèi lǎo gùkè bǎoliú le wèizi.
examples.english: This restaurant doesn't normally accept reservations, but this time it made an exception and reserved a table for a longtime customer.

semanticNote: The boldness and decisiveness to act despite risk, often praised in leaders. 有魄力 (decisive/bold), 領導魄力 (leadership courage). Distinct from 勇氣 (courage facing danger) — 魄力 specifically refers to decisive action in management or leadership.

examples.chinese: 這位新任市長行事果斷、富有魄力，上任後立刻著手改革。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xīnrèn shìzhǎng xíngshì guǒduàn, fùyǒu pòlì, shàngrèn hòu lìkè zhuóshǒu gǎigé.
examples.english: The newly appointed mayor acts decisively and with great resolve — he began reforms immediately after taking office.

examples.chinese: 面對市場的劇變，企業需要有魄力的領導者來做出快速的決策。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì shìchǎng de jùbiàn, qǐyè xūyào yǒu pòlì de lǐngdǎo zhě lái zuòchū kuàisù de juécè.
examples.english: In the face of dramatic market changes, a company needs a bold leader who can make quick decisions.

english: to assault; rush at; throw oneself on
semanticNote: To pounce, lunge, or rush at something suddenly, often with force. 撲過去 (lunge/rush toward), 飛蛾撲火 (a moth flying into a flame — idiom for self-destructive behavior), 撲滅 (extinguish/stamp out, e.g. a fire or epidemic).

examples.chinese: 一聞到食物的香味，小狗立刻撲了過去。
examples.pinyin: Yī wéndào shíwù de xiāngwèi, xiǎo gǒu lìkè pū le guòqù.
examples.english: As soon as the dog smelled the food, it immediately pounced toward it.

examples.chinese: 消防隊員迅速撲滅了大火，避免火勢進一步擴大。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofáng duìyuán xùnsù pūmiè le dàhuǒ, bìmiǎn huǒshì jìnyībù kuòdà.
examples.english: The firefighters quickly extinguished the fire, preventing it from spreading further.

english: bed; store | to spread; to lay
semanticNote: Two readings with distinct meanings: as pù (noun), 鋪 means a shop or stall — 店鋪 (store), 藥鋪 (pharmacy/herbal shop), 床鋪 (bed). As pū (verb), it means to spread out or lay down — 鋪路 (pave a road), 鋪床 (make a bed). Both readings are common.

components.meaning: shop; bed; spread out; lay; pave

examples.chinese: 巷子裡有一家經營了三十年的老字號餅鋪。
examples.pinyin: Xiàngzi lǐ yǒu yī jiā jīngyíng le sānshí nián de lǎozìhào bǐngpù.
examples.english: There's a long-established pastry shop in the alley that has been running for thirty years.

examples.chinese: 工人們正在路面上鋪柏油，準備修整這條道路。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài lùmiàn shàng pū bóyóu, zhǔnbèi xiūzhěng zhè tiáo dàolù.
examples.english: Workers are laying asphalt on the road surface, preparing to repair this road.

semanticNote: Describes a person's character or a thing's style as plain, simple, and unpretentious — in a positive sense. 樸實的生活 (a simple, unpretentious life), 為人樸實 (down-to-earth in character). Often contrasted with 浮華 (showy/superficial).

examples.chinese: 他從小在鄉下長大，為人樸實，從不愛炫耀。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo zài xiāngxià zhǎngdà, wéirén pǔshí, cóng bù ài xuànyào.
examples.english: He grew up in the countryside and has always been down-to-earth, never one to show off.

examples.chinese: 這間民宿裝潢樸實，卻處處充滿主人的用心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān mínsù zhuānghuáng pǔshí, què chùchù chōngmǎn zhǔrén de yòngxīn.
examples.english: This homestay's décor is simple and unpretentious, yet filled everywhere with the host's thoughtful care.

semanticNote: Plain and simple, especially regarding lifestyle, dress, or appearance — implies modesty and lack of extravagance. 衣著樸素 (dressed simply), 生活樸素 (a frugal lifestyle). Similar to 樸實 but 樸素 focuses more on outward appearance/style, while 樸實 focuses more on character.

examples.chinese: 儘管家境富裕，她平時穿著卻十分樸素，從不鋪張。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jiājìng fùyù, tā píngshí chuānzhuó què shífēn pǔsù, cóng bù pūzhāng.
examples.english: Although her family is well-off, she usually dresses very plainly and never shows off.

examples.chinese: 老一輩的人多半生活樸素，捨不得浪費任何一分錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo yī bèi de rén duōbàn shēnghuó pǔsù, shěbude làngfèi rèn yī fēn qián.
examples.english: People of the older generation mostly live simple lives and are reluctant to waste even a single cent.

semanticNote: To popularize or become widespread, often of technology, education, or knowledge becoming accessible to the masses. 普及教育 (universal education), 網路普及率 (internet penetration rate), 智慧型手機已經非常普及 (smartphones have become very widespread).

examples.chinese: 隨著科技進步，智慧型手機在臺灣已經相當普及。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì jìnbù, zhìhuìxíng shǒujī zài Táiwān yǐjīng xiāngdāng pǔjí.
examples.english: With advances in technology, smartphones have become quite widespread in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 政府致力於普及偏鄉地區的網路建設，縮小城鄉差距。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhìlì yú pǔjí piānxiāng dìqū de wǎnglù jiànshè, suōxiǎo chéngxiāng chājù.
examples.english: The government is working to extend internet infrastructure to remote areas, narrowing the urban-rural gap.

semanticNote: A waterfall — a common scenic and tourism word. 十分瀑布 (Shifen Waterfall, a famous Taiwan tourist spot). Concrete noun with no special register issues.

examples.chinese: 這座瀑布從數十公尺高的懸崖傾瀉而下，氣勢驚人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò pùbù cóng shù shí gōngchǐ gāo de xuányá qīngxiè ér xià, qìshì jīngrén.
examples.english: This waterfall cascades down from a cliff dozens of meters high — its power is breathtaking.

examples.chinese: 夏天到瀑布旁戲水，是許多家庭最喜愛的消暑活動之一。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān dào pùbù páng xìshuǐ, shì xǔduō jiātíng zuì xǐ'ài de xiāoshǔ huódòng zhī yī.
examples.english: Playing in the water near a waterfall in summer is one of many families' favorite ways to beat the heat.

english: desolate; feel like no one likes you
semanticNote: Desolate, bleak, and forlorn — describes scenery, atmosphere, or one's life situation, often evoking pity. 晚景淒涼 (a desolate old age), 景色淒涼 (a bleak scene). Literary and emotionally evocative — common in descriptions of loneliness or decline.

examples.chinese: 老屋早已荒廢，雜草叢生，景象十分淒涼。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo wū zǎo yǐ huāngfèi, zácǎo cóngshēng, jǐngxiàng shífēn qīliáng.
examples.english: The old house has long since fallen into disrepair, overgrown with weeds — the scene is utterly desolate.

examples.chinese: 他晚年孤身一人，過得相當淒涼，令人感到心酸。
examples.pinyin: Tā wǎnnián gūshēn yī rén, guò de xiāngdāng qīliáng, lìng rén gǎndào xīnsuān.
examples.english: In his later years he lived alone, in rather desolate circumstances — it was heartbreaking to see.

semanticNote: To hope for or expect something, often with a sense of trust or reliance placed on someone. 父母的期望 (parents' expectations), 期望值 (expected value, also used statistically). More formal than 希望 — often implies expectations placed on a person by others.

examples.chinese: 父母對孩子的期望往往會在無形中造成壓力。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi de qīwàng wǎngwǎng huì zài wúxíng zhōng zàochéng yālì.
examples.english: Parents' expectations of their children often create pressure in invisible ways.

examples.chinese: 這部續集的票房表現並未達到製片公司的期望。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xùjí de piàofáng biǎoxiàn bìng wèi dádào zhìpiàn gōngsī de qīwàng.
examples.english: The box office performance of this sequel did not meet the production company's expectations.

semanticNote: A deadline or time limit — a fixed point by which something must be done. 截止期限 (deadline), 保存期限 (expiration/shelf-life date — very common on packaged food in Taiwan), 合約期限 (contract term).

examples.chinese: 這份報告的繳交期限是下週五，請大家務必準時提交。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de jiǎojiāo qīxiàn shì xià zhōu wǔ, qǐng dàjiā wùbì zhǔnshí tíjiāo.
examples.english: The deadline for submitting this report is next Friday — please be sure to submit it on time.

examples.chinese: 購買食品前，記得先檢查包裝上標示的保存期限。
examples.pinyin: Gòumǎi shípǐn qián, jìde xiān jiǎnchá bāozhuāng shàng biāoshì de bǎocún qīxiàn.
examples.english: Before buying food, remember to check the expiration date printed on the packaging.

semanticNote: To bully, mistreat, or take advantage of someone weaker. 欺負弱小 (bully the weak). 校園霸凌 (school bullying) is the more formal term for systemic bullying, while 欺負 describes the act itself, often used colloquially, including between children.

examples.chinese: 老師發現有同學在欺負新轉來的學生，立刻出面處理。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī fāxiàn yǒu tóngxué zài qīfu xīn zhuǎn lái de xuéshēng, lìkè chūmiàn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The teacher noticed some classmates were bullying the newly transferred student and immediately stepped in to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 他從小被哥哥欺負慣了，長大後反而變得特別獨立堅強。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo bèi gēge qīfu guàn le, zhǎngdà hòu fǎn'ér biàn de tèbié dúlì jiānqiáng.
examples.english: He was used to being bullied by his older brother since childhood, but as an adult he became especially independent and strong instead.

semanticNote: To deceive or cheat someone, often through lies. 欺騙感情 (deceive someone's feelings, e.g. in a relationship), 受騙 (be deceived). More serious/formal than 騙 alone — implies a deliberate, often harmful deception.

examples.chinese: 他編造謊言欺騙投資人，最終被檢警調查並起訴。
examples.pinyin: Tā biānzào huǎngyán qīpiàn tóuzīrén, zuìzhōng bèi jiǎnjǐng diàochá bìng qǐsù.
examples.english: He fabricated lies to deceive investors and was eventually investigated and indicted by prosecutors and police.

examples.chinese: 她發現自己一直被男友欺騙感情，傷心欲絕。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ yīzhí bèi nányǒu qīpiàn gǎnqíng, shāngxīn yù jué.
examples.english: She discovered that her boyfriend had been deceiving her feelings all along, and she was devastated.

semanticNote: Complete, comprehensive — everything that should be present, is present. 設備齊全 (fully equipped), 證件齊全 (all documents in order). Common in describing facilities, inventories, or paperwork.

examples.chinese: 這間健身房的設備相當齊全，從重訓器材到有氧課程都有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān jiànshēn fáng de shèbèi xiāngdāng qíquán, cóng zhòngxùn qìcái dào yǒuyǎng kèchéng dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This gym's equipment is quite complete, from weight-training machines to aerobics classes.

examples.chinese: 辦理簽證前，請先確認所有證件都已準備齊全。
examples.pinyin: Bànlǐ qiānzhèng qián, qǐng xiān quèrèn suǒyǒu zhèngjiàn dōu yǐ zhǔnbèi qíquán.
examples.english: Before applying for a visa, please first make sure all documents are fully prepared.

semanticNote: A chengyu meaning to unite efforts toward a common goal — 'pull together'. Often used in team, community, or national contexts. 齊心協力克服困難 (work together to overcome difficulties).

examples.chinese: 面對這次的天災，社區居民齊心協力清理街道、互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhè cì de tiānzāi, shèqū jūmín qíxīnxiélì qīnglǐ jiēdào, hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: Faced with this natural disaster, community residents worked together to clean up the streets and help one another.

examples.chinese: 只要全公司齊心協力，這個專案一定能如期完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào quán gōngsī qíxīnxiélì, zhège zhuān'àn yīdìng néng rúqí wánchéng.
examples.english: As long as the whole company pulls together, this project can definitely be completed on schedule.

semanticNote: Marvelous, fascinating, or mysteriously wonderful — often describes nature, experiences, or coincidences with a sense of wonder. 奇妙的緣分 (a wonderful, fateful coincidence), 大自然的奇妙 (the wonders of nature).

examples.chinese: 海底世界充滿了各種奇妙的生物，讓人大開眼界。
examples.pinyin: Hǎidǐ shìjiè chōngmǎn le gèzhǒng qímiào de shēngwù, ràng rén dà kāi yǎnjiè.
examples.english: The undersea world is full of all kinds of wondrous creatures, opening one's eyes to amazing sights.

examples.chinese: 兩人在異國相遇，展開了一段奇妙的緣分。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng rén zài yìguó xiāngyù, zhǎnkāi le yī duàn qímiào de yuánfèn.
examples.english: The two met in a foreign country, beginning a wonderful, fateful connection.

semanticNote: To discriminate against someone unfairly, based on race, gender, age, etc. 性別歧視 (gender discrimination), 種族歧視 (racial discrimination), 職場歧視 (workplace discrimination). A formal term common in social, legal, and human-rights discussions.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的法律明文禁止雇主因性別或年齡歧視求職者。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de fǎlǜ míngwén jìnzhǐ gùzhǔ yīn xìngbié huò niánlíng qíshì qiúzhízhě.
examples.english: Taiwan's laws explicitly prohibit employers from discriminating against job applicants based on gender or age.

examples.chinese: 他因為自己的口音而遭到同事歧視，感到非常難過。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi zìjǐ de kǒuyīn ér zāodào tóngshì qíshì, gǎndào fēicháng nánguò.
examples.english: He felt very upset about being discriminated against by colleagues because of his accent.

semanticNote: A form-fitting traditional Chinese dress, often worn at formal occasions or weddings. Concrete cultural noun, no special register issues. 旗袍秀 (cheongsam fashion show).

examples.chinese: 新娘在婚宴上換上一件繡花旗袍，展現古典優雅的氣質。
examples.pinyin: Xīnniáng zài hūnyàn shàng huànshàng yī jiàn xiùhuā qípáo, zhǎnxiàn gǔdiǎn yōuyǎ de qìzhí.
examples.english: The bride changed into an embroidered cheongsam at the wedding banquet, displaying classic elegance.

examples.chinese: 這家裁縫店專門為顧客量身訂做傳統旗袍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cáiféng diàn zhuānmén wèi gùkè liángshēn dìngzuò chuántǒng qípáo.
examples.english: This tailor shop specializes in making custom-fitted traditional cheongsams for customers.

semanticNote: A flag or banner, often used figuratively for a cause, ideology, or symbol that people rally behind. 高舉……的旗幟 (raise the banner of...). More formal/figurative than 旗子 (a literal flag).

examples.chinese: 廣場上飄揚著各國代表隊的旗幟，氣氛十分熱烈。
examples.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shàng piāoyáng zhe gèguó dàibiǎoduì de qízhì, qìfēn shífēn rèliè.
examples.english: National flags of the various delegations fluttered in the square, creating a lively atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 這項運動高舉環保的旗幟，吸引了許多年輕人響應。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yùndòng gāojǔ huánbǎo de qízhì, xīyǐn le xǔduō niánqīngrén xiǎngyìng.
examples.english: This movement raises the banner of environmental protection and has attracted many young people to respond.

semanticNote: A beggar — someone who begs for money or food. Neutral descriptive term, though context can carry pity or social commentary; 街友 is the more common, euphemistic term in Taiwan for the homeless.

examples.chinese: 街角坐著一位乞丐，向路過的行人伸手乞討。
examples.pinyin: Jiējiǎo zuò zhe yī wèi qǐgài, xiàng lùguò de xíngrén shēnshǒu qǐtǎo.
examples.english: A beggar sat on the street corner, holding out a hand to passersby.

examples.chinese: 政府推出多項社會福利政策，希望能減少乞丐與街友的人數。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū duō xiàng shèhuì fúlì zhèngcè, xīwàng néng jiǎnshǎo qǐgài yǔ jiēyǒu de rénshù.
examples.english: The government has rolled out several social-welfare policies, hoping to reduce the number of beggars and homeless people.

semanticNote: An exclamation expressing indignation — 'how outrageous!' or 'that's absurd!'. Used when something is so unreasonable it defies logic. Common in spoken complaints and dramatic dialogue.

examples.chinese: 餐廳竟然多收我們一倍的費用，真是豈有此理！
examples.pinyin: Cāntīng jìngrán duō shōu wǒmen yī bèi de fèiyòng, zhēnshi qǐyǒucǐlǐ!
examples.english: The restaurant actually charged us double the fee — it's absolutely outrageous!

examples.chinese: 他工作沒做好，反而怪我們監督不周，真是豈有此理。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò méi zuò hǎo, fǎn'ér guài wǒmen jiāndū bùzhōu, zhēnshi qǐyǒucǐlǐ.
examples.english: He did a poor job and then blamed us for not supervising him properly — how absurd.

semanticNote: To attempt or scheme to do something, often with negative connotation — implies an ulterior or improper motive. 企圖逃跑 (attempt to escape), 不良企圖 (ill intentions). More negative than 嘗試 (a neutral attempt).

components.meaning: plan; hope for; stand on tiptoe

examples.chinese: 警方查獲一名企圖闖入民宅行竊的嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng cháhuò yī míng qǐtú chuǎngrù mínzhái xíngqiè de xiányírén.
examples.english: Police apprehended a suspect who attempted to break into a residence to steal.

examples.chinese: 對方提出的合作方案，背後似乎隱藏著不可告人的企圖。
examples.pinyin: Duìfāng tíchū de hézuò fāng'àn, bèihòu sìhū yǐncáng zhe bùkěgàorén de qǐtú.
examples.english: The cooperation proposal the other party put forward seems to conceal some hidden, undisclosed agenda.

semanticNote: To set out or depart on a journey — formal/written register. 即將啟程 (about to set off). Taiwan standard writes this character as 啟 (not the variant 啓). More formal than 出發, often used in travel announcements and formal writing.

examples.chinese: 探險隊已做好充分的準備，明日將啟程前往南極。
examples.pinyin: Tànxiǎn duì yǐ zuò hǎo chōngfèn de zhǔnbèi, míngrì jiāng qǐchéng qiánwǎng nánjí.
examples.english: The expedition team has made full preparations and will set out for Antarctica tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 飛機將於清晨六點啟程，請旅客提早抵達機場辦理登機手續。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī jiāng yú qīngchén liù diǎn qǐchéng, qǐng lǚkè zǎo dǐdá jīchǎng bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù.
examples.english: The flight will depart at 6 a.m., so passengers are asked to arrive at the airport early to check in.

english: enlighten; enlightenment； instruct the young; to initiate
semanticNote: To enlighten or impart basic/foundational knowledge, especially to children or in intellectual history. 啟蒙教育 (early childhood education), 啟蒙運動 (the Enlightenment), 啟蒙老師 (the teacher who first introduced someone to a subject). Taiwan standard uses 啟 (not 啓).

examples.chinese: 十八世紀的啟蒙運動為歐洲帶來理性與科學的思潮。
examples.pinyin: Shíbā shìjì de qǐméng yùndòng wèi Ōuzhōu dàilái lǐxìng yǔ kēxué de sīcháo.
examples.english: The 18th-century Enlightenment brought a wave of rationalist and scientific thought to Europe.

examples.chinese: 這位老師是我學習繪畫的啟蒙老師，影響我至今。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī shì wǒ xuéxí huìhuà de qǐméng lǎoshī, yǐngxiǎng wǒ zhìjīn.
examples.english: This teacher was the one who first introduced me to painting, and her influence has stayed with me to this day.

semanticNote: A revelation, insight, or lesson that prompts deeper understanding — often drawn from an experience, story, or event. 帶來啟示 (bring/offer insight), 給人啟示 (offer a lesson to people). Taiwan standard uses 啟. More reflective/philosophical than 教訓 (lesson, often implies punishment).

examples.chinese: 這次失敗的經驗給了他一個重要的啟示：謙虛才能進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài de jīngyàn gěi le tā yī gè zhòngyào de qǐshì: qiānxū cái néng jìnbù.
examples.english: This failure gave him an important insight: only humility leads to progress.

examples.chinese: 這部紀錄片帶給觀眾深刻的啟示，引發大家對環境議題的反思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn dài gěi guānzhòng shēnkè de qǐshì, yǐnfā dàjiā duì huánjìng yìtí de fǎnsī.
examples.english: This documentary offers viewers profound insight, prompting reflection on environmental issues.

english: announcement; public information (usually posted on a billboard)
semanticNote: A public notice or announcement, typically posted on a board, online, or in a newspaper. 徵人啟事 (job-wanted notice), 尋人啟事 (missing-person notice), 道歉啟事 (public apology notice). Taiwan standard uses 啟. Same pinyin as 啟示 but different meaning — 啟事 is a posted notice, 啟示 is an insight/revelation.

examples.chinese: 公司在公告欄貼出徵人啟事，招募新進員工。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zài gōnggàolán tiē chū zhēngrén qǐshì, zhāomù xīnjìn yuángōng.
examples.english: The company posted a job notice on the bulletin board, recruiting new employees.

examples.chinese: 他在報紙上刊登尋人啟事，希望能找到失蹤多年的父親。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàozhǐ shàng kāndēng xúnrén qǐshì, xīwàng néng zhǎodào shīzōng duōnián de fùqīn.
examples.english: He placed a missing-person notice in the newspaper, hoping to find his father who had been missing for many years.

semanticNote: To draft a document, bill, plan, or contract — the first step before formal review/finalization. 起草法案 (draft a bill), 起草合約 (draft a contract). Formal, used in legal, governmental, and business contexts.

examples.chinese: 立法委員正在起草一項保護動物權益的新法案。
examples.pinyin: Lìfǎ wěiyuán zhèngzài qǐcǎo yī xiàng bǎohù dòngwù quányì de xīn fǎ'àn.
examples.english: The legislator is drafting a new bill to protect animal welfare.

examples.chinese: 律師已經起草好合約草案，等待雙方確認後正式簽署。
