examples.pinyin: Lǜshī yǐjīng qǐcǎo hǎo héyuē cǎo'àn, děngdài shuāngfāng quèrèn hòu zhèngshì qiānshǔ.
examples.english: The lawyer has already drafted the contract and is waiting for both parties to confirm it before formal signing.

english: at first; originally; in the beginning
semanticNote: At the start of a sequence of events, often contrasted with what happened later (用後來/最後 to contrast). 起初……後來…… (at first... later...). More literary/written than 一開始, though both are common.

examples.chinese: 起初大家都不看好這個計畫，但後來證明它非常成功。
examples.pinyin: Qǐchū dàjiā dōu bù kànhǎo zhège jìhuà, dàn hòulái zhèngmíng tā fēicháng chénggōng.
examples.english: At first, everyone was skeptical of this plan, but it later proved to be very successful.

examples.chinese: 起初他對臺灣的飲食文化感到陌生，現在卻已經完全習慣了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐchū tā duì Táiwān de yǐnshí wénhuà gǎndào mòshēng, xiànzài què yǐjīng wánquán xíguàn le.
examples.english: At first he felt unfamiliar with Taiwan's food culture, but now he has gotten completely used to it.

english: ups and downs; with a wavy motion
semanticNote: Rising and falling — literally of terrain or waves, figuratively of emotions, fortunes, or markets. 心情起伏 (emotional ups and downs), 起伏不定 (fluctuating/unstable), 地勢起伏 (undulating terrain).

examples.chinese: 這條山路地勢起伏，沿途風景十分優美。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù dìshì qǐfú, yántú fēngjǐng shífēn yōuměi.
examples.english: This mountain road has undulating terrain, and the scenery along the way is very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 股市最近起伏劇烈，許多投資人都感到不安。
examples.pinyin: Gǔshì zuìjìn qǐfú jùliè, xǔduō tóuzīrén dōu gǎndào bù'ān.
examples.english: The stock market has been fluctuating wildly lately, making many investors feel uneasy.

semanticNote: To stir up a commotion, often by a group joining in to tease, jeer, or create a ruckus — can be playful or disruptive. 在旁起哄 (egg on/heckle from the sidelines), 群眾起哄 (the crowd causes an uproar). Colloquial.

examples.chinese: 同學們在台下起哄，讓上台演講的人緊張得說不出話來。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen zài tái xià qǐhòng, ràng shàng tái yǎnjiǎng de rén jǐnzhāng de shuō bù chū huà lái.
examples.english: The classmates in the audience were making a ruckus, making the person on stage so nervous he couldn't speak.

examples.chinese: 看到有人吵架，路人紛紛圍過來起哄，場面一度十分混亂。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào yǒurén chǎojià, lùrén fēnfēn wéi guòlái qǐhòng, chǎngmiàn yī dù shífēn hùnluàn.
examples.english: Seeing people arguing, passersby gathered around to egg them on, and the scene became quite chaotic for a while.

english: at the minimum; at the very least
semanticNote: At the very least — sets a minimum bar/expectation. 起碼的尊重 (basic respect), 起碼也要... (at the very least, should...). Colloquial, common in spoken complaints about unmet minimum standards.

examples.chinese: 不管多忙，起碼也要打個電話跟家人報平安吧。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn duō máng, qǐmǎ yě yào dǎ ge diànhuà gēn jiārén bào píng'ān ba.
examples.english: No matter how busy you are, you should at least call your family to let them know you're okay.

examples.chinese: 即使意見不同，起碼的尊重還是要有的。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ yìjiàn bùtóng, qǐmǎ de zūnzhòng háishì yào yǒu de.
examples.english: Even if opinions differ, basic mutual respect is still necessary.

semanticNote: The origin or source of something — often used for cultures, species, ideas, or historical phenomena. 起源於... (originate from...), 文化起源 (cultural origins). More formal/academic than 來源 (source, more general).

examples.chinese: 關於人類語言的起源，學界至今仍有許多不同的理論。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú rénlèi yǔyán de qǐyuán, xuéjiè zhìjīn réng yǒu xǔduō bùtóng de lǐlùn.
examples.english: Regarding the origin of human language, academics still have many differing theories to this day.

examples.chinese: 這項傳統習俗起源於古代的祭祀活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chuántǒng xísú qǐyuán yú gǔdài de jìsì huódòng.
examples.english: This traditional custom originated from ancient sacrificial rituals.

semanticNote: An admirable spirit or bearing — courage, integrity, and dignity combined. 英雄氣概 (heroic spirit), 大丈夫氣概 (manly fortitude/integrity). Formal/literary, used to praise someone's noble character or strength of spirit.

examples.chinese: 他面對強敵毫不退縮，展現出令人敬佩的英雄氣概。
examples.pinyin: Tā miànduì qiángdí háo bù tuìsuō, zhǎnxiàn chū lìng rén jìngpèi de yīngxióng qìgài.
examples.english: He didn't back down at all in the face of a strong opponent, displaying admirable heroic spirit.

examples.chinese: 真正的領導者應該具備不畏艱難的氣概。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de lǐngdǎo zhě yīnggāi jùbèi bù wèi jiānnán de qìgài.
examples.english: A true leader should possess the spirit of not fearing hardship.

english: Qi Gong, a system of deep breathing exercises
semanticNote: Qigong — a system of breathing exercises and movements rooted in traditional Chinese medicine, often linked to martial arts or health cultivation. 練氣功 (practice qigong), 氣功大師 (qigong master). Cultural/health term, neutral.

examples.chinese: 許多長輩每天早上會到公園練氣功，藉此保持身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō zhǎngbèi měitiān zǎoshàng huì dào gōngyuán liàn qìgōng, jíecǐ bǎochí shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Many elderly people go to the park every morning to practice qigong to stay healthy.

examples.chinese: 氣功講究呼吸與動作的配合，講求身心合一。
examples.pinyin: Qìgōng jiǎngjiù hūxī yǔ dòngzuò de pèihé, jiǎngqiú shēnxīn héyī.
examples.english: Qigong emphasizes the coordination of breathing and movement, seeking unity of body and mind.

english: spirit; daring; nerve; boldness; enterprising outlook
semanticNote: A grand, bold spirit or outlook — often describing ambitious vision in leaders or works of art/architecture. 恢宏的氣魄 (a magnificent, grand presence), 有氣魄 (bold/visionary). Similar to 魄力 but 氣魄 emphasizes grandness of scale/vision and can also describe non-human things like buildings or artworks.

examples.chinese: 這棟建築展現出宏偉的氣魄，象徵著城市的繁榮與野心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng jiànzhú zhǎnxiàn chū hóngwěi de qìpò, xiàngzhēng zhe chéngshì de fánróng yǔ yěxīn.
examples.english: This building displays a grand and imposing presence, symbolizing the city's prosperity and ambition.

examples.chinese: 領導者若沒有寬廣的氣魄，很難帶領團隊走向更大的格局。
examples.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo zhě ruò méiyǒu kuānguǎng de qìpò, hěn nán dàilǐng tuánduì zǒuxiàng gèng dà de géjú.
examples.english: If a leader lacks a broad, visionary outlook, it's difficult to lead the team toward a bigger picture.

semanticNote: One's complexion or color in the face, often used as an indicator of health. 氣色不錯/氣色很好 (looking healthy/well), 氣色差 (looking unwell/pale). Common in everyday conversation, especially greetings and health check-ins.

examples.chinese: 你最近氣色很好，是不是睡得比較充足？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn qìsè hěn hǎo, shìbùshì shuì de bǐjiào chōngzú?
examples.english: You've been looking really healthy lately — have you been getting more sleep?

examples.chinese: 他生病住院後氣色變得很差，讓家人非常擔心。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngbìng zhùyuàn hòu qìsè biàn de hěn chà, ràng jiārén fēicháng dānxīn.
examples.english: After he fell ill and was hospitalized, his complexion turned very pale, worrying his family greatly.

english: imposing manner; look of great force or imposing manner
semanticNote: A powerful, imposing presence or momentum — can describe people, performances, sports teams, or natural phenomena. 氣勢磅礡 (majestic/powerful), 氣勢如虹 (unstoppable momentum), 氣勢驚人 (astonishing power). Often used for dramatic visual or psychological impact.

examples.chinese: 瀑布從高處傾瀉而下，氣勢磅礡，令人嘆為觀止。
examples.pinyin: Pùbù cóng gāochù qīngxiè ér xià, qìshì pángbó, lìng rén tàn wéi guān zhǐ.
examples.english: The waterfall cascades down from a great height with majestic force, leaving people in awe.

examples.chinese: 球隊在主場觀眾的加油下，氣勢如虹，最終逆轉了比賽。
examples.pinyin: Qiúduì zài zhǔchǎng guānzhòng de jiāyóu xià, qìshì rúhóng, zuìzhōng nìzhuǎn le bǐsài.
examples.english: Cheered on by the home crowd, the team had unstoppable momentum and ultimately turned the game around.

semanticNote: A smell or odor — can be pleasant or unpleasant; also used figuratively in 氣味相投 (to be on the same wavelength, lit. 'smells that match'). Neutral term for scent, more general than 香味 (fragrance, positive) or 臭味 (stench, negative).

examples.chinese: 廚房裡飄出陣陣食物的氣味，讓人忍不住食指大動。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng lǐ piāo chū zhènzhèn shíwù de qìwèi, ràng rén rěnbúzhù shízhǐ dàdòng.
examples.english: The smell of food wafted out from the kitchen, making it hard to resist the urge to eat.

examples.chinese: 兩人初次見面就聊得十分投機，彷彿氣味相投。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng rén chūcì jiànmiàn jiù liáo de shífēn tóujī, fǎngfú qìwèi xiāngtóu.
examples.english: The two of them clicked right away at their first meeting, as if they were kindred spirits.

semanticNote: Meteorology/weather phenomena, or figuratively, an overall scene/atmosphere of vitality. 氣象局 (Central Weather Administration in Taiwan), 氣象預報 (weather forecast). Figuratively, 一片新氣象 (a whole new look/atmosphere).

examples.chinese: 中央氣象署預測，明天午後各地將有局部雷雨。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyāng qìxiàng shǔ yùcè, míngtiān wǔhòu gèdì jiāng yǒu júbù léiyǔ.
examples.english: The Central Weather Administration forecasts scattered thunderstorms in various areas tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 新政策上路後，整個產業呈現出一片欣欣向榮的新氣象。
examples.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè shàng lù hòu, zhěnggè chǎnyè chéngxiàn chū yī piàn xīnxīn xiàngróng de xīn qìxiàng.
examples.english: After the new policy was implemented, the whole industry showed a thriving new atmosphere.

semanticNote: Atmospheric/barometric pressure — a meteorological/scientific term. 低氣壓 (low-pressure system, often associated with storms/typhoons), 高氣壓 (high-pressure system). Technical, but commonly heard in weather reports.

examples.chinese: 氣象報告指出，一個熱帶低氣壓正朝臺灣東部海面靠近。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng bàogào zhǐchū, yī gè rèdài dī qìyā zhèng cháo Táiwān dōngbù hǎimiàn kàojìn.
examples.english: The weather report indicates that a tropical low-pressure system is approaching the seas off eastern Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 高山地區氣壓較低，初次登山的人容易出現高山症的症狀。
examples.pinyin: Gāoshān dìqū qìyā jiào dī, chūcì dēngshān de rén róngyì chūxiàn gāoshānzhèng de zhèngzhuàng.
examples.english: Air pressure is lower in high-mountain areas, and first-time climbers easily develop symptoms of altitude sickness.

semanticNote: One's temperament, bearing, or refined personal aura — often a compliment implying elegance or distinctiveness. 有氣質 (has presence/refinement), 藝術家氣質 (an artistic temperament). Positive/neutral, common in describing people's overall vibe or class.

examples.chinese: 她舉止優雅、談吐得體，整個人散發出一種與眾不同的氣質。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǔzhǐ yōuyǎ, tántǔ détǐ, zhěnggè rén sànfā chū yī zhǒng yǔzhòngbùtóng de qìzhì.
examples.english: She carries herself elegantly and speaks appropriately — she radiates a distinctive, refined air.

examples.chinese: 這間咖啡廳裝潢簡約，瀰漫著一種文藝氣質。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān kāfēi tīng zhuānghuáng jiǎnyuē, mímàn zhe yī zhǒng wényì qìzhì.
examples.english: This café has a simple, minimalist décor and is filled with a literary, artistic atmosphere.

english: until now; so far; to date
semanticNote: A formal phrase meaning 'up to now' or 'to date' — used in reports, summaries, and academic writing. Note: 為 (wéi) is the Taiwan standard form; 爲 is a variant not used in Taiwan, so the correct Taiwan form is 迄今為止. More formal than 到目前為止, often interchangeable.

examples.chinese: 迄今為止，這項罕見疾病仍沒有有效的治療方法。
examples.pinyin: Qìjīnwéizhǐ, zhè xiàng hǎnjiàn jíbìng réng méiyǒu yǒuxiào de zhìliáo fāngfǎ.
examples.english: To date, there is still no effective treatment for this rare disease.

examples.chinese: 迄今為止，這部電影的全球票房已突破十億美元。
examples.pinyin: Qìjīnwéizhǐ, zhè bù diànyǐng de quánqiú piàofáng yǐ tūpò shí yì měiyuán.
examples.english: So far, this film's worldwide box office has surpassed one billion US dollars.

semanticNote: Equipment or gear — physical tools/devices for a specific purpose. 攝影器材 (photography equipment), 運動器材 (sports equipment), 救援器材 (rescue equipment). Concrete and neutral, common in technical and recreational contexts.

examples.chinese: 他花了不少錢購買專業的攝影器材，希望拍出更好的作品。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le bù shǎo qián gòumǎi zhuānyè de shèyǐng qìcái, xīwàng pāi chū gèng hǎo de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: He spent quite a lot of money buying professional photography equipment, hoping to produce better work.

examples.chinese: 學校的體育器材老舊，許多設備都需要更換。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de tǐyù qìcái lǎojiù, xǔduō shèbèi dōu xūyào gēnghuàn.
examples.english: The school's sports equipment is outdated, and much of it needs to be replaced.

semanticNote: A bodily organ — biological/medical term. 器官移植 (organ transplant), 內臟器官 (internal organs), 器官捐贈 (organ donation, a significant public-health topic in Taiwan). Neutral, scientific.

examples.chinese: 心臟是維持人體生命最重要的器官之一。
examples.pinyin: Xīnzàng shì wéichí réntǐ shēngmìng zuì zhòngyào de qìguān zhī yī.
examples.english: The heart is one of the most important organs for sustaining human life.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人簽署器官捐贈同意書，希望在身後幫助他人延續生命。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén qiānshǔ qìguān juānzèng tóngyìshū, xīwàng zài shēnhòu bāngzhù tārén yánxù shēngmìng.
examples.english: More and more people are signing organ donation consent forms, hoping to help others continue living after they pass away.

semanticNote: To pinch, squeeze, or clutch tightly with the fingers — often of necks (掐脖子, choke), flowers/buds (掐花), or time (掐時間, time something precisely). A concrete physical-action verb that sometimes implies force or aggression.

examples.chinese: 電影裡的反派角色一氣之下掐住了對方的脖子。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de fǎnpài juésè yī qì zhī xià qiā zhù le duìfāng de bózi.
examples.english: The villain in the movie, in a fit of anger, grabbed the other person by the throat.

examples.chinese: 她仔細掐著時間，確保每一道菜都能準時上桌。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǐxì qiā zhe shíjiān, quèbǎo měi yī dào cài dōu néng zhǔnshí shàngzhuō.
examples.english: She carefully timed everything to make sure every dish would be served on time.

semanticNote: To hold discussions or negotiations, typically in business contexts. 洽談合作 (discuss cooperation), 洽談生意 (discuss business deals). Formal/business register — more polite and professional than 談 alone.

examples.chinese: 雙方代表將於下週於臺北舉行會議，洽談合作細節。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng dàibiǎo jiāng yú xià zhōu yú Táiběi jǔxíng huìyì, qiàtán hézuò xìjié.
examples.english: Representatives from both sides will hold a meeting in Taipei next week to discuss the details of the cooperation.

examples.chinese: 他專程飛往海外，與當地廠商洽談新產品的代理權。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuānchéng fēiwǎng hǎiwài, yǔ dāngdì chǎngshāng qiàtán xīn chǎnpǐn de dàilǐquán.
examples.english: He flew abroad specifically to discuss agency rights for the new product with a local manufacturer.

semanticNote: Appropriate, fitting, or suitable for a particular situation, context, or purpose. 用詞恰當 (appropriate wording), 處理得恰當 (handled appropriately). Slightly more formal than 合適; often used to evaluate word choice, behavior, and timing.

examples.chinese: 寫作時，選擇恰當的詞語可以讓文章更生動有力。
examples.pinyin: Xiězuò shí, xuǎnzé qiàdàng de cíyǔ kěyǐ ràng wénzhāng gèng shēngdòng yǒulì.
examples.english: When writing, choosing appropriate words can make an essay more vivid and powerful.

examples.chinese: 面對顧客的抱怨，店員的處理方式十分恰當，化解了一場糾紛。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì gùkè de bàoyuàn, diànyuán de chǔlǐ fāngshì shífēn qiàdàng, huàjiě le yī chǎng jiūfēn.
examples.english: In the face of the customer's complaint, the clerk's handling was very appropriate and defused the dispute.

semanticNote: A set phrase describing something done to the perfect degree — neither too much nor too little. 火候恰到好處 (cooked to perfection), 分寸恰到好處 (the right balance/tact). Positive and complimentary.

examples.chinese: 這道菜的調味恰到好處，鹹淡適中，令人回味無窮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de tiáowèi qià dào hǎo chù, xiándàn shìzhōng, lìng rén huíwèi wúqióng.
examples.english: The seasoning of this dish is just right — neither too salty nor too bland — leaving a lingering aftertaste.

examples.chinese: 主持人的幽默掌握得恰到好處，讓現場氣氛輕鬆又不失莊重。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔchírén de yōumò zhǎngwò de qià dào hǎo chù, ràng xiànchǎng qìfēn qīngsōng yòu bù shī zhuāngzhòng.
examples.english: The host's sense of humor was perfectly judged, keeping the atmosphere relaxed without losing its dignity.

semanticNote: By coincidence, as it happens — describes a fortunate or notable timing overlap. 恰巧遇到 (happen to run into), 恰巧今天... (it just so happens that today...). Similar to 剛好/正好, slightly more literary.

examples.chinese: 我走在路上時恰巧遇到多年不見的老同學，兩人聊了好久。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu zài lùshàng shí qiàqiǎo yùdào duō nián bù jiàn de lǎo tóngxué, liǎng rén liáo le hǎojiǔ.
examples.english: While walking down the street, I happened to run into an old classmate I hadn't seen in years, and we chatted for a long time.

examples.chinese: 我打電話過去時，恰巧他正準備出門，差點就錯過了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà guòqù shí, qiàqiǎo tā zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén, chàdiǎn jiù cuòguò le.
examples.english: When I called him, he happened to be just about to head out — I almost missed him.

semanticNote: A chengyu meaning to try every possible method to achieve a goal — implies great effort and resourcefulness. 千方百計地說服 (try every possible way to persuade). Neutral-to-positive, emphasizing determination.

examples.chinese: 為了挽回這位重要客戶，業務員千方百計地提出各種優惠方案。
examples.pinyin: Wèile wǎnhuí zhè wèi zhòngyào kèhù, yèwùyuán qiānfāngbǎijì de tíchū gèzhǒng yōuhuì fāng'àn.
examples.english: To win back this important client, the salesperson tried every possible means, offering all kinds of discount packages.

examples.chinese: 父母總是千方百計地想為孩子提供最好的教育資源。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì qiānfāngbǎijì de xiǎng wèi háizi tígōng zuì hǎo de jiàoyù zīyuán.
examples.english: Parents always try every means possible to provide their children with the best educational resources.

semanticNote: To accommodate or give in to someone or something, often against one's own preference — implies compromise, sometimes excessively. 過度遷就 (overly accommodate), 不能一味遷就 (shouldn't always give in). Slightly negative if overdone, implying a loss of one's own standards.

examples.chinese: 父母不應該一味遷就孩子的要求，否則容易養成壞習慣。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù yìng gāi yī wèi qiānjiù háizi de yāoqiú, fǒuzé róngyì yǎngchéng huài xíguàn.
examples.english: Parents shouldn't simply give in to all of their child's demands, or it can easily lead to bad habits.

examples.chinese: 為了維持和諧的關係，她常常遷就丈夫的喜好，忽略了自己的需求。
examples.pinyin: Wèile wéichí héxié de guānxì, tā chángcháng qiānjiù zhàngfū de xǐhào, hūlüè le zìjǐ de xūqiú.
examples.english: To maintain a harmonious relationship, she often accommodates her husband's preferences, neglecting her own needs.

semanticNote: To migrate — of populations, animals, or birds. 候鳥遷徙 (bird migration), 人口遷徙 (population migration). More formal/scientific than 搬家 (move house, personal/everyday).

examples.chinese: 每年秋天，大批候鳥會從北方遷徙到溫暖的南方過冬。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián qiūtiān, dàpī hòuniǎo huì cóng běifāng qiānxǐ dào wēnnuǎn de nánfāng guòdōng.
examples.english: Every autumn, large flocks of migratory birds travel from the north to the warmer south for the winter.

examples.chinese: 歷史上，許多族群因戰亂或天災而被迫遷徙至他鄉。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ shàng, xǔduō zúqún yīn zhànluàn huò tiānzāi ér bèipò qiānxǐ zhì tāxiāng.
examples.english: Throughout history, many ethnic groups were forced to migrate to other regions due to war or natural disasters.

english: to lead along; to pull (an animal on a tether)
semanticNote: To lead by holding or pulling, e.g. on a leash or by the hand — also used figuratively for involving or connecting (牽連, 牽涉). 牽手 (hold hands; also a Taiwanese-Hokkien-derived term of endearment for one's spouse), 牽狗 (walk a dog on a leash).

examples.chinese: 她每天傍晚都會牽著狗到附近的公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān bàngwǎn dōu huì qiān zhe gǒu dào fùjìn de gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: Every evening she takes her dog for a walk in the nearby park on a leash.

examples.chinese: 兩人牽著手走在海邊，享受寧靜美好的時光。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng rén qiān zhe shǒu zǒu zài hǎibiān, xiǎngshòu níngjìng měihǎo de shíguāng.
examples.english: The two of them walked along the beach hand in hand, enjoying a peaceful, lovely time.

semanticNote: To implicate, drag in, or become entangled with — often of being involved in a troublesome matter, scandal, or dispute. 牽扯到 (be implicated in/involve), 牽扯不清 (entangled, unclear involvement). Slightly negative connotation.

examples.chinese: 這起貪污案牽扯到多名政府官員，引發社會高度關注。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ tānwū àn qiānchě dào duō míng zhèngfǔ guānyuán, yǐnfā shèhuì gāodù guānzhù.
examples.english: This corruption case implicates several government officials and has drawn intense public attention.

examples.chinese: 他不想被牽扯進這場家族紛爭，選擇保持中立。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùxiǎng bèi qiānchě jìn zhè chǎng jiāzú fēnzhēng, xuǎnzé bǎochí zhōnglì.
examples.english: He doesn't want to be dragged into this family dispute and has chosen to remain neutral.

semanticNote: To restrain or tie down an opposing force or party, often in military, political, or competitive contexts — to prevent them from acting freely. 牽制對手 (tie down/distract an opponent), 互相牽制 (check each other). More tactical/strategic than 限制 (restrict, more general).

examples.chinese: 教練派出一名球員專門牽制對方的得分後衛，以削弱其進攻火力。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn pàichū yī míng qiúyuán zhuānmén qiānzhì duìfāng de défēn hòuwèi, yǐ xuēruò qí jìngōng huǒlì.
examples.english: The coach sent a player specifically to tie down the opposing shooting guard, weakening their offensive power.

examples.chinese: 政府的三權分立制度，目的是讓行政、立法、司法三方互相牽制與監督。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de sānquán fēnlì zhìdù, mùdì shì ràng xíngzhèng, lìfǎ, sīfǎ sānfāng hùxiāng qiānzhì yǔ jiāndū.
examples.english: The separation-of-powers system is designed so that the executive, legislative, and judicial branches check and monitor one another.

semanticNote: Humble and modest, especially in attitude toward one's own accomplishments. 為人謙遜 (humble in character), 謙遜的態度 (a modest attitude). More formal/literary than 謙虛 — both are common, but 謙遜 is slightly more elevated.

examples.chinese: 即使獲得了極高的成就，他依然保持謙遜的態度，不驕傲自滿。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ huòdé le jí gāo de chéngjiù, tā yīrán bǎochí qiānxùn de tàidù, bù jiāo'ào zìmǎn.
examples.english: Even after achieving extremely high success, he still maintains a modest attitude and doesn't become arrogant.

examples.chinese: 她謙遜地表示，這次的成功要歸功於整個團隊的努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiānxùn de biǎoshì, zhè cì de chénggōng yào guīgōng yú zhěnggè tuánduì de nǔlì.
examples.english: She humbly stated that this success should be credited to the whole team's efforts.

semanticNote: To formally sign a document, agreement, or treaty — official register. 簽署協議 (sign an agreement), 簽署備忘錄 (sign a memorandum). More formal than 簽 (just sign), implying an official, binding act.

examples.chinese: 兩國領袖在記者面前正式簽署了和平協議。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó lǐngxiù zài jìzhě miànqián zhèngshì qiānshǔ le hépíng xiéyì.
examples.english: The leaders of the two countries formally signed the peace agreement in front of reporters.

examples.chinese: 在簽署合約之前，請務必仔細閱讀每一項條款。
examples.pinyin: Zài qiānshǔ héyuē zhīqián, qǐng wùbì zǐxì yuèdú měi yī xiàng tiáokuǎn.
examples.english: Before signing the contract, please be sure to carefully read every clause.

semanticNote: Future prospects or outlook — often economic, career, or industry-related. 發展前景 (development prospects), 前景看好 (promising outlook). The literal sense of 'foreground' (in an image) is much rarer.

examples.chinese: 分析師普遍認為，這個產業未來的發展前景十分樂觀。
examples.pinyin: Fēnxī shī pǔbiàn rènwéi, zhège chǎnyè wèilái de fāzhǎn qiánjǐng shífēn lèguān.
examples.english: Analysts generally believe that this industry's future development prospects are very optimistic.

examples.chinese: 面對不明的前景，許多年輕人選擇出國尋找更好的機會。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì bùmíng de qiánjǐng, xǔduō niánqīngrén xuǎnzé chūguó xúnzhǎo gèng hǎo de jīhuì.
examples.english: Facing an uncertain future, many young people choose to go abroad to seek better opportunities.

semanticNote: A premise or precondition — a necessary basis or assumption for something else to follow. 以……為前提 (on the premise of...), 前提是… (the precondition is...). Common in logical, argumentative, and conditional statements.

examples.chinese: 雙方願意合作，但前提是必須先解決過去的爭議。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yuànyì hézuò, dàn qiántí shì bìxū xiān jiějué guòqù de zhēngyì.
examples.english: Both sides are willing to cooperate, but the precondition is that past disputes must first be resolved.

examples.chinese: 自由必須以不侵犯他人權利為前提。
examples.pinyin: Zìyóu bìxū yǐ bù qīnfàn tārén quánlì wéi qiántí.
examples.english: Freedom must be premised on not infringing upon the rights of others.

semanticNote: Latent potential or capacity that has not yet been fully realized — of people, markets, or technologies. 發展潛力 (development potential), 潛力股 (a stock or person with growth potential), 激發潛力 (unlock potential). Positive and forward-looking.

examples.chinese: 這位年輕選手展現出極大的潛力，未來有望成為國家代表隊的主力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng xuǎnshǒu zhǎnxiàn chū jí dà de qiánlì, wèilái yǒuwàng chéngwéi guójiā dàibiǎo duì de zhǔlì.
examples.english: This young athlete has shown enormous potential and may become a mainstay of the national team in the future.

examples.chinese: 東南亞市場具有龐大的消費潛力，吸引許多企業前往投資。
examples.pinyin: Dōngnányà shìchǎng jùyǒu pángdà de xiāofèi qiánlì, xīyǐn xǔduō qǐyè qiánwǎng tóuzī.
examples.english: The Southeast Asian market has enormous consumer potential, attracting many companies to invest there.

semanticNote: To dive underwater — recreational or professional. 潛水證 (diving certification), 浮潛 (snorkeling, a related but distinct activity). Common in Taiwan's outlying-island tourism contexts, e.g. 小琉球, 綠島.

examples.chinese: 小琉球是臺灣著名的潛水勝地，海底有豐富的珊瑚與海龜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Liúqiú shì Táiwān zhùmíng de qiánshuǐ shèngdì, hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de shānhú yǔ hǎiguī.
examples.english: Xiaoliuqiu is a famous diving destination in Taiwan, with rich coral reefs and sea turtles underwater.

examples.chinese: 第一次潛水時，他既緊張又興奮，緊緊跟著教練的指示。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì qiánshuǐ shí, tā jì jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn, jǐnjǐn gēn zhe jiàoliàn de zhǐshì.
examples.english: The first time he went diving, he was both nervous and excited, closely following the instructor's directions.

english: exert a subtle influence on sb.'s character, thinking, etc.; impercebtibly influence; to influence secretly
semanticNote: A chengyu describing gradual, imperceptible influence on someone's character, thinking, or habits over time, e.g. through environment, upbringing, or culture. 潛移默化地影響 (influence subtly/gradually). Neutral-to-positive, often used about education and upbringing.

examples.chinese: 父母的言行舉止會在潛移默化中影響孩子的價值觀。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de yánxíng jǔzhǐ huì zài qiányímòhuà zhōng yǐngxiǎng háizi de jiàzhíguān.
examples.english: Parents' words and actions imperceptibly shape their children's values over time.

examples.chinese: 良好的閱讀環境能潛移默化地培養孩子對書本的興趣。
examples.pinyin: Liánghǎo de yuèdú huánjìng néng qiányímòhuà de péiyǎng háizi duì shūběn de xìngqù.
examples.english: A good reading environment can gradually and subtly cultivate a child's interest in books.

semanticNote: To formally condemn or denounce, often used for serious wrongdoing — political, moral, or criminal. 強烈譴責 (strongly condemn), 遭到國際社會譴責 (be condemned by the international community). Formal/official register.

examples.chinese: 多個國家強烈譴責這場無端發起的軍事行動。
examples.pinyin: Duō gè guójiā qiángliè qiǎnzé zhè chǎng wúduān fāqǐ de jūnshì xíngdòng.
examples.english: Many countries strongly condemned this unprovoked military action.

examples.chinese: 這種歧視性的言論受到社會大眾的一致譴責。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qíshì xìng de yánlùn shòudào shèhuì dàzhòng de yīzhì qiǎnzé.
examples.english: This kind of discriminatory speech has been unanimously condemned by the public.

semanticNote: To compel or enforce by force or law, leaving no choice. 強制執行 (enforce by law), 強制規定 (mandatory regulation), 強制險 (compulsory insurance, e.g. for vehicles in Taiwan). Formal/legal register, implying legal authority behind the compulsion.

examples.chinese: 政府規定機車騎士強制配戴安全帽，以降低事故傷亡。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ guīdìng jīchē qíshì qiángzhì pèidài ānquánmào, yǐ jiàngdī shìgù shāngwáng.
examples.english: The government mandates that scooter riders must wear helmets to reduce accident casualties.

examples.chinese: 若欠款人持續拖欠，銀行將申請強制執行扣押其財產。
examples.pinyin: Ruò qiànkuǎnrén chíxù tuōqiàn, yínháng jiāng shēnqǐng qiángzhì zhíxíng kòuyā qí cáichǎn.
examples.english: If the debtor continues to default, the bank will apply for enforced seizure of their assets.

semanticNote: To rob, typically with force or threat — a serious crime. 持槍搶劫 (armed robbery), 搶劫銀行 (rob a bank). More violent/serious than 偷 (steal, covertly).

examples.chinese: 昨晚這間便利商店遭到一名蒙面男子持刀搶劫。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn zhè jiān biànlì shāngdiàn zāodào yī míng méngmiàn nánzǐ chídāo qiǎngjié.
examples.english: Last night this convenience store was robbed at knifepoint by a masked man.

examples.chinese: 警方在三天內就成功逮捕了搶劫銀行的嫌疑犯。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài sān tiān nèi jiù chénggōng dàibǔ le qiǎngjié yínháng de xiányífàn.
examples.english: Police successfully arrested the suspect who robbed the bank within three days.

semanticNote: To urgently rescue or save someone or something from imminent danger — implies urgency and a race against time. 搶救生命 (save lives), 搶救古蹟 (rescue/preserve historical sites). More urgent than 救 alone, often used for emergencies, disasters, or critical medical situations.

examples.chinese: 醫護人員全力搶救這名車禍傷患，最終成功挽回他的性命。
examples.pinyin: Yīhù rényuán quánlì qiǎngjiù zhè míng chēhuò shānghuàn, zuìzhōng chénggōng wǎnhuí tā de xìngmìng.
examples.english: Medical staff worked desperately to save the car-accident victim and ultimately succeeded in saving his life.

examples.chinese: 消防隊員冒著生命危險，從火場中搶救出受困的居民。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofáng duìyuán mào zhe shēngmìng wéixiǎn, cóng huǒchǎng zhōng qiǎngjiù chū shòukùn de jūmín.
examples.english: Firefighters risked their lives to rescue trapped residents from the fire scene.

semanticNote: To force or coerce someone into doing something against their will. 強迫勞動 (forced labor), 強迫症 (OCD, obsessive-compulsive disorder — a common clinical term). More personal/interpersonal than 強制 (which often implies legal/institutional force).

examples.chinese: 沒有人可以強迫你做你不願意做的事。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qiǎngpò nǐ zuò nǐ bù yuànyì zuò de shì.
examples.english: No one can force you to do something you don't want to do.

examples.chinese: 她患有強迫症，總是反覆檢查門窗有沒有鎖好。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn yǒu qiǎngpòzhèng, zǒngshì fǎnfù jiǎnchá ménchuāng yǒu méiyǒu suǒ hǎo.
examples.english: She suffers from OCD and is always repeatedly checking whether the doors and windows are locked.

semanticNote: A bridge — literal (a physical structure) or figurative (a connecting link between people or things). 文化交流的橋梁 (a bridge for cultural exchange), 溝通的橋梁 (a bridge of communication). Common in both concrete and figurative usage.

examples.chinese: 這座橋梁是連接兩座城市的重要交通要道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáoliáng shì liánjiē liǎng zuò chéngshì de zhòngyào jiāotōng yàodào.
examples.english: This bridge is an important transportation link connecting the two cities.

examples.chinese: 老師常常扮演著學生與家長之間溝通的橋梁。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī chángcháng bànyǎn zhe xuéshēng yǔ jiāzhǎng zhījiān gōutōng de qiáoliáng.
examples.english: Teachers often play the role of a communication bridge between students and parents.

semanticNote: A trick, knack, or know-how for doing something efficiently — practical and informal. 學會竅門 (learn the trick/knack), 掌握竅門 (master the technique). Colloquial, often used when sharing tips for everyday tasks.

examples.chinese: 學會了這個小竅門之後，整理房間的時間縮短了一半。
examples.pinyin: Xuéhuì le zhège xiǎo qiàomén zhīhòu, zhěnglǐ fángjiān de shíjiān suōduǎn le yī bàn.
examples.english: After learning this little trick, the time it takes to tidy the room was cut in half.

examples.chinese: 做菜其實有不少竅門，多練習幾次就能掌握。
examples.pinyin: Zuò cài qíshí yǒu bù shǎo qiàomén, duō liànxí jǐ cì jiù néng zhǎngwò.
examples.english: Cooking actually has quite a few tricks to it — with more practice you'll get the hang of it.

semanticNote: To curl, tilt, or stick up at one end — e.g. of a board warping, lips pouting, or legs crossed (翹腳/翹腿). 翹課 (skip class — very common student slang), 翹起嘴巴 (pout).

examples.chinese: 木板放在潮濕的地方太久，邊緣都翹起來了。
examples.pinyin: Mùbǎn fàng zài cháoshī de dìfāng tài jiǔ, biānyuán dōu qiào qǐlái le.
examples.english: The wooden board was left in a damp place too long, and the edges have started to warp.

examples.chinese: 他常常翹課去打籃球，成績因此一落千丈。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng qiàokè qù dǎ lánqiú, chéngjì yīncǐ yī luò qiān zhàng.
examples.english: He often skips class to play basketball, and his grades have plummeted as a result.

semanticNote: Realistic, practical, and grounded — as opposed to vague or empty. 切實可行 (feasible/practicable), 切實執行 (conscientiously carry out). Common in formal/policy language, emphasizing that something must be actually workable, not just theoretical.

examples.chinese: 政府應提出切實可行的方案，而不是空泛的口號。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīng tíchū qièshí kěxíng de fāng'àn, ér bùshì kōngfàn de kǒuhào.
examples.english: The government should propose realistic, workable plans, rather than empty slogans.

examples.chinese: 公司要求各部門切實執行新的安全規範。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú gè bùmén qièshí zhíxíng xīn de ānquán guīfàn.
examples.english: The company requires all departments to conscientiously implement the new safety regulations.

english: keep on chipping away; work with perseverance
semanticNote: A chengyu describing relentless perseverance, like continuously carving or engraving without giving up. 鍥而不捨的精神 (a spirit of relentless perseverance). Positive, often used to praise persistence in study, research, or pursuit of goals. Pinyin is hyphenated per chengyu convention: qiè'érbùshě.

examples.chinese: 科學家憑著鍥而不捨的精神，花了十年終於找到解決方法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā píngzhe qiè'érbùshě de jīngshén, huā le shí nián zhōngyú zhǎodào jiějué fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Relying on a spirit of relentless perseverance, the scientist spent ten years and finally found a solution.

examples.chinese: 只要鍥而不捨地練習，總有一天你會看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào qiè'érbùshě de liànxí, zǒng yǒu yī tiān nǐ huì kàn dào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: As long as you keep practicing without giving up, you'll see results someday.

semanticNote: To deeply admire and respect someone, usually for their character, achievements, or actions. 令人欽佩 (admirable/commendable), 深感欽佩 (feel deep admiration). More formal/written than 佩服, often used to express respect for someone's moral qualities.

examples.chinese: 他在逆境中依然堅持夢想，這種精神令人欽佩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài nìjìng zhōng yīrán jiānchí mèngxiǎng, zhè zhǒng jīngshén lìng rén qīnpèi.
examples.english: He continued to pursue his dream even in adversity — this kind of spirit is admirable.

examples.chinese: 對於老師多年來無私的付出，學生們都感到十分欽佩。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú lǎoshī duōnián lái wúsī de fùchū, xuéshēngmen dōu gǎndào shífēn qīnpèi.
examples.english: The students all feel great admiration for their teacher's years of selfless dedication.

semanticNote: To infringe upon or violate someone's rights, territory, or privacy. 侵犯隱私 (invade privacy), 侵犯主權 (violate sovereignty), 侵犯肖像權 (infringe on portrait/likeness rights). Formal/legal register.

examples.chinese: 未經同意擅自使用他人的照片，可能構成侵犯肖像權。
examples.pinyin: Wèijīng tóngyì shànzì shǐyòng tārén de zhàopiàn, kěnéng gòuchéng qīnfàn xiàoxiàng quán.
examples.english: Using someone else's photo without consent may constitute an infringement of their portrait rights.

examples.chinese: 軍隊越過邊界，侵犯了鄰國的領土。
examples.pinyin: Jūnduì yuèguò biānjiè, qīnfàn le línguó de lǐngtǔ.
examples.english: The army crossed the border and violated the neighboring country's territory.

semanticNote: Military invasion or aggression — more serious and large-scale than 侵犯, typically used at the national or state level. 侵略行為 (act of aggression), 遭受侵略 (suffer invasion).

examples.chinese: 二次大戰期間，許多國家遭受外國軍隊的侵略。
examples.pinyin: Èrcì dàzhàn qíjiān, xǔduō guójiā zāoshòu wàiguó jūnduì de qīnlüè.
examples.english: During World War II, many countries suffered invasion by foreign armies.

examples.chinese: 該國強烈譴責鄰國的侵略行為，並向聯合國提出申訴。
examples.pinyin: Gāi guó qiángliè qiǎnzé línguó de qīnlüè xíngwéi, bìng xiàng Liánhéguó tíchū shēnsù.
examples.english: The country strongly condemned its neighbor's act of aggression and filed a complaint with the United Nations.

semanticNote: Close and intimate, describing a relationship between friends, family members, or couples. 親密關係 (intimate relationship), 親密無間 (extremely close, with no gap between them).

examples.chinese: 她和姐姐從小感情就很親密，無話不談。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé jiějiě cóngxiǎo gǎnqíng jiù hěn qīnmì, wú huà bù tán.
examples.english: She and her older sister have been very close since childhood and tell each other everything.

examples.chinese: 這對情侶看起來十分親密，總是手牽著手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì qínglǔ kànqǐlái shífēn qīnmì, zǒngshì shǒu qiān zhe shǒu.
examples.english: This couple looks very intimate — they're always holding hands.

semanticNote: Warm and affectionate in manner or behavior — often describes the warmth of an interaction or greeting, rather than the closeness of the relationship itself (compare 親密, which describes the relationship). 親熱地打招呼 (greet warmly).

examples.chinese: 小狗一看到主人回家，就搖著尾巴親熱地撲上去。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu yī kàndào zhǔrén huíjiā, jiù yáo zhe wěibā qīnrè de pū shàngqù.
examples.english: As soon as the dog saw its owner come home, it wagged its tail and affectionately jumped on him.

examples.chinese: 多年不見的老友重逢，兩人親熱地擁抱在一起。
examples.pinyin: Duōnián bùjiàn de lǎoyǒu chóngféng, liǎng rén qīnrè de yǒngbào zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: Old friends who hadn't seen each other in years were reunited and warmly embraced.

semanticNote: Hardworking and thrifty — a traditional virtue combining diligence with frugality. 勤儉節約 (diligent and frugal), 勤儉持家 (manage a household with diligence and thrift).

examples.chinese: 爺爺奶奶那一代人大多勤儉持家，捨不得浪費任何東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéyé nǎinai nà yī dài rén dàduō qínjiǎn chí jiā, shěbude làngfèi rènhé dōngxi.
examples.english: The generation of our grandparents mostly ran their households with diligence and thrift, unwilling to waste anything.

examples.chinese: 父母從小教導我們要勤儉，不該亂花錢。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ cóngxiǎo jiàodǎo wǒmen yào qínjiǎn, bù gāi luàn huāqián.
examples.english: Our parents taught us from a young age to be diligent and thrifty, and not to spend money carelessly.

semanticNote: Hardworking and diligent in labor — emphasizes effort and industriousness in work, without the connotation of thrift found in 勤儉. 勤勞的雙手 (hardworking hands).

examples.chinese: 這些農民每天勤勞地在田裡耕作，從不偷懶。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē nóngmín měitiān qínláo de zài tián lǐ gēngzuò, cóng bù tōulǎn.
examples.english: These farmers work the fields diligently every day and never slack off.

examples.chinese: 臺灣早期的經濟發展，靠的是人民勤勞的精神與努力。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zǎoqī de jīngjì fāzhǎn, kào de shì rénmín qínláo de jīngshén yǔ nǔlì.
examples.english: Taiwan's early economic development relied on the people's diligent spirit and hard work.

semanticNote: To listen attentively, especially to other people's opinions or feelings — implies respect, openness, and patience. 傾聽他人的意見 (listen to others' opinions), 學會傾聽 (learn to listen). More formal and considerate than plain 聽.

examples.chinese: 一個好的領導者必須懂得傾聽員工的心聲。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè hǎo de lǐngdǎozhě bìxū dǒngde qīngtīng yuángōng de xīnshēng.
examples.english: A good leader must know how to listen attentively to employees' concerns.

examples.chinese: 心理諮商師的工作之一，就是耐心傾聽客戶內心的困擾。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ zīshāngshī de gōngzuò zhī yī, jiùshì nàixīn qīngtīng kèhù nèixīn de kùnrǎo.
examples.english: One of a counselor's jobs is to patiently listen to clients' inner troubles.

semanticNote: A tendency, inclination, or leaning toward something. 傾向於 (tend to/lean toward), 政治傾向 (political leaning).

examples.chinese: 近年來，消費者的購物傾向逐漸轉向線上平台。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, xiāofèizhě de gòuwù qīngxiàng zhújiàn zhuǎnxiàng xiànshàng píngtái.
examples.english: In recent years, consumers' shopping tendencies have gradually shifted toward online platforms.

examples.chinese: 在這場辯論中，他比較傾向支持改革派的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng biànlùn zhōng, tā bǐjiào qīngxiàng zhīchí gǎigé pài de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: In this debate, he leans more toward supporting the reformist viewpoint.

english: incline; lean; to slant; to slope; to tilt
semanticNote: To lean, tilt, or slope — describes physical objects (a leaning wall) or figurative bias (a policy favoring one side). 地基傾斜 (the foundation is tilting), 政策向某方傾斜 (policy is tilted toward a certain side).

examples.chinese: 地震過後，這棟老舊建築的牆面明顯出現傾斜的情況。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu, zhè dòng lǎojiù jiànzhú de qiángmiàn míngxiǎn chūxiàn qīngxié de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the walls of this old building clearly began to tilt.

examples.chinese: 部分人士批評，新政策過於向大企業傾斜，忽視了中小企業的需求。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn rénshì pīpíng, xīn zhèngcè guòyú xiàng dà qǐyè qīngxié, hūshì le zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de xūqiú.
examples.english: Some people criticize the new policy for being too tilted toward large corporations, ignoring the needs of small and medium-sized businesses.

semanticNote: Clear and limpid — describes transparent water, or by extension a clear and innocent gaze. 清澈的溪水 (clear stream water), 眼神清澈 (a clear, innocent gaze).

examples.chinese: 溪水清澈見底，可以清楚看到水中的魚兒游動。
examples.pinyin: Xīshuǐ qīngchè jiàndǐ, kěyǐ qīngchǔ kàndào shuǐzhōng de yúér yóudòng.
examples.english: The stream water is so clear you can see straight to the bottom and watch the fish swimming.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子的眼神清澈純真，讓人看了不禁微笑。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi de yǎnshén qīngchè chúnzhēn, ràng rén kàn le bùjīn wēixiào.
examples.english: This child's gaze is so clear and innocent that it makes anyone who sees it smile.

semanticNote: Early morning, just after dawn — a time-of-day expression. 清晨五點 (5am), 清晨的空氣 (the morning air).

examples.chinese: 他習慣在清晨五點起床，到公園慢跑半小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài qīngchén wǔ diǎn qǐchuáng, dào gōngyuán mànpǎo bàn xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He's in the habit of getting up at 5am and jogging in the park for half an hour.

examples.chinese: 清晨的陽光透過窗簾灑進房間，喚醒了沉睡中的她。
examples.pinyin: Qīngchén de yángguāng tòuguò chuānglián sǎ jìn fángjiān, huànxǐng le chénshuì zhōng de tā.
examples.english: The early morning sunlight streamed through the curtains into the room, waking her from a deep sleep.

semanticNote: To thoroughly remove or eliminate something unwanted — dirt, obstacles, computer viruses, etc. 清除病毒 (remove a virus), 清除障礙 (clear obstacles).

examples.chinese: 工人們花了一整天的時間，才清除路面上倒塌的樹木。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen huā le yī zhěng tiān de shíjiān, cái qīngchú lùmiàn shàng dǎotā de shùmù.
examples.english: The workers spent an entire day clearing the fallen trees from the road.

examples.chinese: 這套軟體可以幫助使用者清除電腦中的病毒與垃圾檔案。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào ruǎntǐ kěyǐ bāngzhù shǐyòngzhě qīngchú diànnǎo zhōng de bìngdú yǔ lèsè dǎng'àn.
examples.english: This software can help users remove viruses and junk files from their computers.

semanticNote: Clean, sanitary — emphasizes hygiene and the absence of dirt or pollution. 清潔用品 (cleaning supplies), 環境清潔 (environmental cleanliness).

examples.chinese: 餐廳的衛生與清潔狀況，是顧客最在意的事情之一。
examples.pinyin: Cāntīng de wèishēng yǔ qīngjié zhuàngkuàng, shì gùkè zuì zàiyì de shìqíng zhī yī.
examples.english: A restaurant's hygiene and cleanliness are among the things customers care about most.

examples.chinese: 每天放學後，值日生都要負責打掃教室，保持環境清潔。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān fàngxué hòu, zhírìshēng dōu yào fùzé dǎsǎo jiàoshì, bǎochí huánjìng qīngjié.
examples.english: After school every day, the student on duty is responsible for cleaning the classroom and keeping the environment clean.

english: cleanup; put in order; check up
semanticNote: To clean up or sort out — often involves organizing and removing unwanted items, as opposed to just removing dirt. 清理倉庫 (clear out a warehouse), 清理檔案 (sort out files).

examples.chinese: 周末他花了一整天的時間清理房間，丟掉許多用不到的舊物。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā huā le yī zhěng tiān de shíjiān qīnglǐ fángjiān, diūdiào xǔduō yòng bùdào de jiùwù.
examples.english: On the weekend he spent the whole day tidying up his room and throwing out a lot of old things he no longer needed.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，市政府派人清理街道上散落的招牌與樹枝。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, shìzhèngfǔ pài rén qīnglǐ jiēdào shàng sànluò de zhāopái yǔ shùzhī.
examples.english: After the typhoon, the city government sent people to clear away the signs and branches scattered across the streets.

semanticNote: Clear and distinct — used for images, sounds, thinking, or expression. 思路清晰 (clear thinking), 畫面清晰 (a clear image).

examples.chinese: 這台相機拍出來的照片畫質非常清晰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái xiàngjī pāi chūlái de zhàopiàn huàzhì fēicháng qīngxī.
examples.english: The photos taken by this camera are extremely clear and sharp.

examples.chinese: 他用清晰的邏輯，把複雜的問題解釋得簡單易懂。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng qīngxī de luójí, bǎ fùzá de wèntí jiěshì de jiǎndān yìdǒng.
examples.english: With clear logic, he explained the complicated problem in a simple and easy-to-understand way.

semanticNote: Clear-headed and sober — mentally alert, or regaining consciousness/coming to one's senses. 保持清醒 (stay alert), 清醒過來 (regain consciousness/come to one's senses).

examples.chinese: 開車前千萬不可喝酒，務必保持頭腦清醒。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē qián qiānwàn bùkě hējiǔ, wùbì bǎochí tóunǎo qīngxǐng.
examples.english: You must never drink before driving — be sure to keep a clear head.

examples.chinese: 經過這次失敗，他終於清醒過來，認真檢討自己的問題。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shībài, tā zhōngyú qīngxǐng guòlái, rènzhēn jiǎntǎo zìjǐ de wèntí.
examples.english: After this failure, he finally came to his senses and seriously reflected on his own problems.

semanticNote: Relating to Islam or Muslim practice — 清真寺 (mosque), 清真食品 (halal food). Increasingly relevant in Taiwan with growing halal tourism and food certification.

examples.chinese: 臺灣近年來積極推廣清真認證，吸引更多穆斯林觀光客來臺旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān jìnnián lái jījí tuīguǎng qīngzhēn rènzhèng, xīyǐn gèng duō Mùsīlín guānguāngkè lái Tái lǚyóu.
examples.english: In recent years Taiwan has been actively promoting halal certification to attract more Muslim tourists.

examples.chinese: 這間餐廳提供清真餐點，符合伊斯蘭教飲食規範。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān cāntīng tígōng qīngzhēn cāndiǎn, fúhé Yīsīlánjiào yǐnshí guīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant offers halal meals that comply with Islamic dietary rules.

semanticNote: Intelligence or information-gathering — often in a military, political, or espionage context. 情報機構 (intelligence agency), 蒐集情報 (gather intelligence).

examples.chinese: 這部電影描述一名情報員潛入敵後蒐集機密情報的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng miáoshù yī míng qíngbào yuán qiánrù dí hòu sōují jīmì qíngbào de gùshì.
examples.english: This movie depicts the story of an intelligence agent infiltrating behind enemy lines to gather classified information.

examples.chinese: 警方根據線民提供的情報，成功破獲一起毒品交易案。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng gēnjù xiànmín tígōng de qíngbào, chénggōng pòhuò yī qǐ dúpǐn jiāoyì àn.
examples.english: Based on intelligence provided by an informant, the police successfully broke up a drug trafficking case.

semanticNote: The plot of a story or film, or the circumstances/details of a case or event. 劇情情節 (plot), 案件情節嚴重 (the circumstances of the case are serious).

examples.chinese: 這部小說的情節跌宕起伏，讓讀者欲罷不能。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō de qíngjié diēdàng qǐfú, ràng dúzhě yùbà bùnéng.
examples.english: This novel's plot is full of twists and turns, leaving readers unable to put it down.

examples.chinese: 法官考量到案件的情節輕微，最終決定從輕量刑。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān kǎoliáng dào ànjiàn de qíngjié qīngwēi, zuìzhōng juédìng cóngqīng liàngxíng.
examples.english: Taking into account the minor circumstances of the case, the judge ultimately decided on a lighter sentence.

semanticNote: Reason and sense, in a human/emotional sense — combines feeling (情) with logic (理). 合情合理 (reasonable, makes sense), 不合情理 (unreasonable).

examples.chinese: 他的這番解釋既合情理，也讓大家心服口服。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhè fān jiěshì jì hé qínglǐ, yě ràng dàjiā xīnfú kǒufú.
examples.english: His explanation was both reasonable and made everyone genuinely convinced.

examples.chinese: 老闆要求員工無薪加班，這樣的做法實在不合情理。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yāoqiú yuángōng wúxīn jiābān, zhèyàng de zuòfǎ shízài bù hé qínglǐ.
examples.english: The boss demanding unpaid overtime from employees is simply unreasonable.

semanticNote: The circumstances or situation of something — slightly more concrete/specific than 情況, often describing a scenario one is directly observing. 視情形而定 (depends on the situation).

examples.chinese: 根據目前的情形，我們最好先取消這次的戶外活動。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián de qíngxing, wǒmen zuì hǎo xiān qǔxiāo zhè cì de hùwài huódòng.
examples.english: Given the current situation, we'd better cancel this outdoor activity for now.

examples.chinese: 醫生詳細詢問了病人發病時的情形，以便做出正確診斷。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng xiángxì xúnwèn le bìngrén fābìng shí de qíngxing, yǐbiàn zuòchū zhèngquè zhěnduàn.
examples.english: The doctor asked the patient in detail about the circumstances when the illness occurred, in order to make an accurate diagnosis.

semanticNote: Sunny and clear, describing cloudless weather. 晴朗的天氣 (sunny weather).

examples.chinese: 今天天氣晴朗，非常適合到戶外踏青。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì qínglǎng, fēicháng shìhé dào hùwài tàqīng.
examples.english: The weather is clear and sunny today, perfect for an outdoor outing.

examples.chinese: 經過幾天的陰雨，終於迎來了晴朗的好天氣。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ tiān de yīnyǔ, zhōngyú yíngláile qínglǎng de hǎo tiānqì.
examples.english: After several days of overcast rain, clear and sunny weather has finally arrived.

semanticNote: A formal written invitation card. 婚禮請柬 (wedding invitation). Formal/written register, similar to 請帖 but slightly more modern in usage.

examples.chinese: 他們特地設計了一份精美的請柬，邀請親友參加婚禮。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen tèdì shèjì le yī fèn jīngměi de qǐngjiǎn, yāoqǐng qīnyǒu cānjiā hūnlǐ.
examples.english: They specially designed an exquisite invitation card to invite friends and family to the wedding.

examples.chinese: 公司將寄發正式請柬，邀請貴賓出席週年慶活動。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāng jìfā zhèngshì qǐngjiǎn, yāoqǐng guìbīn chūxí zhōuniánqìng huódòng.
examples.english: The company will send out formal invitations to invite VIP guests to the anniversary event.

semanticNote: To politely ask someone more knowledgeable for advice or guidance. 向專家請教 (consult an expert), 請教問題 (ask for advice on a question). Polite, humble register.

examples.chinese: 遇到不懂的地方，學生應該主動向老師請教。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào bù dǒng de dìfāng, xuéshēng yīnggāi zhǔdòng xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjiào.
examples.english: When students encounter something they don't understand, they should proactively seek their teacher's guidance.

examples.chinese: 我想請教您一個關於投資的問題，不知是否方便？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐngjiào nín yī gè guānyú tóuzī de wèntí, bùzhī shìfǒu fāngbiàn?
examples.english: I'd like to ask for your advice on an investment question — would that be convenient?

semanticNote: To formally ask a superior for instructions or approval before taking action — bureaucratic/organizational register. 向上級請示 (ask superiors for instructions).

examples.chinese: 這件事情比較重大，員工不敢自行決定，必須先向主管請示。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng bǐjiào zhòngdà, yuángōng bùgǎn zìxíng juédìng, bìxū xiān xiàng zhǔguǎn qǐngshì.
examples.english: This matter is fairly significant, so the employee doesn't dare decide on their own and must first ask the supervisor for instructions.

examples.chinese: 在採取行動之前，士兵必須先向長官請示。
examples.pinyin: Zài cǎiqǔ xíngdòng zhīqián, shìbīng bìxū xiān xiàng zhǎngguān qǐngshì.
examples.english: Before taking action, the soldier must first ask his superior for instructions.

semanticNote: A written invitation card, similar to 請柬 — often used for weddings, banquets, and traditional celebrations. 喜帖 (wedding invitation) is closely related.

examples.chinese: 收到喜宴的請帖後，記得回覆是否能出席。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào xǐyàn de qǐngtiě hòu, jìde huífù shìfǒu néng chūxí.
examples.english: After receiving the wedding banquet invitation, remember to reply whether you can attend.

examples.chinese: 奶奶的八十大壽，全家人都收到了一份紅色的請帖。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai de bāshí dàshòu, quánjiā rén dōu shōudào le yī fèn hóngsè de qǐngtiě.
examples.english: For grandma's 80th birthday celebration, the whole family received a red invitation card.

semanticNote: Hills or hilly terrain — a geographic term. 丘陵地形 (hilly terrain).

examples.chinese: 這個地區多為丘陵地形，因此種植茶葉十分適合。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū duō wéi qiūlíng dìxíng, yīncǐ zhòngzhí cháyè shífēn shìhé.
examples.english: This area is mostly hilly terrain, which makes it very suitable for growing tea.

examples.chinese: 從山頂望去，可以看到一片連綿的丘陵與綠地。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shāndǐng wàng qù, kěyǐ kàndào yī piàn liánmián de qiūlíng yǔ lǜdì.
examples.english: Looking out from the mountaintop, you can see a stretch of rolling hills and green land.

english: differentiate; find differing aspects; find the difference between
semanticNote: To differentiate or distinguish between things. 區分真假 (distinguish real from fake), 加以區分 (differentiate).

examples.chinese: 這兩種菇類外型十分相似，一般人很難區分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng gūlèi wàixíng shífēn xiāngsì, yībān rén hěn nán qūfēn.
examples.english: These two types of mushrooms look very similar, and ordinary people find it hard to tell them apart.

examples.chinese: 老師教導學生如何區分事實與個人意見。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiàodǎo xuéshēng rúhé qūfēn shìshí yǔ gèrén yìjiàn.
examples.english: The teacher taught students how to distinguish between facts and personal opinions.

semanticNote: A geographic area, region, or zone. 商業區域 (commercial area), 區域性 (regional).

examples.chinese: 這個區域近年來發展迅速，新建了不少住宅與商場。
examples.pinyin: Zhège qūyù jìnnián lái fāzhǎn xùnsù, xīnjiàn le bùshǎo zhùzhái yǔ shāngchǎng.
examples.english: This area has developed rapidly in recent years, with many new residential buildings and shopping centers.

examples.chinese: 颱風來襲期間，部分區域的居民被要求暫時撤離。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng láixí qíjiān, bùfèn qūyù de jūmín bèi yāoqiú zànshí chèlí.
examples.english: During the typhoon, residents in some areas were asked to evacuate temporarily.

semanticNote: Winding or zigzagging (of a path), or full of twists and complications (of a story or course of events). 曲折的山路 (a winding mountain road), 情節曲折 (a plot full of twists).

examples.chinese: 這條山路曲折蜿蜒，開車時要特別小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù qūzhé wānyán, kāichē shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This mountain road winds and twists — you need to be especially careful when driving.

examples.chinese: 他的成功之路充滿曲折，並非一帆風順。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chénggōng zhī lù chōngmǎn qūzhé, bìngfēi yīfānfēngshùn.
examples.english: His road to success was full of twists and turns, not smooth sailing.

semanticNote: To expel or drive out by force. 驅逐出境 (deport/expel from the country), 驅逐艦 (destroyer, a type of warship).

examples.chinese: 這名外籍人士因違反法律規定，遭政府驅逐出境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng wàijí rénshì yīn wéifǎn fǎlǜ guīdìng, zāo zhèngfǔ qūzhú chūjìng.
examples.english: This foreign national was deported by the government for violating the law.

examples.chinese: 海軍派出驅逐艦，前往該海域進行巡邏任務。
examples.pinyin: Hǎijūn pàichū qūzhú jiàn, qiánwǎng gāi hǎiyù jìnxíng xúnluó rènwù.
examples.english: The navy dispatched a destroyer to carry out patrol duties in that maritime area.

semanticNote: To yield, submit, or give in, usually under pressure or threat — carries a negative connotation of abandoning resistance. 向壓力屈服 (yield to pressure), 不屈服 (refuse to submit).

examples.chinese: 面對敵人的威脅，他始終不肯屈服。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì dírén de wēixié, tā shǐzhōng bùkěn qūfú.
examples.english: Facing the enemy's threats, he never agreed to submit.

examples.chinese: 公司一開始堅持立場，最終卻在輿論壓力下屈服了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yī kāishǐ jiānchí lìchǎng, zuìzhōng què zài yúlùn yālì xià qūfú le.
examples.english: The company held its position at first, but ultimately gave in under pressure from public opinion.

english: irrigation ditch; medium or channel of communication
semanticNote: Literally an irrigation ditch, but commonly used figuratively for a channel of communication, distribution, or sales. 銷售渠道 (sales channel), 溝通渠道 (communication channel).

examples.chinese: 政府應建立暢通的溝通渠道，傾聽民眾的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīng jiànlì chàngtōng de gōutōng qúdào, qīngtīng mínzhòng de shēngyīn.
examples.english: The government should establish open channels of communication to listen to the voices of the people.

examples.chinese: 這家公司透過多種銷售渠道，將產品推廣到海外市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tòuguò duō zhǒng xiāoshòu qúdào, jiāng chǎnpǐn tuīguǎng dào hǎiwài shìchǎng.
examples.english: This company promotes its products to overseas markets through multiple sales channels.

semanticNote: A tune, melody, or piece of music — colloquial register. 唱一首曲子 (sing a tune), 寫曲子 (compose a tune).

examples.chinese: 這首曲子的旋律優美動人，讓人聽了難以忘懷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu qǔzi de xuánlǜ yōuměi dòngrén, ràng rén tīng le nányǐ wànghuái.
examples.english: This tune's melody is beautiful and moving, leaving listeners unable to forget it.

examples.chinese: 他從小就學習鋼琴，能彈奏許多經典的曲子。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xuéxí gāngqín, néng tánzòu xǔduō jīngdiǎn de qǔzi.
examples.english: He has studied piano since childhood and can play many classic tunes.

semanticNote: To ban or crack down on (illegal activity) — official/legal register. 取締非法攤販 (crack down on illegal street vendors), 遭到取締 (be banned/cracked down on).

examples.chinese: 警方近日加強取締酒駕，呼籲民眾切勿心存僥倖。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng jìnrì jiāqiáng qǔdì jiǔjià, hūqiào mínzhòng qièwù xīncún jiǎoxìng.
examples.english: Police have recently stepped up crackdowns on drunk driving and urge the public not to take chances.

examples.chinese: 政府宣布全面取締未經核准的線上賭博網站。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù quánmiàn qǔdì wèi jīng hézhǔn de xiànshàng dǔbó wǎngzhàn.
examples.english: The government announced a complete crackdown on unapproved online gambling websites.

semanticNote: The interest, fun, or flavor of something. 趣味十足 (full of fun/interest), 生活趣味 (the fun/flavor of everyday life).

examples.chinese: 這部紀錄片用幽默的方式呈現科學知識，趣味十足。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn yòng yōumò de fāngshì chéngxiàn kēxué zhīshì, qùwèi shízú.
examples.english: This documentary presents scientific knowledge in a humorous way, full of fun.

examples.chinese: 假日帶孩子到戶外走走，能增添不少生活趣味。
examples.pinyin: Jiàrì dài háizi dào hùwài zǒuzou, néng zēngtiān bùshǎo shēnghuó qùwèi.
examples.english: Taking the kids outdoors on holidays adds quite a bit of flavor to everyday life.

semanticNote: A trap, snare, or scheme designed to deceive someone. 設下圈套 (set a trap), 落入圈套 (fall into a trap).

examples.chinese: 這名詐騙犯設下圈套，誘騙被害人匯款至指定帳戶。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng zhàpiàn fàn shèxià quāntào, yòupiàn bèihài rén huìkuǎn zhì zhǐdìng zhànghù.
examples.english: This scammer set a trap to lure the victim into transferring money to a designated account.

examples.chinese: 多虧朋友提醒，他才沒有掉入這個投資騙局的圈套。
examples.pinyin: Duōkuī péngyǒu tíxǐng, tā cái méiyǒu diàorù zhège tóuzī piànjú de quāntào.
examples.english: Thanks to a friend's warning, he avoided falling into the trap of this investment scam.

semanticNote: To weigh up or balance pros and cons before making a decision. 權衡利弊 (weigh the pros and cons), 仔細權衡 (carefully weigh).

examples.chinese: 做出這個決定之前，我們必須仔細權衡各種利弊。
examples.pinyin: Zuòchū zhège juédìng zhīqián, wǒmen bìxū zǐxì quánhéng gè zhǒng lìbì.
examples.english: Before making this decision, we must carefully weigh the various pros and cons.

examples.chinese: 在事業與家庭之間，她不斷權衡，最終選擇了兼顧兩者的方式。
examples.pinyin: Zài shìyè yǔ jiātíng zhījiān, tā bùduàn quánhéng, zuìzhōng xuǎnzé le jiāngù liǎngzhě de fāngshì.
examples.english: Between career and family, she weighed her options repeatedly and ultimately chose a way to balance both.

semanticNote: An authority (a person or institution with recognized expertise), or authoritative (adjective). 醫學權威 (a medical authority), 權威機構 (an authoritative institution).

examples.chinese: 這位教授是該領域的權威，著作受到廣泛引用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu shì gāi lǐngyù de quánwēi, zhùzuò shòudào guǎngfàn yǐnyòng.
examples.english: This professor is an authority in the field, and their works are widely cited.

examples.chinese: 報告引用了多項權威機構的研究數據，增加其可信度。
examples.pinyin: Bàogào yǐnyòng le duō xiàng quánwēi jīgòu de yánjiū shùjù, zēngjiā qí kěxìndù.
examples.english: The report cites research data from several authoritative institutions, increasing its credibility.

semanticNote: The overall situation or the whole picture, as opposed to a localized part. 從全局考量 (consider the overall situation), 顧全局 (keep the big picture in mind).

examples.chinese: 領導者必須具備從全局考量問題的能力，而非只看眼前利益。
examples.pinyin: Lǐngdǎozhě bìxū jùbèi cóng quánjú kǎoliáng wèntí de nénglì, ér fēi zhǐ kàn yǎnqián lìyì.
examples.english: A leader must have the ability to consider problems from an overall perspective, rather than only looking at immediate gains.

examples.chinese: 這項決策牽涉到全局，不能只考慮單一部門的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng juécè qiānshè dào quánjú, bùnéng zhǐ kǎolǜ dānyī bùmén de xūqiú.
examples.english: This decision affects the overall situation and cannot be made by considering only a single department's needs.

english: do at all costs; make an all-out effort
semanticNote: Four-character idiom meaning to devote all one's strength to a task — go all out. Formal-to-neutral register; common in motivational, sports, and professional contexts. 全力以赴地完成任務 (go all out to complete a task).

examples.chinese: 比賽前教練要求球員全力以赴，不留任何遺憾。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài qián jiàoliàn yāoqiú qiúyuán quánlì-yǐfù, bù liú rènhé yíhàn.
examples.english: Before the match, the coach urged the players to go all out and leave no regrets.

examples.chinese: 面對這次難得的機會，她決定全力以赴，爭取最好的結果。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhè cì nándé de jīhuì, tā juédìng quánlì-yǐfù, zhēngqǔ zuì hǎo de jiéguǒ.
examples.english: Faced with this rare opportunity, she decided to give it everything she had and aim for the best outcome.

semanticNote: A fist; the hand clenched. Also used metaphorically: 拳頭產品 (flagship product; literally 'fist product') is a common Taiwan business expression meaning a company's most competitive offering.

examples.chinese: 他憤怒地握緊拳頭，努力克制自己不發作。
examples.pinyin: Tā fènnù de wòjǐn quántou, nǔlì kèzhì zìjǐ bù fāzuò.
examples.english: He clenched his fist in anger, struggling to keep himself from lashing out.

examples.chinese: 這款智慧型手機是該公司的拳頭產品，銷量長期居冠。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn zhìhuì xíng shǒujī shì gāi gōngsī de quántou chǎnpǐn, xiāoliàng chángqī jū guàn.
examples.english: This smartphone is the company's flagship product and has long led in sales.

semanticNote: Formal/literary word for dog; 狗 is the everyday term. 犬 appears in compounds (犬齒 canine tooth, 警犬 police dog) and classical texts. Also Kangxi radical 94.

examples.chinese: 警方調派警犬協助搜索失蹤登山客的下落。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng diàopài jǐngquǎn xiézhù sōusuǒ shīzōng dēngshān kè de xiàluò.
examples.english: Police deployed police dogs to help search for the missing hiker.

examples.chinese: 古代皇室常以犬作為狩獵的夥伴，並賦予其特殊地位。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài huángshì cháng yǐ quǎn zuòwéi shòuliè de huǒbàn, bìng fùyǔ qí tèshū dìwèi.
examples.english: Ancient royalty often used dogs as hunting companions and accorded them a special status.

semanticNote: A gap, notch, or breach — physical or figurative. 填補缺口 (fill a gap) is standard in business/policy discourse. Can refer to a physical break in a wall, a shortfall in funding, or a gap in the market.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，海堤出現了一道巨大的缺口，工程隊正緊急修復中。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, hǎidī chūxiàn le yī dào jùdà de quēkǒu, gōngchéng duì zhèng jǐnjí xiūfù zhōng.
examples.english: After the typhoon, a huge breach appeared in the sea wall and a construction crew is urgently making repairs.

examples.chinese: 這項新服務填補了市場上長期存在的缺口，獲得消費者熱烈迴響。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fúwù tiánbǔ le shìchǎng shàng chángqī cúnzài de quēkǒu, huòdé xiāofèizhě rèliè huíxiǎng.
examples.english: This new service fills a long-standing gap in the market and has been warmly received by consumers.

semanticNote: To be absent; absence — used in legal, academic, and formal meeting contexts. 缺席審判 (trial in absentia) is a common legal term. More formal than 沒來 or 不在.

examples.chinese: 被告無故缺席，法院決定依法進行缺席審判。
examples.pinyin: Bèigào wúgù quēxí, fǎyuàn juédìng yīfǎ jìnxíng quēxí shěnpàn.
examples.english: The defendant was absent without reason, so the court decided to proceed with a trial in absentia.

examples.chinese: 他因臨時出差而缺席這次重要的股東大會。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīn línshí chūchāi ér quēxí zhè cì zhòngyào de gǔdōng dàhuì.
examples.english: He was absent from the important shareholders' meeting due to a last-minute business trip.

semanticNote: A defect, flaw, or shortcoming — physical, mental, or systemic. More formal than 缺點 (shortcoming). 先天缺陷 (congenital defect), 制度缺陷 (systemic flaw). In Taiwan, 身心障礙 is preferred over 缺陷 when referring to disability.

examples.chinese: 這批產品因製造缺陷被全面召回，廠商也公開致歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī chǎnpǐn yīn zhìzào quēxiàn bèi quánmiàn zhàohuí, chǎngshāng yě gōngkāi zhìqiàn.
examples.english: This batch of products was fully recalled due to manufacturing defects, and the manufacturer issued a public apology.

examples.chinese: 現行法律存在明顯的缺陷，亟需修訂以因應新興科技帶來的挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Xiànxíng fǎlǜ cúnzài míngxiǎn de quēxiàn, jíxū xiūdìng yǐ yīnyìng xīnxīng kējì dài lái de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: The current law has obvious flaws and urgently needs revision to address challenges posed by emerging technology.

semanticNote: Lame; to limp — describes a person or animal that cannot walk normally due to a leg/foot injury or disability. Colloquial and direct; in medical or formal contexts 跛行 (limp) or 行動不便 is preferred.

examples.chinese: 他從高處跌落後，左腿受了重傷，走路開始有點瘸。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng gāochù diēluò hòu, zuǒ tuǐ shòu le zhòngshāng, zǒulù kāishǐ yǒudiǎn qué.
examples.english: After falling from a height, his left leg was severely injured and he began to walk with a limp.

examples.chinese: 那隻流浪狗有一條腿是瘸的，但仍然活潑地搖著尾巴。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī liúlàng gǒu yǒu yī tiáo tuǐ shì qué de, dàn réngrán huópō de yáo zhe wěibā.
examples.english: That stray dog has a lame leg, but still wags its tail energetically.

semanticNote: To ensure or guarantee — widely used in formal, official, and professional writing. 確保安全 (ensure safety), 確保品質 (ensure quality). Stronger than 保證 in bureaucratic/procedural contexts.

examples.chinese: 主辦單位已採取多項措施，以確保活動當天的安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔbàn dānwèi yǐ cǎiqǔ duō xiàng cuòshī, yǐ quèbǎo huódòng dāngtiān de ānquán.
examples.english: The organizers have taken multiple measures to ensure safety on the day of the event.

examples.chinese: 請在送出表單前仔細檢查，以確保所填資料正確無誤。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài sòngchū biǎodān qián zǐxì jiǎnchá, yǐ quèbǎo suǒ tián zīliào zhèngquè wúwù.
examples.english: Please review carefully before submitting the form to ensure all information entered is accurate.

semanticNote: To establish or institute something firmly — goals, systems, principles, positions. More formal and final than 建立; implies laying a solid, lasting foundation. 確立地位 (establish one's position), 確立制度 (institute a system).

examples.chinese: 這項判決確立了一個重要的法律先例，對未來類似案件影響深遠。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng pànjué quèlì le yī gè zhòngyào de fǎlǜ xiānlì, duì wèilái lèisì ànjiàn yǐngxiǎng shēnyuǎn.
examples.english: This ruling established an important legal precedent with far-reaching impact on future similar cases.

examples.chinese: 經過多年努力，她終於在業界確立了自己的專業地位。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián nǔlì, tā zhōngyú zài yèjiè quèlì le zìjǐ de zhuānyè dìwèi.
examples.english: After years of hard work, she finally established her professional standing in the industry.

semanticNote: Definite, exact, precise — used to describe information, figures, or wording that is accurate and unambiguous. 確切的數字 (exact figures), 確切地說 (to be precise). More formal than 準確.

examples.chinese: 目前我們還不清楚確切的傷亡人數，待官方公布後再行更新。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián wǒmen hái bù qīngchǔ quèqiè de shāngyáng rénshù, dài guānfāng gōngbù hòu zài xíng gēngxīn.
examples.english: We do not yet know the exact casualty figures; updates will follow once officially announced.

examples.chinese: 請給我一個確切的答覆，不要再模糊帶過了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī gè quèqiè de dáfù, bùyào zài móhu dài guò le.
examples.english: Please give me a definitive answer — stop being vague about it.

english: confident; be certain of; to firmly believe
semanticNote: To be firmly convinced or certain of something. Stronger than 相信 (believe) — implies personal conviction after deliberation. 我確信他是對的 (I am certain he is right). Common in written and formal speech.

examples.chinese: 經過仔細調查，偵探確信這起事故並非意外，背後另有隱情。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zǐxì diàochá, zhēntàn quèxìn zhè qǐ shìgù bìng fēi yìwài, bèihòu lìng yǒu yǐnqíng.
examples.english: After careful investigation, the detective was firmly convinced that this incident was not an accident and that there was more behind it.

examples.chinese: 她確信自己的判斷是正確的，即使旁人紛紛提出質疑。
examples.pinyin: Tā quèxìn zìjǐ de pànduàn shì zhèngquè de, jíshǐ pángrén fēnfēn tíchū zhíyí.
examples.english: She was certain that her judgment was correct, even as others raised one objection after another.

semanticNote: The masses; the general public; a crowd of people. In Taiwan political discourse, 民眾 or 大眾 is more common for 'the public'; 群眾 can sound slightly PRC-flavored but is still used in Taiwan for physical crowds and in historical/rhetorical contexts.

examples.chinese: 廣場上聚集了大批群眾，等候聆聽候選人發表演說。
examples.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shàng jùjí le dà pī qúnzhòng, děnghòu língtīng hòuxuǎnrén fābiǎo yǎnshuō.
examples.english: Large crowds gathered in the square, waiting to hear the candidate's speech.

examples.chinese: 這部紀錄片引發群眾廣泛討論，帶動了社會對環保議題的關注。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn yǐnfā qúnzhòng guǎngfàn tǎolùn, dàidòng le shèhuì duì huánbǎo yìtí de guānzhù.
examples.english: This documentary sparked widespread public discussion and drove greater social attention to environmental issues.

semanticNote: To dye (fabric, hair) or to be infected/contaminated by (disease, bad habits). 染髮 (dye one's hair) is everyday Taiwan usage; 染病 (contract a disease) is formal. Also in 感染 (infect) and 污染 (pollution).

examples.chinese: 她把頭髮染成棕色，整個人看起來更有氣質。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóufa rǎn chéng zōngsè, zhěnggè rén kànqǐlái gèng yǒu qìzhì.
examples.english: She dyed her hair brown, which made her look more elegant overall.

examples.chinese: 近來流感肆虐，許多學生相繼染病，學校已提前放假。
examples.pinyin: Jìnlái liúgǎn sìnüè, xǔduō xuéshēng xiāngjì rǎnbìng, xuéxiào yǐ tíqián fàngjià.
examples.english: With the flu running rampant lately, many students have fallen ill one after another and the school has let out early.

semanticNote: To shout, yell, or blurt out loudly — often with a sense of agitation or complaint. Colloquial register. 嚷嚷 (make a racket; clamor) is the reduplicated form. Also written 嚷嚷 as a verb-verb compound.

examples.chinese: 孩子一看到玩具店就開始嚷著要買東西，讓媽媽十分頭痛。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yī kàn dào wánjù diàn jiù kāishǐ rǎng zhe yào mǎi dōngxi, ràng māma shífēn tóuténg.
examples.english: The moment the child spotted the toy store, he started shouting to buy things, giving his mother a terrible headache.

examples.chinese: 別嚷了，大家都在休息，你這樣吵會影響到鄰居的。
examples.pinyin: Bié rǎng le, dàjiā dōu zài xiūxi, nǐ zhèyàng chǎo huì yǐngxiǎng dào línjū de.
examples.english: Stop yelling — everyone is resting, and making this much noise will disturb the neighbors.

semanticNote: To concede, yield, or make a concession; a concession. Used in negotiations, disputes, and relationships. 做出讓步 (make a concession), 互相讓步 (make mutual concessions). Often implies reluctant compromise.

examples.chinese: 雙方在談判桌上僵持不下，最終都做出了一定程度的讓步。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zài tánpàn zhuō shàng jiāngjì bùxià, zuìzhōng dōu zuòchū le yīdìng chéngdù de ràngbù.
examples.english: Both sides were deadlocked at the negotiating table and ultimately each made certain concessions.

examples.chinese: 在這件事上我不打算讓步，因為原則問題不能妥協。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiàn shì shàng wǒ bù dǎsuàn ràngbù, yīnwèi yuánzé wèntí bùnéng tuǒxié.
examples.english: I have no intention of giving in on this matter, because issues of principle cannot be compromised.

semanticNote: To forgive, pardon, or spare someone — usually after a wrongdoing. More solemn and literary than 原諒; implies a deliberate act of mercy. Common in religious, literary, and dramatic contexts. 請求饒恕 (beg for forgiveness).

examples.chinese: 他跪在地上懇求饒恕，但受害者仍無法原諒他的所作所為。
examples.pinyin: Tā guì zài dì shàng kěnqiú ráoshù, dàn shòuhài zhě réng wúfǎ yuánliàng tā de suǒzuò suǒwéi.
examples.english: He knelt and begged for forgiveness, but the victim still could not forgive what he had done.

examples.chinese: 宗教教義鼓勵信徒學習饒恕，放下仇恨以求內心平靜。
examples.pinyin: Zōngjiào jiàoyì gǔlì xìntú xuéxí ráoshù, fàngxià chóuhèn yǐ qiú nèixīn píngjìng.
examples.english: Religious teachings encourage believers to practice forgiveness, letting go of hatred in pursuit of inner peace.

semanticNote: To disturb, disrupt, or throw into disorder — public order, plans, or mental state. Formal register. 擾亂社會秩序 (disrupt public order) is a standard legal phrase in Taiwan. Stronger than 打擾.

examples.chinese: 該名男子因在公共場所大聲叫嚷、擾亂秩序而遭員警逮捕。
examples.pinyin: Gāi míng nánzǐ yīn zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ dàshēng jiàorǎng, rǎoluàn zhìxù ér zāo yuánjǐng dàibǔ.
examples.english: The man was arrested by police for shouting loudly in a public place and disrupting public order.

examples.chinese: 突如其來的噩耗完全擾亂了她的生活節奏，讓她難以平靜。
examples.pinyin: Tū rú qí lái de è hào wánquán rǎoluàn le tā de shēnghuó jiézòu, ràng tā nányǐ píngjìng.
examples.english: The sudden bad news completely disrupted her daily rhythm and made it hard for her to stay calm.

semanticNote: To stir up trouble or cause a disaster — often through carelessness or recklessness. Colloquial; implies the speaker blames the subject for bringing problems upon themselves or others. 你又惹禍了 (you've caused trouble again).

examples.chinese: 他在網路上發表不當言論，沒想到惹了大禍，公司也因此受到牽連。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǎnglù shàng fābiǎo bùdàng yánlùn, méi xiǎngdào rě le dà huò, gōngsī yě yīncǐ shòudào qiānlián.
examples.english: He posted inappropriate comments online and unexpectedly caused a major scandal, dragging his company into it as well.

examples.chinese: 媽媽警告他不要去招惹那群人，免得惹禍上身。
examples.pinyin: Māma jǐnggào tā bùyào qù zhāorě nà qún rén, miǎndé rěhuò shàngshēn.
examples.english: His mother warned him not to provoke that group of people, lest he bring trouble upon himself.

english: (saying) eyes brimming with tears; extremely moved
semanticNote: Eyes brimming with hot tears — deeply moved to the point of tears, but not necessarily crying outright. Used to describe profound emotion at touching scenes, reunions, or moments of gratitude. Literary and formal register.

components.meaning: eye socket; rim of the eye

examples.chinese: 看到多年未見的老父親出現在門口，她頓時熱淚盈眶，說不出話來。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào duō nián wèi jiàn de lǎo fùqīn chūxiàn zài ménkǒu, tā dùnshí rèlèi-yíngkuàng, shuō bù chū huà lái.
examples.english: Seeing her aged father, whom she hadn't seen in years, appear at the doorway, her eyes instantly filled with tears and she was speechless.

examples.chinese: 頒獎典禮上，得主熱淚盈眶地感謝所有支持他走到今天的人。
examples.pinyin: Bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ shàng, dézhǔ rèlèi-yíngkuàng de gǎnxiè suǒyǒu zhīchí tā zǒu dào jīntiān de rén.
examples.english: At the awards ceremony, the winner, eyes brimming with tears, thanked everyone who had supported him on his journey.

semanticNote: Popular, trending, or in high demand. 熱門話題 (hot topic), 熱門職業 (in-demand career). Common in Taiwan media and everyday speech. Slightly more colloquial than 流行; implies something everyone is talking about or competing for.

examples.chinese: 人工智慧近年來成為最熱門的科技領域，吸引大量人才投入。
examples.pinyin: Réngōng zhìhuì jìnnián lái chéngwéi zuì rèmén de kējì lǐngyù, xīyǐn dàliàng réncái tóurù.
examples.english: Artificial intelligence has become the hottest field in tech in recent years, attracting a large influx of talent.

examples.chinese: 這家新開的珍珠奶茶店天天大排長龍，已經是整條街最熱門的店。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xīn kāi de zhēnzhū nǎichá diàn tiāntiān dà pái cháng lóng, yǐjīng shì zhěng tiáo jiē zuì rèmén de diàn.
examples.english: This newly opened bubble tea shop has long lines every day and has become the most popular spot on the entire street.

semanticNote: Humanitarianism; humane treatment. 人道主義 (humanitarianism) and 人道救援 (humanitarian aid) are standard compound forms in Taiwan media. As an adjective, 人道的 means humane. Contrasts with 殘忍 (cruel) or 不人道 (inhumane).

examples.chinese: 國際組織呼籲各方遵守人道原則，保護平民免受戰火波及。
examples.pinyin: Guójì zǔzhī hūqiào gèfāng zūnshǒu réndào yuánzé, bǎohù píngmín miǎn shòu zhànhuǒ bōjí.
examples.english: International organizations have called on all parties to uphold humanitarian principles and protect civilians from the ravages of war.

examples.chinese: 批評者認為這種關押方式不人道，應立即改善拘留條件。
examples.pinyin: Pīpíng zhě rènwéi zhè zhǒng guānyā fāngshì bù réndào, yīng lìjí gǎishàn jūliú tiáojiàn.
examples.english: Critics argued that this method of detention is inhumane and that conditions should be improved immediately.

semanticNote: Personality, character, or moral integrity. In psychology, 人格 maps to 'personality' (人格障礙 = personality disorder). In everyday speech it often means one's personal dignity or moral character — 有人格 (has integrity), 人格低落 (of low moral character).

examples.chinese: 他以人格擔保這件事的真實性，讓在場所有人都相信了他。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ réngé dānbǎo zhè jiàn shì de zhēnshíxìng, ràng zàichǎng suǒyǒu rén dōu xiāngxìn le tā.
examples.english: He vouched for the truth of the matter on his personal integrity, convincing everyone present.

examples.chinese: 心理師指出，童年創傷往往會對一個人日後的人格發展產生深遠影響。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ shī zhǐchū, tóngnián chuāngshāng wǎngwǎng huì duì yī gè rén rìhòu de réngé fāzhǎn chǎnshēng shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: The psychologist noted that childhood trauma often has a profound impact on a person's personality development later in life.

semanticNote: Manual labor, manpower, or something man-made/artificial. 人工智慧 (artificial intelligence — standard Taiwan term, abbreviated AI or 人工智慧) is ubiquitous in current usage. 人工費 (labor cost), 人工湖 (man-made lake). Contrasts with 天然 (natural).

examples.chinese: 這座人工湖由政府出資興建，如今已成為市民休閒的好去處。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò réngōng hú yóu zhèngfǔ chūzī xīngjiàn, rújīn yǐ chéngwéi shìmín xiūxián de hǎo qùchù.
examples.english: This man-made lake was funded and built by the government and has now become a popular leisure spot for residents.

examples.chinese: 隨著人工智慧技術的普及，許多重複性工作正逐漸被自動化取代。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe réngōng zhìhuì jìshù de pǔjí, xǔduō chóngfùxìng gōngzuò zhèng zhújiàn bèi zìdònghuà qǔdài.
examples.english: As artificial intelligence technology becomes more widespread, many repetitive jobs are gradually being replaced by automation.

english: other people; others; they; I; family; household
semanticNote: Multi-functional: (1) other people / others (別人); (2) a household or family (一戶人家); (3) colloquial first-person pronoun — spoken (especially by women) to refer to oneself with a soft or mildly aggrieved tone. Context determines meaning.

examples.chinese: 你老是這樣，人家說什麼你都不聽，真的很讓人傷心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lǎo shì zhèyàng, rénjia shuō shénme nǐ dōu bù tīng, zhēnde hěn ràng rén shānxīn.
examples.english: You're always like this — you never listen to what I say, it's really heartbreaking.

examples.chinese: 山腳下住著幾戶人家，過著與世無爭的平靜生活。
examples.pinyin: Shānjiǎo xià zhù zhe jǐ hù rénjia, guò zhe yǔ shì wú zhēng de píngjìng shēnghuó.
examples.english: A few households live at the foot of the mountain, leading peaceful lives removed from the outside world.

semanticNote: The human world; this mortal realm — often used poetically to contrast with heaven (天堂) or hell (地獄), or simply to evoke the beauty or suffering of earthly life. Literary register. 人間仙境 (earthly paradise), 人間蒸發 (vanish without a trace).

examples.chinese: 詩人筆下的九份，宛如人間仙境，吸引無數旅人前往探尋。
examples.pinyin: Shīrén bǐ xià de Jiǔfèn, wǎnrú rénjiān xiānjìng, xīyǐn wúshù lǚrén qiánwǎng tànxún.
examples.english: The Jiufen depicted in the poet's writing resembles an earthly paradise, drawing countless travelers to explore it.

examples.chinese: 他在案發後便從此人間蒸發，警方至今仍未掌握其下落。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài àn fā hòu biàn cóngcǐ rénjiān zhēngfā, jǐngfāng zhìjīn réng wèi zhǎngwò qí xiàluò.
