examples.english: The new brand entered the market with enormous fanfare, but went quiet within three months — shocking the industry.

semanticNote: Reputation or fame — the esteem in which a person, institution, or product is held. 聲譽卓著 (of outstanding reputation), 損害聲譽 (damage one's reputation). More formal than 名聲; common in corporate, academic, and professional contexts.

examples.chinese: 這所大學在工程領域享有卓著的國際聲譽，每年吸引大批優秀學生申請。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài gōngchéng lǐngyù xiǎngyǒu zhuózhe de guójì shēngyù, měi nián xīyǐn dà pī yōuxiù xuéshēng shēnqǐng.
examples.english: This university enjoys outstanding international renown in engineering, attracting large numbers of outstanding students to apply every year.

examples.chinese: 這起食安醜聞嚴重損害了該品牌的聲譽，消費者信心一時難以恢復。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shí'ān chǒuwén yánzhòng sǔnhài le gāi pǐnpái de shēngyù, xiāofèizhě xìnxīn yīshí nányǐ huīfù.
examples.english: This food safety scandal seriously damaged the brand's reputation, and consumer confidence will take time to recover.

semanticNote: Livestock or domesticated animals — specifically those raised for agricultural use: cattle, horses, pigs, goats, sheep, and so on. Formal and technical register; everyday speech uses specific animal names. 牲畜疾病 (livestock disease), 飼養牲畜 (raise livestock).

examples.chinese: 口蹄疫一旦爆發，會在牲畜之間迅速蔓延，造成農業上的嚴重損失。
examples.pinyin: Kǒutí yì yīdàn bàofā, huì zài shēngchù zhījiān xùnsù mànyán, zàochéng nóngyè shàng de yánzhòng sǔnshī.
examples.english: Once foot-and-mouth disease breaks out, it spreads rapidly among livestock, causing serious agricultural losses.

examples.chinese: 這個山區部落仍保有傳統的游牧生活方式，居民逐水草而居，帶著牲畜遷徙。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū bùluò réng bǎoyǒu chuántǒng de yóumù shēnghuó fāngshì, jūmín zhú shuǐcǎo ér jū, dài zhe shēngchù qiānxǐ.
examples.english: This mountain community still maintains a traditional nomadic way of life, with residents following water and pasture and migrating with their livestock.

semanticNote: A provincial capital — the seat of a provincial government in mainland China's administrative system. Taiwan does not have provinces in active use (臺灣省 was functionally abolished in 1998), so 省會 appears mainly in historical, geographical, or references to mainland China's cities.

examples.chinese: 成都是四川省的省會，也是西南地區最重要的經濟與文化中心之一。
examples.pinyin: Chéngdū shì Sìchuān shěng de shěnghuì, yě shì xīnán dìqū zuì zhòngyào de jīngjì yǔ wénhuà zhōngxīn zhī yī.
examples.english: Chengdu is the provincial capital of Sichuan and one of the most important economic and cultural centers in southwest China.

examples.chinese: 許多求職者從鄉村移居到省會城市，尋求更多的就業機會。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qiúzhí zhě cóng xiāngcūn yíjū dào shěnghuì chéngshì, xúnqiú gèng duō de jiùyè jīhuì.
examples.english: Many job seekers relocate from rural areas to provincial capitals in search of greater employment opportunities.

english: victory or defeat; the outcome of a battle
semanticNote: Victory or defeat; the outcome of a contest. 勝負未定 (the outcome is still undecided), 一決勝負 (fight it out; settle who wins), 不計勝負 (not caring about winning or losing). Used in sports, competition, and military contexts.

examples.chinese: 這場棋局雙方勢均力敵，勝負難料，觀眾全程屏氣凝神。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng qíjú shuāngfāng shì jūn lì dí, shèngfù nán liào, guānzhòng quánchéng bǐng qì níng shén.
examples.english: Both sides in this chess match were evenly matched, the outcome unpredictable; the audience was riveted throughout.

examples.chinese: 運動比賽的勝負固然重要，但比賽過程中所展現的運動精神更值得讚許。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng bǐsài de shèngfù gùrán zhòngyào, dàn bǐsài guòchéng zhōng suǒ zhǎnxiàn de yùndòng jīngshén gèng zhídé zànxǔ.
examples.english: The outcome of an athletic competition matters, of course, but the sportsmanship displayed throughout the contest is even more worthy of praise.

semanticNote: To be abundant in; to produce in large quantities. 盛產水果 (abound in fruit), 臺灣盛產鳳梨 (Taiwan is famous for pineapples). Positive connotation emphasizing natural abundance. Common in agricultural, tourism, and geographic descriptions.

examples.chinese: 臺灣盛產各式熱帶與亞熱帶水果，芒果、鳳梨、蓮霧等享譽國際。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shèngchǎn gè shì rèdài yǔ yàrèdài shuǐguǒ, mángguǒ, fènglí, liánwù děng xiǎngyù guójì.
examples.english: Taiwan abounds in all kinds of tropical and subtropical fruits; mangoes, pineapples, and wax apples are internationally renowned.

examples.chinese: 這個沿海縣份盛產生蠔，每年吸引大批饕客專程前來品嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yánhǎi xiànfèn shèngchǎn shēngháo, měi nián xīyǐn dà pī tāokè zhuānchéng qiánlái pǐncháng.
examples.english: This coastal county abounds in oysters, drawing large numbers of food lovers each year who come especially to taste them.

english: to bloom; be in full flower
semanticNote: To bloom fully; to be in full flower. 鮮花盛開 (flowers in full bloom). Used both literally of plants and figuratively of a person's best years or talents flourishing. Highly visual and poetic; common in literary and travel writing.

examples.chinese: 陽明山每年春天百花盛開，吸引無數市民上山賞花踏青。
examples.pinyin: Yángmíng shān měi nián chūntiān bǎihuā shèngkāi, xīyǐn wúshù shìmín shàng shān shǎng huā tà qīng.
examples.english: Every spring, wildflowers bloom in full glory on Yangmingshan, drawing countless city residents up the mountain to admire the flowers and enjoy the outdoors.

examples.chinese: 她的藝術才華在中年時才真正盛開，作品在五十歲後愈發成熟動人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yìshù cáihuá zài zhōngnián shí cái zhēnzhèng shèngkāi, zuòpǐn zài wǔshí suì hòu yùfā chéngshú dòngrén.
examples.english: Her artistic talent truly blossomed in middle age; her work grew increasingly mature and moving after she turned fifty.

semanticNote: Great kindness or boundless hospitality — the warm generosity shown by a host. 盛情款待 (entertain with great hospitality), 盛情難卻 (hard to decline such gracious hospitality — a polite formula for accepting an invitation). Formal and ceremonial register.

examples.chinese: 承蒙貴公司的盛情款待，讓我們在訪問期間感受到無比的溫暖與熱情。
examples.pinyin: Chéngméng guì gōngsī de shèngqíng kuǎndài, ràng wǒmen zài fǎngwèn qījiān gǎnshòu dào wúbǐ de wēnnuǎn yǔ rèqíng.
examples.english: We are deeply grateful for your company's generous hospitality, which made us feel an immense warmth throughout our visit.

examples.chinese: 既然主人如此盛情，我也就不好意思再推辭，只好留下來共進晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán zhǔrén rúcǐ shèngqíng, wǒ yě jiù bù hǎoyìsi zài tuīcí, zhǐhǎo liú xiàlái gòng jìn wǎncān.
examples.english: Since the host was so gracious, I could hardly keep refusing and had no choice but to stay and join for dinner.

semanticNote: To be prevalent, widespread, or in vogue — something that is widely practiced or fashionable at a given time. 盛行一時 (prevalent for a time), 盛行於某地 (prevalent in a certain area). Neutral to slightly neutral-negative depending on context (e.g., bad practices can also 盛行).

examples.chinese: 近年來，手搖飲料文化在臺灣盛行，便利商店和專賣店幾乎無所不在。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, shǒuyáo yǐnliào wénhuà zài Táiwān shèngxíng, biànlì shāngdiàn hé zhuānmài diàn jīhū wúsuǒ bù zài.
examples.english: In recent years, the culture of hand-shaken beverages has become widespread in Taiwan, with convenience stores and specialty shops appearing almost everywhere.

examples.chinese: 十九世紀末，殖民主義在歐洲列強之間盛行，導致非洲和亞洲遭受大規模的侵略與剝削。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiǔ shìjì mò, zhímín zhǔyì zài Ōuzhōu lièqiáng zhījiān shèngxíng, dǎozhì Fēizhōu hé Yàzhōu zāoshòu dàguīmó de qīnlüè yǔ bōxuē.
examples.english: At the end of the nineteenth century, colonialism was rampant among the European powers, leading to large-scale invasion and exploitation of Africa and Asia.

semanticNote: A corpse or dead body — of a human or animal. 屍體 is the Traditional Chinese form. Neutral clinical register in forensic, medical, and news contexts. In criminal/legal reporting, 陳屍 (found dead) and 屍體 are standard Taiwan press usage. 遺體 is a more respectful term for a human body.

examples.chinese: 員警在河邊發現一具身分不明的屍體，已通知法醫前往相驗。
examples.pinyin: Yuánjǐng zài hé biān fāxiàn yī jù shēnfèn bùmíng de shītǐ, yǐ tōngzhī fǎyī qiánwǎng xiāngyàn.
examples.english: Police discovered an unidentified body by the river and have notified the medical examiner to proceed with an inspection.

examples.chinese: 考古學家在遺址中挖掘出距今三千年的屍體，保存狀況出乎意料地完整。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔ xué jiā zài yízhǐ zhōng wājué chū jù jīn sānqiān nián de shītǐ, bǎocún zhuàngkuàng chūhū yìliào de wánzhěng.
examples.english: Archaeologists excavated a body at the site dating back three thousand years, remarkably well preserved.

english: be involved in a crash; (have an) accident
semanticNote: To be involved in a crash or accident — specifically used for aviation, maritime, and train accidents. 飛機失事 (plane crash), 船隻失事 (ship disaster). Formal news register. Not used for minor traffic accidents (which are 車禍 or 事故).

examples.chinese: 一架私人飛機昨晚在山區失事墜毀，搜救人員正全力展開搜尋行動。
examples.pinyin: Yī jià sīrén fēijī zuówǎn zài shānqū shīshì zhuìhuǐ, sōujiù rényuán zhèng quánlì zhǎnkāi sōuxún xíngdòng.
examples.english: A private aircraft crashed in a mountainous area last night, and rescue personnel are conducting a full-scale search operation.

examples.chinese: 根據飛航安全調查委員會的報告，這次失事是由人為疏失所引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Fēiháng Ānquán Diàochá Wěiyuánhuì de bàogào, zhè cì shīshì shì yóu rénwéi shūshī suǒ yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to the Aviation Safety Council's report, this accident was caused by human error.

semanticNote: A mistake, error, or lapse — especially one made during performance (sports, music, work). 操作失誤 (operational error), 出現失誤 (make a mistake). More specific to an error committed in the course of action than 錯誤 (which is a broader term for being wrong).

examples.chinese: 選手在最後一跳出現失誤，痛失了原本觸手可及的金牌。
examples.pinyin: Xuǎnshǒu zài zuìhòu yī tiào chūxiàn shīwù, tòng shī le yuánběn chù shǒu kě jí de jīnpái.
examples.english: The athlete made an error on the final jump, heartbreakingly losing the gold medal that had been within reach.

examples.chinese: 這次手術中的操作失誤已提交醫療事故審查委員會進行調查。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shǒushù zhōng de cāozuò shīwù yǐ tíjiāo yīliáo shìgù shěnchá wěiyuánhuì jìnxíng diàochá.
examples.english: The operational error in this surgery has been referred to the medical incident review committee for investigation.

semanticNote: To go missing; to be unaccounted for. 失蹤人口 (missing persons), 人間蒸發 is the more vivid colloquial phrase. 失蹤案 (missing persons case). Taiwan has a formal missing persons alert system (協尋) coordinated through police.

examples.chinese: 一名八歲女童昨日放學後下落不明，家長已向員警報案協尋。
examples.pinyin: Yī míng bā suì nǚtóng zuórì fàngxué hòu xiàluò bùmíng, jiāzhǎng yǐ xiàng yuánjǐng bào'àn xiéxún.
examples.english: An eight-year-old girl went missing after school yesterday; her parents have filed a missing persons report with the police.

examples.chinese: 這名登山客已失蹤逾四十八小時，搜救人員持續在山區展開地毯式搜索。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng dēngshān kè yǐ shīzōng yú sìshíbā xiǎoshí, sōujiù rényuán chíxù zài shānqū zhǎnkāi dìtǎn shì sōusuǒ.
examples.english: This hiker has been missing for more than 48 hours; rescue personnel continue a carpet-search operation in the mountain area.

semanticNote: Teacher training; normal (school) — referring to the system for training educators. 師範大學 (Teachers University — 師大) is a prestigious institution in Taiwan; National Taiwan Normal University (國立臺灣師範大學, NTNU) is the most famous. 師範學院 (teachers college).

examples.chinese: 她畢業於國立臺灣師範大學中文系，目前在高中擔任國文老師。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìyè yú Guólì Táiwān Shīfàn Dàxué Zhōngwén xì, mùqián zài gāozhōng dānrèn Guówén lǎoshī.
examples.english: She graduated from the Department of Chinese at National Taiwan Normal University and currently teaches Chinese Literature at a senior high school.

examples.chinese: 師範教育的目的不只是傳授知識，更在於培養學生正直的品格與教育熱忱。
examples.pinyin: Shīfàn jiàoyù de mùdì bù zhǐ shì chuánshòu zhīshì, gèng zàiyú péiyǎng xuéshēng zhèngzhí de pǐngé yǔ jiàoyù rèchén.
examples.english: The purpose of teacher education is not merely to impart knowledge, but also to cultivate students' integrity and passion for education.

semanticNote: To exert or apply (pressure, influence, punishment, force). 施加壓力 (exert pressure), 施加影響 (exert influence). Always requires an object of what is being applied; the target follows 於 or 對. Formal register.

examples.chinese: 國際社會正對該政權施加強大的外交壓力，要求立即停止人權侵害。
examples.pinyin: Guójì shèhuì zhèng duì gāi zhèngquán shījiā qiángdà de wàijiāo yālì, yāoqiú lìjí tíngzhǐ rénquán qīnhài.
examples.english: The international community is exerting strong diplomatic pressure on the regime, demanding an immediate halt to human rights violations.

examples.chinese: 父母不應對孩子施加過多的學業壓力，以免影響其心理健康。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù yīng duì háizi shījiā guòduō de xuéyè yālì, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng qí xīnlǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Parents should not apply excessive academic pressure on their children, lest it affect their mental health.

english: use fully; put to good use
semanticNote: To display, exercise, or give full rein to (a skill, talent, or power). 施展才能 (display one's talents), 施展不開 (unable to exercise one's abilities — hemmed in). Implies deploying something one is capable of; often positive but can appear in the phrase 施展伎倆 (resort to tricks).

examples.chinese: 新公司給了他充分的空間施展才能，讓他如魚得水。
examples.pinyin: Xīn gōngsī gěi le tā chōngfèn de kōngjiān shīzhǎn cáinéng, ràng tā rú yú dé shuǐ.
examples.english: The new company gave him ample space to exercise his talents, and he thrived like a fish in water.

examples.chinese: 在這個守舊的環境裡，她的創意根本施展不開，只好萌生去意。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège shǒujiù de huánjìng lǐ, tā de chuàngyì gēnběn shīzhǎn bù kāi, zhǐhǎo méngshēng qù yì.
examples.english: In this conservative environment, her creativity had nowhere to go, and she began to think about leaving.

semanticNote: Full of; completely; one hundred percent. Intensifier meaning something is in full measure or utterly. 十足的信心 (complete confidence), 幹勁十足 (brimming with drive and energy), 神氣十足 (full of swagger). Always precedes or follows the quality it intensifies.

examples.chinese: 她上台演講時自信十足，完全看不出之前有多緊張。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngtái yǎnjiǎng shí zìxìn shízú, wánquán kàn bù chū zhīqián yǒu duō jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: When she took the stage to speak, she was brimming with confidence — you couldn't tell at all how nervous she'd been before.

examples.chinese: 這棟老宅充滿了日據時代的建築風格，十足的歷史感讓許多遊客流連忘返。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo zhái chōngmǎn le Rì jù shídài de jiànzhú fēnggé, shízú de lìshǐ gǎn ràng xǔduō yóukè liúlián wàngfǎn.
examples.english: This old building is full of Japanese colonial architectural style; its overwhelming historical atmosphere keeps many visitors lingering.

semanticNote: Petroleum or crude oil. 石油輸出國組織 (OPEC), 石油危機 (oil crisis), 石油公司 (oil company). Taiwan has no significant domestic oil production and is heavily dependent on imports; 中油 (CPC Corporation, Taiwan) is the state-run oil company. 汽油 is gasoline (refined product).

examples.chinese: 一九七三年的石油危機導致全球油價暴漲，重創各國經濟。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiǔ qī sān nián de shíyóu wéijī dǎozhì quánqiú yóujià bàozhǎng, zhòng chuāng gèguó jīngjì.
examples.english: The 1973 oil crisis caused global oil prices to skyrocket, severely damaging economies worldwide.

examples.chinese: 臺灣所需的石油幾乎全靠進口，因此國際油價的波動對民生影響十分直接。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān suǒ xū de shíyóu jīhū quán kào jìnkǒu, yīncǐ guójì yóujià de bōdòng duì mínshēng yǐngxiǎng shífēn zhíjiē.
examples.english: Taiwan relies almost entirely on imports for its petroleum needs, so fluctuations in international oil prices directly affect people's livelihoods.

semanticNote: Often; frequently; time and again. Interchangeable with 經常 in most contexts but slightly more literary. 時常想起 (often think of), 時常發生 (occur frequently). Implies a pattern of regularity without specifying intervals.

examples.chinese: 出國多年，他時常在夢中回到那條熟悉的老街，思念家鄉的滋味。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó duō nián, tā shícháng zài mèng zhōng huídào nà tiáo shúxī de lǎo jiē, sīniàn jiāxiāng de zīwèi.
examples.english: After years abroad, he often returned in his dreams to that familiar old street, longing for the tastes of home.

examples.chinese: 她時常提醒自己要活在當下，不要讓對未來的焦慮耗盡當下的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Tā shícháng tíxǐng zìjǐ yào huó zài dāngxià, bùyào ràng duì wèilái de jiāolǜ hàojìn dāngxià de kuàilè.
examples.english: She often reminds herself to live in the present and not let anxiety about the future drain the joy of now.

english: occasionally; often, but not at any fixed time
semanticNote: Occasionally; from time to time — often appearing in pairs (時而A，時而B) to describe alternating states or actions. 時而晴時而陰 (sometimes sunny, sometimes cloudy). Literary and descriptive; common in prose and poetry. More nuanced than 有時.

examples.chinese: 海面上的天氣時而晴朗時而起霧，讓出海的漁民格外謹慎。
examples.pinyin: Hǎimiàn shàng de tiānqì shí'ér qínglǎng shí'ér qǐ wù, ràng chūhǎi de yúmín gé wài jǐnshèn.
examples.english: The weather at sea alternates between clear and foggy, making fishermen who venture out especially cautious.

examples.chinese: 孩子躺在草地上，時而仰望天空，時而翻身玩耍，一臉無憂無慮的模樣。
examples.pinyin: Háizi tǎng zài cǎodì shàng, shí'ér yǎngwàng tiānkōng, shí'ér fān shēn wánshuǎ, yī liǎn wúyōu wúlǜ de múyàng.
examples.english: The child lay on the grass, sometimes gazing up at the sky, sometimes rolling over to play — a picture of carefree contentment.

semanticNote: Time; an era or period of life — with a nostalgic, poetic connotation. 美好的時光 (wonderful times), 似水流年 and 時光流逝 (time passes like flowing water) are common literary phrases. More emotionally resonant than 時間 (objective time) or 時代 (era).

examples.chinese: 回憶起童年在外婆家度過的那段時光，她的嘴角便忍不住微微上揚。
examples.pinyin: Huíyì qǐ tóngnián zài wàipó jiā dùguò de nà duàn shíguāng, tā de zuǐjiǎo biàn rěn bù zhù wēiwēi shàngyáng.
examples.english: Recalling the time she spent at her grandmother's house as a child, she couldn't help but let a faint smile cross her lips.

examples.chinese: 時光荏苒，轉眼間孩子已經長大成人，讓父母既驚喜又感慨。
examples.pinyin: Shíguāng rěnrǎn, zhuǎnyǎnjiān háizi yǐjīng zhǎngdà chéngrén, ràng fùmǔ jì jīngxǐ yòu gǎnkǎi.
examples.english: Time passes imperceptibly; in the blink of an eye the child has grown into an adult, filling the parents with both wonder and wistful emotion.

semanticNote: An opportune moment; timing; the right chance. 時機成熟 (the time is ripe), 抓住時機 (seize the moment), 時機不對 (bad timing). Emphasizes that the opportunity is time-sensitive and must be seized at the right moment. More strategic than 機會.

examples.chinese: 他認為現在進軍海外市場的時機已經成熟，決定大膽投資。
examples.pinyin: Tā rènwéi xiànzài jìnjūn hǎiwài shìchǎng de shíjī yǐjīng chéngshú, juédìng dǎdǎn tóuzī.
examples.english: He believes the time is now ripe to enter overseas markets and has decided to invest boldly.

examples.chinese: 談判時選對時機表態，往往能夠取得事半功倍的效果。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn shí xuǎn duì shíjī biǎotài, wǎngwǎng nénggòu qǔdé shì bàn gōng bèi de xiàoguǒ.
examples.english: Choosing the right moment to state your position in negotiations often achieves twice the result with half the effort.

semanticNote: Current events; the present situation. 關心時事 (follow current affairs), 時事評論 (current affairs commentary). Standard in news, education, and political discourse. 時事新聞 (current events news) appears in school curricula — Taiwan high schools include 時事 as a discussion topic in civics.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上固定閱讀三份報紙，以掌握國內外的最新時事動態。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang gùdìng yuèdú sān fèn bàozhǐ, yǐ zhǎngwò guónèi wài de zuìxīn shíshì dòngtài.
examples.english: He regularly reads three newspapers every morning to stay on top of the latest current events at home and abroad.

examples.chinese: 這堂課要求學生每週針對一則時事新聞發表個人看法，培養批判性思考能力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè yāoqiú xuéshēng měi zhōu zhēn duì yī zé shíshì xīnwén fābiǎo gèrén kànfǎ, péiyǎng pīpànxìng sīkǎo nénglì.
examples.english: This class requires students to share their personal views on one current news story each week to develop critical thinking skills.

semanticNote: To identify, distinguish, or recognize — by discerning characteristics. 識別身分 (identify someone), 人臉識別 (facial recognition), 品牌識別 (brand identity). Common in tech and security contexts: 指紋識別 (fingerprint recognition) is standard Taiwan usage for biometrics.

examples.chinese: 這款手機支援臉部識別解鎖，使用起來既方便又安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī zhīchí liǎnbù shíbié jiěsuǒ, shǐyòng qǐlái jì fāngbiàn yòu ānquán.
examples.english: This phone supports facial recognition unlocking, which is both convenient and secure to use.

examples.chinese: 專家能從筆跡的細微差異中識別出偽造文件，防止詐騙行為。
examples.pinyin: Zhuānjiā néng cóng bǐjì de xìwēi chāyì zhōng shíbié chū wèizào wénjiàn, fángzhǐ zhàpiàn xíngwéi.
examples.english: Experts can identify forged documents from subtle differences in handwriting to prevent fraud.

semanticNote: Good value; offering real, tangible benefit — especially price-to-quality ratio. 實惠的價格 (affordable/value price), 又好又實惠 (good quality and great value). Very common in Taiwan consumer and retail contexts; the opposite of flashy or overpriced. More pragmatic than 划算.

examples.chinese: 這家自助餐廳的菜色豐富、價格實惠，附近的上班族幾乎天天報到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zìzhù cāntīng de càisè fēngfù, jiàgé shíhuì, fùjìn de shàngbān zú jīhū tiāntiān bàodào.
examples.english: This buffet restaurant has a wide variety of dishes at great prices; nearby office workers come in almost every day.

examples.chinese: 買東西不一定要選最貴的，只要品質好、價格實惠，就是最聰明的消費選擇。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi bù yīdìng yào xuǎn zuì guì de, zhǐyào pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàgé shíhuì, jiù shì zuì cōngmíng de xiāofèi xuǎnzé.
examples.english: When shopping you don't have to choose the most expensive — as long as the quality is good and the price is right, it's the smartest consumer choice.

semanticNote: Strength, capability, or real power — the actual capacity someone or something has, as opposed to appearance or reputation. 實力派 (someone whose success is backed by genuine ability), 展現實力 (demonstrate one's strength). Common in sports, business, and geopolitics.

examples.chinese: 這支球隊雖然排名不高，但實力不容小覷，對手切勿輕敵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì suīrán páimíng bù gāo, dàn shílì bùróng xiǎoqù, duìshǒu qièwù qīngdí.
examples.english: This team may not be highly ranked, but their actual strength is not to be underestimated — opponents should not take them lightly.

examples.chinese: 在競爭激烈的就業市場上，光靠學歷是不夠的，紮實的專業實力才是關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Zài jìngzhēng jīliè de jiùyè shìchǎng shàng, guāng kào xuélì shì bùgòu de, zhāshí de zhuānyè shílì cái shì guānjiàn.
examples.english: In a fiercely competitive job market, academic credentials alone aren't enough — solid professional capability is the key.

english: to implement; put into effect; carry out
semanticNote: To implement or put into effect — specifically for policies, laws, plans, or measures. 實施方案 (implement a plan), 全面實施 (implement comprehensively). More formal than 執行 (carry out); implies rolling something out on a systemic level.

examples.chinese: 新的垃圾分類政策將於下個月起正式實施，民眾需配合調整丟垃圾的習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xīn de lājī fēnlèi zhèngcè jiāng yú xià gè yuè qǐ zhèngshì shíshī, mínzhòng xū pèihé tiáozhěng diū lājī de xíguàn.
examples.english: The new waste sorting policy will officially be implemented starting next month; residents need to adjust their rubbish disposal habits accordingly.

examples.chinese: 該法案通過後，主管機關將在六個月內研擬細則並著手實施。
examples.pinyin: Gāi fǎ'àn tōngguò hòu, zhǔguǎn jīguān jiāng zài liù gè yuè nèi yánní xìzé bìng zhuóshǒu shíshī.
examples.english: After the bill passes, the competent authority will draft detailed rules within six months and proceed with implementation.

english: be practical and realistic; seek truth from facts
semanticNote: Seek truth from facts; be practical and realistic. A key phrase in Chinese political and intellectual discourse — stresses grounding decisions in objective reality rather than ideology or wishful thinking. Used in academic, business, and everyday contexts to mean 'let's be realistic about this'.

examples.chinese: 我們在評估這項計畫時，必須實事求是，不能因為情感因素而迴避問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài pínggū zhè xiàng jìhuà shí, bìxū shíshì-qiúshì, bùnéng yīnwèi qínggǎn yīnsù ér huíbì wèntí.
examples.english: When evaluating this project, we must seek truth from the facts and not avoid issues because of emotional considerations.

examples.chinese: 他做事一向實事求是，從不誇大成績，也不掩蓋問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì yīxiàng shíshì-qiúshì, cóng bù kuādà chéngjì, yě bù yǎngài wèntí.
examples.english: He has always been realistic in his work — never exaggerating achievements or concealing problems.

english: to implement; put into practice; carry out
semanticNote: To put into practice; to carry out — similar to 實施 but slightly more general and less formal. 實行民主 (practice democracy), 實行新制度 (put a new system into practice). Often used when emphasizing the transition from theory to practice.

examples.chinese: 公司決定從下季起實行彈性上班制，允許員工自行調整工作時間。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng cóng xià jì qǐ shíxíng tánxìng shàngbān zhì, yǔnxǔ yuángōng zìxíng tiáozhěng gōngzuò shíjiān.
examples.english: The company has decided to implement a flextime policy starting next quarter, allowing employees to adjust their working hours themselves.

examples.chinese: 學校開始實行手機禁令後，學生上課的專注度明顯提升。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāishǐ shíxíng shǒujī jìnlìng hòu, xuéshēng shàngkè de zhuānzhùdù míngxiǎn tíshēng.
examples.english: Since the school started enforcing the mobile phone ban, students' focus in class has noticeably improved.

semanticNote: Substance, essence, or the real nature of something — as opposed to surface form or appearance. 實質內容 (substantive content), 實質上 (in substance; essentially), 名存實亡 (exists in name only — lacking substance). Formal and analytical register.

examples.chinese: 這份協議雖然措辭模糊，但實質上已賦予對方相當大的法律權利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn xiéyì suīrán cuòcí móhu, dàn shízhì shàng yǐ fùyǔ duìfāng xiāngdāng dà de fǎlǜ quánlì.
examples.english: Though the wording of this agreement is vague, it has in substance already granted the other party considerable legal rights.

examples.chinese: 我們需要的是改革的實質，而不只是表面上的形式調整。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào de shì gǎigé de shízhì, ér bù zhǐ shì biǎomiàn shàng de xíngshì tiáozhěng.
examples.english: What we need is substantive reform, not just surface-level adjustments in form.

semanticNote: To pick up (from the ground); also the formal financial numeral for 十 (10) used on checks and legal documents to prevent fraud (e.g., 拾萬元 = 100,000 dollars). 拾金不昧 (return found valuables honestly — an idiom) is a classic moral phrase in Taiwan primary school ethics.

examples.chinese: 他在路上拾到一個裝有現金和證件的皮夾，立刻送到附近的派出所。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lùshàng shí dào yī gè zhuāng yǒu xiànjīn hé zhèngjiàn de píjiā, lìkè sòng dào fùjìn de pàichūsuǒ.
examples.english: He found a wallet containing cash and documents on the road and immediately turned it in to the nearest police station.

examples.chinese: 支票上的金額必須以大寫數字填寫，例如「新臺幣拾萬元整」，以防止遭人竄改。
examples.pinyin: Zhīpiào shàng de jīn'é bìxū yǐ dàxiě shùzì tiánxiě, lìrú "Xīn Táibì shí wàn yuán zhěng", yǐ fángzhǐ zāo rén cuàngǎi.
examples.english: The amount on a cheque must be written in formal numerals — e.g., 'NT$100,000 exactly' — to prevent tampering.

semanticNote: A mission — a diplomatic or official assignment; also a sense of calling or personal purpose. 使命感 (sense of mission; calling) is widely used in Taiwan in education, corporate culture, and personal development contexts. 完成使命 (accomplish the mission).

examples.chinese: 這批外交官肩負著維護雙邊關係的重大使命，此行意義非凡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī wàijiāo guān jiānfù zhe wéihù shuāngbiān guānxi de zhòngdà shǐmìng, cǐ xíng yìyì fēifán.
examples.english: These diplomats bear the weighty mission of upholding bilateral relations; this trip is of extraordinary significance.

examples.chinese: 她從小就立志成為醫生，將照顧病患視為自己一生的使命。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù lìzhì chéngwéi yīshēng, jiāng zhàogù bìnghuàn shì wéi zìjǐ yīshēng de shǐmìng.
examples.english: She aspired to be a doctor from childhood and sees caring for patients as her life's calling.

english: demonstrate; lead the way; show how something is done
semanticNote: To demonstrate or show how something is done; a demonstration or model. 示範動作 (demonstrate a movement), 示範教學 (demonstration teaching), 示範區 (model zone/pilot zone). In Taiwan, 示範 also appears in policy contexts: 自由經濟示範區 (Free Economic Pilot Zone).

examples.chinese: 教練親自示範正確的跑步姿勢，讓學員能清楚理解動作要領。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn qīnzì shìfàn zhèngquè de pǎobù zīshì, ràng xuéyuán néng qīngchǔ lǐjiě dòngzuò yàolǐng.
examples.english: The coach personally demonstrated the correct running posture so that students could clearly understand the key points of the movement.

examples.chinese: 這所學校被指定為數位教學的示範學校，其經驗將推廣至全縣各校。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào bèi zhǐdìng wéi shùwèi jiàoxué de shìfàn xuéxiào, qí jīngyàn jiāng tuīguǎng zhì quán xiàn gè xiào.
examples.english: This school has been designated a model school for digital teaching; its experience will be extended to all schools in the county.

semanticNote: To hold a protest demonstration; a demonstration or rally. 示威遊行 (protest march), 示威群眾 (protesters). Taiwan has a vibrant protest culture with a robust legal framework (集會遊行法) — street demonstrations are common and widely reported. Not inherently negative in Taiwan context.

examples.chinese: 數千名民眾聚集在立法院外示威，要求政府撤回有爭議的修法草案。
examples.pinyin: Shù qiān míng mínzhòng jùjí zài Lìfǎyuàn wài shìwēi, yāoqiú zhèngfǔ chèhuí yǒu zhēngyì de xiū fǎ cǎo'àn.
examples.english: Thousands of people gathered outside the Legislative Yuan to protest, demanding the government withdraw the controversial legislative amendment.

examples.chinese: 這場示威遊行全程平和，參與者手持標語，高喊訴求口號。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng shìwēi yóuxíng quánchéng pínghé, cānyù zhě shǒuchí biāoyǔ, gāo hǎn sùqiú kǒuhào.
examples.english: The protest march was entirely peaceful; participants held banners and chanted slogans expressing their demands.

english: to signal; to hint; to gesture; to motion; to indicate (an idea to sb)
semanticNote: To signal, hint, or gesture — conveying meaning through a look, nod, hand movement, or other non-verbal cue. 示意圖 (schematic diagram; illustration showing intent) is also a common written usage. More subtle than 暗示 (hint) and less verbal than 說明.

examples.chinese: 主持人向台下的工作人員示意，請他們立刻切換到下一個畫面。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔchírén xiàng tái xià de gōngzuò rényuán shìyì, qǐng tāmen lìkè qiēhuàn dào xià yī gè huàmiàn.
examples.english: The host signaled to the crew backstage to immediately switch to the next screen.

examples.chinese: 他用眼神向她示意，讓她不要在此時開口，等一會兒再說。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng yǎnshén xiàng tā shìyì, ràng tā bùyào zài cǐ shí kāikǒu, děng yīhuìr zài shuō.
examples.english: He signaled to her with a look not to speak at this moment and to wait a while before saying anything.

semanticNote: A generation or era; from generation to generation. 世代交替 (generational turnover), 世代差異 (generational gap), 跨世代 (cross-generational). In Taiwan sociology and media, 世代 is frequently used in discussions of 年輕世代 (younger generation) vs. older cohorts on topics like housing, politics, and values.

examples.chinese: 臺灣不同世代對於房價和租屋問題有截然不同的看法與處境。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān bùtóng shìdài duìyú fángjià hé zū wū wèntí yǒu jiérán bùtóng de kànfǎ yǔ chǔjìng.
examples.english: Different generations in Taiwan hold vastly different views and face very different circumstances when it comes to housing prices and renting.

examples.chinese: 這個家族世代務農，對這片土地有著難以割捨的深厚情感。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiāzú shìdài wùnóng, duì zhè piàn tǔdì yǒu zhe nányǐ gēshě de shēnhòu qínggǎn.
examples.english: This family has farmed for generations and holds a deep, inseparable emotional bond with this land.

semanticNote: Is bound to; will inevitably. Expresses logical or situational inevitability — stronger than 可能 (possibly) and 必然 (necessarily) in conveying a near-certain outcome given current conditions. 勢必造成影響 (is bound to have an impact). Formal written register.

examples.chinese: 若政府不盡快採取因應措施，這場旱災勢必對農業生產造成嚴重衝擊。
examples.pinyin: Ruò zhèngfǔ bù jǐnkuài cǎiqǔ yīnyìng cuòshī, zhè chǎng hànzāi shìbì duì nóngyè shēngchǎn zàochéng yánzhòng chōngjí.
examples.english: If the government doesn't take countermeasures soon, this drought is bound to cause serious disruption to agricultural production.

examples.chinese: 雙方若繼續僵持，談判勢必破裂，後果難以估量。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng ruò jìxù jiāngjì, tánpàn shìbì pòliè, hòuguǒ nányǐ gūliàng.
examples.english: If both sides continue to dig in their heels, the negotiations are bound to collapse — the consequences would be hard to estimate.

semanticNote: Power, influence, or force — especially of a group, faction, or organization. 勢力範圍 (sphere of influence), 黑道勢力 (criminal underworld influence). Often carries a slightly negative or threatening connotation; used in political, criminal, and geopolitical contexts.

examples.chinese: 當局正積極打擊滲透地方政治的黑道勢力，以維護選舉的公正性。
examples.pinyin: Dāngjú zhèng jījí dǎjí shèntòu dìfāng zhèngzhì de hēidào shìlì, yǐ wéihù xuǎnjǔ de gōngzhèngxìng.
examples.english: Authorities are actively cracking down on criminal underworld forces that have infiltrated local politics to protect the fairness of elections.

examples.chinese: 這兩大政黨長期主導臺灣的政治生態，其他小黨的勢力相對有限。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng dà zhèngdǎng chángqī zhǔdǎo Táiwān de zhèngzhì shēngtài, qítā xiǎo dǎng de shìlì xiāngduì yǒuxiàn.
examples.english: These two major parties have long dominated Taiwan's political landscape; the influence of smaller parties is relatively limited.

semanticNote: An accident or mishap — typically unplanned and causing damage or injury. 交通事故 (traffic accident), 工安事故 (workplace accident), 核能事故 (nuclear accident). More formal than 意外; common in official reports, insurance, and news. 事故責任 (accident liability).

examples.chinese: 工廠昨日發生一起工安事故，造成兩名作業員受傷，已送醫治療。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng zuórì fāshēng yī qǐ gōng'ān shìgù, zàochéng liǎng míng zuòyèyuán shòushāng, yǐ sòng yī zhìliáo.
examples.english: A workplace accident occurred at the factory yesterday, injuring two workers who were taken to hospital for treatment.

examples.chinese: 交通事故發生後，駕駛應立即開啟警示燈並設置警示三角錐，避免二次撞擊。
examples.pinyin: Jiāotōng shìgù fāshēng hòu, jiàshǐ yīng lìjí kāiqǐ jǐngshì dēng bìng shèzhì jǐngshì sānjião zhuī, bìmiǎn èrcì zhuàngjí.
examples.english: After a traffic accident occurs, the driver should immediately switch on hazard lights and set out warning triangles to prevent a secondary collision.

semanticNote: Deeds, achievements, or notable acts — typically of a person being praised or commemorated. 先烈事蹟 (deeds of martyrs), 英雄事蹟 (heroic deeds). Slightly formal and retrospective; used in biographies, tributes, and commendations. More concrete than 貢獻 (contributions).

examples.chinese: 博物館特設展廳，詳細介紹這位臺灣醫療先驅一生的事蹟與貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn tè shè zhǎntīng, xiángxì jièshào zhè wèi Táiwān yīliáo xiānqū yīshēng de shìjì yǔ gòngxiàn.
examples.english: The museum has set up a special exhibition hall providing a detailed account of this pioneering figure in Taiwan's medical history and their lifetime of achievements.

examples.chinese: 她的慈善事蹟廣為人知，長年默默資助偏鄉兒童的教育費用。
examples.pinyin: Tā de císhàn shìjì guǎng wéi rén zhī, chángnián mòmò zīzhù piānyāng értóng de jiàoyù fèiyòng.
examples.english: Her charitable deeds are widely known; for years she has quietly funded the education of children in remote areas.

semanticNote: An event, incident, or happening — often of some significance or public interest. More neutral in tone than 事故 (accident) or 事變 (upheaval). 歷史事件 (historical event), 突發事件 (sudden incident), 外交事件 (diplomatic incident). Standard in news and academic contexts.

examples.chinese: 二二八事件是臺灣近代史上最重要也最沉痛的歷史事件之一。
examples.pinyin: Èr'èrbā shìjiàn shì Táiwān jìndài shǐ shàng zuì zhòngyào yě zuì chéntòng de lìshǐ shìjiàn zhī yī.
examples.english: The February 28 Incident is one of the most significant and painful events in Taiwan's modern history.

examples.chinese: 這起外交事件迅速發酵，兩國緊張關係在短短幾天內急劇升溫。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ wàijiāo shìjiàn xùnsù fājiào, liǎng guó jǐnzhāng guānxi zài duǎnduǎn jǐ tiān nèi jíjù shēngwēn.
examples.english: This diplomatic incident escalated quickly, and tensions between the two countries intensified dramatically within just a few days.

semanticNote: The state of affairs; the situation as it currently stands — often used when referring to a developing or concerning situation. 事態嚴峻 (the situation is serious), 事態發展 (how the situation develops), 控制事態 (control the situation). Formal news and official register.

examples.chinese: 隨著事態不斷升溫，政府決定介入調停，避免衝突進一步擴大。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shìtài bùduàn shēngwēn, zhèngfǔ juédìng jièrù tiáotíng, bìmiǎn chōngtū jìnyībù kuòdà.
examples.english: As the situation continued to escalate, the government decided to step in to mediate and prevent the conflict from spreading further.

examples.chinese: 記者會上，發言人強調事態仍在掌控之中，請民眾保持冷靜。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě huì shàng, fāyán rén qiángdiào shìtài réng zài zhǎngkòng zhī zhōng, qǐng mínzhòng bǎochí lěngjìng.
examples.english: At the press conference, the spokesperson stressed that the situation remains under control and asked the public to stay calm.

semanticNote: Affairs, work, or business matters — often routine or administrative tasks. 日常事務 (daily affairs), 法律事務所 (law firm; literally 'legal affairs office' — the standard Taiwan term for a law office). 公務 is specifically public/government affairs; 事務 is broader.

examples.chinese: 他委託一家法律事務所處理遺產繼承的相關事宜。
examples.pinyin: Tā wěituō yī jiā fǎlǜ shìwùsuǒ chǔlǐ yíchǎn jìchéng de xiāngguān shìyí.
examples.english: He entrusted a law firm to handle matters related to the inheritance of the estate.

examples.chinese: 秘書負責處理主管的日常行政事務，讓主管能專注於核心業務。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū fùzé chǔlǐ zhǔguǎn de rìcháng xíngzhèng shìwù, ràng zhǔguǎn néng zhuānzhù yú héxīn yèwù.
examples.english: The secretary handles the manager's routine administrative affairs so the manager can focus on core business.

semanticNote: A matter, item, or point on an agenda — typically listed in formal notices, contracts, or instructions. 注意事項 (points to note; precautions) is extremely common in Taiwan on signage, forms, and documents. 待辦事項 (to-do items; action items).

examples.chinese: 報名表背面列有詳細的注意事項，請參加者務必仔細閱讀後再填寫。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng biǎo bèimiàn liè yǒu xiángxì de zhùyì shìxiàng, qǐng cānjiā zhě wùbì zǐxì yuèdú hòu zài tiánxiě.
examples.english: The back of the registration form lists detailed points to note; participants must read carefully before filling it in.

examples.chinese: 會議結束前，主席逐一確認了本次會議決議的各項待辦事項及負責人。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù qián, zhǔxí zhúyī quèrèn le běn cì huìyì juéyì de gèxiàng dài bàn shìxiàng jí fùzé rén.
examples.english: Before the meeting concluded, the chair went through each action item arising from the meeting's resolutions and confirmed who was responsible.

semanticNote: Career, enterprise, or a cause one devotes oneself to. 事業心 (career ambition; drive), 公益事業 (public-interest enterprise), 慈善事業 (charitable cause). In everyday Taiwan usage, 事業 most often refers to one's professional career or business ventures. 事業有成 (achieve professional success).

examples.chinese: 她三十歲創業，花了十年時間將一個小工作室打造成年營業額破億的事業。
examples.pinyin: Tā sānshí suì chuàngyè, huā le shí nián shíjiān jiāng yī gè xiǎo gōngzuòshì dǎzào chéng nián yíngyè'é pò yì de shìyè.
examples.english: She started her business at thirty and spent ten years building a small studio into an enterprise with annual revenues exceeding a hundred million.

examples.chinese: 他將推廣臺灣原住民族文化視為一生的事業，不辭辛勞地奔走各地演說。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāng tuīguǎng Táiwān yuánzhùmínzú wénhuà shì wéi yīshēng de shìyè, bù cí xīnláo de bēnzǒu gèdì yǎnshuō.
examples.english: He regards promoting Taiwan's indigenous cultures as his life's cause and tirelessly travels everywhere to speak about it.

semanticNote: To try or attempt — with the implication that the effort may or may not succeed. More formal than 試著; often appears in contexts where the attempt is difficult, uncertain, or unauthorized. 試圖逃跑 (attempt to escape), 試圖說服 (try to persuade).

examples.chinese: 嫌疑人趁看守不備時試圖逃跑，但被守衛及時制止。
examples.pinyin: Xiányí rén chèn kānshǒu bù bèi shí shìtú táopǎo, dàn bèi shǒuwèi jíshí zhìzhǐ.
examples.english: The suspect attempted to escape while the guard was off guard, but was stopped in time by security.

examples.chinese: 研究人員試圖透過基因療法治癒這種罕見疾病，目前仍在臨床試驗階段。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán shìtú tòuguò jīyīn liáofǎ zhìyù zhè zhǒng hǎnjiàn jíbìng, mùqián réng zài línchuáng shìyàn jiēduàn.
examples.english: Researchers are attempting to cure this rare disease through gene therapy, which is still in the clinical trial stage.

semanticNote: An experiment or test; to test or experiment. 臨床試驗 (clinical trial), 核試驗 (nuclear test), 試驗田 (experimental field). More scientific and systematic than 嘗試 (attempt); implies a controlled procedure to verify something. 試驗階段 (testing phase).

examples.chinese: 新藥在取得上市許可前，必須經過嚴格的臨床試驗，以確保安全性與有效性。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yào zài qǔdé shàngshì xǔkě qián, bìxū jīngguò yángé de línchuáng shìyàn, yǐ quèbǎo ānquánxìng yǔ yǒuxiàoxìng.
examples.english: Before a new drug can receive market approval, it must pass rigorous clinical trials to ensure safety and efficacy.

examples.chinese: 工程師在正式量產前先進行了小規模的試驗，以找出潛在的製程問題。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zài zhèngshì liàngchǎn qián xiān jìnxíng le xiǎo guīmó de shìyàn, yǐ zhǎochū qiánzài de zhìchéng wèntí.
examples.english: Before full-scale production, the engineers first ran a small-scale trial to identify potential process issues.

semanticNote: Eyesight; visual acuity. 視力檢查 (eye exam), 視力不良 (poor eyesight), 視力表 (eye chart). Taiwan has extremely high rates of myopia (近視); 視力保健 (vision care) is a major public health topic and school health program. 視力0.1 (visual acuity 0.1).

examples.chinese: 臺灣學生的近視率居全球前列，政府積極推動戶外活動以保護孩子的視力。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xuéshēng de jìnshì lǜ jū quánqiú qiánliè, zhèngfǔ jījí tuīdòng hùwài huódòng yǐ bǎohù háizi de shìlì.
examples.english: Taiwan's student myopia rate ranks among the highest in the world; the government actively promotes outdoor activities to protect children's eyesight.

examples.chinese: 長時間盯著螢幕會使視力下降，建議每隔三十分鐘讓眼睛休息一下。
examples.pinyin: Chángshíjiān dīng zhe yíngmù huì shǐ shìlì xiàjiàng, jiànyì měi gé sānshí fēnzhōng ràng yǎnjīng xiūxi yīxià.
examples.english: Staring at a screen for long periods can cause eyesight to deteriorate; it's recommended to give your eyes a rest every thirty minutes.

semanticNote: Video — digital video content, a video clip, or video calling. The dominant mainland term; in Taiwan 影片 or 影音 are more traditional, but 視頻 has become widely used due to social media and streaming platforms. 視頻通話 (video call), 視頻直播 (live video streaming).

examples.chinese: 她在海外留學期間，每週都和家人視頻通話，報告生活近況。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎiwài liúxué qījiān, měi zhōu dōu hé jiārén shìpín tōnghuà, bàogào shēnghuó jìnkuàng.
examples.english: While studying abroad, she made a video call to her family every week to share updates on her life.

examples.chinese: 這支在網路上瘋傳的視頻引發廣大迴響，短短三天內觀看次數突破千萬。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī zài wǎnglù shàng fēng chuán de shìpín yǐnfā guǎngdà huíxiǎng, duǎnduǎn sān tiān nèi guānkàn cìshù tūpò qiānwàn.
examples.english: This video that went viral online generated a massive response; views broke ten million in just three days.

semanticNote: Line of sight; one's gaze or visual path. 視線範圍 (within one's field of view), 遮擋視線 (block the line of sight), 轉移視線 (divert attention — literally and figuratively). The figurative use (divert attention from something) is very common in political and media commentary.

examples.chinese: 行駛中請勿分心滑手機，以免視線離開路面導致意外。
examples.pinyin: Xíngshǐ zhōng qǐng wù fēnxīn huá shǒujī, yǐmiǎn shìxiàn líkāi lùmiàn dǎozhì yìwài.
examples.english: Please do not get distracted by your phone while driving, to avoid taking your eyes off the road and causing an accident.

examples.chinese: 評論人士批評，政府此舉不過是為了轉移視線，迴避真正的核心問題。
examples.pinyin: Pínglùn rénshì pīpíng, zhèngfǔ cǐ jǔ bùguò shì wèile zhuǎnyí shìxiàn, huíbì zhēnzhèng de héxīn wèntí.
examples.english: Commentators criticized the government's move as nothing more than an attempt to divert attention and avoid the real core issue.

semanticNote: Field of vision; also used figuratively for breadth of perspective or outlook. 視野開闊 (broad perspective; open-minded), 拓展視野 (broaden one's horizons), 國際視野 (international perspective). The figurative sense — having a broad worldview — is the more common usage in educated discourse.

examples.chinese: 山頂視野遼闊，天氣晴朗時甚至可以看到遠處的海岸線。
examples.pinyin: Shāndǐng shìyě liáokuò, tiānqì qínglǎng shí shènzhì kěyǐ kàndào yuǎnchù de hǎi'àn xiàn.
examples.english: The view from the mountaintop is wide open; on a clear day you can even see the coastline in the distance.

examples.chinese: 出國交流的經驗拓展了她的國際視野，讓她更能從多元角度思考問題。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó jiāoliú de jīngyàn tuòzhǎn le tā de guójì shìyě, ràng tā gèng néng cóng duōyuán jiǎodù sīkǎo wèntí.
examples.english: The experience of studying abroad broadened her international perspective, allowing her to think about issues from more diverse angles.

english: right and wrong; truth and fiction; quarrel
semanticNote: Right and wrong; also gossip or quarrel. 辨別是非 (distinguish right from wrong), 是非不分 (fail to tell right from wrong), 搬弄是非 (spread gossip; stir up trouble). The gossip/dispute sense is very common colloquially: 惹是非 (invite trouble; stir up gossip).

examples.chinese: 從小父母就教她要明辨是非，不能因為怕得罪人而選擇沉默。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎo fùmǔ jiù jiāo tā yào míng biàn shìfēi, bùnéng yīnwèi pà dézuì rén ér xuǎnzé chénmò.
examples.english: From a young age her parents taught her to clearly distinguish right from wrong and not to stay silent just to avoid offending people.

examples.chinese: 他個性低調，從不搬弄是非，也不在背後評論同事的私事。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dīdiào, cóng bù bānnòng shìfēi, yě bù zài bèihòu pínglùn tóngshì de sīshì.
examples.english: He has a low-key personality, never spreads gossip, and never comments on colleagues' private lives behind their backs.

semanticNote: Suitable, appropriate, or fitting for a particular purpose or condition. More formal and literary than 適合; often describes conditions (temperature, climate, environment) or situations rather than people. 氣候適宜 (the climate is suitable), 不適宜兒童觀看 (not suitable for children).

examples.chinese: 春秋兩季氣候溫和，是最適宜到臺灣旅遊的季節。
examples.pinyin: Chūnqiū liǎng jì qìhòu wēnhé, shì zuì shìyí dào Táiwān lǚyóu de jìjié.
examples.english: Spring and autumn have mild climates and are the most suitable seasons for traveling to Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這份工作需要頻繁出差，不太適宜有幼兒需要照顧的應徵者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò xūyào pínfán chūchāi, bù tài shìyí yǒu yòu'ér xūyào zhàogù de yìngzhēng zhě.
examples.english: This job requires frequent travel and is not very suitable for applicants who have young children to care for.

semanticNote: To pass away; to die — a respectful, formal term used for notable or respected individuals. 不幸逝世 (unfortunately passed away), 於昨日逝世 (passed away yesterday). More dignified than 死亡 (die) or 去世 (pass away); the standard term in obituaries, news reports, and formal commemorations.

examples.chinese: 著名文學家余光中於二○一七年十二月十四日逝世，享壽八十九歲，文壇為之同悲。
examples.pinyin: Zhùmíng wénxuéjiā Yú Guāngzhōng yú èr líng yī qī nián shí'èr yuè shísì rì shìshì, xiǎng shòu bāshíjiǔ suì, wéntán wèi zhī tóng bēi.
examples.english: Renowned literary figure Yu Guangzhong passed away on December 14, 2017, at the age of 89, to the shared grief of the literary world.

examples.chinese: 這位老科學家一生奉獻給研究工作，直到逝世前幾週仍堅持撰寫學術論文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo kēxuéjiā yīshēng fèngxiàn gěi yánjiū gōngzuò, zhídào shìshì qián jǐ zhōu réng jiānchí zhuànxiě xuéshù lùnwén.
examples.english: This veteran scientist devoted his whole life to research and continued writing academic papers until just weeks before he passed away.

semanticNote: To release, set free, or liberate. 釋放囚犯 (release prisoners), 釋放善意 (signal goodwill — figurative), 釋放壓力 (release stress). In diplomacy, 釋放訊號 (send a signal) is very common in Taiwan political reporting. Covers both literal (prisoner) and figurative (emotion, energy, signal) senses.

examples.chinese: 法院裁定被告獲釋，羈押近三個月的他步出拘留所後，隨即被家人緊緊擁抱。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn cáidìng bèigào huò shì, jīyā jìn sān gè yuè de tā bù chū jūliúsuǒ hòu, suíjí bèi jiārén jǐnjǐn yōngbào.
examples.english: The court ordered the defendant's release; after walking out of the detention center following nearly three months of custody, he was immediately embraced tightly by his family.

examples.chinese: 主管透過這番講話向員工釋放了一個明確的訊號：公司即將進行大規模人事調整。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn tòuguò zhè fān jiǎnghuà xiàng yuángōng shìfàng le yī gè míngquè de xùnhào: gōngsī jíjiāng jìnxíng dàguīmó rénshì tiáozhěng.
examples.english: Through this speech, the manager sent a clear signal to employees: the company is about to undergo a large-scale personnel reshuffle.

semanticNote: To collect or keep; a collection. 藝術收藏 (art collection), 收藏家 (collector), 珍藏 (prize collection; treasured keepsake). Also the 'save' or 'favorite' function in apps — 加入收藏 (add to favorites) is the standard Taiwan UI term for bookmarking.

examples.chinese: 他花了三十年收藏臺灣早期的黑膠唱片，目前已累積逾兩千張。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le sānshí nián shōucáng Táiwān zǎoqī de hēi jiāo chàngpiàn, mùqián yǐ lèijī yú liǎngqiān zhāng.
examples.english: He has spent thirty years collecting early Taiwanese vinyl records and has now accumulated over two thousand.

examples.chinese: 這篇食譜寫得非常詳細，我先收藏起來，下週試著做看看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān shípǔ xiě dé fēicháng xiángxì, wǒ xiān shōucáng qǐlái, xià zhōu shìzhe zuò kànkàn.
examples.english: This recipe is written in great detail; I'll save it first and try making it next week.

semanticNote: To contract, shrink, or pull back — physical or strategic. 肌肉收縮 (muscle contraction), 血管收縮 (vasoconstriction), 戰略收縮 (strategic retreat; pull back forces). The figurative sense — scaling back, withdrawing — is common in business and military contexts.

examples.chinese: 寒冷的天氣使血管收縮，心血管疾病患者應特別注意保暖。
examples.pinyin: Hánlěng de tiānqì shǐ xuèguǎn shōusuō, xīn xuèguǎn jíbìng huànzhě yīng tèbié zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
examples.english: Cold weather causes blood vessels to constrict; patients with cardiovascular disease should take extra care to keep warm.

examples.chinese: 面對市場萎縮，這家企業選擇收縮戰線，關閉部分虧損的門市，專注核心業務。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì shìchǎng wěisuō, zhè jiā qǐyè xuǎnzé shōusuō zhànxiàn, guānbì bùfèn kuīsǔn de ménshì, zhuānzhù héxīn yèwù.
examples.english: Faced with a shrinking market, the company chose to pull back, closing some loss-making stores to focus on core business.

semanticNote: Earnings, profit, or returns — typically financial. 投資收益 (investment returns), 廣告收益 (advertising revenue), 收益率 (rate of return; yield). More formal than 賺錢 and narrower than 收入 (income overall); focuses specifically on profit/gain from an activity.

examples.chinese: 這檔基金今年的投資收益表現亮眼，年化報酬率達到百分之十五。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dàng jījīn jīnnián de tóuzī shōuyì biǎoxiàn liàngyǎn, niánhuà bàochóu lǜ dádào bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ.
examples.english: This fund's investment returns this year have been impressive, with an annualized return rate of 15%.

examples.chinese: 創作者可透過平台的廣告分潤機制獲得穩定的廣告收益，支持持續創作。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngzuò zhě kě tòuguò píngtái de guǎnggào fēn rùn jīzhì huòdé wěndìng de guǎnggào shōuyì, zhīchí chíxù chuàngzuò.
examples.english: Creators can earn steady advertising revenue through the platform's ad revenue-sharing mechanism to support ongoing content creation.

semanticNote: A radio (receiver). 收音機 is the standard Taiwan term. Radio broadcasting remains culturally significant in Taiwan — talk radio (談話性節目) is popular, and 廣播電台 (radio station) commands a loyal audience, particularly among older demographics and commuters.

examples.chinese: 停電期間，老爸拿出壓箱底的收音機，靠電池收聽颱風最新消息。
examples.pinyin: Tíngdiàn qījiān, lǎobà ná chū yā xiāng dǐ de shōuyīnjī, kào diànchí shōutīng táifēng zuìxīn xiāoxi.
examples.english: During the power outage, Dad dug out the old radio kept at the bottom of a chest and listened to the latest typhoon updates on batteries.

examples.chinese: 她每天早上開車上班時都會收聽廣播，這部收音機已經陪伴了她超過十年。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang kāichē shàngbān shí dōu huì shōutīng guǎngbō, zhè bù shōuyīnjī yǐjīng péibàn le tā chāoguò shí nián.
examples.english: She listens to the radio every morning on her commute; this radio has been her companion for over ten years.

semanticNote: Technique, method, or tactic — can refer to artistic skill (繪畫手法 = painting technique), medical procedure (手術手法), or, often negatively, a trick or underhanded method (詐騙手法 = fraud technique; scam method). Context determines whether positive (skill) or negative (trick).

examples.chinese: 這名詐騙集團的手法非常精細，連許多受過高等教育的人都受騙上當。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng zhàpiàn jítuán de shǒufǎ fēicháng jīngxì, lián xǔduō shòuguò gāoděng jiàoyù de rén dōu shòupiàn shàngdàng.
examples.english: This fraud ring's methods are extremely sophisticated — even many highly educated people have been deceived.

examples.chinese: 這位導演在鏡頭語言上善用象徵手法，讓影片在視覺層次之外還充滿深意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn zài jìngtóu yǔyán shàng shànyòng xiàngzhēng shǒufǎ, ràng yǐngpiàn zài shìjué céngcì zhīwài hái chōngmǎn shēnyì.
examples.english: This director makes skilled use of symbolic techniques in cinematography, giving the film layers of meaning beyond its visual surface.

semanticNote: A gesture — a movement of the hands or body to convey meaning or emotion. 打手勢 (make a gesture), 手勢語言 (gestural language; sign language). In Taiwan, 手語 is the standard term for sign language; 手勢 refers to general gestures used in everyday communication.

examples.chinese: 裁判用手勢示意球出界，比賽因此暫停，雙方球員停下腳步等候裁決。
examples.pinyin: Cáipàn yòng shǒushì shìyì qiú chū jiè, bǐsài yīncǐ zàntíng, shuāngfāng qiúyuán tíngxia jiǎobù děnghòu cáijué.
examples.english: The referee gestured to signal the ball was out of bounds; the game paused and players from both sides stopped to await the ruling.

examples.chinese: 語言不通的情況下，她全靠手勢和表情跟當地居民溝通，竟也順利完成了整趟旅程。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán bù tōng de qíngkuàng xià, tā quán kào shǒushì hé biǎoqíng gēn dāngdì jūmín gōutōng, jìng yě shùnlì wánchéng le zhěng tàng lǚchéng.
examples.english: With no common language, she communicated with local residents entirely through gestures and facial expressions — and still managed to complete the entire journey smoothly.

semanticNote: Craft, workmanship, or culinary skill. 手藝精湛 (exquisite craftsmanship), 手藝人 (artisan; craftsperson). In Taiwan, 手藝 is also commonly used to refer to someone's cooking ability — 她的手藝很好 (she cooks really well) is everyday usage.

examples.chinese: 這位老師傅做了四十年的皮革手工藝，每一件作品都是手藝與心血的結晶。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shīfu zuò le sìshí nián de pígé shǒugōng yì, měi yī jiàn zuòpǐn dōu shì shǒuyì yǔ xīnxuè de jiéjīng.
examples.english: This old craftsman has worked in leather craft for forty years; every piece he makes is a crystallization of skill and painstaking effort.

examples.chinese: 媽媽的手藝一流，每次過節她親手做的菜，總是讓全家人讚不絕口。
examples.pinyin: Māma de shǒuyì yīliú, měi cì guòjié tā qīnshǒu zuò de cài, zǒng shì ràng quánjiā rén zàn bù juékǒu.
examples.english: Mom's cooking is top-notch; every time the family gathers for a holiday her home-cooked dishes always win endless praise from everyone.

semanticNote: To guard, defend, or watch over — with a sense of devotion and care. More emotionally charged than 保護 (protect); implies a steadfast, personal commitment to keeping something or someone safe. 守護天使 (guardian angel), 守護家園 (defend one's homeland).

examples.chinese: 這群義工多年來默默守護著這片老社區，協助獨居長者解決生活上的困難。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qún yìgōng duō nián lái mòmò shǒuhù zhe zhè piàn lǎo shèqū, xiézhù dújū zhǎngzhě jiějué shēnghuó shàng de kùnnán.
examples.english: These volunteers have quietly watched over this old community for years, helping elderly residents living alone deal with difficulties in daily life.

examples.chinese: 父母窮盡一生守護子女，卻往往在年老時發現，孩子早已能獨當一面。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ qióngjìn yīshēng shǒuhù zǐnǚ, què wǎngwǎng zài niánlǎo shí fāxiàn, háizi zǎoyǐ néng dúdāng yī miàn.
examples.english: Parents spend their whole lives watching over their children, only to find in their old age that the children have long since become capable of standing on their own.

semanticNote: Jewelry; ornaments worn on the body. 金飾 (gold jewelry), 珠寶首飾 (gemstone jewelry), 佩戴首飾 (wear jewelry). In Taiwan, 金飾店 (gold jewelry shops) are common and gold jewelry holds cultural significance as gifts for weddings and births.

examples.chinese: 她出席晚宴時佩戴了一整套祖母傳下來的翡翠首飾，典雅大方。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūxí wǎnyàn shí pèidài le yī zhěng tào zǔmǔ chuán xiàlái de fěicuì shǒushì, diǎnyǎ dàfāng.
examples.english: She wore a complete set of jade jewelry passed down from her grandmother to the evening banquet, looking classically elegant.

examples.chinese: 臺灣民間習俗中，長輩常在孫子滿月時贈送金飾首飾，象徵祝福與期望。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān mínjiān xísú zhōng, zhǎngbèi cháng zài sūnzi mǎnyuè shí zèngsòng jīn shì shǒushì, xiàngzhēng zhùfú yǔ qīwàng.
examples.english: In Taiwanese folk custom, elders often give gold jewelry when a grandchild reaches one month old, symbolizing blessings and hopes for the future.

semanticNote: The most important; primary; chief — used to rank a concern or task above all others. 首要任務 (primary mission; top priority), 首要原則 (guiding principle). Formal register; often introduces the most critical item in a list of priorities.

examples.chinese: 震災發生後，搜救倖存者是首要任務，其他重建工作均列為次要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèn zāi fāshēng hòu, sōujiù xìngcún zhě shì shǒuyào rènwù, qítā chóngjiàn gōngzuò jūn liè wéi cìyào.
examples.english: After the earthquake, rescuing survivors is the primary task; all other reconstruction work is secondary.

examples.chinese: 在制定新政策前，了解民眾的真實需求應是首要考量。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng xīn zhèngcè qián, liǎojiě mínzhòng de zhēnshí xūqiú yīng shì shǒuyào kǎoliàng.
examples.english: Before formulating new policies, understanding the genuine needs of the public should be the primary consideration.

english: endure hardships; have a hard time
semanticNote: To suffer; to endure hardship or discomfort. Colloquial and expressive. 真受罪 (what a torment), 讓人受罪 (put someone through the wringer). Unlike 受苦 (suffer hardship), 受罪 often implies unnecessary or avoidable discomfort — a slightly exasperated tone.

examples.chinese: 夏天沒有冷氣的宿舍真的很受罪，半夜熱到根本睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān méiyǒu lěngqì de sùshè zhēnde hěn shòuzuì, bànyè rè dào gēnběn shuì bùzháo.
examples.english: A dormitory without air conditioning in summer is absolute torture — it's so hot at midnight you simply can't sleep.

examples.chinese: 他偏偏對海鮮過敏，在這場以海鮮為主的婚宴上只能受罪地坐著乾看。
examples.pinyin: Tā piānpiān duì hǎixiān guòmǐn, zài zhè chǎng yǐ hǎixiān wéi zhǔ de hūnyàn shàng zhǐ néng shòuzuì de zuò zhe gān kàn.
examples.english: Of all people, he's allergic to seafood, so at this seafood-focused wedding banquet he could only sit there suffering, watching everyone else eat.

semanticNote: To award, confer, or bestow — a formal act by a higher authority granting a title, degree, honor, or right. 授予學位 (confer a degree), 授予勳章 (award a medal), 授予公民權 (grant citizenship). Strictly formal and ceremonial register.

examples.chinese: 總統府在國慶日授予多位傑出人士褒揚令，以表彰其對社會的卓越貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒngfǔ zài Guóqìng rì shòuyǔ duō wèi jiéchū rénshì bāoyánglìng, yǐ biǎozhāng qí duì shèhuì de zhuóyuè gòngxiàn.
examples.english: The Presidential Office awarded commendations to several distinguished individuals on National Day to recognize their outstanding contributions to society.

examples.chinese: 畢業典禮上，校長親自授予每位畢業生學位證書，場面隆重而感人。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng, xiàozhǎng qīnzì shòuyǔ měi wèi bìyè shēng xuéwèi zhèngshū, chǎngmiàn lóngzhòng ér gǎnrén.
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, the president personally conferred degree certificates on each graduate in a solemn and moving occasion.

semanticNote: Chinese calligraphy — the art of brush writing. A classical art form deeply embedded in Chinese culture; 練書法 (practice calligraphy) is common among students and enthusiasts in Taiwan. 書法家 (calligrapher), 楷書/行書/草書 (regular/running/cursive script). Taiwan still uses Traditional Chinese characters in calligraphy.

examples.chinese: 她從小跟著外公學書法，一手漂亮的楷書讓同學們羨慕不已。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo gēn zhe wàigōng xué shūfǎ, yī shǒu piàoliàng de kǎishū ràng tóngxuémen xiànmù bùyǐ.
examples.english: She learned calligraphy from her grandfather since childhood, and her beautiful regular script is the envy of her classmates.

examples.chinese: 每逢農曆年前，許多書法家會義務幫民眾寫春聯，傳承這項傳統文化。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng nónglì nián qián, xǔduō shūfǎ jiā huì yìwù bāng mínzhòng xiě chūnlián, chuánchéng zhè xiàng chuántǒng wénhuà.
examples.english: Around every Lunar New Year, many calligraphers volunteer to write spring couplets for the public, passing on this traditional cultural practice.

semanticNote: Books; written works — a collective or formal term. More literary and formal than 書 or 書本. 書籍種類 (types of books), 珍貴書籍 (precious volumes), 書籍出版 (publication of books). Often used when discussing books as a category or institution.

examples.chinese: 圖書館定期將老舊破損的書籍進行修復，以延長典藏文獻的壽命。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn dìqī jiāng lǎojiù pòsǔn de shūjí jìnxíng xiūfù, yǐ yáncháng diǎncáng wénxiàn de shòumìng.
examples.english: The library regularly restores old and damaged books to extend the lifespan of its archival materials.

examples.chinese: 這位旅行家每到一個新城市，第一件事就是逛當地的書店，蒐集當地出版的書籍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǚxíng jiā měi dào yī gè xīn chéngshì, dì yī jiàn shì jiù shì guàng dāngdì de shūdiàn, sōují dāngdì chūbǎn de shūjí.
examples.english: Whenever this traveler arrives in a new city, the first thing he does is browse the local bookshops and collect locally published books.

semanticNote: Secretary or clerk — in Taiwan usage primarily means a court clerk (法院書記官) or organizational secretary. In mainland Chinese political contexts, 書記 specifically means the top Communist Party secretary (黨委書記), the most powerful figure in a unit. Taiwan contexts almost never use 書記 in the CCP sense.

examples.chinese: 法院書記官負責記錄庭審過程中的所有陳述，並整理成正式的庭審紀錄。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn shūjì guān fùzé jìlù tíng shěn guòchéng zhōng de suǒyǒu chénshù, bìng zhěnglǐ chéng zhèngshì de tíngshěn jìlù.
examples.english: Court clerks are responsible for recording all statements made during hearings and compiling them into official court records.

examples.chinese: 這個社團的書記每次開會後都要整理會議記錄，發給全體會員參閱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shètuán de shūjì měi cì kāihuì hòu dōu yào zhěnglǐ huìyì jìlù, fā gěi quántǐ huìyuán cānyuè.
examples.english: The club's secretary compiles minutes after each meeting and distributes them to all members for reference.

semanticNote: Written; in writing — as opposed to verbal or oral. 書面申請 (written application), 書面合約 (written contract), 書面保證 (written guarantee). Formal and legal register; 書面 communication carries more legal weight than verbal agreements in Taiwan contract law.

examples.chinese: 雙方已達成口頭協議，但正式生效前仍需簽訂書面合約。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yǐ dáchéng kǒutóu xiéyì, dàn zhèngshì shēngxiào qián réng xū qiāndìng shūmiàn héyuē.
examples.english: Both parties have reached a verbal agreement, but a written contract must be signed before it officially takes effect.

examples.chinese: 請以書面方式提出申請，相關表格可在官網下載或臨櫃索取。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng yǐ shūmiàn fāngshì tíchū shēnqǐng, xiāngguān biǎogé kě zài guānwǎng xiàzài huò lín guì suǒqǔ.
examples.english: Please submit your application in writing; the relevant forms can be downloaded from the official website or obtained at the counter.

semanticNote: Happy, relaxed, and free from worry — a pleasant feeling of physical or emotional ease. 心情舒暢 (feeling light-hearted and at ease), 呼吸舒暢 (breathing freely). More positive and body-felt than 輕鬆 (relaxed); implies a satisfying, flowing sense of well-being.

examples.chinese: 週末在山中健行了一整天，回到家後整個人感覺無比舒暢。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò zài shān zhōng jiànxíng le yī zhěng tiān, huídào jiā hòu zhěnggè rén gǎnjué wúbǐ shūchàng.
examples.english: After a full day of hiking in the mountains over the weekend, she felt utterly refreshed and at ease when she got home.

examples.chinese: 把積壓已久的心事說出來之後，她如釋重負，心情頓時舒暢多了。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ jīyā yǐjiǔ de xīnshì shuō chūlái zhīhòu, tā rú shì zhòng fù, xīnqíng dùnshí shūchàng duō le.
examples.english: After finally voicing the worries that had been bottled up for so long, she felt a weight lifted off her and her mood immediately brightened.

semanticNote: To neglect or overlook; negligence — failing to pay proper attention. 一時疏忽 (a momentary lapse), 疏忽大意 (negligent and careless). In legal contexts, 過失疏忽 (negligence) is important in tort and criminal law. 醫療疏忽 (medical negligence) is a key Taiwan legal term.

examples.chinese: 這起事故是由於工作人員一時疏忽，未按規定關閉安全閥門所引起的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìgù shì yóuyú gōngzuò rényuán yīshí shūhu, wèi àn guīdìng guānbì ānquán fámén suǒ yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: This accident was caused by a momentary lapse on the part of a worker who failed to close the safety valve as required.

examples.chinese: 家長不應對孩子的安全疏忽大意，尤其在游泳池或道路旁時需特別留意。
examples.pinyin: Jiāzhǎng bù yīng duì háizi de ānquán shūhu dàyì, yóuqí zài yóuyǒngchí huò dàolù páng shí xū tèbié liúyì.
examples.english: Parents should not be negligent about their children's safety, especially near swimming pools or roads where extra vigilance is needed.

english: drift apart; keep at a distance; not in close touch; estranged
semanticNote: To become estranged; to drift apart from someone; distant in relationship. 關係疏遠 (the relationship has grown distant), 疏遠了舊友 (drifted away from old friends). Implies a gradual emotional or social distancing, often without open conflict. More literary than 不親近.

examples.chinese: 自從搬到不同城市後，兩人的聯繫越來越少，感情也漸漸疏遠了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bān dào bùtóng chéngshì hòu, liǎng rén de liánxì yuèlái yuè shǎo, gǎnqíng yě jiànjiàn shūyuǎn le.
examples.english: Since moving to different cities, the two kept in less and less contact, and their bond gradually faded.

examples.chinese: 他疏遠了以前的朋友圈，把大部分的時間都投入在新創事業上。
examples.pinyin: Tā shūyuǎn le yǐqián de péngyǒu quān, bǎ dà bùfèn de shíjiān dōu tóurù zài xīnchuàng shìyè shàng.
examples.english: He drifted away from his old social circle and poured most of his time into his startup.

english: to tie; to bind; restrain; (mw for bunches, bundles, bouquets, etc.)
semanticNote: To tie, bind, or restrain; also a measure word for bunches, bundles, or bouquets (一束花 = a bouquet of flowers). 約束 (restrain; constraint), 束手無策 (at a total loss; with hands tied). Both the binding action and the measure word use are common.

examples.chinese: 他送給她一束玫瑰花，紅得如此鮮豔，讓她忍不住臉紅心跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng gěi tā yī shù méiguī huā, hóng dé rúcǐ xiānyàn, ràng tā rěn bù zhù liǎn hóng xīn tiào.
examples.english: He gave her a bouquet of roses so brilliantly red that she couldn't help but blush with a racing heart.

examples.chinese: 面對這突如其來的危機，整個團隊束手無策，不知從何著手解決。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhè tūrú qí lái de wéijī, zhěnggè tuánduì shùshǒu wú cè, bù zhī cóng hé zhuóshǒu jiějué.
examples.english: Faced with this sudden crisis, the entire team was at a total loss and didn't know where to begin solving it.

semanticNote: To bind, restrict, or constrain; a restriction or fetter. 擺脫束縛 (break free from constraints), 傳統束縛 (traditional shackles), 束縛思想 (constrain one's thinking). Figurative use is far more common than literal binding; implies something that limits freedom or potential.

examples.chinese: 她辭掉朝九晚五的工作，決定擺脫制度的束縛，走上自由創作的道路。
examples.pinyin: Tā cídiào cháo jiǔ wǎn wǔ de gōngzuò, juédìng bǎituō zhìdù de shùfù, zǒushàng zìyóu chuàngzuò de dàolù.
examples.english: She quit her nine-to-five job, resolved to break free from institutional constraints, and set out on a path of independent creative work.

examples.chinese: 許多年輕人感到被過高的房價束縛，難以在大城市紮根。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīng rén gǎndào bèi guògāo de fángjià shùfù, nányǐ zài dà chéngshì zhā gēn.
examples.english: Many young people feel shackled by sky-high housing prices and find it difficult to put down roots in big cities.

semanticNote: To establish, set up, or hold up as a model — for ideals, images, reputations, or examples. 樹立典範 (set an example; establish a model), 樹立形象 (build an image), 樹立信心 (build confidence). More abstract and exemplary than 設立 (which is for institutions or rules).

examples.chinese: 這位老師以身作則，為學生樹立了誠實守信的良好典範。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī yǐ shēn zuò zé, wèi xuéshēng shùlì le chéngshí shǒuxìn de liánghǎo diǎnfàn.
examples.english: This teacher leads by example, establishing for students an excellent model of honesty and integrity.

examples.chinese: 品牌需要長期的努力才能樹立起消費者心目中的正面形象，一旦受損便很難修復。
examples.pinyin: Pǐnpái xūyào chángqī de nǔlì cái néng shùlì qǐ xiāofèizhě xīnmù zhōng de zhèngmiàn xíngxiàng, yīdàn shòusǔn biàn hěn nán xiūfù.
examples.english: It takes long-term effort to build a positive image in consumers' minds; once damaged it is very hard to repair.

semanticNote: Vertical; to erect or stand something upright. As an adjective: 豎排版 (vertical text layout — the traditional Chinese typesetting direction, still used in Taiwan books and newspapers). As a verb: 豎起耳朵 (prick up one's ears), 豎起大拇指 (give a thumbs-up). Taiwan books and newspapers commonly use vertical right-to-left layout.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的傳統書籍多採豎排版式，文字由右至左閱讀，保留了漢字的傳統書寫方向。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chuántǒng shūjí duō cǎi shù pái bǎnshì, wénzì yóu yòu zhì zuǒ yuèdú, bǎoliú le Hànzì de chuántǒng shūxiě fāngxiàng.
examples.english: Traditional Taiwanese books mostly use vertical typesetting, read from right to left, preserving the traditional writing direction of Chinese characters.

examples.chinese: 他的精彩演說結束時，台下觀眾紛紛豎起大拇指，掌聲雷動。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jīngcǎi yǎnshuō jiéshù shí, tái xià guānzhòng fēnfēn shù qǐ dà mǔ zhǐ, zhǎngshēng léidòng.
examples.english: When his brilliant speech ended, audience members one after another gave a thumbs-up and the applause was thunderous.

english: amount; sum of money; fixed number
semanticNote: An amount, sum, or fixed number — especially of money. 金額 and 數額 are near synonyms; 數額 is slightly more formal and often used in legal/official documents. 詐騙數額 (amount defrauded), 賠償數額 (amount of compensation). Note pinyin: shù'é — apostrophe before 額 (starts with 'e').

examples.chinese: 法院判定被告需賠償的數額高達新臺幣五百萬元，創下同類案件的紀錄。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn pàndìng bèigào xū péicháng de shù'é gāodá Xīn Táibì wǔbǎi wàn yuán, chuàngxià tónglèi ànjiàn de jìlù.
examples.english: The court ruled that the amount the defendant must pay in compensation reaches NT$5 million, setting a record for this type of case.

examples.chinese: 這批詐騙集團在短短半年內騙取的數額超過一億元，受害者遍及全臺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī zhàpiàn jítuán zài duǎnduǎn bàn nián nèi piànqǔ de shù'é chāoguò yī yì yuán, shòuhài zhě biànjí quán Tái.
examples.english: This fraud gang defrauded an amount exceeding 100 million dollars in just half a year, with victims spread across all of Taiwan.

semanticNote: To play around with, juggle, or manipulate — often with a negative or playful connotation. 耍把戲 (play tricks), 耍賴 (act shamelessly; refuse to comply), 耍花招 (resort to tricks), 耍大牌 (act like a diva; throw one's weight around). 耍 implies showing off or using something with cunning or flair.

examples.chinese: 別跟我耍花招了，你那點小心思我一眼就看穿了。
examples.pinyin: Bié gēn wǒ shuǎ huāzhāo le, nǐ nà diǎn xiǎo xīnsi wǒ yī yǎn jiù kànchuān le.
examples.english: Stop trying to play tricks on me — I can see through your little scheme at a glance.

examples.chinese: 這位雜耍藝人能同時耍六個球，精湛的技藝令現場觀眾嘖嘖稱奇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi záshuǎ yìrén néng tóngshí shuǎ liù gè qiú, jīngzhàn de jìyì lìng xiànchǎng guānzhòng zézé chēng qí.
examples.english: This juggler can juggle six balls simultaneously; his exquisite skill left the audience marveling in amazement.

semanticNote: To grow old; to age; senescent. 衰老是自然規律 (aging is a natural process). More medical and clinical than 老 alone; implies physical deterioration accompanying age. 抗衰老 (anti-aging) is a major category in Taiwan's beauty and health industries.

examples.chinese: 科學家正積極研究如何延緩人體的衰老過程，以提升老年人的生活品質。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèng jījí yánjiū rúhé yáncháng réntǐ de shuāilǎo guòchéng, yǐ tíshēng lǎonián rén de shēnghuó pǐnzhì.
examples.english: Scientists are actively researching how to slow the aging process of the human body to improve the quality of life for the elderly.

examples.chinese: 父親衰老的速度比預期快，這讓她深刻意識到要把握當下，多陪伴家人。
examples.pinyin: Fùqīn shuāilǎo de sùdù bǐ yùqī kuài, zhè ràng tā shēnkè yìshídào yào bǎwò dāngxià, duō péibàn jiārén.
examples.english: Her father aged faster than expected, making her acutely aware of the need to cherish the present and spend more time with family.

semanticNote: To decline, fall, or deteriorate — of economies, health, ability, or influence. 經濟衰退 (economic recession/decline) is the most frequent collocation in Taiwan news. 景氣衰退 (economic downturn), 功能衰退 (functional decline). Distinguished from 衰老 (aging) by being applicable to non-living systems.

examples.chinese: 受全球景氣衰退影響，出口訂單大幅減少，多家製造業廠商面臨裁員壓力。
examples.pinyin: Shòu quánqiú jǐngqì shuāituì yǐngxiǎng, chūkǒu dìngdān dàfú jiǎnshǎo, duō jiā zhìzào yè chǎngshāng miànlín cáiyuán yālì.
examples.english: Affected by the global economic downturn, export orders have dropped sharply and many manufacturers are facing pressure to lay off workers.

examples.chinese: 他步入中年後，記憶力開始衰退，有時連剛放下的東西都想不起來放在哪裡。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùrù zhōngnián hòu, jìyìlì kāishǐ shuāituì, yǒushí lián gāng fàng xià de dōngxi dōu xiǎng bù qǐlái fàng zài nǎlǐ.
examples.english: Since entering middle age, his memory has begun to decline; sometimes he can't even remember where he just put something.

semanticNote: To lead, command, or head — a group of people in a mission, expedition, or competition. 率領代表團 (lead a delegation), 率領軍隊 (command troops). More dynamic and action-oriented than 領導 (lead/manage); implies leading people forward into something.

examples.chinese: 總教練率領國家隊赴日參加世界棒球經典賽，全國球迷熱切期待佳績。
examples.pinyin: Zǒng jiàoliàn shuàilǐng guójiāduì fù Rì cānjiā Shìjiè Bàngqiú Jīngdiǎn Sài, quánguó qiúmí rèqiè qīdài jiājì.
examples.english: The head coach led the national team to Japan for the World Baseball Classic; fans across the country are eagerly awaiting good results.

examples.chinese: 外交部長率領訪問團抵達歐洲，展開為期一週的多邊外交行程。
examples.pinyin: Wàijiāobùzhǎng shuàilǐng fǎngwèn tuán dǐdá Ōuzhōu, zhǎnkāi wéiqī yī zhōu de duōbiān wàijiāo xíngchéng.
examples.english: The Foreign Minister led a visiting delegation to Europe for a week-long multilateral diplomatic itinerary.

semanticNote: To cook ingredients by swishing them briefly in boiling broth — the technique used in hot pot (火鍋). 涮羊肉 (instant-boil mutton), 涮火鍋 as a shared meal is a beloved social tradition in Taiwan, with 麻辣鍋 (mala hotpot) and 鴛鴦鍋 (dual-broth pot) being the most popular styles.

examples.chinese: 冬天最幸福的事莫過於和朋友圍坐在一起涮火鍋，邊吃邊聊天。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān zuì xìngfú de shì mòguòyú hé péngyǒu wéi zuò zài yīqǐ shuàn huǒguō, biān chī biān liáotiān.
examples.english: There is no greater happiness in winter than gathering with friends around a hotpot, eating and chatting all at once.

examples.chinese: 他第一次嘗試自己在家涮火鍋，結果湯底太淡，食材也沒有泡熟，鬧了個笑話。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì zìjǐ zài jiā shuàn huǒguō, jiéguǒ tāng dǐ tài dàn, shícái yě méiyǒu pào shú, nào le gè xiàohuà.
examples.english: The first time he tried making hotpot at home, the broth was too bland and the ingredients weren't cooked through — it turned into a comedy of errors.

semanticNote: Twins — a pair of children born together from the same pregnancy. 同卵雙胞胎 (identical twins), 異卵雙胞胎 (fraternal twins). Common in everyday speech. The birth of twins is often considered auspicious in Taiwan culture.

examples.chinese: 她生了一對雙胞胎女兒，兩個孩子長得一模一樣，連親戚都常常認錯。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēng le yī duì shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér, liǎng gè háizi zhǎng dé yīmú yīyàng, lián qīnqī dōu chángcháng rèncuò.
examples.english: She gave birth to twin daughters who look exactly alike — even relatives often mix them up.

examples.chinese: 研究顯示，同卵雙胞胎在性格和健康方面有高度的相似性，但環境因素仍會造成差異。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū xiǎnshì, tónglǎn shuāngbāotāi zài xìnggé hé jiànkāng fāngmiàn yǒu gāodù de xiāngsìxìng, dàn huánjìng yīnsù réng huì zàochéng chāyì.
examples.english: Research shows that identical twins have a high degree of similarity in personality and health, but environmental factors can still create differences.

semanticNote: Refreshed and invigorated (physical sense); also frank, direct, and decisive (personality sense). 說話爽快 (speak directly and frankly), 答應得很爽快 (agreed without hesitation). The personality sense — someone who doesn't beat around the bush — is very common in Taiwan colloquial use.

examples.chinese: 她辦事爽快，從來不拖泥帶水，客戶都很信任她的工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Tā bànshì shuǎngkuài, cónglái bù tuō ní dài shuǐ, kèhù dōu hěn xìnrèn tā de gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: She handles everything with straightforward efficiency and never drags her feet — clients all trust her work ethic.

examples.chinese: 洗完冷水澡後整個人清涼爽快，暑氣頓時消了大半。
examples.pinyin: Xǐ wán lěng shuǐ zǎo hòu zhěnggè rén qīngliáng shuǎngkuài, shǔqì dùnshí xiāo le dàbàn.
examples.english: After a cold shower, the whole body feels cool and refreshed — most of the summer heat gone in an instant.

semanticNote: Water conservancy; irrigation and water management works. 水利工程 (hydraulic engineering), 農田水利 (agricultural irrigation). In Taiwan, 農田水利會 (Irrigation Associations) historically managed local water distribution for rice paddies — a key institution in rural Taiwan, restructured in 2020.

examples.chinese: 臺灣農業的發展離不開完善的水利設施，嘉南大圳便是日治時期最重要的水利工程之一。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nóngyè de fāzhǎn lí bù kāi wánshàn de shuǐlì shèshī, Jiā-Nán Dàzuì biàn shì Rì zhì shíqī zuì zhòngyào de shuǐlì gōngchéng zhī yī.
examples.english: The development of Taiwan's agriculture is inseparable from well-developed water conservancy facilities; the Jianan Canal is one of the most important hydraulic engineering projects from the Japanese colonial period.

examples.chinese: 極端氣候使水利調度愈加困難，旱澇兩極化的情形對農業生產造成嚴峻考驗。
examples.pinyin: Jíduān qìhòu shǐ shuǐlì diàodù yùjiā kùnnán, hàn lào liǎng jíhuà de qíngxíng duì nóngyè shēngchǎn zàochéng yánjùn kǎoyàn.
examples.english: Extreme weather is making water management increasingly difficult, and the polarization between droughts and floods poses a severe challenge for agricultural production.

semanticNote: A faucet or tap. 水龍頭 is the standard Taiwan term (同: 龍頭). 打開水龍頭 (turn on the tap), 水龍頭滴水 (the tap is dripping). Extremely common in everyday speech; not a formal term.

examples.chinese: 浴室的水龍頭一直在滴水，不但浪費資源，還發出惱人的滴答聲讓人睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Yùshì de shuǐlóngtóu yīzhí zài dī shuǐ, bùdàn làngfèi zīyuán, hái fāchū nǎorén de dīdā shēng ràng rén shuì bùzháo.
examples.english: The bathroom faucet has been dripping constantly — not only wasting water but making an annoying dripping sound that keeps people awake.

examples.chinese: 記得刷牙時要隨手關水龍頭，這樣每天可以節省好幾公升的水。
examples.pinyin: Jìde shuā yá shí yào suíshǒu guān shuǐlóngtóu, zhèyàng měitiān kěyǐ jiéshěng hǎo jǐ gōngshēng de shuǐ.
examples.english: Remember to turn off the tap while brushing your teeth — this can save several liters of water every day.

semanticNote: Cement; also used colloquially to mean concrete (混凝土 is the technical term, but 水泥 is used loosely for both in everyday speech). 水泥廠 (cement plant), 水泥叢林 (concrete jungle). 台灣水泥 (Taiwan Cement, TCC) is a major listed company and household name.

examples.chinese: 工人將水泥、沙和水按比例混合後，倒入模具中澆鑄成型。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrén jiāng shuǐní, shā hé shuǐ àn bǐlì hùnhé hòu, dào rù múju zhōng jiāo zhù chéngxíng.
examples.english: Workers mixed cement, sand, and water in the right proportions, then poured the mixture into molds to cast into shape.

examples.chinese: 都市化快速推進，讓許多人嚮往逃離水泥叢林，回歸大自然的懷抱。
examples.pinyin: Dūshìhuà kuàisù tuījìn, ràng xǔduō rén xiǎngwǎng táolí shuǐní cónglín, huíguī dàzìrán de huáibào.
examples.english: The rapid advance of urbanization has many people longing to escape the concrete jungle and return to the embrace of nature.

english: in the twinkling of an eye; in an instant; momentary
semanticNote: An instant; in the blink of an eye. 瞬間 is both a noun (a moment) and a time adverb meaning 'in an instant'. 一瞬間 (in a flash), 瞬間爆發力 (explosive power in an instant — sports term). Common in literary, journalistic, and everyday contexts.

examples.chinese: 地震在瞬間改變了一切，原本完好的房屋頃刻化為廢墟。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn zài shùnjiān gǎibiàn le yīqiè, yuánběn wánhǎo de fángwū qǐngkè huàwéi fèixū.
