examples.pinyin: Yīqī jiǔwǔ nián Qīngcháo yǔ Rìběn qiāndìng 《Mǎguān Tiáoyuē》, jiāng Táiwān gēràng gěi Rìběn, kāiqǐ le cháng dá wǔshí nián de Rì zhì shíqī.
examples.english: In 1895, the Qing dynasty signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan, ceding Taiwan to Japan and opening a colonial period lasting fifty years.

examples.chinese: 兩國為了貿易糾紛展開談判，最終達成一項互惠條約，解決了長期懸而未決的關稅爭議。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó wèile màoyì jiūfēn zhǎnkāi tánpàn, zuìzhōng dáchéng yī xiàng hùhuì tiáoyuē, jiějué le chángqī xuán ér wèi jué de guānshuì zhēngyì.
examples.english: The two countries entered into negotiations over a trade dispute and ultimately reached a mutual treaty, resolving the long-standing tariff controversy.

semanticNote: To harmonize; to blend; to bring into accord — making things compatible or balanced. 調和矛盾 (reconcile contradictions), 色彩調和 (harmonious color blending), 調和油 (blended cooking oil — a common product in Taiwan supermarkets). More about achieving balance between different elements than 協調 (coordinate/cooperate).

examples.chinese: 設計師巧妙地調和了傳統與現代元素，讓這座老屋在翻新後既保有歷史韻味，又不失時尚感。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī qiǎomiào de tiáohé le chuántǒng yǔ xiàndài yuánsù, ràng zhè zuò lǎo wū zài fānxīn hòu jì bǎoyǒu lìshǐ yùnwèi, yòu bù shī shíshàng gǎn.
examples.english: The designer skillfully harmonized traditional and modern elements, allowing this old house, after renovation, to retain its historical atmosphere while remaining stylish.

examples.chinese: 談判期間，第三方調停人居中調和雙方立場，協助找出讓步空間。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn qījiān, dìsānfāng tiáotíng rén jū zhōng tiáohé shuāngfāng lìchǎng, xiézhù zhǎo chū ràngbù kōngjiān.
examples.english: During negotiations, a third-party mediator worked between the two sides to harmonize their positions and help identify room for concessions.

semanticNote: To make an adjustment; to redistribute or reallocate; to provide variety or relief. 調劑生活 (add variety to life; balance out routine), 調劑人員 (redeploy staff), 藥劑師調劑 (pharmacist dispensing/compounding medication). Two quite different domains share this word: personnel/resource reallocation and pharmacist dispensing (the pharmacy sense is significant in Taiwan's large pharmacy sector).

examples.chinese: 長時間埋首工作很容易感到疲憊，適時出去走走可以調劑身心，提高工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān máishǒu gōngzuò hěn róngyì gǎndào píbèi, shìshí chūqù zǒuzǒu kěyǐ tiáojì shēnxīn, tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Working with your head buried for long stretches easily leads to fatigue; stepping out for a walk at the right time can refresh body and mind and boost work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 藥局藥師負責依照醫師處方調劑藥品，並向病患說明服藥方式和注意事項。
examples.pinyin: Yàojú yàoshī fùzé yīzhào yīshī chǔfāng tiáojì yàopǐn, bìng xiàng bìnghuàn shuōmíng fú yào fāngshì hé zhùyì shìxiàng.
examples.english: The pharmacy pharmacist is responsible for dispensing medications according to the doctor's prescription, and for explaining to patients how to take the medication and what precautions to observe.

semanticNote: To adjust; to regulate; to bring into balance. 調節溫度 (regulate temperature), 調節情緒 (regulate one's emotions), 自動調節 (auto-regulate). More technical and systemic than 調整 (adjust — often a one-time correction); 調節 implies ongoing regulation or fine-tuning of a system. Common in psychology (情緒調節), physiology, and engineering.

examples.chinese: 人體能自動調節體溫，確保各器官在最適合的環境下運作，但極端氣候仍可能超出負荷。
examples.pinyin: Réntǐ néng zìdòng tiáojié tǐwēn, quèbǎo gè qìguān zài zuì shìhé de huánjìng xià yùnzuò, dàn jíduān qìhòu réng kěnéng chāochū fùhè.
examples.english: The human body can automatically regulate body temperature to ensure all organs operate in the most suitable environment, but extreme climates can still exceed its capacity.

examples.chinese: 壓力大時，她習慣用跑步和冥想來調節情緒，讓自己保持穩定的心理狀態。
examples.pinyin: Yālì dà shí, tā xíguàn yòng pǎobù hé míngxiǎng lái tiáojié qíngxù, ràng zìjǐ bǎochí wěndìng de xīnlǐ zhuàngtài.
examples.english: When under stress, she habitually uses running and meditation to regulate her emotions and keep herself in a stable mental state.

english: mediation; bring together to an agreement
semanticNote: Mediation; to mediate and bring disputing parties to an agreement. 調解委員會 (mediation committee), 勞資調解 (labor-management mediation), 法院外調解 (out-of-court mediation). In Taiwan, 鄉鎮市調解委員會 (Township/District Mediation Committees) handle civil and minor criminal disputes, providing a widely used alternative to litigation. 成功調解 (successful mediation).

examples.chinese: 鄰居間的土地糾紛經由鄉鎮公所調解委員會調解，雙方達成和解協議，避免了曠日廢時的訴訟。
examples.pinyin: Línjū jiān de tǔdì jiūfēn jīngyóu xiāngzhèn gōngsuǒ tiáojiě wěiyuánhuì tiáojiě, shuāngfāng dáchéng héjiě xiéyì, bìmiǎn le kuàngrì fèi shí de sùsòng.
examples.english: The land dispute between neighbors was mediated by the township office's Mediation Committee; both parties reached a settlement agreement, avoiding the drawn-out burden of litigation.

examples.chinese: 資深的工會代表出面調解這場罷工危機，協助勞資雙方找到可接受的妥協方案。
examples.pinyin: Zīshēn de gōnghuì dàibiǎo chūmiàn tiáojiě zhè chǎng bàgōng wēijī, xiézhù láozī shuāngfāng zhǎodào kě jiēshòu de tuǒxié fāng'àn.
examples.english: A senior union representative stepped in to mediate the strike crisis, helping both labor and management find an acceptable compromise.

semanticNote: Seasoning; flavoring; condiments. 調料種類繁多 (a wide variety of seasonings), 加入調料 (add seasoning). Common in cooking contexts. Taiwan has a rich condiment culture: 豆瓣醬 (doubanjiang), 沙茶醬 (shacha sauce), 烏醋 (black vinegar), 醬油膏 (thick soy sauce), and 辣椒醬 (chili sauce) are staples. 調味料 is a near synonym.

examples.chinese: 臺灣料理講究調料的層次感，一道滷肉飯可能用到十幾種不同的香料和醬汁。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān liàolǐ jiǎngjiū tiáoliào de céngcì gǎn, yī dào lǔròufàn kěnéng yòng dào shí jǐ zhǒng bùtóng de xiāngliào hé jiàngzhī.
examples.english: Taiwan cuisine emphasizes layered complexity in its seasonings; a single braised pork rice dish may use over a dozen different spices and sauces.

examples.chinese: 超市的調料區陳列著來自世界各地的香料，從日式味噌到義大利香草，應有盡有。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshì de tiáoliào qū chénliè zhe láizì shìjiè gèdì de xiāngliào, cóng Rìshì wèizēng dào Yìdàlì xiāngcǎo, yīngyǒu jìnyǒu.
examples.english: The seasoning aisle of the supermarket displays spices from around the world, from Japanese miso to Italian herbs — everything one could want.

english: incite disharmony; provoke; stir up tension in others
semanticNote: To incite discord; to stir up tension between people; to provoke dissension. 挑撥離間 (sow discord and alienate — a classic strategy of driving a wedge between allies). Always negative — the agent is deliberately trying to create conflict between others. 挑撥感情 (stir up relationship problems), 惡意挑撥 (maliciously incite).

examples.chinese: 他在兩個好友之間散佈謠言、惡意挑撥，最終導致這段多年的友誼破裂。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài liǎng gè hǎoyǒu zhī jiān sànbù yáoyán, èyì tiǎobō, zuìzhōng dǎozhì zhè duàn duō nián de yǒuyì pòliè.
examples.english: He spread rumors between two close friends and maliciously stirred up discord, ultimately destroying a friendship that had lasted many years.

examples.chinese: 外界的挑撥離間沒有動搖兩人的互信，他們反而在危機中更加理解和依靠彼此。
examples.pinyin: Wàijiè de tiǎobō-líjiàn méiyǒu dòngyáo liǎng rén de hùxìn, tāmen fǎn'ér zài wēijī zhōng gèngjiā lǐjiě hé yīkào bǐcǐ.
examples.english: Outside attempts to sow discord did nothing to shake the mutual trust between them; if anything, they came to understand and rely on each other even more through the crisis.

semanticNote: To provoke; to challenge aggressively; deliberate defiance. 軍事挑釁 (military provocation), 言語挑釁 (verbal provocation), 挑釁行為 (provocative behavior). Common in Taiwan's political and national security discourse: 對台挑釁 (provocations against Taiwan) appears frequently in news about PLA military activities near Taiwan. More aggressive and confrontational than 挑撥.

components.meaning: provoke; challenge; carry on a pole

examples.chinese: 中國軍機頻繁越過臺海中線，此類挑釁行為引發國際社會高度關注。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó jūnjī pínfán yuèguò Táihǎi zhōngxiàn, cǐ lèi tiǎoxìn xíngwéi yǐnfā guójì shèhuì gāodù guānzhù.
examples.english: Chinese military aircraft frequently crossing the Taiwan Strait median line has drawn high levels of attention from the international community as a form of provocation.

examples.chinese: 球場上對手不斷出言挑釁，他沉住氣沒有回應，繼續用成績說話。
examples.pinyin: Qiúchǎng shàng duìshǒu bùduàn chūyán tiǎoxìn, tā chén zhù qì méiyǒu huíyìng, jìxù yòng chéngjì shuōhuà.
examples.english: The opponent kept up a stream of verbal provocations on the court, but he kept his composure without responding and let his results speak for themselves.

semanticNote: To jump; to leap; to bound — suggests energetic, springy, repeated jumping rather than a single leap (for which 跳 alone suffices). 跳躍式成長 (leapfrog growth — a common business/development metaphor), 思維跳躍 (leap of thought; non-linear thinking), 跳躍前進 (advance in leaps). The figurative uses are common in business and academic writing.

examples.chinese: 小孩子在彈跳床上盡情跳躍，笑聲傳遍了整個遊樂場。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi zài tán tiào chuáng shàng jìnqíng tiàoyuè, xiàoshēng chuánbiàn le zhěnggè yóulèchǎng.
examples.english: The children leaped freely on the trampoline, their laughter spreading all across the playground.

examples.chinese: 這家新創公司短短五年內完成了跳躍式的成長，員工人數從五人擴張到五百人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xīnchuàng gōngsī duǎnduǎn wǔ nián nèi wánchéng le tiàoyuè shì de chéngzhǎng, yuángōng rénshù cóng wǔ rén kuòzhāng dào wǔbǎi rén.
examples.english: This startup achieved leapfrog growth in just five years, expanding from 5 employees to 500.

semanticNote: A pavilion or gazebo — a small, roofed, open-sided structure in a garden, park, or scenic area. 涼亭 (open-air pavilion for shade), 公園亭子 (park pavilion). A classic feature of Chinese garden design, prominently featured in 故宮博物院 gardens and traditional parks throughout Taiwan. Also: 電話亭 (telephone booth — the 亭 suffix for kiosk-type structures).

examples.chinese: 公園裡的涼亭是老人家下棋聊天的好去處，夏天遮陰、冬天擋風，四季皆宜。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ de liángtíng shì lǎorénjiā xià qí liáotiān de hǎo qùchù, xiàtiān zhē yīn, dōngtiān dǎng fēng, sìjì jiē yí.
examples.english: The pavilion in the park is a favorite spot for elderly people to play chess and chat — shady in summer and sheltered from the wind in winter, suitable for all seasons.

examples.chinese: 她從登山步道遠眺，看到山腰間有一座紅柱綠瓦的傳統亭子，在蒼翠的山林中格外醒目。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng dēngshān bùdào yuǎntiào, kàndào shānyāo jiān yǒu yī zuò hóng zhù lǜ wǎ de chuántǒng tíngzi, zài cāngcuì de shānlín zhōng géwài xǐngmù.
examples.english: From the hiking trail she gazed into the distance and spotted a traditional pavilion with red pillars and green tiles on the mountainside, standing out vividly against the lush forest.

semanticNote: To anchor or moor (a ship); to be at berth. 停泊港口 (moor in harbor), 船隻停泊 (vessel at anchor/berth). Exclusively used for watercraft. Taiwan's major ports — 基隆港, 高雄港, 台中港 — are busy commercial shipping hubs; 停泊費 (berthing fee) is a port operation term. Not used for aircraft (use 停靠 or 降落).

examples.chinese: 颱風來臨前，高雄港的船隻全數回港停泊，等待風雨過後再出航。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng láilín qián, Gāoxióng gǎng de chuánzhī quánshù huí gǎng tíngbó, děngdài fēngyǔ guòhòu zài chūháng.
examples.english: Before the typhoon arrived, all vessels in Kaohsiung Port returned to port to moor, waiting to set sail again after the storm passed.

examples.chinese: 夕陽餘暉下，一艘古帆船靜靜地停泊在漁港邊，構成一幅如詩如畫的美景。
examples.pinyin: Xīyáng yúhuī xià, yī sōu gǔ fānchuán jìngjìng de tíngbó zài yúgǎng biān, gòuchéng yī fú rú shī rú huà de měijǐng.
examples.english: In the glow of the sunset, an old sailing vessel sat quietly moored beside the fishing harbor, forming a scene of picture-perfect beauty.

semanticNote: A pause; a halt; a brief cessation. 說話停頓 (pause in speech — used in rhetoric and public speaking), 工程停頓 (construction halt), 交通停頓 (traffic standstill). A 停頓 is typically brief and followed by continuation, distinguishing it from 停止 (complete stop) or 停滯 (prolonged stagnation). In linguistics, 停頓 refers to prosodic pauses.

examples.chinese: 演講者在關鍵句子後刻意停頓幾秒，讓聽眾有時間消化剛才說的內容。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng zhě zài guānjiàn jùzi hòu kèyì tíngdùn jǐ miǎo, ràng tīngzhòng yǒu shíjiān xiāohuà gāngcái shuō de nèiróng.
examples.english: The speaker deliberately paused for a few seconds after the key sentence, giving the audience time to absorb what had just been said.

examples.chinese: 地鐵號誌系統出現故障，導致列車全線停頓長達一個小時，通勤族怨聲載道。
examples.pinyin: Dìtiě hàozhì xìtǒng chūxiàn gùzhàng, dǎozhì lièchē quánxiàn tíngdùn cháng dá yīgè xiǎoshí, tōngqín zú yuàn shēng zài dào.
examples.english: A fault in the metro signaling system caused trains to halt system-wide for a full hour, with commuters expressing widespread frustration.

english: stagnation; be at a standstill; bogged down
semanticNote: Stagnation; to be at a standstill; to be bogged down without progress. 停滯不前 (stagnate and fail to advance — a very common set phrase), 經濟停滯 (economic stagnation), 颱風停滯 (typhoon stalling — a meteorological term used in Taiwan when a typhoon hovers over an area rather than moving through). Always implies undesirable lack of movement or progress.

examples.chinese: 這個案子在審查階段停滯了將近半年，始終沒有進入實質討論，令申請方十分焦慮。
examples.pinyin: Zhège àn zi zài shěnchá jiēduàn tíngzhì le jiāngjìn bàn nián, shǐzhōng méiyǒu jìnrù shízhì tǎolùn, lìng shēnqǐng fāng shífēn jiāolǜ.
examples.english: The case stagnated at the review stage for nearly half a year without ever entering substantive discussion, leaving the applicant extremely anxious.

examples.chinese: 颱風在海上停滯了兩天，導致附近海域風浪持續偏大，多艘漁船無法出港。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng zài hǎi shàng tíngzhì le liǎng tiān, dǎozhì fùjìn hǎiyù fēnglàng chíxù piān dà, duō sōu yúchuán wúfǎ chū gǎng.
examples.english: The typhoon stalled over the sea for two days, causing persistently high winds and waves in nearby waters and preventing several fishing boats from leaving port.

semanticNote: Tall and straight; erect and imposing — describing trees, posture, or physique that stands upright with strength and elegance. 挺拔的松柏 (tall, straight pines and cypresses), 身姿挺拔 (erect and imposing bearing/posture). A literary and elevated adjective; common in nature writing, descriptions of people's bearing, and architectural metaphors.

components.meaning: straight; erect; stick out; rather; quite
pull out; rise above; select; surpass

examples.chinese: 玉山頂峰的台灣冷杉在嚴峻的高山環境中挺拔生長，展現出驚人的生命力。
examples.pinyin: Yùshān dǐngfēng de Táiwān lěng shān zài yánjùn de gāoshān huánjìng zhōng tǐngbá shēngzhǎng, zhǎnxiàn chū jīngrén de shēngmìnglì.
examples.english: The Taiwan firs at the summit of Yushan grow tall and straight in the harsh alpine environment, demonstrating a remarkable will to live.

examples.chinese: 他身材高挑挺拔，步伐穩健有力，一走進會議室就令全場為之側目。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēncái gāotiāo tǐngbá, bùfá wěnjiàn yǒulì, yī zǒu jìn huìyì shì jiù lìng quánchǎng wéi zhī cè mù.
examples.english: He is tall and upright in stature with a steady, powerful stride; the moment he walked into the conference room, every eye in the room turned to look.

semanticNote: Inflation — the general rise in price levels over time, reducing purchasing power. 通貨膨脹率 (inflation rate), 惡性通貨膨脹 (hyperinflation), 抑制通貨膨脹 (curb inflation). In Taiwan, the 消費者物價指數 (CPI) is the main inflation measure, tracked by 行政院主計總處 (DGBAS). 通膨 is the common abbreviated form used in news.

examples.chinese: 近年全球供應鏈中斷加上能源價格上漲，導致多國面臨數十年來最嚴重的通貨膨脹壓力。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián quánqiú gōngyìng liàn zhōngduàn jiā shàng néngyuán jiàgé shàngzhǎng, dǎozhì duō guó miànlín shùshí nián lái zuì yánzhòng de tōnghuò péngzhàng yālì.
examples.english: In recent years, global supply chain disruptions combined with rising energy prices have caused many countries to face their worst inflationary pressure in decades.

examples.chinese: 央行通常透過升息來壓制通貨膨脹，但這樣做也可能放緩經濟成長的速度。
examples.pinyin: Yāngháng tōngcháng tòuguò shēng xī lái yāzhì tōnghuò péngzhàng, dàn zhèyàng zuò yě kěnéng fàngmàn jīngjì chéngzhǎng de sùdù.
examples.english: Central banks typically use interest rate hikes to suppress inflation, but doing so can also slow the pace of economic growth.

english: order the arrest of a criminal
semanticNote: To issue a wanted order for a criminal; to order the arrest of a fugitive. 通緝令 (wanted notice), 發出通緝 (issue an arrest warrant), 遭警方通緝 (be wanted by police). 通緝犯 (wanted criminal/fugitive). Common in crime news; Taiwan's National Police Agency (警政署) issues 通緝令 for fugitives publicly.

examples.chinese: 警方對涉嫌詐欺的嫌疑人發出通緝令，並透過媒體公布其照片及特徵，請民眾協助舉報。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng duì shèxián zhàqī de xiányírén fāchū tōngjī lìng, bìng tòuguò méitǐ gōngbù qí zhàopiàn jí tèzhēng, qǐng mínzhòng xiézhù jǔbào.
examples.english: Police issued a wanted notice for the suspect accused of fraud and released their photo and description through the media, asking the public to help report sightings.

examples.chinese: 這名通緝犯躲藏多年，最終在邊境查驗時被辨識出真實身份而落網。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng tōngjī fàn duǒcáng duō nián, zuìzhōng zài biānjìng cháyàn shí bèi biànshí chū zhēnshí shēnfèn ér luò wǎng.
examples.english: This wanted criminal had been in hiding for years and was finally caught when their true identity was discovered during a border inspection.

semanticNote: Popular; common; accessible to ordinary people. 通俗文學 (popular literature), 通俗易懂 (easy to understand; accessible), 通俗讀物 (popular reading material). In Taiwan, 通俗 carries a neutral-to-positive sense of 'accessible to the general public' rather than 'lowbrow.' 通俗 vs. 高雅 (refined/highbrow) is a common contrast in cultural discussions.

examples.chinese: 這位教授擅長把深奧的物理概念用通俗的語言解釋清楚，讓普通人也能理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu shàncháng bǎ shēn'ào de wùlǐ gàiniàn yòng tōngsú de yǔyán jiěshì qīngchǔ, ràng pǔtōng rén yě néng lǐjiě.
examples.english: This professor excels at explaining profound physics concepts in plain, accessible language so that ordinary people can also understand them.

examples.chinese: 這本通俗科學書籍以生動的例子和簡單明瞭的文字，讓讀者輕鬆掌握現代天文學的核心知識。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn tōngsú kēxué shūjí yǐ shēngdòng de lìzi hé jiǎndān míngliǎo de wénzì, ràng dúzhě qīngsōng zhǎngwò xiàndài tiānwénxué de héxīn zhīshí.
examples.english: This popular science book uses vivid examples and clear, simple language to help readers easily grasp the core knowledge of modern astronomy.

semanticNote: Communication; correspondence; a news dispatch. 通訊技術 (communication technology), 通訊社 (news agency — e.g., 中央通訊社, Taiwan's Central News Agency), 5G通訊 (5G communications). 通訊 covers both the act of communicating and the infrastructure/technology enabling it. In journalism, 通訊 also refers to a news feature dispatch.

examples.chinese: 中央通訊社是臺灣的國家通訊社，負責提供國內外新聞報導給各大媒體機構。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyāng Tōngxùn Shè shì Táiwān de guójiā tōngxùn shè, fùzé tígōng guónèi wài xīnwén bàodǎo gěi gè dà méitǐ jīgòu.
examples.english: The Central News Agency is Taiwan's national news agency, responsible for providing domestic and international news coverage to major media organizations.

examples.chinese: 偏遠山區的通訊基礎設施仍不完善，颱風過後往往出現訊號全斷的情況。
examples.pinyin: Piānyuǎn shānqū de tōngxùn jīchǔ shèshī réng bù wánshàn, táifēng guòhòu wǎngwǎng chūxiàn xìnhào quán duàn de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: The communications infrastructure in remote mountain areas is still inadequate; after a typhoon, complete signal blackouts are a common occurrence.

english: in common use; interchangeable; General Motors
semanticNote: In common use; interchangeable; universally applicable. 通用語言 (common/universal language), 通用格式 (universal format), 通用字 (a character in common use). Also: 通用汽車 (General Motors — the company name borrowed this term). 普通話通用 (Mandarin is commonly used). A neutral, practical term emphasizing universal applicability across contexts.

examples.chinese: 這個充電頭採用通用設計，相容於市面上大多數品牌的手機和平板電腦。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chōngdiàn tóu cǎiyòng tōngyòng shèjì, xiāngyòng yú shìmiàn shàng dàduōshù pǐnpái de shǒujī hé píngbǎn diànnǎo.
examples.english: This charger uses a universal design, compatible with most brands of smartphones and tablets on the market.

examples.chinese: 英語是目前國際商務中最通用的語言，掌握流利英語對拓展海外市場至關重要。
examples.pinyin: Yīngyǔ shì mùqián guójì shāngwù zhōng zuì tōngyòng de yǔyán, zhǎngwò liúlì Yīngyǔ duì tuòzhǎn hǎiwài shìchǎng zhìguān zhòngyào.
examples.english: English is currently the most universally used language in international business; fluency in English is critically important for expanding into overseas markets.

semanticNote: Compatriot; fellow countryman; sibling born of the same parents. In political and public discourse, 同胞 carries strong emotional weight — 臺灣同胞 (fellow Taiwanese), 海外同胞 (overseas compatriots). The PRC uses 台灣同胞 as a standard address term in cross-strait messaging. In Taiwan, 同胞 is used warmly for national solidarity, especially in diaspora or disaster contexts.

components.meaning: womb; born of same mother; fellow

examples.chinese: 地震發生後，全臺同胞自發組成志工團隊，前往災區協助搜救和物資發放。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, quán Tái tóngbāo zìfā zǔchéng zhìgōng tuánduì, qiánwǎng zāiqū xiézhù sōujiù hé wùzī fāfàng.
examples.english: After the earthquake, compatriots across Taiwan spontaneously formed volunteer teams and headed to the disaster areas to assist with search-and-rescue and the distribution of supplies.

examples.chinese: 海外臺灣同胞每逢重大選舉都積極返台投票，以實際行動參與民主進程。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiwài Táiwān tóngbāo měi féng zhòngdà xuǎnjǔ dōu jījí fǎn Tái tóupiào, yǐ shíjì xíngdòng cānyù mínzhǔ jìnchéng.
examples.english: Overseas Taiwanese compatriots actively return to Taiwan to vote in major elections, participating in the democratic process through concrete action.

semanticNote: Two very distinct meanings: (1) comrade — the traditional revolutionary/political usage (communist party address form, now largely archaic in Taiwan); (2) gay/queer person — reclaimed slang widely used in Taiwan's LGBTQ+ community and general society. Taiwan Pride (台灣同志遊行, held annually in Taipei) is one of Asia's largest Pride events. In Taiwan, meaning (2) now dominates everyday usage; meaning (1) feels dated or ironic.

examples.chinese: 台灣同志遊行每年十月在臺北舉行，吸引數十萬人上街共同慶祝多元性別的自由與平等。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān Tóngzhì Yóuxíng měinián shí yuè zài Táiběi jǔxíng, xīyǐn shùshí wàn rén shàngjiē gòngtóng qìngzhù duōyuán xìngbié de zìyóu yǔ píngděng.
examples.english: Taiwan Pride is held every October in Taipei, drawing hundreds of thousands of people to the streets to celebrate the freedom and equality of diverse gender identities.

examples.chinese: 二○一九年臺灣成為亞洲第一個同性婚姻合法化的地區，受到國際同志社群的廣泛讚譽。
examples.pinyin: Èr líng yī jiǔ nián Táiwān chéngwéi Yàzhōu dì yī gè tóngxìng hūnyīn héfǎhuà de dìqū, shòudào guójì tóngzhì shèqún de guǎngfàn zànyù.
examples.english: In 2019 Taiwan became the first place in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage, earning widespread praise from LGBTQ+ communities internationally.

semanticNote: Copper — the reddish-brown metal. 銅牌 (bronze medal — note: 銅 is used for bronze as well as copper), 銅鑼 (gong — copper/bronze gong), 銅像 (bronze statue). 銅鑼灣 is a famous district in Hong Kong. In Taiwan, 銅 appears in temple objects (銅爐 — bronze incense burner), traditional music (銅鑼), and metallurgy. 純銅 (pure copper), 黃銅 (brass — copper-zinc alloy).

examples.chinese: 這位臺灣選手在奧運自由車賽事中奪得銅牌，是臺灣近年來在該項目的最佳成績。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi Táiwān xuǎnshǒu zài Àoyùn zìyóu chē sàishì zhōng duódé tóngpái, shì Táiwān jìnnián lái zài gāi xiàngmù de zuì jiā chéngjì.
examples.english: This Taiwanese athlete won a bronze medal in the Olympic cycling event, marking Taiwan's best result in that discipline in recent years.

examples.chinese: 廟宇裡那座巨大的銅爐已有百年歷史，每逢廟慶香火鼎盛，信眾絡繹不絕。
examples.pinyin: Miàoyǔ lǐ nà zuò jùdà de tóng lú yǐ yǒu bǎi nián lìshǐ, měi féng miào qìng xiānghuo dǐngshèng, xìnzhòng luòyì bù jué.
examples.english: The massive bronze incense burner in the temple has a history of a hundred years; during festival celebrations incense burns brightly and a continuous stream of worshippers comes and goes.

semanticNote: A fairy tale; a children's fantasy story. 格林童話 (Grimm's Fairy Tales), 安徒生童話 (Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tales). Also used figuratively: 這簡直是童話般的愛情 (this is a fairy-tale-like love story). 童話故事 (fairy tale story) is the full compound. Taiwan children's literature includes a rich tradition of 台灣民間故事 (Taiwanese folk tales) alongside translated Western fairy tales.

examples.chinese: 媽媽每晚睡前都會念一個童話故事給孩子聽，那些關於公主和騎士的故事成了她最美好的童年記憶。
examples.pinyin: Māma měi wǎn shuì qián dōu huì niàn yī gè tónghuà gùshì gěi háizi tīng, nàxiē guānyú gōngzhǔ hé qíshì de gùshì chéngle tā zuì měihǎo de tóngnián jìyì.
examples.english: Every night before bed, Mom would read a fairy tale to the children; those stories of princesses and knights became her most cherished childhood memories.

examples.chinese: 他們的婚禮在老城堡裡舉行，場景猶如童話般夢幻，令每位賓客都讚嘆不已。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen de hūnlǐ zài lǎo chéngbǎo lǐ jǔxíng, chǎngjǐng yóurú tónghuà bān mènghuàn, lìng měi wèi bīnkè dōu zàntàn bùyǐ.
examples.english: Their wedding was held in an old castle, the setting as dreamlike as a fairy tale — every guest was left in admiration.

english: take every aspects into consideration through plan and preparation
semanticNote: To plan comprehensively and take all aspects into account simultaneously; to balance and coordinate all considerations. 統籌兼顧 is a key governance and management concept in Chinese political discourse — it implies systematic planning that leaves nothing out. Common in policy documents, government work reports, and corporate strategic planning. Often paired with 合理安排 (reasonable arrangement).

components.meaning: take into account; look after; consider

examples.chinese: 這項政策的制定必須統籌兼顧經濟發展、環境保護和社會公平等多方面的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de zhìdìng bìxū tǒngchóu-jiāngù jīngjì fāzhǎn, huánjìng bǎohù hé shèhuì gōngpíng děng duō fāngmiàn de xūqiú.
examples.english: The formulation of this policy must comprehensively balance the needs of economic development, environmental protection, and social equity across multiple dimensions.

examples.chinese: 總指揮在調度資源時展現出統籌兼顧的能力，確保每個部門都能獲得必要的支援。
examples.pinyin: Zǒng zhǐhuī zài diàodù zīyuán shí zhǎnxiàn chū tǒngchóu-jiāngù de nénglì, quèbǎo měi gè bùmén dōu néng huòdé bìyào de zhīyuán.
examples.english: The commander-in-chief demonstrated the ability to coordinate and balance all considerations when allocating resources, ensuring every department received the necessary support.

english: statistics; to tally; to add up
semanticNote: Statistics; to tally; to add up. 統計數字 (statistical figures), 統計分析 (statistical analysis), 行政院主計總處 (Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, DGBAS — Taiwan's main statistical agency). 根據統計 (according to statistics) is an extremely common discourse opener in journalism. 人口統計 (census/demographics).

examples.chinese: 根據主計總處的統計，臺灣去年的出生率再創新低，少子化問題持續惡化。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhǔjì Zǒngchù de tǒngjì, Táiwān qùnián de chūshēng lǜ zài chuàng xīn dī, shǎo zǐ huà wèntí chíxù èhuà.
examples.english: According to DGBAS statistics, Taiwan's birth rate hit a new record low last year, and the problem of declining birth rates continues to worsen.

examples.chinese: 志工花了整整一週時間統計問卷結果，將資料整理成圖表以便進一步分析。
examples.pinyin: Zhìgōng huā le zhěngzhěng yī zhōu shíjiān tǒngjì wènjuàn jiéguǒ, jiāng zīliào zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo yǐ biàn jìnyībù fēnxī.
examples.english: Volunteers spent a full week tallying the survey results, organizing the data into charts for further analysis.

semanticNote: Totally; completely; all of (them) — an emphatic adverb of totality. 統統交出來 (hand everything over), 統統不對 (all of it is wrong). Informal and emphatic; spoken register. Slightly more colloquial and forceful than 全部 or 都. Often signals exasperation or absolute sweep: 全部統統 is redundant but heard colloquially.

examples.chinese: 老師說考試的題目統統出自課本上的例句，要大家放心，不用擔心有課外題。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō kǎoshì de tímù tǒngtǒng chū zì kèběn shàng de lìjù, yào dàjiā fàngxīn, bùyòng dānxīn yǒu kèwài tí.
examples.english: The teacher said all the exam questions would come entirely from the example sentences in the textbook, reassuring everyone there would be no questions from outside the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 她生氣地把桌上的東西統統掃落地上，然後摔門而去，留下一臉愕然的家人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngqì de bǎ zhuō shàng de dōngxī tǒngtǒng sǎo luò dìshàng, ránhòu shuāi mén ér qù, liú xià yī liǎn è rán de jiārén.
examples.english: She angrily swept everything off the table onto the floor, then slammed the door and left, leaving her family standing there dumbfounded.

semanticNote: To rule; to govern; governance — exercising sovereign political control over a territory or population. 統治者 (ruler; sovereign), 殖民統治 (colonial rule), 威權統治 (authoritarian rule). In Taiwan's history, 日本統治時期 (Japanese colonial period, 1895–1945) is a key historical reference. 統治 carries more weight and formality than 管理 (manage/administer).

examples.chinese: 羅馬帝國曾統治地中海周邊廣大地區長達數百年，留下了深遠的文化和法律遺產。
examples.pinyin: Luómǎ Dìguó céng tǒngzhì Dìzhōnghǎi zhōubiān guǎngdà dìqū cháng dá shù bǎi nián, liúxià le shēnyuǎn de wénhuà hé fǎlǜ yíchǎn.
examples.english: The Roman Empire once ruled vast territories around the Mediterranean for several centuries, leaving behind a profound cultural and legal legacy.

examples.chinese: 臺灣在荷蘭、西班牙、明鄭、清朝和日本的先後統治下，形成了多元豐富的歷史文化面貌。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài Hélán, Xībānyá, Míng Zhèng, Qīngcháo hé Rìběn de xiānhòu tǒngzhì xià, xíngchéng le duōyuán fēngfù de lìshǐ wénhuà miànmào.
examples.english: Under the successive rule of the Dutch, Spanish, Ming loyalists, Qing dynasty, and Japan, Taiwan developed its diverse and rich historical and cultural character.

semanticNote: Two meanings: (1) to speculate (financial markets) — 投機取巧 (seek advantage through opportunism), 股市投機 (stock market speculation); (2) congenial; to find one's thoughts and interests in harmony with another — 談得投機 (found we got along really well; hit it off in conversation). Meaning (2) is a distinct, positive sense in everyday Taiwanese conversation.

examples.chinese: 這個人慣於投機取巧，每次改革都在觀望形勢，等到方向明朗才跟著表態。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén guànyú tóujī qǔqiǎo, měi cì gǎigé dōu zài guānwàng xíngshì, děng dào fāngxiàng míngláng cái gēnzhe biǎotài.
examples.english: This person is habitually opportunistic, watching the situation from the sidelines during every reform and only declaring their position once the direction is clear.

examples.chinese: 他和老朋友久別重逢，相談甚歡、格外投機，一不留神就聊了三個多小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé lǎopéngyǒu jiǔbié chóngféng, xiāngtán shèn huān, géwài tóujī, yī bù liúshén jiù liáo le sān gè duō xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Reuniting with an old friend after a long separation, they found themselves wonderfully in sync; they were so caught up in conversation that they talked for more than three hours without noticing.

semanticNote: To vote; a vote; a poll. 投票率 (voter turnout), 投票所 (polling station), 公民投票 (referendum — 公投 for short), 投票日 (election day). Taiwan has a highly active electoral culture with regular 總統大選 (presidential elections), 立法委員選舉 (legislative elections), and referendums. 全民投票 (universal suffrage vote).

examples.chinese: 今天是地方選舉投票日，各投票所一早便大排長龍，投票率預計創下近年新高。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì dìfāng xuǎnjǔ tóupiào rì, gè tóupiào suǒ yī zǎo biàn dà pái cháng lóng, tóupiào lǜ yùjì chuàng xià jìnnián xīn gāo.
examples.english: Today is local election voting day; long queues formed early at every polling station, with voter turnout expected to hit a new high in recent years.

examples.chinese: 這次公民投票的結果顯示，大多數選民支持修改能源政策，朝向非核家園的方向邁進。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì gōngmín tóupiào de jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, dàduōshù xuǎnmín zhīchí xiūgǎi néngyuán zhèngcè, cháo xiàng fēi hé jiāyuán de fāngxiàng màijìn.
examples.english: The results of this referendum showed that the majority of voters support revising energy policy and moving toward a nuclear-free homeland.

english: make a complaint; appeal to a court
semanticNote: To make a complaint; to file a complaint or appeal. 向消保會投訴 (file a complaint with the Consumer Protection Commission), 投訴管道 (complaint channels), 客戶投訴 (customer complaint). In Taiwan, 行政院消費者保護處 (Consumer Protection Division) and 1950 消費者服務熱線 are key channels for consumer complaints. Also used for filing appeals in quasi-judicial settings.

examples.chinese: 消費者購買到瑕疵品後，可撥打消費者服務專線投訴，要求商家退換貨或賠償。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě gòumǎi dào xiácìpǐn hòu, kě bōdǎ xiāofèizhě fúwù zhuānxiàn tóusù, yāoqiú shāngjiā tuì huàn huò huò péicháng.
examples.english: When consumers purchase a defective product, they can call the consumer services hotline to file a complaint and request that the merchant offer an exchange or compensation.

examples.chinese: 他對施工噪音忍無可忍，最終向環保局投訴，請求派員前往稽查。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì shīgōng zàoyīn rěn wú kě rěn, zuìzhōng xiàng Huánbǎo Jú tóusù, qǐngqiú pài yuán qiánwǎng jīchá.
examples.english: Having reached the end of his patience with construction noise, he finally filed a complaint with the Environmental Protection Bureau, requesting that inspectors be sent to investigate.

semanticNote: To surrender; to capitulate — giving up in a military, political, or competitive confrontation. 舉旗投降 (raise the white flag), 無條件投降 (unconditional surrender), 拒絕投降 (refuse to surrender). In colloquial use, 投降 can be said humorously: 我投降了！(I give up! — when overwhelmed by a task or argument). Historically significant: 日本無條件投降 in 1945 ended WWII and Japan's colonial rule of Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 一九四五年八月十五日，日本宣布無條件投降，結束了長達十四年的戰爭，臺灣也正式脫離日本統治。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiǔ sì wǔ nián bā yuè shíwǔ rì, Rìběn xuānbù wútiáojiàn tóuxiáng, jiéshù le cháng dá shísì nián de zhànzhēng, Táiwān yě zhèngshì tuōlí Rìběn tǒngzhì.
examples.english: On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional surrender, ending fourteen years of war; Taiwan also formally ended its period under Japanese rule.

examples.chinese: 面對一道怎麼想也想不通的數學題，她終於舉白旗投降，決定去問老師。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì yī dào zěnme xiǎng yě xiǎng bùtōng de shùxué tí, tā zhōngyú jǔ bái qí tóuxiáng, juédìng qù wèn lǎoshī.
examples.english: Faced with a math problem she simply couldn't work out no matter how hard she tried, she finally raised the white flag and decided to ask the teacher.

english: throw something a long distance; hurl
semanticNote: To throw something a long distance; to hurl; to fling. More forceful and deliberate than 丟 (toss) or 扔 (throw casually). 投擲手榴彈 (throw a grenade), 投擲鉛球 (shot put), 投擲項目 (throwing events — athletics). Common in military, sports, and literary descriptions of forceful throwing. 田徑投擲項目 includes javelin, shot put, discus, and hammer throw.

examples.chinese: 他在田徑隊負責標槍和鉛球等投擲項目，憑藉天生的爆發力在全國賽事中屢有佳績。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài tiánjìng duì fùzé biāoqiāng hé qiānqiú děng tóuzhì xiàngmù, píng jiè tiānshēng de bàofā lì zài quánguó sàishì zhōng lǚ yǒu jiā jì.
examples.english: He handles javelin and shot put among the throwing events on the track and field team; relying on his natural explosive strength, he has repeatedly achieved strong results in national competitions.

examples.chinese: 她憤而投擲手中的杯子，陶瓷碎片在地板上四濺，現場一片譁然。
examples.pinyin: Tā fèn ér tóuzhì shǒu zhōng de bēizi, táocí suìpiàn zài dìbǎn shàng sì jiàn, xiànchǎng yī piàn huárán.
examples.english: In a fit of rage she hurled the cup in her hand; ceramic shards scattered across the floor, and there was an uproar in the room.

semanticNote: To divulge; to reveal; to let something leak out — typically information that was previously private, secret, or not yet officially released. 透露消息 (leak information), 透露計畫 (reveal plans), 拒絕透露 (refused to disclose). Common in journalism: 知情人士透露 (informed sources revealed...). More deliberate than 洩漏 (accidentally leak).

examples.chinese: 知情人士向媒體透露，這家科技公司即將宣布一項重大的企業合併計畫。
examples.pinyin: Zhīqíng rénshì xiàng méitǐ tòulù, zhè jiā kējì gōngsī jíjiāng xuānbù yī xiàng zhòngdà de qǐyè hébìng jìhuà.
examples.english: An informed source revealed to the media that this tech company is about to announce a major corporate merger plan.

examples.chinese: 她事先透露了幾個面試的關鍵問題，讓同學們能提前準備，大家都對她感激不盡。
examples.pinyin: Tā shìxiān tòulù le jǐ gè miànshì de guānjiàn wèntí, ràng tóngxuémen néng tíqián zhǔnbèi, dàjiā dōu duì tā gǎnjī bùjìn.
examples.english: She revealed a few key interview questions in advance so that classmates could prepare ahead of time; everyone was extremely grateful to her.

semanticNote: Bald; bare; blunt (of a tip). 禿頭 (bald head), 禿頂 (bald on top — male pattern baldness), 禿鷲 (vulture — literally 'bald eagle' in Chinese), 這支筆禿了 (this pen's nib is worn blunt). 禿 can describe the top of a mountain (光禿禿的山頂 — bare mountaintop) as well as baldness. Common colloquially; not offensive in neutral descriptive use.

examples.chinese: 他三十歲時已開始禿頂，五十歲後頭頂幾乎全禿，只剩兩側幾縷白髮。
examples.pinyin: Tā sānshí suì shí yǐ kāishǐ tū dǐng, wǔshí suì hòu tóudǐng jīhū quán tū, zhǐ shèng liǎng cè jǐ lǚ bái fà.
examples.english: He began to go bald on top at thirty; by his fifties his crown was almost completely bare, with only a few strands of white hair remaining on the sides.

examples.chinese: 這支鉛筆的筆頭已經禿了，寫出來的字模糊一片，要趕快削尖才能繼續用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiānbǐ de bǐ tóu yǐjīng tū le, xiě chūlái de zì móhú yī piàn, yào gǎnkuài xuē jiān cái néng jìxù yòng.
examples.english: The tip of this pencil is already worn blunt; the writing it produces is a blur — it needs to be sharpened right away before it can be used again.

semanticNote: To break through; a breakthrough. 突破困境 (break through difficulties), 科技突破 (technological breakthrough), 突破封鎖 (break through a blockade), 有所突破 (make a breakthrough). One of the most common positive-outcome words in Taiwan business, science, and sports reporting. 突破瓶頸 (break through a bottleneck) is an especially common business expression.

examples.chinese: 臺灣半導體產業在先進製程技術上取得重大突破，鞏固了在全球供應鏈中不可取代的地位。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè zài xiānjìn zhìchéng jìshù shàng qǔdé zhòngdà tūpò, gǒnggù le zài quánqiú gōngyìng liàn zhōng bùkě qǔdài de dìwèi.
examples.english: Taiwan's semiconductor industry achieved a major breakthrough in advanced process technology, consolidating its irreplaceable position in the global supply chain.

examples.chinese: 她在訓練了十年之後終於突破個人最佳成績，以○點三秒之差刷新了全國紀錄。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xùnliàn le shí nián zhīhòu zhōngyú tūpò gèrén zuì jiā chéngjì, yǐ líng diǎn sān miǎo zhī chā shuāxīn le quánguó jìlù.
examples.english: After ten years of training she finally broke through her personal best, setting a new national record by a margin of 0.3 seconds.

semanticNote: A design; a decorative pattern. 幾何圖案 (geometric pattern), 傳統圖案 (traditional pattern), 圖案設計 (pattern design). Taiwan's Indigenous peoples are known for distinctive woven 圖案 featuring zigzags, diamonds, and human figures — appearing on traditional Paiwan and Amis clothing and crafts.

examples.chinese: 這塊布料上的圖案靈感來自排灣族的傳統刺繡，以鮮豔的色彩和幾何紋路展現原住民族的美學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bùliào shàng de tú'àn línggǎn láizì Páiwān zú de chuántǒng cìxiù, yǐ xiānyàn de sècǎi hé jǐhé wénlù zhǎnxiàn yuánzhùmínzú de měixué.
examples.english: The pattern on this fabric is inspired by Paiwan traditional embroidery, showcasing Indigenous aesthetics through vivid colors and geometric motifs.

examples.chinese: 設計師花了三個月反覆修改商標圖案，最終呈現出簡約而不失質感的視覺效果。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī huā le sān gè yuè fǎnfù xiūgǎi shāngbiāo tú'àn, zuìzhōng chéngxiàn chū jiǎnyuē ér bù shī zhìgǎn de shìjué xiàoguǒ.
examples.english: The designer spent three months repeatedly refining the logo design, ultimately achieving a visual effect that is minimal yet rich in texture.

semanticNote: A disciple; an apprentice learning under a master (師父). 收徒弟 (take on an apprentice), 出師 (complete one's apprenticeship). The 師父–徒弟 relationship is a cornerstone of traditional craft transmission in Taiwan — seen in 廟宇彩繪 (temple painting), 木雕 (wood carving), 布袋戲 (glove puppetry), and traditional cuisine.

components.meaning: disciple; follower; on foot; in vain

examples.chinese: 這位老木雕師傅一生收了七名徒弟，每一位都在他嚴格指導下習得精湛的雕刻技藝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo mùdiāo shīfu yīshēng shōu le qī míng túdì, měi yī wèi dōu zài tā yángé zhǐdǎo xià xí dé jīngzhàn de diāokè jìyì.
examples.english: This old master woodcarver took on seven apprentices in his lifetime; each one learned exquisite carving skills under his strict guidance.

examples.chinese: 她是師父最得意的徒弟，不僅繼承了傳統廚藝，更在古法基礎上發展出自己獨特的風格。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì shīfu zuì déyì de túdì, bùjǐn jìchéng le chuántǒng chúyì, gèng zài gǔfǎ jīchǔ shàng fāzhǎn chū zìjǐ dútè de fēnggé.
examples.english: She is the master's most prized apprentice — not only did she inherit the traditional culinary art, but she also developed her own unique style on the foundation of the ancient methods.

semanticNote: A way; a channel; a means to achieve something. 獲取資訊的途徑 (channels for obtaining information), 合法途徑 (legal channels). More abstract and formal than 方法 (method); 途徑 emphasizes the pathway or route through which something is accomplished.

examples.chinese: 現代人取得知識的途徑比以往更加多元，網路、書籍、線上課程各有其優缺點。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén qǔdé zhīshì de tújìng bǐ yǐwǎng gèngjiā duōyuán, wǎnglù, shūjí, xiànshàng kèchéng gè yǒu qí yōu quēdiǎn.
examples.english: The channels through which modern people acquire knowledge are more diverse than ever — the internet, books, and online courses each have their own strengths and weaknesses.

examples.chinese: 若對行政決定有異議，應透過合法途徑提出申訴，而非採取激烈的抗議行動。
examples.pinyin: Ruò duì xíngzhèng juédìng yǒu yìyì, yīng tòuguò héfǎ tújìng tíchū shēnsù, ér fēi cǎiqǔ jīliè de kàngyì xíngdòng.
examples.english: If you have objections to an administrative decision, you should file an appeal through legal channels rather than resorting to aggressive protest.

semanticNote: To smear; to daub; to scribble. Covers both deliberate application (sunscreen, paint, medicine) and careless smearing or scrawling. 塗抹防曬乳 (apply sunscreen — very common in Taiwan's sunny climate), 在牆上塗抹 (scrawl on walls). Neutral to slightly negative for the scribbling sense.

examples.chinese: 出門前她在臉上塗抹了厚厚一層防曬乳，以抵禦臺灣夏日強烈的紫外線。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián tā zài liǎn shàng túmǒ le hòu hòu yī céng fángsài rǔ, yǐ dǐyù Táiwān xiàrì qiángliè de zǐwàixiàn.
examples.english: Before heading out, she applied a thick layer of sunscreen to her face to protect against Taiwan's intense summer UV rays.

examples.chinese: 孩子拿著蠟筆在牆壁上塗抹了一幅奇怪的圖，讓媽媽哭笑不得。
examples.pinyin: Háizi ná zhe làbǐ zài qiángbì shàng túmǒ le yī fú qíguài de tú, ràng māma kū xiào bù dé.
examples.english: The child grabbed a crayon and scrawled a strange drawing all over the wall, leaving Mom not knowing whether to laugh or cry.

semanticNote: Soil; earth. 土壤肥沃 (fertile soil), 土壤汙染 (soil contamination). Used literally (agriculture, geology) and figuratively: 民主的土壤 (the soil of democracy). The Jianan Plain's fertile soil (嘉南平原) and the 農田水利 system made it Taiwan's most productive agricultural region.

examples.chinese: 嘉南平原的土壤肥沃，加上完善的水利灌溉系統，使這裡成為臺灣最重要的農業產區。
examples.pinyin: Jiā-Nán píngyuán de tǔrǎng féiwò, jiā shàng wánshàn de shuǐlì guàngài xìtǒng, shǐ zhèlǐ chéngwéi Táiwān zuì zhòngyào de nóngyè chǎnqū.
examples.english: The fertile soil of the Jianan Plain, combined with a well-developed irrigation system, makes this Taiwan's most important agricultural production area.

examples.chinese: 工業廢水長期排放造成周邊農地土壤嚴重汙染，影響農作物的安全與品質。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyè fèishuǐ chángqī páifàng zàochéng zhōubiān nóngdì tǔrǎng yánzhòng wūrǎn, yǐngxiǎng nóngzuòwù de ānquán yǔ pǐnzhì.
examples.english: The long-term discharge of industrial wastewater has caused severe soil contamination in surrounding farmland, affecting the safety and quality of agricultural products.

english: unite; hold a rally; join forces
semanticNote: To unite; solidarity. 團結一致 (stand united as one), 團結力量大 (united we are strong). In Taiwan appears more in civil society and sports contexts than in political rhetoric. 勞工團結 (worker solidarity) in labor movements.

examples.chinese: 在這場國際賽事中，全體國民空前團結，無論政治立場為何，都為臺灣選手大聲喝采。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng guójì sàishì zhōng, quántǐ guómín kōngqián tuánjié, wúlùn zhèngzhì lìchǎng wéihé, dōu wèi Táiwān xuǎnshǒu dàshēng hècǎi.
examples.english: During this international competition, the entire nation was united as never before — regardless of political affiliation, everyone cheered loudly for Taiwan's athletes.

examples.chinese: 面對外部壓力，社區居民自發組織起來，以團結的力量爭取應有的環境權益。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì wàibù yālì, shèqū jūmín zìfā zǔzhī qǐlái, yǐ tuánjié de lìliàng zhēngqǔ yīngyǒu de huánjìng quányì.
examples.english: Faced with external pressure, community residents spontaneously organized and used the strength of solidarity to fight for their rightful environmental rights.

semanticNote: A group; an organization; a team. 民間團體 (civic organization), 宗教團體 (religious organization), 團體票 (group ticket). More formal and organizational than 群體. 人民團體法 (People's Organizations Act) governs civil organizations in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這個環保團體長期投入海洋廢棄物清除工作，每月定期組織志工在海岸線進行淨灘活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huánbǎo tuántǐ chángqī tóurù hǎiyáng fèiqìwù qīngchú gōngzuò, měi yuè dìngqī zǔzhī zhìgōng zài hǎi'àn xiàn jìnxíng jìng tān huódòng.
examples.english: This environmental group has long been engaged in marine debris removal, regularly organizing volunteers each month to conduct beach clean-up activities along the coastline.

examples.chinese: 參加合唱比賽的各個團體各有特色，有的擅長古典曲目，有的則以創意編排見長。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā héchàng bǐsài de gège tuántǐ gè yǒu tèsè, yǒude shàncháng gǔdiǎn qǔmù, yǒude zé yǐ chuàngyì biānpái jiàncháng.
examples.english: Each group participating in the choral competition has its own distinct character — some excel at classical repertoire while others stand out for creative arrangements.

english: have a reunion; reunite as a family
semanticNote: Family reunion; to reunite as a family. 闔家團圓 (the whole family reunited), 中秋團圓 (Mid-Autumn reunion). One of the most emotionally resonant words in Chinese culture — the Mid-Autumn Festival and Lunar New Year are defined by 團圓 as their core value. The round moon symbolizes 團圓.

examples.chinese: 每逢中秋佳節，在外工作的遊子紛紛趕回家鄉，只為與家人共享那一頓團圓飯。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng Zhōngqiū jiājié, zài wài gōngzuò de yóuzǐ fēnfēn gǎn huí jiāxiāng, zhǐ wèi yǔ jiārén gòng xiǎng nà yī dùn tuányuán fàn.
examples.english: Every Mid-Autumn Festival, people working away from home rush back to their hometowns, just to share that one family reunion meal with their loved ones.

examples.chinese: 分隔兩地多年的父子終於在機場相見，緊緊相擁的那一刻讓旁觀者無不動容。
examples.pinyin: Fēngé liǎng dì duō nián de fùzǐ zhōngyú zài jīchǎng xiāngjiàn, jǐnjǐn xiāng yōng de nà yī kè ràng pángguān zhě wú bù dòng róng.
examples.english: Father and son, separated for years, finally reunited at the airport; the moment they held each other tight moved every bystander who witnessed it.

semanticNote: To speculate; to conjecture; to surmise. 合理推測 (reasonable conjecture), 無從推測 (no way to speculate). More tentative than 推斷 (deduce); 推測 implies educated guessing rather than firm logical deduction. Common in scientific, legal, and journalistic contexts.

examples.chinese: 調查人員根據現場跡象推測，火災可能是由電線走火引起，但確切原因仍有待鑑定。
examples.pinyin: Diàochá rényuán gēnjù xiànchǎng jìxiàng tuīcè, huǒzāi kěnéng shì yóu diànxiàn zǒu huǒ yǐnqǐ, dàn quèqiè yuányīn réng yǒudài jiàndìng.
examples.english: Investigators speculated based on scene evidence that the fire may have been caused by an electrical fault, but the exact cause is still pending investigation.

examples.chinese: 她遲遲不回訊息，我只能推測她可能正在開會或手機沒電了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chíchí bù huí xùnxī, wǒ zhǐ néng tuīcè tā kěnéng zhèngzài kāihuì huò shǒujī méidiàn le.
examples.english: She hasn't replied for a long time; I can only guess she's in a meeting or her phone has run out of battery.

semanticNote: To overthrow; to overturn. 推翻政府 (overthrow a government), 推翻原來的結論 (overturn the original conclusion), 推翻判決 (overturn a verdict). Used for both literal political overthrow and figurative reversal of decisions, theories, or plans.

examples.chinese: 新出土的考古證據推翻了學界長期以來對這段歷史的主流詮釋，引發廣泛的學術討論。
examples.pinyin: Xīn chū tǔ de kǎogǔ zhèngjù tuīfān le xuéjiè chángqī yǐlái duì zhè duàn lìshǐ de zhǔliú quánshì, yǐnfā guǎngfàn de xuéshù tǎolùn.
examples.english: Newly unearthed archaeological evidence overturned the mainstream academic interpretation of this period of history, sparking widespread scholarly discussion.

examples.chinese: 被告律師提出新的不在場證明，試圖推翻檢察官的指控，法庭為此展開新一輪調查。
examples.pinyin: Bèigào lǜshī tíchū xīn de bù zàichǎng zhèngmíng, shìtú tuīfān jiǎncháguān de zhǐkòng, fǎtíng wèicǐ zhǎnkāi xīn yī lún diàochá.
examples.english: The defense attorney presented a new alibi in an attempt to overturn the prosecutor's charges; the court launched a new round of investigation.

semanticNote: Reasoning; inference; deductive logic. 推理小說 (detective/mystery fiction — hugely popular in Taiwan; Japanese authors like 東野圭吾 dominate bestseller lists), 邏輯推理 (logical reasoning). 推理 implies following a chain of logic from clues to conclusion.

examples.chinese: 這部推理小說情節縝密、伏筆精心，讀者要到最後一頁才能推理出真正的兇手是誰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù tuīlǐ xiǎoshuō qíngjié zhěnmì, fúbǐ jīngxīn, dúzhě yào dào zuìhòu yī yè cái néng tuīlǐ chū zhēnzhèng de xiōngshǒu shì shuí.
examples.english: This mystery novel has a meticulous plot and carefully laid foreshadowing; readers can only deduce the true culprit on the very last page.

examples.chinese: 數學教育的核心目標之一是培養學生運用邏輯推理解決複雜問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Shùxué jiàoyù de héxīn mùbiāo zhī yī shì péiyǎng xuéshēng yùnyòng luójí tuīlǐ jiějué fùzá wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: One of the core goals of mathematics education is to develop students' ability to use logical reasoning to solve complex problems.

semanticNote: To infer; a deduction; a corollary. 由此推論 (from this we can infer), 數學推論 (mathematical corollary). More formal than 推測 (conjecture); 推論 implies structured logical derivation from premises. Common in academic writing and mathematics.

examples.chinese: 由現有的統計數據推論，未來十年臺灣的老齡化程度將超越多數歐洲國家。
examples.pinyin: Yóu xiànyǒu de tǒngjì shùjù tuīlùn, wèilái shí nián Táiwān de lǎolínghuà chéngdù jiāng chāoyuè duōshù Ōuzhōu guójiā.
examples.english: Inferring from current statistical data, the degree of aging in Taiwan over the next decade will surpass that of most European countries.

examples.chinese: 這個推論雖然在邏輯上成立，但缺乏實證支撐，難以被學界廣泛接受。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tuīlùn suīrán zài luójí shàng chénglì, dàn quēfá shízhèng zhīchēng, nányǐ bèi xuéjiè guǎngfàn jiēshòu.
examples.english: Although this inference holds up logically, it lacks empirical support and is unlikely to gain wide acceptance in academic circles.

semanticNote: To market; to sell; to promote. 推銷員 (salesperson), 上門推銷 (door-to-door sales), 推銷自己 (sell oneself — promote one's abilities in an interview or pitch). Aggressive phone and door-to-door 推銷 is regulated under Taiwan's consumer protection laws.

examples.chinese: 那名推銷員話術流利、態度親切，讓她在不知不覺中買下了原本不打算購買的保險方案。
examples.pinyin: Nà míng tuīxiāo yuán huàshù liúlì, tàidù qīnqiè, ràng tā zài bùzhī bùjué zhōng mǎi xià le yuánběn bù dǎsuàn gòumǎi de bǎoxiǎn fāng'àn.
examples.english: The salesperson had a smooth pitch and a warm manner, and she found herself buying an insurance plan she hadn't intended to purchase before she even realized it.

examples.chinese: 求職面試時能有效推銷自己的優點和經驗，往往是決定能否獲得工作機會的關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Qiúzhí miànshì shí néng yǒuxiào tuīxiāo zìjǐ de yōudiǎn hé jīngyàn, wǎngwǎng shì juédìng néng fǒu huòdé gōngzuò jīhuì de guānjiàn.
examples.english: Being able to effectively sell your own strengths and experience in a job interview is often the deciding factor in whether you get the opportunity.

english: hum and haw (idiom); mumble as if hiding something; speak and break off, then start again; to hold something back
semanticNote: Speaking haltingly; hemming and hawing; mumbling as if hiding something. Always describes communication that is unclear and tentative, suggesting the speaker is holding something back. The opposite: 直說 (speak directly) or 坦白 (be frank).

examples.chinese: 他被問到當晚的行蹤時，回答得吞吞吐吐，讓警方對他的陳述產生了更多疑問。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi wèn dào dāngwǎn de xíngzōng shí, huídá de tūntūntǔtǔ, ràng jǐngfāng duì tā de chénshù chǎnshēng le gèngduō yíwèn.
examples.english: When asked about his whereabouts that evening, he answered in a halting, evasive manner, raising even more questions about his account.

examples.chinese: 有什麼話就直說吧，你這樣吞吞吐吐的，讓我覺得事情比想像的還要嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shénme huà jiù zhí shuō ba, nǐ zhèyàng tūntūntǔtǔ de, ràng wǒ juéde shìqíng bǐ xiǎngxiàng de hái yào yánzhòng.
examples.english: Just say it directly — the way you're hemming and hawing makes me feel the situation is even more serious than I imagined.

semanticNote: To check in baggage; to consign goods for shipment. 行李託運 (checked baggage), 託運費 (checked baggage fee), 託運限額 (baggage allowance). Most commonly refers to checking luggage at the airport. 隨身行李 (carry-on) is the opposite.

components.meaning: entrust; support from below; rely on

examples.chinese: 她把大件行李辦理了託運，只帶著一個隨身背包上飛機，輕鬆許多。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ dà jiàn xínglǐ bànlǐ le tuōyùn, zhǐ dài zhe yīgè suíshēn bèibāo shàng fēijī, qīngsōng xǔduō.
examples.english: She checked her large bags and boarded the plane with just a small carry-on backpack — much more comfortable.

examples.chinese: 液態物品若超過一百毫升，在安全檢查時會被沒收，建議放入託運行李中。
examples.pinyin: Yètài wùpǐn ruò chāoguò yī bǎi háoshēng, zài ānquán jiǎnchá shí huì bèi mòshōu, jiànyì fàngrù tuōyùn xínglǐ zhōng.
examples.english: Liquid items exceeding 100ml will be confiscated at security screening; it is recommended to put them in checked luggage.

semanticNote: To delay; to procrastinate; to protract. 拖延症 (procrastination disorder — widely discussed in Taiwan), 拖延時間 (stall for time), 一拖再拖 (delay again and again). 拖延症 is a familiar self-deprecating label in Taiwan's working culture.

examples.chinese: 她有嚴重的拖延症，每次報告都等到最後一天才開始動筆，結果搞得自己壓力極大。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yánzhòng de tuōyán zhèng, měi cì bàogào dōu děng dào zuìhòu yī tiān cái kāishǐ dòng bǐ, jiéguǒ gǎo dé zìjǐ yālì jí dà.
examples.english: She has a serious procrastination problem; every time she has a report due she waits until the last day to start writing, putting herself under enormous stress.

examples.chinese: 工程因材料供應問題不得不拖延，預計將比原定完工時間晚兩個月。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéng yīn cáiliào gōngyìng wèntí bùdé bù tuōyán, yùjì jiāng bǐ yuán dìng wángōng shíjiān wǎn liǎng gè yuè.
examples.english: The project was forced to delay due to material supply issues and is expected to be completed two months behind schedule.

english: to separate oneself from; to break away from; be divorced from; diastasis (medicine); abscission; abjunction (botany)
semanticNote: To separate from; to break away from; to become divorced from. 脫離危險 (out of danger — extremely common in medical news), 脫離現實 (divorced from reality), 脫離組織 (break away from an organization). The sense is of actively leaving or escaping a state or affiliation.

examples.chinese: 經過七個小時的緊急手術，病患終於脫離生命危險，目前在加護病房觀察中。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò qī gè xiǎoshí de jǐnjí shǒushù, bìnghuàn zhōngyú tuōlí shēngmìng wēixiǎn, mùqián zài jiāhù bìngfáng guānchá zhōng.
examples.english: After seven hours of emergency surgery, the patient is finally out of danger and is currently under observation in the ICU.

examples.chinese: 他在海外定居多年後，感覺自己漸漸脫離了故鄉的文化脈絡，心中不免有些惆悵。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎiwài dìngjū duō nián hòu, gǎnjué zìjǐ jiànjiàn tuōlí le gùxiāng de wénhuà màiluò, xīnzhōng bùmiǎn yǒuxiē chóuchàng.
examples.english: After settling overseas for many years, he felt he was gradually becoming disconnected from the cultural context of his hometown — a feeling he found somewhat melancholy.

semanticNote: Appropriate; proper; well-handled. 安排妥當 (properly arranged), 處理得妥當 (handled appropriately). Slightly more formal than 合適 (suitable); 妥當 implies thorough, careful handling with nothing out of place.

examples.chinese: 出發前她把家裡大小事都安排妥當，確保貓咪有人照顧、帳單也自動扣款。
examples.pinyin: Chūfā qián tā bǎ jiālǐ dàxiǎo shì dōu ānpái tuǒdàng, quèbǎo māomī yǒu rén zhàogù, zhàngdān yě zìdòng kòukuǎn.
examples.english: Before setting off she had everything at home properly arranged — making sure the cat was taken care of and the bills were set to auto-pay.

examples.chinese: 這件事的處理方式是否妥當，各方見解不一，引發了不小的爭議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de chǔlǐ fāngshì shìfǒu tuǒdàng, gèfāng jiànjiě bù yī, yǐnfā le bù xiǎo de zhēngyì.
examples.english: Whether this matter was handled appropriately is a matter of differing opinion and has sparked no small amount of controversy.

semanticNote: Appropriate and thorough; well-arranged and careful. Implies a higher standard of care than 妥當. 妥善處理 (handle with care and thoroughness), 妥善保存 (store/preserve properly), 妥善安置 (properly settle — used for disaster victims or refugees in government policy language).

examples.chinese: 颱風災後，政府承諾將妥善安置所有受災家庭，提供臨時住所和生活補助。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng zāi hòu, zhèngfǔ chéngnuò jiāng tuǒshàn ānzhì suǒyǒu shòuzāi jiātíng, tígōng línshí zhùsuǒ hé shēnghuó bǔzhù.
examples.english: After the typhoon disaster, the government pledged to properly resettle all affected families, providing temporary housing and living subsidies.

examples.chinese: 個人資料應妥善保存，避免洩漏給未經授權的第三方，以防個資遭到濫用。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zīliào yīng tuǒshàn bǎocún, bìmiǎn xièlòu gěi wèi jīng shòuquán de dìsānfāng, yǐ fáng gè zī zāodào lànyòng.
examples.english: Personal data should be properly stored and kept from being disclosed to unauthorized third parties to prevent misuse.

semanticNote: To compromise; a compromise. 做出妥協 (make a concession), 拒絕妥協 (refuse to compromise). In Taiwan's political culture, 妥協 has mixed connotations: pragmatic in negotiations, but 不妥協的立場 (an uncompromising stance) is often framed as principled strength.

examples.chinese: 談判雙方堅持各自立場近三個月後，終於在關鍵議題上做出了相互妥協。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn shuāngfāng jiānchí gèzì lìchǎng jìn sān gè yuè hòu, zhōngyú zài guānjiàn yìtí shàng zuò chū le xiānghù tuǒxié.
examples.english: After both sides held firm to their positions for nearly three months, they finally made mutual compromises on the key issues.

examples.chinese: 她在藝術創作上從不妥協，寧可作品賣不出去，也不願為迎合市場而改變風格。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yìshù chuàngzuò shàng cóng bù tuǒxié, nìngkě zuòpǐn mài bùchūqù, yě bù yuàn wèi yínghe shìchǎng ér gǎibiàn fēnggé.
examples.english: She never compromises in her artistic creation — she would rather her work go unsold than change her style to cater to the market.

semanticNote: Geometry and general-usage term for an oval/elliptical shape; used both as a technical noun (math, physics, orbits) and as a modifier for oval-shaped everyday objects.

examples.chinese: 這個橢圓的游泳池很特別。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tuǒyuán de yóuyǒngchí hěn tèbié.
examples.english: This oval swimming pool is quite unique.

examples.chinese: 數學課教我們如何計算橢圓的面積。
examples.pinyin: Shùxué kè jiāo wǒmen rúhé jìsuàn tuǒyuán de miànjī.
examples.english: Math class taught us how to calculate the area of an ellipse.

semanticNote: Strong, formal-register verb for spurning or rejecting someone/something with contempt, usually for moral reasons — corruption, betrayal, disgrace. Rarely used in casual speech.

examples.chinese: 貪污被起訴的官員,遭到全民唾棄。
examples.pinyin: Tānwū bèi qǐsù de guānyuán, zāodào quánmín tuòqì.
examples.english: The official prosecuted for corruption was spurned by the entire public.

examples.chinese: 他的背叛行為讓昔日戰友都唾棄他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bèipàn xíngwéi ràng xírì zhànyǒu dōu tuòqì tā.
examples.english: His act of betrayal made his former comrades spurn him.

semanticNote: Used literally for physical digging/excavation (archaeology, construction) and figuratively for uncovering talent, potential, or hidden facts. Neutral-to-formal register.

examples.chinese: 考古學家在臺南挖掘出許多史前文物。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔ xuéjiā zài Táinán wājué chū xǔduō shǐqián wénwù.
examples.english: Archaeologists excavated many prehistoric artifacts in Tainan.

examples.chinese: 這位教練很擅長挖掘年輕選手的潛力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoliàn hěn shàncháng wājué niánqīng xuǎnshǒu de qiánlì.
examples.english: This coach is very skilled at unearthing young athletes' potential.

semanticNote: Interjection expressing surprise or admiration; also used onomatopoeically for the sound of sudden crying (哇的一聲). Very common in speech and casual text.

examples.chinese: 哇,這個夜市的臭豆腐味道好特別!
examples.pinyin: Wa, zhège yèshì de chòudòufu wèidào hǎo tèbié!
examples.english: Wow, the stinky tofu at this night market tastes so unique!

examples.chinese: 小妹妹一放開媽媽的手就哇的一聲哭了出來。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo mèimei yī fàngkāi māma de shǒu jiù wā de yī shēng kū le chūlái.
examples.english: As soon as the little girl let go of her mom's hand, she burst out crying with a wail.

semanticNote: Colloquial, affectionate term for a baby or young child, and also the generic word for a doll (洋娃娃 "Western-style doll"). Common in everyday Taiwan speech.

examples.chinese: 她送給女兒一個很漂亮的洋娃娃。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng gěi nǚ'ér yí ge hěn piàoliang de yángwáwa.
examples.english: She gave her daughter a very pretty doll.

examples.chinese: 那個娃娃看起來眼睛好大,好可愛。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wáwa kànqǐlái yǎnjīng hǎo dà, hǎo kě'ài.
examples.english: That doll's eyes look so big, so cute.

semanticNote: Formal, written-register verb for an organization, regime, alliance, or morale falling apart — mostly figurative rather than literal collapse.

examples.chinese: 這場醜聞讓執政聯盟迅速瓦解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng chǒuwén ràng zhízhèng liánméng xùnsù wǎjiě.
examples.english: This scandal caused the ruling coalition to rapidly disintegrate.

examples.chinese: 士兵長期缺糧,軍心逐漸瓦解。
examples.pinyin: Shìbīng chángqí quē liáng, jūnxīn zhújiàn wǎjiě.
examples.english: With prolonged food shortages, the soldiers' morale gradually crumbled.

english: to distort; to misrepresent; to twist; crooked; askew; aslant
semanticNote: Formal register verb meaning to distort or misrepresent facts, the truth, or someone's words — commonly used critically in news and political commentary.

examples.chinese: 部分媒體歪曲事實,誤導社會大眾。
examples.pinyin: Bùfen méitǐ wāiqū shìshí, wùdǎo shèhuì dàzhòng.
examples.english: Some media outlets distort facts and mislead the public.

examples.chinese: 他抗議對方歪曲了他的原意。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàngyì duìfāng wāiqū le tā de yuányì.
examples.english: He protested that the other side had distorted his original meaning.

semanticNote: Neutral, everyday term for outward appearance, contrasted with 內在 "inner character"; used for both people and objects/buildings.

examples.chinese: 別只看外表,要多了解一個人的內在。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhǐ kàn wàibiǎo, yào duō liǎojiě yí ge rén de nèizài.
examples.english: Don't just look at appearances — get to know a person's inner character.

examples.chinese: 這棟大樓外表看起來很新,其實已經蓋了二十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng dàlóu wàibiǎo kànqǐlái hěn xīn, qíshí yǐjīng gài le èrshí nián.
examples.english: This building's exterior looks new, but it was actually built twenty years ago.

semanticNote: Contrasts with 內行 "expert/insider"; often used self-deprecatingly ("我是外行") or to criticize someone's lack of expertise in a trade or field.

examples.chinese: 對於股票投資,我完全是外行。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú gǔpiào tóuzī, wǒ wánquán shì wàiháng.
examples.english: When it comes to stock investing, I'm a complete layman.

examples.chinese: 別讓外行人來指揮這場手術。
examples.pinyin: Bié ràng wàihángrén lái zhǐhuī zhè chǎng shǒushù.
examples.english: Don't let a layman direct this surgery.

semanticNote: Common in news register — 外界關注/外界質疑 "outside observers are concerned/question" — referring to people or opinion outside a specific organization or group.

examples.chinese: 外界對這項政策多有質疑。
examples.pinyin: Wàijiè duì zhè xiàng zhèngcè duō yǒu zhíyí.
examples.english: Outside observers have many doubts about this policy.

examples.chinese: 公司決定暫時不對外界公開細節。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng zhànshí bú duì wàijiè gōngkāi xìjié.
examples.english: The company decided not to disclose details to the outside world for now.

semanticNote: Most common sense is a personality trait, opposite of 內向 "introverted"; a secondary, more formal economic sense (外向型經濟) describes export-oriented industries — relevant to Taiwan's trade-dependent economy.

examples.chinese: 她個性外向,很容易跟陌生人聊起來。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng wàixiàng, hěn róngyì gēn mòshēngrén liáo qǐlái.
examples.english: She has an extroverted personality and easily strikes up conversations with strangers.

examples.chinese: 臺灣屬於外向型經濟,高度依賴出口。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shǔyú wàixiàng xíng jīngjì, gāodù yīlài chūkǒu.
examples.english: Taiwan has an export-oriented economy, highly dependent on exports.

semanticNote: Usually a suffix in compound nouns for small round objects (藥丸 "pill", 肉丸 "meatball", 魚丸 "fish ball") rather than standing alone in casual speech.

examples.chinese: 醫生開了幾顆藥丸給我,一天吃三次。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng kāi le jǐ kē yàowán gěi wǒ, yì tiān chī sān cì.
examples.english: The doctor gave me a few pills to take three times a day.

examples.chinese: 新竹的貢丸和魚丸都很有名。
examples.pinyin: Xīnzhú de gòngwán hàn yúwán dōu hěn yǒumíng.
examples.english: Hsinchu's pork meatballs and fish balls are both famous.

semanticNote: Formal, written-register adjective describing systems, facilities, laws, or documentation as thoroughly complete; rarely applied to people.

examples.chinese: 這套社會福利制度已經相當完備。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào shèhuì fúlì zhìdù yǐjīng xiāngdāng wánbèi.
examples.english: This social welfare system is already quite comprehensive.

examples.chinese: 圖書館的藏書分類十分完備。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn de cángshū fēnlèi shífēn wánbèi.
examples.english: The library's book classification is very complete.

semanticNote: Formal register, common in official announcements or written notices (手術完畢, 會議完畢); casual spoken Chinese prefers 完 or 結束.

examples.chinese: 手術已於下午三點完畢。
examples.pinyin: Shǒushù yǐ yú xiàwǔ sān diǎn wánbì.
examples.english: The surgery was completed at 3pm.

examples.chinese: 各項登記手續辦理完畢後,即可領取健保卡。
examples.pinyin: Gè xiàng dēngjì shǒuxù bànlǐ wánbì hòu, jí kě lǐngqǔ jiànbǎokǎ.
examples.english: Once all registration procedures are completed, you can collect your National Health Insurance card.

english: resort to; play with; engage in
semanticNote: Negative connotation — to toy with someone's feelings or manipulate through tricks (玩弄手段, 玩弄感情); rarely used neutrally.

examples.chinese: 他只是在玩弄她的感情,並不是真心的。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì zài wánnòng tā de gǎnqíng, bìng búshì zhēnxīn de.
examples.english: He's just toying with her feelings, not being sincere.

examples.chinese: 有些政客擅長玩弄文字遊戲來逃避責任。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē zhèngkè shàncháng wánnòng wénzì yóuxì lái táobì zérèn.
examples.english: Some politicians are skilled at playing word games to dodge responsibility.

semanticNote: Very colloquial, Beijing-flavored erhua term for "thing/gadget," often dismissive ("這什麼玩意兒"); Taiwan Mandarin speakers more often say 東西 or 小玩意 instead.

examples.chinese: 這是什麼玩意兒,怎麼用啊?
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì shénme wányìr, zěnme yòng a?
examples.english: What is this thing, how do you use it?

examples.chinese: 桌上擺著一堆稀奇古怪的小玩意兒。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō shàng bǎi zhe yì duī xīqí gǔguài de xiǎo wányìr.
examples.english: A bunch of strange little gadgets were sitting on the table.

semanticNote: Negative register describing someone rigidly clinging to outdated views or bad habits (頑固分子, 頑固的想法); stronger and more critical than 固執.

examples.chinese: 爺爺個性頑固,很難接受新的想法。
examples.pinyin: Yéye gèxìng wángù, hěn nán jiēshòu xīn de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: Grandpa is stubborn by nature and finds it hard to accept new ideas.

examples.chinese: 這種頑固的偏見很難在短時間內改變。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wángù de piānjiàn hěn nán zài duǎn shíjiān nèi gǎibiàn.
examples.english: This kind of stubborn prejudice is hard to change in a short time.

semanticNote: Positive register (unlike 頑固) — praises perseverance and resilience against adversity, illness, or tough competition.

examples.chinese: 她以頑強的意志力戰勝了病魔。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wánqiáng de yìzhìlì zhànshèng le bìngmó.
examples.english: She overcame her illness with tenacious willpower.

examples.chinese: 這支球隊展現出頑強的鬥志,最終逆轉勝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì zhǎnxiàn chū wánqiáng de dòuzhì, zuìzhōng nìzhuǎn shèng.
examples.english: This team showed tenacious fighting spirit and ultimately won by a comeback.

english: reverse or salvage (a situation); redeem; retrieve
semanticNote: Used for salvaging a bad situation, reputation, or relationship before it's too late (挽回顏面, 挽回感情); implies active effort against decline.

examples.chinese: 他努力想挽回這段感情,但為時已晚。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xiǎng wǎnhuí zhè duàn gǎnqíng, dàn wéishí yǐwǎn.
examples.english: He tried hard to salvage the relationship, but it was too late.

examples.chinese: 公司緊急推出優惠方案,希望挽回顧客的信任。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jǐnjí tuīchū yōuhuì fāng'àn, xīwàng wǎnhuí gùkè de xìnrèn.
examples.english: The company urgently rolled out a discount plan, hoping to win back customers' trust.

semanticNote: Similar to 挽回 but more urgent — used for saving lives, a failing situation, or averting disaster; frequently paired with 生命, 危機, 局勢.

examples.chinese: 醫護人員全力搶救,終於挽救了他的生命。
examples.pinyin: Yīhù rényuán quánlì qiǎngjiù, zhōngyú wǎnjiù le tā de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Medical staff worked with all their strength and finally saved his life.

examples.chinese: 政府試圖挽救每況愈下的經濟局勢。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ shìtú wǎnjiù měikuàngyùxià de jīngjì júshì.
examples.english: The government tried to salvage the deteriorating economic situation.

english: feel sorry for a person; sympathize; to regret
semanticNote: Formal-ish register for feeling regret or sympathy over a pitiable situation or missed opportunity — usually about someone else's misfortune rather than one's own.

examples.chinese: 聽到老師退休的消息,學生們都感到十分惋惜。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào lǎoshī tuìxiū de xiāoxi, xuéshēngmen dōu gǎndào shífēn wǎnxī.
examples.english: Hearing the news that the teacher was retiring, the students all felt a great sense of regret.

examples.chinese: 他因傷退賽,教練替他感到惋惜。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīn shāng tuìsài, jiàoliàn tì tā gǎndào wǎnxī.
examples.english: He withdrew from the competition due to injury, and the coach felt sorry for him.

semanticNote: Intensifying adverb used before certain emotion or state words (萬分感激, 萬分抱歉); formal, written register.

examples.chinese: 對於您的幫助,我萬分感激。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú nín de bāngzhù, wǒ wànfēn gǎnjī.
examples.english: I'm extremely grateful for your help.

examples.chinese: 這次失誤造成的損失,他萬分自責。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shīwù zàochéng de sǔnshī, tā wànfēn zìzé.
examples.english: He blamed himself extremely for the loss caused by this mistake.

english: habitually in the past; as one used to do; as it used to be
semanticNote: Refers to how things usually were in the past, often contrasted with a changed present (不像往常一樣); common narrative/spoken register.

examples.chinese: 今天他比往常早到公司。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tā bǐ wǎngcháng zǎo dào gōngsī.
examples.english: Today he arrived at the office earlier than usual.

examples.chinese: 這條街道不像往常那麼熱鬧了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào bú xiàng wǎngcháng nàme rènào le.
examples.english: This street isn't as lively as it used to be.

semanticNote: Often nostalgic or emotionally weighted — memories or past experiences (回憶往事, 塵封的往事); literary, reflective register.

examples.chinese: 每次回到老家,他總會想起童年的往事。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì huídào lǎojiā, tā zǒng huì xiǎngqǐ tóngnián de wǎngshì.
examples.english: Every time he returns to his hometown, he always recalls memories of his childhood.

examples.chinese: 她不願再提起那段傷心的往事。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuàn zài tíqǐ nà duàn shāngxīn de wǎngshì.
examples.english: She doesn't want to bring up that sad past event again.

semanticNote: Negative register for an unrealistic, delusional hope or scheme, often mocking someone's unrealistic plan; also a clinical psychiatric term (被害妄想 "persecutory delusion").

examples.chinese: 他妄想一夜致富,結果被詐騙集團騙光積蓄。
examples.pinyin: Tā wàngxiǎng yíyè zhìfù, jiéguǒ bèi zhàpiàn jítuán piàn guāng jīxù.
examples.english: He fantasized about getting rich overnight, and ended up being swindled out of his savings.

examples.chinese: 醫生說這名病患出現被害妄想的症狀。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè míng bìnghuàn chūxiàn bèihài wàngxiǎng de zhèngzhuàng.
examples.english: The doctor said the patient is showing symptoms of persecutory delusion.

semanticNote: Standard word for a serious crisis (financial, political, environmental); contains 機 "opportunity," a point often made rhetorically (危機就是轉機).

examples.chinese: 這場金融危機影響了全球經濟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng jīnróng wēijī yǐngxiǎngle quánqiú jīngjì.
examples.english: This financial crisis affected the global economy.

examples.chinese: 政府正設法化解這次的外交危機。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèng shèfǎ huàjiě zhè cì de wàijiāo wēijī.
examples.english: The government is trying to resolve this diplomatic crisis.

english: awe-inspiring authority; power and prestige; impressive force
semanticNote: Describes an imposing, commanding presence or show of power/status — can be admiring or slightly critical (逞威風 "flaunt one's power").

examples.chinese: 將軍騎著馬進城,十分威風。
examples.pinyin: Jiāngjūn qízhe mǎ jìnchéng, shífēn wēifēng.
examples.english: The general rode into the city on horseback, looking very impressive.

examples.chinese: 他仗著背景在公司裡耍威風。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàngzhe bèijǐng zài gōngsī lǐ shuǎ wēifēng.
examples.english: He throws his weight around at the company relying on his connections.

semanticNote: Refers to the destructive or forceful power of something concrete — weapons, storms, technology — rather than a person's authority (that's 威望/威信 instead).

examples.chinese: 這種颱風的威力足以摧毀整棟房屋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng táifēng de wēilì zúyǐ cuīhuǐ zhěng dòng fángwū.
examples.english: A typhoon of this strength is powerful enough to destroy an entire house.

examples.chinese: 核子武器的威力遠超過一般人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Hézǐ wǔqì de wēilì yuǎn chāoguò yìbān rén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: The destructive power of nuclear weapons far exceeds what most people imagine.

semanticNote: Earned prestige and respect from others due to accomplishment or standing — used for respected leaders, elders, or institutions.

examples.chinese: 這位教授在學術界擁有極高的威望。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu zài xuéshùjiè yǒngyǒu jí gāo de wēiwàng.
examples.english: This professor holds extremely high prestige in academic circles.

examples.chinese: 校長辦事公正,在師生間建立起相當的威望。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng bànshì gōngzhèng, zài shīshēng jiān jiànlì qǐ xiāngdāng de wēiwàng.
examples.english: The principal handles matters fairly and has built considerable prestige among teachers and students.

semanticNote: Similar to 威望 but emphasizes trust and credibility earned through consistent, fair conduct — often used for leaders or institutions maintaining public trust (威信掃地 "lose all credibility").

examples.chinese: 政府必須言行一致,才能建立威信。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bìxū yánxíng yízhì, cái néng jiànlì wēixìn.
examples.english: The government must act consistently with its words in order to build credibility.

examples.chinese: 這次決策失誤讓他在同事間的威信掃地。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì juécè shīwù ràng tā zài tóngshì jiān de wēixìn sǎodì.
examples.english: This decision-making mistake completely destroyed his credibility among colleagues.

semanticNote: Chengyu meaning something is too small or trivial to be worth mentioning; often used with self-deprecating modesty or to downplay significance.

examples.chinese: 跟他遭遇的困難比起來,我的問題根本微不足道。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tā zāoyù de kùnnán bǐ qǐlái, wǒ de wèntí gēnběn wēibù-zúdào.
examples.english: Compared to the hardships he's faced, my problems are utterly insignificant.

examples.chinese: 這點小小的貢獻微不足道,不足掛齒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎoxiǎo de gòngxiàn wēibù-zúdào, bùzú guàchǐ.
examples.english: This small contribution is negligible, not worth mentioning.

semanticNote: Formal/academic register, contrasted with 宏觀 "macro"; common in economics (微觀經濟學) and physics.

examples.chinese: 這門課主要探討個別廠商行為的微觀經濟學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè zhǔyào tàntǎo gèbié chǎngshāng xíngwéi de wēiguān jīngjìxué.
examples.english: This course mainly explores microeconomics, the behavior of individual firms.

examples.chinese: 從微觀的角度來看,粒子的運動遵循量子力學。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wēiguān de jiǎodù láikàn, lìzǐ de yùndòng zūnxún liàngzǐ lìxué.
examples.english: From a microscopic perspective, particle motion follows quantum mechanics.

english: make things difficult for someone; embarrassed
semanticNote: Can mean to deliberately put someone in a difficult position (別為難他了) or to describe one's own awkward, embarrassed predicament; common in everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 別再為難服務生了,不是他的錯。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài wéinán fúwùshēng le, búshì tā de cuò.
examples.english: Stop giving the waiter a hard time, it's not his fault.

examples.chinese: 這個要求讓他左右為難,不知如何是好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yāoqiú ràng tā zuǒyòu wéinán, bùzhī rúhé shì hǎo.
examples.english: This request put him in an awkward bind, not knowing what to do.

english: be scheduled for; last for (a certain duration)
semanticNote: Formal register used to state the duration of an event (為期三天的會議 "a three-day conference"); always followed by a time span.

examples.chinese: 這場為期一週的展覽吸引了大批民眾參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng wéiqī yì zhōu de zhǎnlǎn xīyǐn le dàpī mínzhòng cānguān.
examples.english: This week-long exhibition attracted a large crowd of visitors.

examples.chinese: 公司舉辦為期三個月的員工訓練計畫。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jǔbàn wéiqī sān ge yuè de yuángōng xùnliàn jìhuà.
examples.english: The company is holding a three-month employee training program.

semanticNote: Formal register — to go against principles, promises, laws, or conscience (違背良心, 違背承諾); more solemn than 違反.

components.meaning: turn one's back on; go against

examples.chinese: 他不願違背自己的良心說謊。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuàn wéibèi zìjǐ de liángxīn shuōhuǎng.
examples.english: He is unwilling to go against his conscience and lie.

examples.chinese: 這項規定明顯違背了憲法保障的人權。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng míngxiǎn wéibèi le xiànfǎ bǎozhàng de rénquán.
examples.english: This regulation clearly violates the human rights guaranteed by the constitution.

english: only; just (i.e. it is only that ...); alone
semanticNote: Singles out one exception among a group (大家都到了,唯獨他還沒來 "everyone's arrived, only he hasn't"); formal-leaning but used in speech too.

examples.chinese: 全班都及格了,唯獨他一個人被當掉。
examples.pinyin: Quán bān dōu jígé le, wéidú tā yí ge rén bèi dàngdiào.
examples.english: The whole class passed, only he alone failed.

examples.chinese: 我什麼水果都喜歡,唯獨不敢吃榴槤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shénme shuǐguǒ dōu xǐhuān, wéidú bùgǎn chī liúlián.
examples.english: I like every kind of fruit, except I don't dare eat durian.

semanticNote: Neutral, very common verb for keeping something (order, relationship, balance, standard of living) in its current state without letting it decline.

examples.chinese: 警方在現場維持秩序。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài xiànchǎng wéichí zhìxù.
examples.english: The police maintained order at the scene.

examples.chinese: 他們努力維持婚姻關係的和諧。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen nǔlì wéichí hūnyīn guānxì de héxié.
examples.english: They work hard to maintain harmony in their marriage.

semanticNote: Stronger than 維持 — actively protecting something valuable from threat or damage (維護權益, 維護和平, 系統維護 "system maintenance").

examples.chinese: 這項法律旨在維護消費者的權益。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fǎlǜ zhǐ zài wéihù xiāofèizhě de quányì.
examples.english: This law is intended to protect consumers' rights.

examples.chinese: 網站將於今晚進行系統維護。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn jiāng yú jīn wǎn jìnxíng xìtǒng wéihù.
examples.english: The website will undergo system maintenance tonight.

semanticNote: Standard scientific/everyday term for vitamins; in Taiwan, 維他命 is at least as common in casual and commercial speech, especially on supplement packaging.

examples.chinese: 多吃蔬果可以補充維生素C。
examples.pinyin: Duō chī shūguǒ kěyǐ bǔchōng wéishēngsù C.
examples.english: Eating more fruits and vegetables can supplement vitamin C.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議他每天服用維生素D。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān fúyòng wéishēngsù D.
examples.english: The doctor recommended he take vitamin D daily.

semanticNote: Legal/formal register for forging documents, signatures, currency, or evidence — a criminal offense (偽造文書罪) under Taiwan law.

examples.chinese: 他因偽造他人簽名而被依偽造文書罪起訴。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīn wěizào tārén qiānmíng ér bèi yī wěizào wénshū zuì qǐsù.
examples.english: He was prosecuted for forgery of documents after forging someone else's signature.

examples.chinese: 警方查獲一批偽造的名牌皮包。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng chá huò yì pī wěizào de míngpái píbāo.
