examples.chinese: 自主駕駛技術近年來發展迅速。
examples.pinyin: Zìzhǔ jiàshǐ jìshù jìnnián lái fāzhǎn xùnsù.
examples.english: Autonomous driving technology has developed rapidly in recent years.

semanticNote: 'Religion' — the standard, general term for organized religious belief systems (宗教信仰, religious faith; 宗教自由, freedom of religion). Fundamental civics and cultural vocabulary, especially relevant given Taiwan's rich religious diversity (佛教, 道教, 基督教, 民間信仰).

examples.chinese: 台灣是一個宗教信仰多元的社會。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yí ge zōngjiào xìnyǎng duōyuán de shèhuì.
examples.english: Taiwan is a society with diverse religious beliefs.

examples.chinese: 憲法保障每個人擁有宗教自由的權利。
examples.pinyin: Xiànfǎ bǎozhàng měi ge rén yōngyǒu zōngjiào zìyóu de quánlì.
examples.english: The constitution guarantees everyone the right to freedom of religion.

semanticNote: 'Purpose; mission; founding aim' — refers to the core guiding purpose or mission behind an organization or endeavor (成立宗旨, founding purpose/mission statement; 服務宗旨, service mission). Formal vocabulary common in describing the core mission of nonprofits, companies, and institutions, often appearing in official mission statements.

examples.chinese: 這個基金會的宗旨是幫助弱勢家庭改善生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jījīnhuì de zōngzhǐ shì bāngzhù ruòshì jiātíng gǎishàn shēnghuó.
examples.english: This foundation's mission is to help disadvantaged families improve their lives.

examples.chinese: 公司的經營宗旨始終是提供優質的顧客服務。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de jīngyíng zōngzhǐ shǐzhōng shì tígōng yōuzhì de gùkè fúwù.
examples.english: The company's guiding business mission has always been to provide high-quality customer service.

semanticNote: 'Brown (color)' — the standard everyday term for the color brown (棕色頭髮, brown hair; 棕熊, brown bear). Basic descriptive vocabulary, standard across all contexts describing brown-colored objects, hair, or animals.

examples.chinese: 她染了一頭時髦的棕色頭髮。
examples.pinyin: Tā rǎnle yì tóu shímáo de zōngsè tóufǎ.
examples.english: She dyed her hair a fashionable brown color.

examples.chinese: 動物園裡新來了一隻可愛的棕熊寶寶。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ xīn láile yì zhī kě'ài de zōngxióng bǎobǎo.
examples.english: The zoo recently got a cute new baby brown bear.

semanticNote: 'Tracks; traces; whereabouts (evidence of passage or presence)' — refers to signs indicating something or someone has been present or passed through (毫無蹤跡, no trace whatsoever; 追蹤蹤跡, track down someone's trail). Common in describing investigations, wildlife tracking, and mysteries where evidence of presence is being sought.

examples.chinese: 警方至今仍未找到失蹤者的任何蹤跡。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhìjīn réng wèi zhǎodào shīzōngzhě de rènhé zōngjì.
examples.english: Police have still not found any trace of the missing person to this day.

examples.chinese: 研究人員追蹤這隻候鳥遷徙的蹤跡。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán zhuīzōng zhè zhī hòuniǎo qiānxǐ de zōngjì.
examples.english: Researchers tracked the migratory trail of this migratory bird.

semanticNote: 'In short; in summary; to sum up' — a formal connective phrase used to introduce a concluding summary after a discussion of multiple points (總而言之,這個計畫值得推行, in short, this plan is worth implementing). Common in formal writing and speeches to transition into a final, condensed conclusion after presenting detailed information.

examples.chinese: 總而言之,這次的活動辦得相當成功。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngéryánzhī, zhè cì de huódòng bàn de xiāngdāng chénggōng.
examples.english: In short, this event was quite successfully organized.

examples.chinese: 總而言之,只要大家團結合作,一定能克服困難。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngéryánzhī, zhǐyào dàjiā tuánjié hézuò, yídìng néng kèfú kùnnán.
examples.english: In summary, as long as everyone unites and cooperates, we will definitely be able to overcome the difficulties.

semanticNote: 'Sum; total (of combined amounts or factors)' — used for the aggregate result of adding multiple quantities or factors together, common in mathematics and statistics (數字的總和, the sum of the numbers) as well as figuratively for a combined total impact (努力的總和, the sum total of one's efforts). Standard vocabulary for describing cumulative totals in both quantitative and abstract contexts.

examples.chinese: 這三筆款項的總和超過十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè sān bǐ kuǎnxiàng de zǒnghé chāoguò shíwàn yuán.
examples.english: The sum of these three amounts exceeds one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: 成功並非單一因素,而是長期努力的總和。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng bìngfēi dānyī yīnsù, ér shì chángqí nǔlì de zǒnghé.
examples.english: Success isn't a single factor, but the sum total of long-term effort.

english: able to move unhindered; length and breadth
semanticNote: 'Crisscrossing; in every direction; to move unhindered (across a wide area)' — describes something extending or moving freely across a vast area in all directions, whether physical (道路縱橫交錯, roads crisscrossing in every direction) or figurative (縱橫商場, dominate/move freely across the business world). Common in describing complex networks (roads, rivers) and, figuratively, someone's wide-ranging dominance or freedom of movement in a field.

examples.chinese: 這座城市的道路縱橫交錯,初來乍到容易迷路。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de dàolù zònghéng jiāocuò, chūlái zhàdào róngyì mílù.
examples.english: This city's roads crisscross in every direction, making it easy for newcomers to get lost.

examples.chinese: 他縱橫商場多年,累積了豐富的人脈與經驗。
examples.pinyin: Tā zònghéng shāngchǎng duōnián, lěijīle fēngfù de rénmài yǔ jīngyàn.
examples.english: He has moved freely across the business world for many years, accumulating rich connections and experience.

semanticNote: 'Corridor; hallway' — standard architectural vocabulary for an indoor passageway connecting rooms (學校走廊, school hallway; 醫院走廊, hospital corridor). Common everyday vocabulary for describing indoor building layout, also used figuratively for geopolitical/geographic 'corridors' (交通走廊, transportation corridor).

examples.chinese: 下課鐘聲一響,學生們紛紛湧入走廊。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, xuéshēngmen fēnfēn yǒngrù zǒuláng.
examples.english: As soon as the class-end bell rang, students poured into the hallway.

examples.chinese: 家屬焦急地在醫院走廊上等待手術結果。
examples.pinyin: Jiāshǔ jiāojí de zài yīyuàn zǒuláng shàng děngdài shǒushù jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The family members anxiously waited in the hospital corridor for the surgery results.

semanticNote: 'To leak (information); to let slip (accidentally reveal)' — describes confidential information unintentionally becoming known to unauthorized people, common in discussions of secrets, plans, or classified matters being exposed prematurely (走漏消息, leak news/information). Similar to 洩露/泄露 (leak information), often used specifically for information escaping before it was meant to be revealed.

examples.chinese: 計畫尚未正式公布,消息卻已提前走漏。
examples.pinyin: Jìhuà shàngwèi zhèngshì gōngbù, xiāoxi què yǐ tíqián zǒulòu.
examples.english: The plan hadn't been officially announced yet, but the news had already leaked out prematurely.

examples.chinese: 警方懷疑內部有人走漏了搜查行動的消息。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng huáiyí nèibù yǒu rén zǒulòule sōuchá xíngdòng de xiāoxi.
examples.english: Police suspect someone inside leaked information about the search operation.

semanticNote: 'To smuggle (illegal goods across a border)' — the standard legal term for illegally transporting goods to avoid customs duties or bans (走私毒品, smuggle drugs; 走私集團, smuggling ring). Common in news about customs enforcement, organized crime, and border security in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 海關人員成功查獲一批走私毒品。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiguān rényuán chénggōng cháhuò yì pī zǒusī dúpǐn.
examples.english: Customs officials successfully seized a shipment of smuggled drugs.

examples.chinese: 這個犯罪集團長期從事野生動物走私。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fànzuì jítuán chángqí cóngshì yěshēng dòngwù zǒusī.
examples.english: This criminal organization has long been engaged in wildlife smuggling.

semanticNote: 'To beat; to hit; to give someone a beating (informal/colloquial)' — a casual, physical verb for hitting or beating someone, common in everyday speech about fights or punishment (被揍了一頓, got beaten up). More colloquial and blunt than the formal 毆打 (assault/beat, legal/formal term) — 揍 is the everyday spoken word for physical fighting or punishment.

examples.chinese: 他因為說謊,被爸爸狠狠揍了一頓。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shuōhuǎng, bèi bàba hěnhěn zòule yí dùn.
examples.english: He got a severe beating from his dad for lying.

examples.chinese: 兩個小男孩因為搶玩具而打了起來,互相揍對方。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge xiǎo nánhái yīnwèi qiǎng wánjù ér dǎle qǐlái, hùxiāng zòu duìfāng.
examples.english: The two little boys got into a fight over a toy, hitting each other.

semanticNote: 指以付費方式取得物品或不動產的使用權，或提供這種使用權，涵蓋「租」與「賃」兩個同義語素，語體較正式，常見於合約、法律或商業文件，例如房屋租賃、車輛租賃、設備租賃。口語中談日常租房多半直接說「租」，但「租賃」在正式書面語與商業情境中更精確、更常見，尤其在台灣的租賃契約、租賃業（如租車公司）名稱裡幾乎固定使用這個詞。

examples.chinese: 他們決定租賃一間辦公室，而不是自己購買。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng zūlìn yì jiān bàngōngshì, ér búshì zìjǐ gòumǎi.
examples.english: They decided to lease an office instead of buying one themselves.

examples.chinese: 這份租賃合約的期限是兩年，到期可以續約。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn zūlìn héyuē de qíxiàn shì liǎng nián, dàoqí kěyǐ xùyuē.
examples.english: This lease contract has a two-year term, and it can be renewed upon expiration.

english: sufficient to ...; so much so that; sufficiently
semanticNote: 表示程度或數量已經達到能夠產生某種結果或效果的地步，後面接動詞或分句，語體偏書面、正式，常用於強調某個條件或事實所帶來的充分後果，例如「這些證據足以證明他的清白」。與「足夠」不同，「足以」不能單獨接名詞當謂語，必須帶動詞性成分，凸顯的是「達到某種結果的充分性」而非單純的數量足夠。

components.meaning: in order to; by means of

examples.chinese: 他所犯的錯誤已經足以讓公司蒙受重大損失。
examples.pinyin: Tā suǒ fàn de cuòwù yǐjīng zúyǐ ràng gōngsī méngshòu zhòngdà sǔnshī.
examples.english: The mistake he made was already enough to cause the company significant losses.

examples.chinese: 這些數據足以說明消費者對新產品的興趣正在上升。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù zúyǐ shuōmíng xiāofèizhě duì xīn chǎnpǐn de xìngqù zhèngzài shàngshēng.
examples.english: This data is sufficient to show that consumer interest in the new product is rising.

semanticNote: 指妨礙、阻擋某件事情的順利進行，可以當動詞（阻礙某事）也可以當名詞（成為一種阻礙），語體正式，常用於描述抽象的發展、進步、溝通或計畫受到干擾，例如「語言不通阻礙了雙方的合作」。與「阻擋」偏向具體的物理攔截不同，「阻礙」更強調對過程或發展造成的負面干擾，適用範圍較廣，涵蓋制度、觀念、環境等抽象因素。

examples.chinese: 官僚作風常常阻礙政策的有效執行。
examples.pinyin: Guānliáo zuòfēng chángcháng zǔ'ài zhèngcè de yǒuxiào zhíxíng.
examples.english: Bureaucratic practices often hinder the effective implementation of policies.

examples.chinese: 資金不足是這個計畫最大的阻礙。
examples.pinyin: Zījīn bùzú shì zhège jìhuà zuìdà de zǔ'ài.
examples.english: Insufficient funding is the biggest obstacle to this project.

semanticNote: 指用力量或行動去攔住、制止某人做某事，語體正式，動作性比「阻礙」更強，通常涉及具體的攔阻行為，例如攔住一個人不讓他離開，或阻止某項行動的進行。常帶有一種較直接、面對面的對抗意味，例如「警衛阻攔了闖入者」，強調的是「攔住不讓通過或不讓做」，而不是抽象的妨礙過程。

examples.chinese: 保全人員試圖阻攔示威群眾進入大樓。
examples.pinyin: Bǎoquán rényuán shìtú zǔlán shìwēi qúnzhòng jìnrù dàlóu.
examples.english: The security personnel tried to stop the protesters from entering the building.

examples.chinese: 父母無法阻攔他做出這個重大的決定。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ wúfǎ zǔlán tā zuòchū zhège zhòngdà de juédìng.
examples.english: His parents were unable to stop him from making this major decision.

english: thwart; to obstruct (something); stand in the way
semanticNote: 指故意設置障礙、暗中破壞或蓄意妨礙某件事順利進行，語體正式，帶有明顯的貶義，暗示行為者出於私心或惡意而刻意阻擋，常見於政治、法律或組織內部鬥爭的語境，例如「反對派阻撓法案的表決」。與「阻礙」相比，「阻撓」更強調「刻意、蓄意」的主觀動機，而不只是客觀上造成障礙。

examples.chinese: 少數議員蓄意阻撓這項改革法案的通過。
examples.pinyin: Shǎoshù yìyuán xùyì zǔnáo zhè xiàng gǎigé fǎ'àn de tōngguò.
examples.english: A small number of legislators deliberately obstructed the passage of this reform bill.

examples.chinese: 他懷疑有人在暗中阻撓調查的進行。
examples.pinyin: Tā huáiyí yǒurén zài ànzhōng zǔnáo diàochá de jìnxíng.
examples.english: He suspected that someone was secretly obstructing the investigation.

semanticNote: 指父親的父親，也就是爺爺，是較正式、書面的稱謂，常用於族譜、正式介紹或書面敘述中，例如「他的祖父曾經是這座城市的市長」。日常口語中，台灣人多半直接稱呼「阿公」或「爺爺」，「祖父」則更常出現在正式文件、傳記、族譜等書面語境，帶有一種莊重、正式的語感。

examples.chinese: 這棟老房子是他祖父留下來的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo fángzi shì tā zǔfù liú xiàlái de.
examples.english: This old house was left behind by his paternal grandfather.

examples.chinese: 她的祖父曾在戰爭期間經歷過許多艱難的歲月。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zǔfù céng zài zhànzhēng qíjiān jīnglìguò xǔduō jiānnán de suìyuè.
examples.english: Her grandfather went through many difficult years during the war.

semanticNote: 指自己祖先世代居住、自己所屬的國家，帶有濃厚的情感色彩與歸屬意識，語體正式，常用於表達愛國情懷、民族認同或歷史敘事，例如「他為祖國的發展貢獻了一生」。這個詞比中性的「國家」更強調血緣、歷史與情感上的連結，在演講、文學作品或愛國主題的文章中特別常見。

examples.chinese: 許多海外華僑始終心繫祖國的發展。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō hǎiwài huáqiáo shǐzhōng xīnxì zǔguó de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: Many overseas Chinese have always cared deeply about the development of their homeland.

examples.chinese: 他決定學成之後回到祖國貢獻所學。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng xuéchéng zhīhòu huídào zǔguó gòngxiàn suǒxué.
examples.english: He decided that after completing his studies, he would return to his homeland to contribute what he had learned.

semanticNote: 指一個家族或民族更早期的先輩，時間跨度通常比「祖父母」更久遠，可以追溯到好幾代之前甚至更早的歷史時期，語體正式、中性，常見於談論家族歷史、民族起源或考古、人類學話題，例如「這個部落的祖先可能來自更北方的地區」。強調的是「血緣或文化上的源頭」，而不是具體某一位長輩。

examples.chinese: 根據族譜記載，他們的祖先在清朝時期遷居到台灣。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zúpǔ jìzǎi, tāmen de zǔxiān zài Qīngcháo shíqí qiānjū dào Táiwān.
examples.english: According to the family genealogy, their ancestors moved to Taiwan during the Qing dynasty.

examples.chinese: 科學家利用基因分析追溯人類祖先的遷徙路線。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā lìyòng jīyīn fēnxī zhuīsù rénlèi zǔxiān de qiānxǐ lùxiàn.
examples.english: Scientists use genetic analysis to trace the migration routes of human ancestors.

semanticNote: 指深入、專注地研究某個學問或技術，通常帶有長期投入、鑽入細節、追求精通的意味，語體正式，常用於形容學者、專業人士或愛好者在某個領域下苦功，例如「他多年來鑽研古典音樂理論」。比一般的「研究」語氣更強調投入的深度與毅力，帶有一種埋頭苦讀、精益求精的正面評價。

examples.chinese: 他從小就對機械結構產生興趣，長大後專心鑽研工程技術。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù duì jīxiè jiégòu chǎnshēng xìngqù, zhǎngdà hòu zhuānxīn zuānyán gōngchéng jìshù.
examples.english: He became interested in mechanical structures from a young age, and as an adult he devoted himself to studying engineering.

examples.chinese: 她花了十年時間鑽研中醫的理論與臨床應用。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle shí nián shíjiān zuānyán zhōngyī de lǐlùn yǔ línchuáng yìngyòng.
examples.english: She spent ten years delving deeply into the theory and clinical application of traditional Chinese medicine.

semanticNote: 指經過切割、拋光的天然礦物寶石，也就是鑽石，語體中性，日常生活與商業廣告中都常用，例如婚戒、珠寶、鑽石礦等。在台灣，「鑽石」也常被引申用於形容珍貴、頂級的事物，例如「鑽石級會員」表示最高等級，這種比喻用法在商業行銷中相當普遍。

examples.chinese: 他花了半年的薪水買了一枚鑽石戒指向女友求婚。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle bànnián de xīnshuǐ mǎile yì méi zuànshí jièzhǐ xiàng nǚyǒu qiúhūn.
examples.english: He spent half a year's salary to buy a diamond ring to propose to his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 這家銀行的鑽石級會員享有專屬的理財顧問服務。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yínháng de zuànshí jí huìyuán xiǎngyǒu zhuānshǔ de lǐcái gùwèn fúwù.
examples.english: This bank's diamond-tier members enjoy exclusive financial advisory services.

semanticNote: 指人臉部口腔周圍上下兩片可以開合的柔軟肌肉組織，也就是嘴唇，語體中性、日常，可用於描述外貌、健康狀況或動作，例如「她的嘴唇因為天氣乾燥而龜裂」。這是一個非常基礎的身體部位詞彙，使用頻率高，沒有特別的語體限制，口語和書面都常用。

examples.chinese: 冬天氣候乾燥，她的嘴唇經常裂開。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān qìhòu gānzào, tā de zuǐchún jīngcháng lièkāi.
examples.english: In winter the climate is dry, so her lips often crack.

examples.chinese: 他緊閉著嘴唇，似乎在忍住不說出真相。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnbìzhe zuǐchún, sìhū zài rěnzhù bù shuōchū zhēnxiàng.
examples.english: He kept his lips tightly closed, as if holding back from revealing the truth.

semanticNote: 指觸犯法律、被判定或被認定犯罪的人，語體正式，常見於法律、新聞或司法相關語境，例如「警方逮捕了這名逃亡多年的罪犯」。與較口語的「壞人」不同，「罪犯」強調法律上的定性，通常需要經過司法程序的認定，帶有明確的法律意涵，而不只是道德上的評價。

examples.chinese: 這名罪犯在潛逃十年後終於被警方逮捕歸案。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng zuìfàn zài qiántáo shí nián hòu zhōngyú bèi jǐngfāng dàibǔ guī'àn.
examples.english: This criminal was finally arrested by the police after ten years on the run.

examples.chinese: 法官依法對這名罪犯做出了嚴厲的判決。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān yīfǎ duì zhè míng zuìfàn zuòchūle yánlì de pànjué.
examples.english: The judge, in accordance with the law, handed down a severe sentence against this criminal.

semanticNote: 指一個人或群體應該受到的尊重與自我價值感，強調不容侵犯的人格地位，語體正式，常用於人權、倫理或社會議題的討論，例如「每個人都應該有尊嚴地生活」。這個詞帶有較強的價值判斷色彩，通常出現在強調尊重、平等與人性尊嚴的嚴肅語境，而不是輕鬆的日常對話。

examples.chinese: 他寧可失去這份工作，也不願意犧牲自己的尊嚴。
examples.pinyin: Tā nìngkě shīqù zhè fèn gōngzuò, yě bú yuànyì xīshēng zìjǐ de zūnyán.
examples.english: He would rather lose this job than sacrifice his own dignity.

examples.chinese: 這項政策的目的是保障弱勢族群的基本尊嚴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de mùdì shì bǎozhàng ruòshì zúqún de jīběn zūnyán.
examples.english: The purpose of this policy is to protect the basic dignity of disadvantaged groups.

semanticNote: 指依照、按照既定的規則、原則或傳統去行動，語體正式、書面，常用於法律、制度、規範或原則的遵守，例如「所有員工都必須遵循公司的規章制度」。與較口語的「照著做」不同，「遵循」帶有一種尊重既有規範、不隨意更動的正式感，多用於正式文件、公告或嚴肅的敘述中。

examples.chinese: 這項實驗必須嚴格遵循既定的操作流程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng shíyàn bìxū yángé zūnxún jìdìng de cāozuò liúchéng.
examples.english: This experiment must strictly follow the established operating procedures.

examples.chinese: 他一向遵循誠信經營的原則來對待每一位客戶。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíxiàng zūnxún chéngxìn jīngyíng de yuánzé lái duìdài měi yí wèi kèhù.
examples.english: He has always followed the principle of honest business dealings when treating every customer.

semanticNote: 指用不正當的手段欺騙、矇混以取得不應得的利益，最常見於考試、比賽或選舉等需要公平競爭的場合，語體中性偏書面，但在日常談論考試時也很常用，例如「他因為考試作弊被記過處分」。這個詞帶有明確的負面評價，強調違反規則、破壞公平的行為，適用範圍不限於考試，也可延伸到選舉舞弊、體育賽事作弊等。

examples.chinese: 監考老師當場抓到兩名學生在考試中作弊。
examples.pinyin: Jiānkǎo lǎoshī dāngchǎng zhuādào liǎng míng xuéshēng zài kǎoshì zhōng zuòbì.
examples.english: The proctor caught two students cheating on the exam on the spot.

examples.chinese: 選舉委員會嚴查任何可能作弊的行為。
examples.pinyin: Xuǎnjǔ wěiyuánhuì yánchá rènhé kěnéng zuòbì de xíngwéi.
examples.english: The election committee strictly investigates any behavior that might involve fraud.

english: cancellation; delete; to nullify; to expire and thus lose validity
semanticNote: 指因為過期、失效或被宣告無效而不再具有法律或實際效力，語體正式、書面，常用於證件、票券、合約等失去效用的情況，例如「這張優惠券已經作廢，無法使用」。既可以是自然過期造成的作廢，也可以是人為宣布無效，強調的是「原本有效的東西現在不再有效」這個結果。

examples.chinese: 這張機票因為航班取消而作廢，必須重新購買。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng jīpiào yīnwèi hángbān qǔxiāo ér zuòfèi, bìxū chóngxīn gòumǎi.
examples.english: This plane ticket became invalid because the flight was canceled, so a new one had to be purchased.

examples.chinese: 銀行宣布舊版存摺將於明年全面作廢。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng xuānbù jiùbǎn cúnzhé jiāng yú míngnián quánmiàn zuòfèi.
examples.english: The bank announced that the old-version passbooks would be completely invalidated next year.

semanticNote: 指一個人或組織長期表現出來的行事態度、處事風格或工作方式，語體正式，常用於評價領導者、機構或團體的行為模式，例如「他做事的作風向來果斷俐落」。這個詞既可以是中性描述，也可以帶有褒貶色彩，取決於前面搭配的形容詞，例如「官僚作風」通常是負面評價，「務實作風」則是正面評價。

examples.chinese: 新任主管的作風強硬，要求團隊嚴格遵守時間表。
examples.pinyin: Xīnrèn zhǔguǎn de zuòfēng qiángyìng, yāoqiú tuánduì yángé zūnshǒu shíjiānbiǎo.
examples.english: The new supervisor has a tough style, requiring the team to strictly follow the schedule.

examples.chinese: 這家公司一向以踏實的作風贏得客戶的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yíxiàng yǐ tàshí de zuòfēng yíngdé kèhù de xìnrèn.
examples.english: This company has always earned customers' trust with its down-to-earth style.

semanticNote: 指工作與休息的規律安排，涵蓋一個人日常活動的時間分配，例如幾點起床、幾點上班、幾點睡覺，語體中性，常用於談論生活習慣、健康或校園、公司規範，例如「規律的作息有助於身體健康」。常見搭配是「作息時間」或「作息表」，指具體排定的時間表。

examples.chinese: 醫生建議他調整作息，盡量在晚上十一點前入睡。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā tiáozhěng zuòxī, jǐnliàng zài wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn qián rùshuì.
examples.english: The doctor suggested he adjust his daily schedule and try to go to sleep before eleven at night.

examples.chinese: 住宿學生必須遵守宿舍規定的作息時間。
examples.pinyin: Zhùsù xuéshēng bìxū zūnshǒu sùshè guīdìng de zuòxī shíjiān.
examples.english: Boarding students must follow the schedule set by the dormitory rules.

semanticNote: 指一個人用來提醒、勉勵自己的簡短格言或警句，通常放在座位旁邊或隨身攜帶以時時自我提醒，語體中性偏書面，常用於談論人生哲學、學習態度或個人信念，例如「『天道酬勤』是他多年來的座右銘」。這是一個帶有文化色彩的固定用法，常見於自我介紹、勵志文章或訪談中。

examples.chinese: 「不放棄就有希望」是她從小奉行的座右銘。
examples.pinyin: "Bú fàngqì jiù yǒu xīwàng" shì tā cóngxiǎo fèngxíng de zuòyòumíng.
examples.english: "As long as you don't give up, there's hope" has been her motto since childhood.

examples.chinese: 他把這句座右銘刻在書桌前，時時提醒自己努力向上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè jù zuòyòumíng kè zài shūzhuō qián, shíshí tíxǐng zìjǐ nǔlì xiàngshàng.
examples.english: He engraved this motto in front of his desk to constantly remind himself to strive upward.

english: decide; take the responsibility for a decision
semanticNote: 指對某件事情擁有決定權，能夠自己做出最終的判斷或決定，語體中性偏口語，常用於談論家庭、婚姻、公司事務中誰有權做決定，例如「這件事由你來做主」。也常出現在被動語境中，表示需要有人出面替自己主持公道或做決定，例如「請你幫我做主」帶有請求對方主持公道、給予支持的含意。

examples.chinese: 這件婚事最終還是由父母做主決定的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn hūnshì zuìzhōng háishì yóu fùmǔ zuòzhǔ juédìng de.
examples.english: This marriage matter was ultimately decided by the parents.

examples.chinese: 遇到不合理的對待，你要學會為自己做主。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào bù hélǐ de duìdài, nǐ yào xuéhuì wèi zìjǐ zuòzhǔ.
examples.english: When faced with unfair treatment, you need to learn to stand up for yourself.
